**Description of your solution**

Arogya AI is an Agentic AI copilot that predicts patient surges and autonomously prepares hospitals through data-driven staffing, supply planning, and patient advisories.

During India’s major festivals, pollution peaks, or seasonal epidemics, hospitals often face sudden spikes in patient load. The result overcrowding, staff burnout, and resource shortages. Most hospitals today operate reactively, relying on human intuition and static dashboards. Arogya AI changes this by enabling proactive, autonomous hospital management.

How Arogya AI Works

Data Fusion Layer
Arogya AI integrates multiple data sources hospital EMR logs, admissions history, pollution indices, weather forecasts, festival/event calendars, and local outbreak data. It creates a unified temporal dataset of patient trends and operational parameters.

Predictive Intelligence Engine
The core AI uses a hybrid model combining Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT) for time-series forecasting, XGBoost for structured data trends, and Reinforcement Learning to continuously improve accuracy after each event.
The engine predicts patient inflow by department (e.g., respiratory, emergency, pediatrics), days in advance, with probabilistic confidence intervals.

Agentic Decision Layer
Built using LangGraph and CrewAI, Arogya AI deploys specialized agents that work together autonomously:

1. Monitor Agent: Tracks live data streams for anomalies.
2. Planning Agent: Runs optimization models to allocate staff and supplies.
3. Advisory Agent: Drafts hospital-wide or public advisories.
4. Coordinator Agent: Evaluates “what-if” scenarios (e.g.. 20% staff shortage, high AQI spike) and finalizes the best operational strategy.
These agents share memory and coordinate actions functioning like a digital operations team for hospitals.

Human-in-the-Loop Interface
A web dashboard presents the forecast, reasoning, and recommended actions.
Hospital administrators can approve or override AI suggestions (e.g., call in more staff, reorder oxygen cylinders, activate teleconsultations).
Once approved, Arogya AI auto-generates task alerts for departments and vendor notifications closing the loop from prediction to execution.

Why It’s Unique
Unlike traditional dashboards, Arogya AI is agentic, not analytic.
It learns, reasons, and acts autonomously to manage hospital operations before crises occur. The system performs end-to-end surge management predicting, planning, simulating, and executing actions.

This design makes Arogya AI the first “self-preparing hospital” system for Indian healthcare, built specifically for local festival, pollution, and epidemic patterns.

Real-World Impact
40% faster operational readiness before surges.
30% reduction in medicine or supply shortages.
Significant reduction in ER waiting times and staff fatigue.
Scalable from single hospitals to district-wide health networks.
Integrates seamlessly with NDHM and state health APIs for government readiness programs.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Because we uses Agentic AI to transform hospital preparedness from reactive to proactive. Our system continuously analyzes live and historical data including hospital records, pollution indices, weather patterns, and local festival/event calendars to forecast potential surges days in advance.

Once a surge is predicted, Arogya AI’s autonomous agents take over:

The Staffing Agent recommends optimized shift rotations and backup scheduling.

The Supply Agent calculates required oxygen, medicines, and beds, and alerts vendors.

The Advisory Agent crafts preventive patient messages and triage guidance to reduce unnecessary visits.

The Planner Agent runs simulations (e.g., “What if AQI spikes to 400 tomorrow?”) and recommends best response strategies.

All these agents collaborate through a shared reasoning layer, ensuring that hospitals receive not just predictions but ready-to-implement action plans.

> India’s Personal Health Companion

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dialogflow](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dialogflow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
Medical care accessibility is one of the biggest challenges globally, particularly in developing areas.
Millions of people — especially in poverty-stricken or rural communities — do not have access to timely and credible medical advice.
Language difficulties, lack of education, and the shortage of skilled healthcare workers make the situation even worse.
A village patient who speaks a regional dialect, an elderly person living alone, or someone unable to read medical terms often cannot explain symptoms clearly or understand treatment recommendations.
According to the World Health Organization, more than 60% of preventable deaths in low-resource areas occur due to delayed healthcare access or miscommunication with medical professionals.

**Existing Gaps**

- **Language and Literacy Barriers:**
Most health applications and chatbots only support English or a few major languages.

- **Lack of Voice Interaction:**
Current healthcare bots depend on text; voice support is rare, and multilingual comprehension is even rarer.

- **Absence of Real-Time Emergency Detection:**
Existing systems cannot recognize emergencies or provide immediate guidance.

- **Limited Personalization:**
Few tools personalize responses to the user’s health data, emotions, or medical history.

- **No Integrated Wellness Support:**
Physical health, mental health, and wellness tracking often exist in separate systems.

The world needs an empathetic, multilingual, AI-powered health companion that listens, speaks, and cares like a real doctor.

**Proposed Solution — PRANAYA**
PRANAYA is an agentic, multilingual, text- and voice-enabled AI health assistant designed to make healthcare accessible to everyone, regardless of language, literacy, or location.
It combines AI reasoning, speech recognition, language translation, emergency detection, and wellness tracking into one intelligent chatbot.
PRANAYA listens, understands, and responds in the user’s native language ... offering medical advice, first aid, emotional support, and wellness management through a single interface.

**Core Features**

- **End-to-End Multilingual Voice AI:**
Understands and replies in any language or dialect using Whisper, LangDetect, Google Translate, and gTTS.

- **Agentic Medical Reasoning:**
Detects possible diseases, provides accurate information, and offers precautions, treatments, and vaccination suggestions using CrewAI .

- **Emergency Detection and Real-Time Triage:**
Identifies life-threatening conditions, alerts the user to call emergency services (108).

- **Personal Wellness Tracker:**
Tracks hydration, menstrual cycles, vaccination schedules, and more ... featuring visual charts 

- **First Aid Knowledge and Myth Busting:**
Offers verified, step-by-step first aid guidance and debunks common health myths.

- **Virtual Psychiatrist and Emotional Support:**
Provides empathetic listening, mindfulness exercises, and stress or anxiety management support.

- **Personalized Trackers:**
Encourages habits like hydration, medication adherence, and timely vaccinations through context-awareness.

**Impact / Use Cases**

- **Rural Communities:**
Provides non-English speakers with direct access to reliable healthcare advice.

- **Elderly Users:**
Voice-based interaction removes the need for reading or typing.

- **Students and Young Adults:**
Sends personalized reminders for vaccines, hydration, and mental health.

- **Doctors and Caregivers:**
Assists in patient triage and medical data collection.

**Real Impact:**
PRANAYA shifts healthcare from being text-based and exclusive to being voice-driven, inclusive, and compassionate — empowering millions to take control of their health confidently.

**Future Vision**
PRANAYA aims to become a complete digital healthcare ecosystem, blending AI, empathy, and innovation for smarter, personalized care.

**Future features include:**
 
- Audio refinement with dialect matching for regional inclusivity.
-  Image analysis for medical reports and X-rays.
-  Vital tracking for blood, pressure, and sugar levels.
-  Health record database for lifetime report storage.
- Context-based chat for continuous care.
-  Smart reminders for vaccines and medications.
-  "Connect" feature to securely share reports with loved ones.

**Upcoming collaborations:**

-  With hospitals for vaccine availability updates.
-  With doctors and hospitals for appointments and emergency check-ups.

PRANAYA envisions a future where every person, in every language, can access intelligent, compassionate healthcare — anytime, anywhere

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**PRANAYA** is a **next-generation multilingual health chatbot** that perfectly aligns with the **Healthcare track** because it directly addresses three critical challenges in the modern healthcare ecosystem — accessibility, accuracy, and personalization — through agentic AI reasoning, multilingual voice communication, and real-time web-sourced medical intelligence.

Unlike traditional health chatbots that depend on static databases or preprogrammed responses, PRANAYA uses an **Agentic Orchestration Model** powered by **CrewAI and Ollama.**
This allows PRANAYA to actively coordinate several specialized AI agents — each focused on areas such as **disease detection, first aid guidance, symptom interpretation, or emotional support** — and reason collaboratively to deliver precise, context-aware medical advice.

**Core Technological Strengths**
 
- **CrewAI + Ollama Orchestration:**

Integrates multiple domain-specific AI agents in real time to enable parallel medical reasoning and adaptive decision-making.

 - **SerperDev Integration:**

Empowers PRANAYA to conduct live medical web searches for the latest research findings, WHO guidelines, and verified symptom data — ensuring advice that is current and evidence-based.

 - **Whisper + LangDetect + Google Translate + gTTS**:

Supports full multilingual voice communication — converting speech to text, detecting language, translating, and responding naturally in the same language or dialect.

- **Emergency Triage System:**

Leverages real-time symptom pattern recognition to detect emergencies (such as chest pain or breathing difficulty), issue visual and sound alerts, and show nearby hospitals through the Google Maps API.

- **Personal Wellness Trackers:**

PRANAYA currently includes tools for tracking:

- Water intake (visualized through pie charts)

- Menstrual cycles

- Vaccination logs (with manual vaccine entry options)

 **AI Emotional Support and Myth-Busting:**

Functions as a virtual psychiatrist by offering emotional guidance and debunking medical myths using verified information and adaptive natural language tone matching.

**Future Roadmap**
In its next phase, PRANAYA aims to evolve into a full personal health management ecosystem featuring:

 * A smart notification system for medication, hydration, and vaccination reminders.
 * A comprehensive health history database for long-term monitoring of vitals, lab reports, and chronic conditions.
 * Image processing for X-rays and blood reports, with simple AI-driven explanations.
 * A secure “Connect” feature allowing loved ones or caregivers to access shared health summaries safely.
* Collaboration with hospitals for real-time vaccine availability and updates.
* Integration with hospitals and doctors for appointments and emergency check-ups directly through PRANAYA


**Pioneering the Next Generation of Healthcare**
PRANAYA redefines healthcare delivery by combining AI reasoning, live data retrieval, and multilingual accessibility — bringing reliable, real-time medical assistance to users in any language.

Through the integration of CrewAI’s orchestration, Ollama’s local intelligence, and SerperDev’s live medical search capabilities, PRANAYA establishes a new benchmark for preventive and digital healthcare — intelligent, inclusive, and ever-evolving.

It does more than automate medical responses — it enhances and complements human healthcare, helping millions overcome barriers of language, literacy, and geography.

That is exactly what the Healthcare track represents: leveraging technology to make healthcare more accessible, informed, and human-centered.

> Smart AI for Predictive Hospital Management

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

MedPredict is an AI-driven predictive hospital management system that helps healthcare centers in India proactively prepare for sudden patient surges during festivals (Diwali, Holi, Ganesh Chaturthi), pollution spikes and epidemic outbreaks.

The system collects and analyzes real-time and historical data including weather, pollution levels, disease trends, mobility patterns and festival calendars to predict upcoming spikes in hospital visits. Using this insight, it automatically recommends:

-  Optimal staffing levels (doctors, nurses, emergency staff)
-  Inventory and supply planning (oxygen, beds, medicines, PPE)
-  Patient advisories and alerts (via SMS/WhatsApp/web dashboard)

MedPredict functions as an agentic AI assistant that not only forecasts demand but also takes autonomous actions, such as sending early alerts, updating dashboards and generating resource schedules.

By leveraging predictive analytics, healthcare centers can reduce overcrowding, waiting times and resource shortages, improving overall patient care during high-stress periods.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

MedPredict directly addresses the Healthtech track by tackling one of India’s most pressing healthcare challenges unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution seasons and epidemic outbreaks.

Our solution integrates real-time environmental, social and health data (from APIs like OpenWeather, AQICN, and health portals) with predictive AI models (RandomForest, Prophet) to forecast hospital occupancy and supply demands.

The system acts as an autonomous AI agent that:-

- Continuously analyzes multi-source data
- Predicts surge probabilities in different regions
- Generates actionable insights for staffing, inventory planning and public advisories
- Alerts hospital admins in advance via a clean web dashboard

By enabling hospitals to prepare proactively instead of reactively, MedPredict reduces overcrowding, ensures better patient outcomes and enhances the resilience of healthcare systems.

**Description of your solution**

## **Problem Solution: AutisMind AI**

### **The Innovation**
EarlyDetect AI addresses the critical gap in early autism screening by providing an accessible, AI-powered assessment tool that enables parents to conduct preliminary risk evaluations for toddlers aged 18-36 months from the comfort of their homes.

### **How It Works**
Our solution leverages advanced AI analysis to observe and interpret key behavioral markers through a simple 15-20 minute assessment:

**Multi-Modal AI Analysis:**
- **Video Analysis**: Tracks gaze patterns, facial expressions, and behavioral responses during structured interactions
- **Audio Processing**: Analyzes vocalization patterns, response timing, and communication attempts
- **Behavioral Scoring**: Evaluates social engagement, attention shifts, and play patterns

**Three-Stage Assessment Process:**
1. **Name Response** - Measures social attention and response to vocal cues
2. **Toy Interaction** - Observes play patterns, object engagement, and focus
3. **Free Play** - Captures natural behavior during unstructured activities

### **Key Differentiators**
- **Early Intervention Focus**: Targets the critical 18-36 month window when early signs emerge
- **Accessibility**: Eliminates geographical and financial barriers to initial screening
- **Privacy-First Approach**: All processing occurs locally in the browser; no data stored without explicit consent
- **Non-Invasive**: Uses natural play-based interactions rather than clinical settings
- **Immediate Insights**: Provides comprehensive analysis with recommendations within minutes

### **Impact & Value Proposition**
- **For Parents**: Empowers with early awareness and reduces anxiety through accessible screening
- **For Healthcare Systems**: Reduces burden on specialists by filtering cases needing urgent attention
- **For Children**: Enables earlier intervention, significantly improving long-term developmental outcomes

### **Important Disclaimer**
EarlyDetect AI serves as a **screening tool, not a diagnostic instrument**. It provides risk assessment and recommendations for professional evaluation, ensuring parents have the information needed to seek timely medical guidance while maintaining appropriate boundaries for AI-assisted healthcare tools.

**This solution bridges the critical gap between first parental concerns and professional diagnosis, ensuring no child misses their early intervention window due to accessibility barriers.**

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

🏥 Problem Statement — Early Autism Risk Detection for Toddlers (<3 years)
🧠 Track: Healthcare

Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior. Early signs can appear before the age of 3, yet in India, most diagnoses occur between **4 and 5 years** of age, often after **critical developmental** windows have passed.

This delay is not due to a lack of symptoms, but due to a **lack of early detection**. Many parents and caregivers are unaware of subtle early indicators — such as poor eye contact, limited response to name, or repetitive behaviors. These signs are often overlooked or dismissed as **“late blooming,”** causing crucial time to be lost when early intervention could have made the greatest impact.

Compounding this problem is India’s severe shortage of developmental pediatricians and autism specialists. In many rural and semi-urban regions, early screening is practically unavailable. Children from such areas often reach clinics only after symptoms have intensified, leading to more **complex therapy** needs and **higher treatment costs.**

Even in urban settings, formal diagnosis is often expensive, time-consuming, and **difficult to access**, creating a major gap between the onset of early signs and the start of professional support. This delay can **significantly affect** a child’s language development, cognitive growth, emotional regulation, and overall quality of life.

Globally, **research** shows that intervention before age 3 can **dramatically improve** outcomes — but without timely screening tools and accessible early assessments, thousands of children in India **miss this window** every year.

This challenge is not just medical — it is a public health issue, a societal gap, and an **accessibility problem** that affects families, schools, and healthcare systems alike. Addressing this gap requires making early detection more **accessible, faster, and less dependent on specialist availability**, ensuring that no child loses their early chance to thrive.

> Your AI-powered follow-up nurse in your pocket

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

In India, millions of chronic patients **(diabetes, hypertension, thyroid, etc.)** struggle to manage their treatment because they often skip medications, forget diet restrictions, or miss follow-up visits. Doctors provide prescriptions during consultations, but there is no **personalized system** to ensure consistent care once patients leave the clinic. Existing hospital apps are **static, generic**, and fail to offer tailored support.
HealthMate AI is a software-only **digital health companion** that bridges this gap by acting as a **virtual follow-up nurse**. It integrates with hospital EMR systems and patient prescriptions, then uses AI to generate personalized reminders, dietary guidance, follow-up schedules, and health education. Beyond simple notifications, the system actively tracks patient adherence, detects risk patterns, and notifies doctors if intervention is required.
By providing continuous, AI-driven care management, HealthMate AI helps reduce hospital readmissions, improves patient compliance, and ensures proactive chronic disease management.

**Key Highlights**

**Problem Context** – Chronic disease patients often fail to stick to prescribed medication schedules, diet plans, and follow-up visits, leading to deteriorating health and increased hospital burden.
**Target Users** – Patients with chronic illnesses (diabetes, BP, thyroid, asthma, etc.), their caregivers, and doctors who need real-time adherence insights.
**Core Solution** – A personalized, AI-powered post-consultation care platform that reminds, educates, and monitors patients like a digital nurse.
**Data Sources** – Patient EMR data, prescriptions, hospital databases, wearable/smartphone health logs, and lifestyle inputs (diet/exercise patterns).

**Key Features**

- PersonalizedReminders – Smart scheduling of medication, diet, and check-ups tailored to each patient. 

- Follow-up Tracking – Alerts doctors about missed visits or deteriorating adherence. 

- Diet & Lifestyle Guidance – Customized advice aligned with the patient’s condition. 

- RiskcDetection Alerts – AI flags early warning signs (e.g., irregular glucose levels). 

- Doctor-Patient Feedback Loop – Secure communication channel for timely doctor intervention. 

- Gamification for Patients – Reward points, streaks, and leaderboards to keep patients engaged.

**Technology**

The solution is built with a modern web stack, where the frontend uses **HTML**, **React**, **Tailwind CSS**, and **JavaScript** to deliver a clean, user-friendly interface. The backend is powered by **Node.js** and **Python** **(Flask/FastAPI)** for scalable **API** handling. A **MongoDB** database securely stores patient records, prescriptions, and adherence logs. The **AI/ML** layer includes patient adherence prediction models and risk scoring algorithms that personalize care and flag potential health risks. For seamless hospital integration and easy scaling, the system is containerized using **Docker**.

**Impact**

HealthMate AI significantly improves healthcare outcomes by increasing medication adherence and diet compliance, which directly lowers the chances of missed treatments. This leads to fewer hospital readmissions and emergency cases, ensuring that resources are better utilized. The platform strengthens doctor-patient engagement beyond clinic walls, providing continuous care instead of one-time consultations. In the long term, it contributes to a reduction in chronic disease complications, creating a healthier patient population and reducing the overall burden on the healthcare system.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

HealthMate Al perfectly fits the **Healthtech** track by addressing one of India's biggest gaps — the lack of **personalized post-consultation** care for chronic patients. While hospitals focus on in-clinic treatment, patients **often fail to follow through once they leave**, leading to worsening conditions and avoidable readmissions.

By using Al-powered digital agents, HealthMate Al:
•Automates medication, diet, and lifestyle reminders specific to each patient.
•Predicts adherence risks and flags them early to doctors.
• Integrates with **hospital EMR systems**, turning them from static record-keepers into active care managers.
•Acts as a **virtual nurse**, extending the hospital's care ecosystem directly into the patient's pocket.

This makes healthcare continuous, proactive, and personalized, aligning directly with the Healthtech goal of using Al to close critical gaps in patient care and outcomes.

**Description of your solution**

Most financial tools focus only on numbers, but people spend emotionally not logically. FinAura is an agentic AI financial coach that understands both your finances and your feelings. It continuously learns from users’ spending patterns, transaction history, and tone in text inputs to map their financial mood.

When FinAura detects signs of emotional or impulsive spending like stress shopping or weekend overspending it proactively offers empathetic, personalized advice. Over time, it builds a unique **“Financial Aura Profile” **that visualizes how emotions impact money decisions.

Powered by LangChain, GPT, and emotion recognition models from HuggingFace, FinAura blends AI analytics with emotional intelligence to promote financial mindfulness. The system’s autonomous agent monitors, predicts, and intervenes to improve savings discipline and reduce stress-driven spending.

By merging psychology, behavioral insights, and AI, FinAura helps users not just manage money but understand themselves better.

**Fintech: Build an autonomous financial coaching agent that adapts to real user behavior, spending patterns, and income variability - helping gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens make smarter financial decisions proactively.**

FinAura perfectly aligns with the Fintech track by acting as an **autonomous financial coaching agent** that continuously monitors users’ financial activity and proactively detects emotional or impulsive spending, offering personalized advice without user prompts. It **adapts to real user behavior** by learning from individual spending patterns, transaction histories, and emotional cues from text input, ensuring recommendations are tailored to actual financial behavior rather than generic advice—especially valuable for gig workers and informal sector employees with fluctuating income. By **handling spending patterns and income variability**, FinAura analyzes irregular cash flow, correlates it with spending moods, warns against overspending during high-income periods, and encourages saving during low-income periods, making it practical for real-world financial unpredictability. Beyond numbers, it **promotes smarter financial decisions proactively** by understanding the psychological side of spending and creating a “Financial Aura Profile” that visualizes how emotions impact finances, giving actionable insights before financial issues arise. Targeting gig workers, informal sector employees, and everyday citizens who often lack structured financial advice, FinAura’s combination of AI, behavioral insights, and emotional intelligence makes it an ideal solution to help users manage money intelligently and mindfully.

**Description of your solution**

Our Solution: PeriodCare – Web-Based Menstrual Health Platform
1. Web-Based Access
PeriodCare is an AI-powered platform providing girls with private, stigma-free menstrual health education and personalized support. Its web-based design ensures accessibility in rural areas and works well on low connectivity,support most of the language.

2. Personalized AI Support
The platform’s AI chatbot offers:
- Health tips tailored to individual cycles
- Nutrition and exercise guidance 
- Comfort and clothing suggestions
- Pain, mood, and symptom management
- Clear do’s and don’ts per menstrual phase
- Emergency support for critical situations

3. Education & Awareness
- Culturally sensitive explanations of the menstrual cycle
- Myth-busting interactive modules
- Features for school and parental engagement

4. Safe, Accessible, Scalable
- Supports multiple local languages and offline use
- Strong data privacy and safety measures
- Easily scalable for rural and urban outreach
- Additional Components:
- Community workshops and school curriculum inclusion
- Parental and guardian awareness programs

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/36e6930e5ffc48f7a42ae9e0684ce636/1941f342-defc-4a55-812a-d25b3608778e.png)

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Menstrual health is one of the most neglected public issues, especially in rural areas. Due to taboos, lack of awareness, and poor access to hygiene products, millions of girls face shame, isolation, and health risks. Many miss school or drop out entirely because of inadequate facilities and support. Without proper education and guidance, menstrual health will continue to be a silent crisis affecting girls’ dignity and future.

📊 Key Statistics
- 71% of girls are unaware of menstruation before their           first period (UNICEF).
- 23 million girls drop out of school annually due to poor menstrual support.
- Only 36% of women use hygienic menstrual products.
- Over 60% of rural schools lack functional girls’ toilets.
- Poor menstrual hygiene causes ~70% of reproductive health issues among rural adolescents.

**Description of your solution**

Priya's life used to be a series of anxious reminders and last-minute scrambles to care for her father, Mr. Sharma. Her phone was a tool for managing chaos. Now, her phone is a feed of completed tasks.

This morning, she received a notification:
"Action Complete: Mr. Sharma's prescription was running low. I have analyzed local pharmacy inventories, found it in stock at the Sector 22 chemist, placed the order using our secure wallet, and scheduled a delivery for 7 PM. No action is needed from you."

The CogniHealth Care Agent handled the entire task—from detection to fulfillment—autonomously.

Later, the agent sent another message, this time requiring her approval:
"Alert: I have detected a minor but consistent decline in Mr. Sharma's Memory Score over the past 72 hours, despite perfect medication adherence. I have drafted a concise summary report for Dr. Mehta. Would you like me to send it to his clinic's portal now?"

Priya reviewed the clear, professionally-worded summary and tapped "Approve." The agent performed the analysis, drafted the communication, and, with her permission, closed the loop with their doctor.

The CogniHealth agent has transformed Priya's role. She is no longer the stressed-out project manager of her father's health. She is the calm, informed director of his care, with a powerful AI agent as her tireless assistant.

The Agentic AI Core: How It Works?

The CogniHealth platform is built around a central AI agent with three core capabilities:

1. Goal-Oriented Action: The agent is given clear goals (e.g., "Ensure 100% medication availability," "Maximize engagement with cognitive exercises," "Report clinically relevant health changes"). It then autonomously plans and executes the multi-step tasks required to achieve these goals.

2. Autonomous Task Execution: The agent can interact with the digital world on the user's behalf. It can connect to pharmacy APIs to check inventory, place orders with delivery services, schedule calendar events, and communicate with healthcare portals.

3. Human-in-the-Loop Control: For sensitive actions like spending money or communicating with doctors, the agent completes the entire task up to the final step and then prompts the human user for a simple "approve" or "deny," ensuring safety, trust, and ultimate control.

Unique Selling Propositions (USPs):

1. True Autonomy, Not Just Automation: We go beyond simple reminders. Our agent handles the entire task chain—from analysis and decision-making to execution and confirmation—freeing up hours of your time.

2. From Caregiver to Care Director: CogniHealth fundamentally changes your role. You delegate the "work" of caregiving to a reliable AI, allowing you to supervise with peace of mind and focus on emotional support for your loved one.

3. Proactive Clinical Intervention: The agent acts as an early-warning system, identifying subtle but critical health trends and autonomously initiating the communication process with healthcare providers, enabling faster and better-informed medical care.

### DoseTra
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/dosetra-9e9a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/RaazAditya/DoseTra-MERN) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/bbX4X8e-3sg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeSangam%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codesangam2k25.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Health, Tracked

![MERN stack](https://img.shields.io/badge/MERN%20stack-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**
Medication management is one of the most overlooked yet critical parts of healthcare.
People who rely on daily medicines — whether for chronic conditions, mental health, or recovery — often face challenges like:

- Missing doses due to busy schedules or forgetfulness.

- Taking incorrect dosages because of confusing prescriptions.

- Losing track of progress, leading to irregular medication habits.

- No proper log or history, making it difficult to share data with doctors or caregivers.

These small inconsistencies can cause serious medical complications, delayed recovery, and even life-threatening situations in long-term treatments.
Traditional solutions like alarms or manual logs fail to address these issues effectively — they remind users when to take medicines but don’t track whether the dose was actually taken, skipped, or delayed.

**How DoseTra Makes It Easier**

DoseTra is designed to make medication tracking smarter, safer, and simpler for everyone.
It acts as a personal medication assistant, combining intelligent reminders, progress tracking, and dose history in one place.

**Key Benefits**

 - Automated Reminders
Set specific schedules for each medication and receive timely reminders to ensure no dose is missed.

-  Easy Dose Logging
Mark medicines as “Taken,” “Skipped,” or “Missed” with a single tap — making it effortless to stay accountable.

- Progress Visualization
Get visual progress charts and streak trackers to stay consistent and motivated throughout your treatment.

- Detailed Dose History
Access past logs anytime to review your adherence or share with healthcare professionals for better consultation.

- Smart & Intuitive Design
Built with a focus on simplicity — DoseTra helps users of all ages manage medications without confusion or clutter.

At the end, DoseTra ensures that users never miss a dose, always stay organized, and take control of their health without stress.
It transforms medication tracking from a manual, error-prone task into an easy, reliable, and insightful daily habit.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building DoseTra, the main challenge was integrating the DoseLog, Schedule, and Medicine modules.
Each had its own purpose — Medicine stored the drug info, Schedule handled timing and reminders, and DoseLog recorded whether the dose was taken or missed.

The problem was ensuring that these modules stayed connected and synchronized — for example, when a new schedule was added or updated, it had to reflect correctly in both the DoseLog and Medicine data.

How I solved it:
I refactored the backend to establish clear relationships using userId references and Mongoose population, ensuring smooth data flow. Proper API structuring and middleware helped maintain consistency between all three components.

Another hurdle was handling real-time UI updates after dose actions.
Initially, the frontend didn’t refresh instantly after marking a dose, so I fixed it by using React hooks and re-fetching updated data after every API call.

These challenges taught me the importance of well-planned data models, clean integration, and synchronized frontend-backend communication.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Direction API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Direction%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

HealthWise is a production-ready, business-grade healthcare platform built with Next.js, designed to transform how users access medical insights and connect with care providers. Unlike learning or demo applications, HealthWise delivers real-world value by combining artificial intelligence, geolocation services, and telehealth capabilities into a secure, scalable, and user-centric product.

At its core, HealthWise uses a trained AI model to analyze user-reported symptoms and predict potential diseases with clinically relevant accuracy. The system doesn’t stop at diagnosis—it goes further by providing personalized, actionable remedies and preventive precautions tailored to the user’s condition, age, and location. This empowers individuals to make informed health decisions before seeking professional help.

The platform integrates real-time location data to recommend the best-rated doctors and hospitals nearby, using verified directories and user reviews. Each recommendation includes specialty, availability, distance, and contact information—streamlining the path from symptom awareness to professional consultation. A built-in secure contact option allows users to initiate appointments or teleconsultations directly through the app, creating a seamless bridge between AI-driven insight and human medical expertise.

Built on Next.js 14 (App Router) and optimized with Geist fonts via next/font, HealthWise ensures blazing-fast performance, SEO-friendly rendering, and an exceptional user experience across devices. The architecture supports server-side rendering for dynamic content (like doctor listings and AI results) while maintaining static optimization for marketing and informational pages—ideal for both user engagement and search visibility.

The project uses pnpm for efficient, deterministic dependency management and follows modern development practices including TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and environment-based configuration—making it ready for enterprise deployment. It is fully compatible with Vercel, Docker, or any Node.js hosting environment, supporting CI/CD pipelines, scalability, and compliance requirements typical in digital health businesses.

HealthWise is not a prototype or educational exercise—it is a market-ready SaaS product targeting telehealth startups, clinic networks, insurance providers, and public health initiatives. With its modular design, it can be white-labeled, extended with EHR integrations, or enhanced with multilingual and multi-region support.

By merging predictive AI with practical healthcare access, HealthWise reduces diagnostic delays, improves patient triage, and lowers unnecessary hospital visits—delivering measurable value to users, providers, and partners alike. This is digital health, intelligently engineered for real impact.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# 🚑 The Problem Jeeva Solves  

Millions in rural and semi-urban India face:  

- ❌ **Delayed diagnosis** – Lack of radiologists and specialists causes late detection of critical conditions.  
- ❌ **Scattered health data** – Reports often get lost, mixed up, or remain inaccessible when needed.  
- ❌ **Connectivity gaps** – Dependence on physical visits and poor digital infrastructure slows down healthcare.  
- ❌ **Language barriers** – Prescriptions and medical terms are confusing for patients unfamiliar with English.  
- ❌ **Lack of family awareness** – Guardians or relatives often remain uninformed about patient health status.  

---

# 🌿 What People Can Use Jeeva For  

- 📲 **Upload & Store Reports**  
  Keep all medical reports safe in one place — no more lost papers or files.  

- 🤖 **AI-Powered Report Analysis**  
  Instantly interpret X-rays, blood tests, and lab reports with clear, simplified results.  

- 🩺 **AI Doctor Assistant**  
  Get preliminary guidance before consulting a physician, saving time and reducing anxiety.  

- 🌍 **Understand in Your Language**  
  View prescriptions and results in **English, Hindi, or Marathi** for full clarity.  

- 👨‍👩‍👧 **Guardian Access**  
  Share updates with family members so they can stay informed about your health.  

- 🔐 **Secure File Sharing**  
  Send reports directly to doctors or relatives with encrypted, fast transfers.  

---

# ✅ How It Makes Healthcare Easier & Safer  

- ⏱ **Faster care** → AI analysis highlights issues immediately.  
- 🛡 **Safer storage** → Encrypted cloud ensures no report is lost or misused.  
- 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 **More inclusive** → Local language support and guardian access empower both patients and families.  
- 🧠 **Smarter decisions** → Patients walk into hospitals with better awareness of their condition.  
- 🌍 **Bridging the rural gap** → Brings advanced healthcare tools where doctors and infrastructure are scarce.

**Challenges we ran into**

# 🛠 Challenges I Ran Into  

Building **Jeeva** wasn’t smooth sailing — we faced a few real hurdles along the way:  

- ⚡ **AI Report Parsing Issues**  
  At first, our AI struggled with medical PDFs and scanned images (like X-rays or handwritten notes).  
  **Fix:** We integrated preprocessing steps — converting scans into cleaner text/images before analysis.  

- 🔐 **Secure File Sharing**  
  Ensuring patient reports stayed private during transfers was tricky.  
  **Fix:** We used **Firebase Authentication + Encrypted Cloud Storage**, making file access both safe and seamless.  

- 🌍 **Local Language Support**  
  Translating medical jargon into Hindi and Marathi without losing meaning was a challenge.  
  **Fix:** We trained and fine-tuned translation prompts with Gemini API to simplify terms, not just translate word-for-word.  

- 📱 **Cross-Platform Consistency**  
  Making the platform work smoothly on both **web and mobile** with a consistent UI took time.  
  **Fix:** We built a **responsive design system** and tested it across devices.  

- ⏱ **Time Constraints (Hackathon Pressure)**  
  With only limited hours, balancing **AI integration**, **UI polish**, and **security features** was tough.  
  **Fix:** We prioritized core features (AI analysis, secure sharing, multilingual support) first, then added polish later.  

---  

Every challenge pushed us to build a **faster, safer, and more inclusive** platform. In the end, these hurdles shaped Jeeva into something stronger.

> “AI companion for mental wellness.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whisper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whisper-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Calmind bridges the growing gap between rising emotional wellness needs and the lack of affordable, stigma-free, and personalized support. Many people struggle silently because traditional solutions are often expensive, hard to access, or limited by stigma. Calmind creates an instant, safe, and supportive alternative.

💡 What Calmind Offers

AI-Powered Companion – Anytime, Anywhere

A confidential voice + chat friend designed for emotional wellness.

Always available in the user’s own language, making it relatable and accessible.

Acts as a safe space to vent, reflect, and be heard without fear of judgment.

Personalized Support for Everyday Struggles

Provides empathetic responses tailored to the user’s emotional state.

Offers coping strategies like:

Breathing and mindfulness exercises 🧘

Journaling prompts ✍️

Simple CBT-inspired reflections for reframing negative thoughts 💭

Encourages consistent self-reflection to build resilience over time.

Privacy & Anonymity First

Conversations are completely confidential, helping users feel safe to open up.

No labels, no stigma — just a judgment-free space to express emotions freely.

Affordable & Scalable

Unlike traditional mental health solutions, Calmind is designed to be accessible to everyone, regardless of background or income.

AI-driven support allows for scalability — thousands of people can get help simultaneously.

24/7 Accessibility

Human professionals often work on fixed schedules, but emotions don’t.

Calmind is always awake, offering support during late nights, sudden stress, or lonely moments when people need it most.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was making the voice assistant accurate. Many times, the AI misheard what the user actually said, so live transcription didn’t always match the intended words. To solve this, I experimented with better speech-to-text models and auto language detection, but fine-tuning it for real conversations was tricky.

Another challenge was designing empathetic AI responses. I didn’t just want Calmind to reply with short answers — it needed to acknowledge emotions, reflect on them, and then gently suggest helpful actions. Training the AI to always respond in a natural, multi-paragraph, human-like way took a lot of prompt engineering and testing.

On the UI/UX side, balancing simplicity and depth was tough. Calmind has journaling, vision board, mood tracking, and mindfulness features, but I had to make sure the design stayed calming, not cluttered. Choosing soft colors, rounded cards, and smooth layouts helped, but getting it just right was a challenge.

Managing user data securely was another hurdle. With Supabase integration, each journal entry, mood update, or vision board tile needed to be stored per user ID. Making sure this worked smoothly while protecting privacy required careful handling.

I also struggled with turning raw mood data into meaningful insights. The goal was to give users emotional graphs and analytics without overwhelming them or making the app feel too clinical. Finding the right balance between useful and simple was not easy.

Finally, scalability and cost were major concerns. GPT-4o gave incredible results, but it was expensive to run at scale. I had to explore cheaper alternatives while keeping the quality of empathetic responses high. Along with this, ensuring privacy and safety of users — since the app deals with deeply personal emotions — was something I had to prioritize at every step.

Time Constraints ⏳ – Building a complete system (data pipeline → ML model → frontend → reporting) in just 48 hours required precise planning and execution.

> Your trusted health companion, anytime, anywhere.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Access to reliable healthcare is still a major challenge for people in rural and low-income areas. Many individuals struggle with limited medical resources, lack of awareness about remedies, and difficulty managing daily health routines.

HealthMate 2025 solves this problem by providing a simple, lightweight, and accessible healthcare platform. It allows users to check symptoms, get basic remedies, receive reminders for medication, and access health resources in multiple languages. Since it runs directly in the browser without requiring heavy installations or advanced devices, it empowers users to take better control of their health even in low-connectivity environments.

By making healthcare guidance more transparent, inclusive, and easy to use, HealthMate 2025 helps bridge the gap between medical support and underserved communities.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges I faced was building a healthcare-focused platform using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without relying on APIs or a backend. Ensuring that the application worked smoothly with just front-end technologies required careful planning and optimization.

Another challenge was designing a simple, responsive, and accessible interface so that users from rural and low-income backgrounds could use the platform easily. Managing multiple features like symptom input, reminders, and multi-language support within a lightweight website was tricky.

I overcame these challenges by breaking down features into smaller parts, optimizing the code for performance, and focusing on a clean and user-friendly design.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project, HealthMate 2025, leverages Ethereum to build a more transparent and decentralized healthcare support platform. By using Ethereum smart contracts, we can ensure trust in patient–doctor interactions, secure health data sharing, and transparent medical service records. This enables patients in rural/low-income areas to access healthcare information and resources without relying on centralized intermediaries. Ethereum’s decentralized infrastructure ensures security, trust, and accessibility—making it the perfect foundation for building a fair and inclusive healthcare solution.

**Best Use of Akash**

Our project HealthMate2025 leverages Akash Network as a decentralized cloud platform to deploy and scale our health-tech web application. Instead of relying on centralized cloud providers, we used Akash to host and manage our services securely, cost-effectively, and in a censorship-resistant manner.

By running on Akash, HealthMate2025 ensures:

Decentralized deployment → reducing dependency on single-point cloud providers.

Cost optimization → Akash’s marketplace allows us to access compute resources at a fraction of the traditional cost, making our solution sustainable.

Scalability & reliability → our AI-driven health assistance and patient data services can scale seamlessly without worrying about centralized downtime.

Web3-native alignment → using Akash strengthens our mission of building an open, accessible, and transparent health platform.

Thus, the project not only benefits from Akash’s decentralized infrastructure but also demonstrates how healthcare applications can achieve affordability, reliability, and trustlessness through the Best Use of Akash.

> Scan Smart, Eat Healthy.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/OCR-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem:**

Food labels are often filled with confusing jargon, hidden additives, and complex codes that make it hard for consumers to understand what they’re really eating.
People unknowingly consume harmful chemicals & allergens.
Health-conscious users struggle to track sugar, salt, and preservatives.
Current labels meet regulations but fail to inform people in simple language.

Our Solution – **FoodSnap**

An AI-Powered Label Decoder that makes food labels easy, clear, and personalized.
**Simplified Breakdown:** Instantly decode ingredients, nutrition facts & health warnings.
**User-Friendly Insights:** Converts complex terms (e.g., E621) into clear meanings (MSG – may cause allergies).
**Personalized Alerts:** Flags allergens & harmful additives based on preferences (gluten, sugar, salt).
**Transparency & Trust:** Empowers people to make smarter, healthier food choices.
**Innovation & Uniqueness:** Combines OCR + AI + real-time analysis for a solution that works on any packaged food label.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.**Database Limitations**

**Challenge:**
Reliance on OpenFoodFacts API (national & international).
Missing product data → no ingredient/dietary analysis.
Occasional gaps in product information despite app working correctly.

**Solution:**
Integrated both National & International OpenFoodFacts APIs to maximize coverage.
If data is missing, FoodSnap notifies the user clearly instead of failing.
Future-ready: Plan to build a custom ingredient knowledge base to reduce dependency.

2.**API Switching**

**Challenge:**
If national database has no record, fallback to international API.
Sometimes causes delays or incomplete analysis.

**Solution:**
Implemented automatic fallback system (national → international).
Added loading indicators & alerts to keep users informed.
Optimized API calls for faster response and reliability.

3.**Device Compatibility**

**Challenge:**
FoodSnap is mobile responsive, but very old devices/browsers may face loading issues.
Due to modern frameworks & updated versions.

**Solution:**
Developed as a Progressive Web App (PWA) for smooth cross-device performance.
Used responsive design & lightweight optimizations.
Regular testing ensures smooth use on modern devices, while older devices are gracefully handled with alerts.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

Mental health issues like stress, anxiety, and burnout are rising globally.

Current wellness apps (like Calm, Headspace, Wysa) rely mostly on self-reporting (journaling, surveys) or provide generic, one-size-fits-all solutions.

Many people don’t even realize they are stressed or anxious until it’s too late.

In sensitive areas like mental health, privacy is a big concern — most apps send data to the cloud, which discourages people from using them.

**How People Can Use It**

Stress Prevention
Early detection of stress signals (voice tone, facial expressions, heart rate variability) helps people take action before burnout hits.

Daily Wellness Companion 
Receive real-time, personalized suggestions (breathing exercises, music, mindfulness tips) instead of browsing generic libraries.

Safe & Private Tracking
All processing happens locally on the device — no need to worry about your webcam, voice, or biometric data being uploaded anywhere.

Versatility Across Domains 

Students → manage exam anxiety and improve focus.

Employees → reduce work stress with real-time relaxation nudges.

Therapists → use it as a support tool to visualize client mood trends (without replacing therapy).

General users → a fun, interactive way to check-in with your emotions daily.

**Why It Makes Things Easier/Safer**

Automatic, not manual: No need for journaling or manual check-ins — your face, voice, and biometrics are enough.

Engaging & intuitive: Seeing your “mental aura” is more impactful than just reading a number or text.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

 Face Detection Accuracy

Problem: Initially, I used Haarcascade and later MediaPipe for face detection. Both gave unstable results — either missing faces in low light or cropping too tightly. This caused the model to always predict the same emotion (mostly sad).

Solution: I switched to MTCNN, which provides more reliable bounding boxes and works well across lighting conditions. Training and inference were aligned (both cropped faces), which significantly improved accuracy.

> Every heartbeat, every step — your health in check

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 🩺 Problem it Solves

Accessing, managing, and analyzing personal health data is still a fragmented and inefficient process for most people. Patients often struggle with:

* **Scattered medical reports** across different hospitals, labs, and clinics.
* **Difficulty in tracking medical history**, making it hard for doctors to get a complete picture.
* **Manual report analysis** — patients often cannot interpret their own reports without depending on a doctor.
* **Limited access** — health records are not always accessible on-demand, especially in emergencies.
* **Data security concerns** when sharing sensitive health records online.

👉 **SwasthyaVault** (or MediTrack) solves this by providing:

* A **unified digital vault** for storing, accessing, and managing health records securely.
* **AI-powered insights** (via Gemini) to analyze medical reports and provide easy-to-understand summaries.
* A **hospital directory** to quickly locate healthcare providers.
* A **personalized dashboard** to track health trends and history over time.

In short, it bridges the gap between patients, doctors, and data by making healthcare **accessible, secure, and intelligent**.

**Challenges we ran into**

## ⚡ Challenges I Ran Into

* **JWT Authentication Bug**
  While implementing authentication, the JWT cookie (`uid`) was not being set correctly in the browser due to CORS and `httpOnly` issues. This caused protected routes to fail.
  🔧 *Fix:* Configured backend with proper CORS settings (`credentials: true`) and ensured cookies were sent with `axios` requests (`withCredentials: true`).

* **Sidebar Overlap Issue**
  Initially, the sidebar wasn’t stretching to the full height and overlapped with the main content.
  🔧 *Fix:* Used Tailwind utilities (`fixed top-0 left-0 h-screen w-64`) and added `ml-64` to the main content container in `MainLayout.jsx` to align everything properly.

* **AI Response Formatting**
  Gemini’s API returned raw text that wasn’t structured for easy display inside the app.
  🔧 *Fix:* Wrote a custom parser to format the AI’s response into sections, making it readable and user-friendly.

* **Database Schema Confusion**
  Designing MongoDB schemas for reports, users, and hospitals without over-complicating relationships was tough.
  🔧 *Fix:* Broke down schemas into modular collections and used `userId` references for scalability.

**Medical Track**

MediTrack is a patient-centered medical history tracker that centralizes health records, prescriptions, and ABDM-linked reports. With AI-powered insights and hospital-finder features, it bridges the gap between medical jargon and patient understanding. Future-ready with secure storage, MediTrack empowers patients with clarity, control, and continuity in their healthcare journey.

**The problem it solves**

# MapMyClinic — Problem Solved, Effectiveness, and Efficiency

## Problem
Going to a local clinic is usually uncertain and time-consuming:

-   No clear visibility into current wait times or capacity.
-   Broken discovery of nearby clinics and services.
-   Frustrating call trees, manual logs, and inconsistent triage.
-   Newcomers and students find the correct clinic slowly.
-   Clinics do not have lightweight tools to share live queue and triage updates.

## Solution
MapMyClinic is a map-led platform linking patients to local clinics with real-time availability and convenient booking.

It offers:
- **Patient app**: find clinics, see live wait estimates, request a slot, get notifications, and chat for clarifications.  
- **Web admin panel**: receptionists manage queues, establish priority levels, approve bookings, and notify delays.

## How It Works
1. Patient search clinics by location and speciality, see distance and average wait.  
2. Patient requests an appointment slot and optionally provides a brief case description.  
3. Request goes to admin panel; staff assigns priority (Emergency, Routine, Follow-up) and validates.  
4. Real-time updated queue and wait-time information is shown for every patient.  
5. Patients receive turn notifications, status updates, and instructions through the app.  
6. Optional chat facilitates speedy questions between patients and clinic staff.  

## Why This Is Effective
- **Transparency**: Real-time wait times and status updates decrease uncertainty and no-shows.  
- **Improved triage**: Priority marking prioritizes critical cases without interrupting flow.  
- **Less congestion**: Transparency distributes demand to neighboring clinics, reducing peak-hour spikes.  
- **Faster decision-making**: Map-plus-specialty view enables patients to select the correct clinic on their first attempt.  
- **Trust establishment**: Two-way communication eliminates guesswork and constant calls.  

## Why This Works Efficiently

### For Patients
- Less wasted visits through real-time queue visibility.  
- One-tap appointment and turn reminders minimize downtime.  
- Guided directions reduce door-to-door time.  

### For Clinics
- Lightweight web panel; no new hardware needed.  
- Structured queue controls reduce front-desk load.  
- Broadcast delay updates once rather than in many calls.  
- Triage tags simplify doctor time and room allocation.  

### For the System
- Low data payloads and event-driven updates minimize cost.  
- Role-based access and simple data schema scale easily city-wide.  
- Future patient self-check-ins are supported to supplement staff updates.  

## Key Differentiators
- Designed for neighborhood clinics, not just for large hospitals only.  
- Live queue plus triage, not appointment booking only.  
- Dual-sided implementation (patient app + clinic web) for network effects.  

## Impact Metrics (for measurement)
- Average wait-time reduction per visit.  
- Percentage of confirmed bookings vs. walk-ins.  
- No-show rate prior to vs. subsequent to adoption.  
- Peak-hour load distribution across surrounding clinics.  
- Time-to-first-response in chat.  
- Patient satisfaction score and clinic staff workload impact.  

## Future Improvements
- Anonymous patient self-check-ins to increase data freshness.  
- Basic analytics dashboard for clinics (busiest hours, service mix).  
- Service filters (e.g., diagnostics, vaccinations) and insurance tags.  
- Multilingual support and offline-friendly clinic tools.  

## One-Line Summary
MapMyClinic provides priority-aware, real-time clinic access that saves patients time, minimizes front-desk friction, and brings transparency to area healthcare.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Potential Challenges and Solutions

1. **Real-time Queue Updates**
   - *Challenge*: Keeping patient app and clinic admin panel perfectly synchronized with live wait times.  
   - *Solution*: Use a shared backend with event-driven updates (e.g., WebSockets or Firebase listeners) so both sides auto-refresh instantly.  

2. **Clinic Adoption**
   - *Challenge*: Many small clinics still use manual registers and may hesitate to adopt new tech.  
   - *Solution*: Build a lightweight, web-based admin panel that runs on any browser with minimal setup, requiring no extra hardware.  

3. **Authentication & Data Privacy**
   - *Challenge*: Handling sensitive patient data securely while providing smooth login for both patients and staff.  
   - *Solution*: Use Firebase Authentication for secure logins and role-based access, with clear consent options for data sharing.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves
Healthcare systems often face long waiting times, inefficient scheduling, and poor patient-provider communication. Patients frequently spend hours in queues, while hospitals struggle to manage overlapping appointments, cancellations, and resource allocation. This leads to frustration, delayed care, and in some cases, worsening of health conditions due to late treatment.

How CareQueue Helps
CareQueue is designed to streamline patient flow and make healthcare more efficient, safe, and user-friendly:

Reduced Waiting Times – Patients can check live queue status and estimated waiting time before arriving at the hospital.

Smart Scheduling – Automated appointment booking ensures no overlaps and sends reminders to both patients and doctors.

Real-Time Updates – Patients receive instant notifications about delays, rescheduling, or cancellations.

Better Communication – Direct chat or query system with healthcare staff for clarifications.

Safer Environment – By preventing overcrowding in waiting areas, it helps minimize risks (e.g., infection spread).

Data-Driven Insights – Hospitals can analyze patient flow and resource usage for better staff allocation.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

Building CareQueue came with several hurdles that tested both our technical and teamwork skills:

Integrating Multiple Modules:
Challenge: Connecting the frontend (Flutter) with the backend (Django) and ensuring smooth communication with the database was tricky. Initially, API calls were either failing or giving inconsistent data.

Solution: We introduced Postman testing for APIs and standardized JSON response formats, which solved most integration issues.

Real-Time Updates:
Challenge: Implementing live queue status and notifications without causing heavy server load was a big hurdle.

Solution: We switched from frequent API polling to WebSockets, which provided lightweight and real-time updates efficiently.

UI/UX Design:
Challenge: With no dedicated designer, the app initially looked cluttered and confusing for users.

Solution: We studied Material Design principles, built simple prototypes in Figma, and refined the UI iteratively after team feedback.

Team Coordination:
Challenge: Since everyone was working on different stacks (Flutter, Django), merging work often led to conflicts and delays.

Solution: We adopted Git branching strategy and held short daily sync-ups to keep everyone aligned.

> Early detection. Smarter decisions. Better rural

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Progressive Web Apps (PWA)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Progressive%20Web%20Apps%20(PWA)-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLAlchemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLAlchemy-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Rural and semi-urban healthcare workers often have limited access to digital tools for early disease-risk screening, while unreliable internet connectivity makes many cloud-dependent solutions difficult to use.

**RuralHealth AI** provides an AI-powered, offline-first platform that helps frontline health workers identify potential health risks from a patient's symptoms and vital signs before they become serious.

The platform can be used to:

* 🩺 Screen patients using symptoms, vitals, and health information.
* 🤖 Predict potential diseases using a machine-learning model.
* ⚠️ Classify patients into **Low, Moderate, or High risk** for easier prioritization.
* 💡 Provide explainable risk factors instead of only giving a prediction.
* 📱 Store patient records locally and continue working when there is no internet connection.
* 🔄 Synchronize queued patient data when connectivity is restored.
* 🌐 Support **English, Hindi, and Bengali** for better accessibility.
* 🎙️ Allow voice-based symptom input.
* 🏥 Help users find healthcare facilities and support teleconsultation.(Only demo teleconsultation)
* 📊 Give PHC/healthcare staff a dashboard to monitor patients and prioritize high-risk cases.

Instead of replacing doctors, RuralHealth AI acts as a **decision-support and early-screening tool**, helping frontline workers identify patients who may need professional medical attention sooner.

The overall workflow is:

**Symptoms & Vitals → AI Risk Assessment → Disease Prediction → Early Warning → Professional Evaluation**

**Challenges we ran into**

One of our biggest challenges was designing the system to work reliably in **low-connectivity environments**. A conventional cloud-dependent application would fail when a health worker loses internet access, so we had to make patient data entry and storage work locally and synchronize it later.

We addressed this by implementing an **offline-first architecture** using local browser storage. Patient records can be queued while offline and synchronized with the backend once connectivity becomes available.

Another challenge was integrating the **machine-learning model into the web application**. The ML model was developed using Python and Scikit-learn, while the frontend is built with React and TypeScript. We solved this by exposing the trained model through a **FastAPI backend**, allowing the frontend to send patient symptoms and receive predictions through an API.

We also had to deal with the complexity of presenting AI predictions in a healthcare context. Instead of showing only a disease prediction, we added a separate risk-assessment layer that provides **Low/Moderate/High risk levels and contributing factors**, making the output easier for frontline workers to understand.

Finally, designing the interface for rural users required us to consider **multilingual interaction, voice input, simple workflows, and limited connectivity** rather than assuming users would always have a high-speed internet connection or advanced technical knowledge.

> Say what hurts. We'll handle the rest.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Getting sick in India today means juggling three separate apps and a dozen decisions: finding a doctor and booking a slot, remembering what to say, then — once you have a prescription finding a pharmacy, checking stock, and paying, often while unwell, in pain, or looking after someone who is.

HealthCart collapses that into one plain-language request. Tell it what's wrong "I have a fever and body ache, book me a doctor and order whatever they prescribe," and it:

Finds and books an appropriate doctor appointment based on the symptoms described, no manual searching through specialties or clinic listings.
Reads the resulting prescription and finds the prescribed medicines from nearby/available vendors.
Completes the purchase autonomously, using Prava's tokenized, per-transaction payment flow; each purchase is scoped to a specific amount and merchant, approved by the user via biometric passkey, so the agent never holds a persistent card or an unbounded ability to spend.

Who this helps, and how:

People who are actually unwell the moments this matters most are exactly when navigating five different apps is hardest. One request replaces the whole chain.
Elderly users or caregivers managing someone else's care, where the appointment-booking + medicine-ordering flow is often the most friction-heavy part of a health scare.
Anyone in a location without easy access to nearby clinics/pharmacy info with location auto-detection when it isn't specified; the agent fills in context the user might not think (or be well enough) to provide.

Why it's safer, not just faster:
Because Prava scopes every payment to a specific transaction with user-set spending caps and biometric approval, the user retains a hard checkpoint over every purchase the agent makes; the convenience of "book it and get my meds" doesn't come at the cost of handing an AI agent open-ended access to a card.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Prava sandbox authentication kept failing silently

Early on, every session-creation call to the Prava sandbox returned a 401 with no obvious reason in the request itself; the payload looked correct, and the endpoint was correct. After digging into the auth headers, it turned out we were pointing at a stale/incorrect secret key rather than the current sandbox key. Once we swapped in the correct key, session creation returned a clean 201, and the polling loop for session status worked end-to-end against the sandbox API on the first real attempt.

Lesson: when a payments API returns a generic 401, verify the credential itself before assuming the request shape is wrong; we lost time debugging the payload when the fix was one key swap.

2. Visa Payment Passkey enrollment breaking on localhost

When we got to wiring up the passkey approval step, enrollment kept failing during local development. The root cause was WebAuthn's secure-context requirement: passkeys need HTTPS, and while localhost itself is exempted, subtle mismatches (wrong RP ID/origin, or accidentally testing via a LAN IP instead of the literal localhost) broke the flow in ways that weren't obvious from the browser's error alone.

We worked through it methodically:

Ruled out the localhost vs 127.0.0.1 distinction first, since that's the most common cause.
Checked our session config against Prava's documented origin/redirect-URI requirements.
When that still didn't fully resolve it under time pressure, we routed local dev traffic through an HTTPS tunnel (Cloudflare), so the whole secure-context question became moot: no more debugging localhost edge cases, just a real HTTPS origin end to end.

Lesson: for anything biometric/WebAuthn-based, don't assume "it's probably a dev-environment quirk"; trace the actual origin and RP ID being used at the moment the browser throws, rather than guessing from the symptom.
