**The problem it solves**

Problem:

Many people’s health information is scattered across different clinics, labs, apps and devices — making it hard to get the full picture, and causing delays, errors or duplicated work.  

Solution:

Our platform gives you a single, secure health vault where you collect all your records and signals, and then get smart AI-driven guidance + controlled sharing. So you own your data, everything is connected, and decisions get easier and safer.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building the MAE AI agent was easy — verifying it wasn’t. Since our founder’s a doctor, we had to ensure every response could stand real clinical review. Training on data was one thing, but testing in real-world cases with unique patients was a whole new challenge. Collecting consistent feedback from doctors took time and structure, and whenever the AI disagreed with a clinician, we had to loop that insight back into the model — true human-in-the-loop learning.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/andyzbteth/MAE-new

**Live URL of your project**

medicalai.site

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

MAE stands out because it combines medical-grade AI diagnostics with a secure, user-controlled health vault — something most health apps and AI chatbots don’t do together.

Unlike typical symptom checkers that rely on surface-level Q&A, MAE links your real health data (labs, wearables, and medical history) to deliver context-aware insights. Every user fully owns their data — encrypted, permissioned, and shareable only by choice.

Our alpha build proves this by:
	•	Integrating an early version of the AI triage agent that adapts based on user input and verified doctor feedback.
	•	Demonstrating the vault system, where users can upload and manage their health records securely.
	•	Showcasing clinician-verified feedback loops, ensuring that MAE’s medical suggestions improve with real-world validation.

In short: MAE gives you instant, doctor-informed AI health guidance — without sacrificing privacy or control.

**Who is your target customer?**

MAE is for health-conscious users and patients with ongoing conditions who want fast, reliable AI health insights and full control of their data. Early feedback from doctors and beta users confirmed strong demand for our secure, intelligent health assistant.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

We’re Web3-inspired. We’ve built a privacy-first health vault with permissioned sharing, and our roadmap includes a decentralised audit ledger + token-incentive layer.

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Our distribution strategy combines direct-to-consumer sign-ups with clinic/partner integrations and community-driven content — so users can discover and use it easily, while trusted healthcare providers help us scale credibly.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
Current telemedicine platforms have simplified doctor–patient communication but still face critical challenges:
Patients often fail to explain symptoms clearly or forget to mention important details.
Doctors spend valuable time collecting basic history instead of focusing on diagnosis and treatment.
Post-consultation tasks like creating summaries, setting medicine reminders, and recommending lifestyle changes are left entirely to patients, causing poor adherence.
This creates gaps in healthcare delivery miscommunication, delays, and reduced treatment effectiveness.

**Solution Concept**

We propose an AI-Powered Smart Telemedicine Assistant that transforms the telemedicine experience by acting as a pre-consultation assistant, real-time consultation supporter, and post-consultation care companion.

**Core Features**
1)Smart Symptom Intake (AI Triage)
Patients enter symptoms via text/voice.
AI (LLM + symptom classification model) generates a structured pre-diagnosis report with severity levels.

2)Real-Time Consultation Assistance
Background AI listens to doctor–patient video calls.
Extracts key points, prescriptions, next steps, and follow-ups automatically.
Summarizes the conversation for both doctor and patient.

3)Post-Consultation Summary
Doctor-verified summary includes symptoms, diagnosis, prescription, and next steps.
Auto-integrated with a reminder system for medicines & follow-ups.

**Additional Innovative Features**
1)Report Uploads – Patients can upload blood test reports; AI extracts and highlights key results.
2)Prescription-to-Reminders (AI Agent) – AI reads prescriptions and automatically sets medicine & follow-up reminders.
3)Nearby Clinics & Doctors – Integrated with Google Maps API to suggest nearest healthcare providers.
4)AI-Assisted Prescription Writing – Doctors get AI support to quickly generate structured prescriptions.
5)24/7 Chatbot – Provides instant query resolution and health guidance.
6)AI Diet & Lifestyle Recommendations – Personalized diet/exercise suggestions based on diagnosis/disease.
7)Specialist Recommendations – AI suggests the right specialist depending on symptoms/disease.


**What We Plan to Build**
We are building an AI-powered telemedicine platform that enhances the traditional video/audio consultation by integrating intelligent AI systems at every stage of patient–doctor interaction.


**Pain Points Addressed**
Patient Communication Gap – Patients struggle to explain symptoms or forget details.
→ AI-generated symptom reports ensure doctors get accurate input.
Time Wasted in Basic History Taking – Doctors spend 30–40% of consultation time collecting basic info.
→ AI pre-consultation reports save doctors’ time.
Prescription Adherence Issues – Patients often forget medicines or follow-ups.
→ Automated AI reminders improve adherence and treatment outcomes.
Lack of Personalized Post-Care – Patients don’t get diet, lifestyle, or specialist recommendations.
→ AI provides disease-specific personalized guidance.
Accessibility & Availability – Finding the right doctor/clinic is difficult.
→ Google Maps API integration shows nearest specialists instantly.


**Target Audience**

Primary:
Patients in urban & semi-urban areas using telemedicine for convenience.
Busy professionals and elderly people needing structured guidance & reminders.

Secondary:
Doctors/clinics seeking efficient teleconsultation tools.
Small & medium hospitals looking for AI-powered telemedicine add-ons.


**GTM (Go-To-Market) Strategy & Revenue Streams**

🔹 GTM Strategy
B2C Launch (Patients) – Mobile/web app for individuals to book AI-assisted teleconsultations.
B2B Partnerships (Hospitals/Clinics) – Integrate platform as a plug-in for existing telemedicine portals.
Doctor Onboarding – Provide AI-assist tools (prescription writing, summary generation) to attract doctors.
Strategic Partnerships – Tie-ups with diagnostic labs (for test reports) & pharmacies (for medicine delivery).

🔹 Revenue Streams
Subscription Plans (B2C) – Patients pay for premium features like reminders, diet plans, chatbot assistance.
Consultation Fees (Commission Model) – A % cut from each teleconsultation booking.
B2B SaaS Model – Hospitals and clinics pay to integrate AI-powered telemedicine assistant into their platforms.
Pharmacy & Lab Partnerships – Referral-based revenue for medicine delivery & test report integrations.
Future Expansion – Insurance tie-ups for AI-powered claim processing and digital he

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This project directly aligns with HealthTech because it:

**Improves accessibility**: Patients get structured AI assistance before reaching doctors.

**Increases efficiency**: Doctors save time on history-taking and administrative tasks.

**Enhances adherence**: Automated reminders ensure patients follow prescriptions properly.

**Strengthens diagnosis & treatment**: AI-assisted summaries and data extraction reduce medical errors.

**Bridges the gap**: Between patient confusion and doctor clarity through AI mediation.

Essentially, it modernizes telemedicine into an intelligent, proactive healthcare ecosystem.

**Description of your solution**

**Project Title**: **AADHYA: An Agentic AI Ecosystem for Predictive Hospital Management**

**Problem**: Hospital emergency departments in India are frequently overwhelmed by unpredictable patient surges, particularly during major festivals, severe pollution events, and sudden epidemics. This chronic overcrowding leads to inefficient resource allocation, dangerously long wait times, staff burnout, and a decline in the quality of patient care. Hospitals lack the predictive tools to anticipate these surges, forcing them into a constant state of reaction.

**Our Solution**: We developed AADHYA, an agentic AI-powered management system that transforms hospitals from reactive to proactive. AADHYA is a "digital twin" of hospital operations that forecasts patient inflow, optimizes resource allocation, and automates stakeholder communication in real-time.

By integrating disparate data sources—including live pollution levels (AQI), epidemic reports (IDSP), festival calendars, social media sentiment, and internal hospital EHRs—AADHYA's Prediction Agent (using LSTM & Prophet) accurately foresees patient volume spikes 72 hours in advance.

This forecast triggers our Optimization Agent, which uses Reinforcement Learning to automatically generate optimal staff rosters and resource procurement plans, ensuring the right resources are in the right place before the surge hits.

**Key Innovations & Technical Strengths**: AADHYA's true innovation lies in its autonomous Multi-Agent Architecture (built on LangGraph/AutoGen), where specialized AI agents (Prediction, Optimization, Compliance) collaborate to solve complex, dynamic problems.

Explainable AI (XAI): We move beyond "black box" AI. Our system integrates SHAP and LIME models, making every prediction and decision fully transparent and explainable to doctors and administrators.

Blockchain-Backed Audits: To ensure ultimate trust and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, NDHM), all critical decisions and data logs are secured on a Hyperledger Fabric blockchain, creating a tamper-proof audit trail.

Unified Data Ecosystem: We built a robust Real-Time Historical Data Lake capable of ingesting and pre-processing high-velocity data from IoT, APIs (like Google Maps), and internal databases to feed our AI models.

**Impact and Viability**: AADHYA is a complete, end-to-end solution designed for the real world. It directly reduces patient wait times, optimizes hospital bed and staff utilization, and improves patient outcomes. By providing automated advisories to citizens (via a Flutter app) and actionable insights to hospital administrators and public health agencies, our system creates a more resilient, efficient, and transparent healthcare ecosystem for everyone.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project, **AADHYA**, is a direct and complete implementation of this Healthtech track.

**Manages Unpredictable Surges:** AADHYA is an Agentic AI ecosystem built to manage hospital surges by integrating and analyzing data from festivals (Google Calendar), pollution spikes (live AQI APIs), and epidemics (IDSP feeds).

**Autonomous AI Analysis**: Our Prediction Agent (using Prophet/LSTM models) autonomously analyzes this diverse data to accurately forecast patient inflow 72 hours in advance.

**Recommends Staffing & Supply**: The forecast is fed to an Optimization Agent (using Reinforcement Learning & OR-Tools) that automatically generates optimal staffing schedules, bed allocations, and supply procurement plans.

**Patient Advisory Actions**: The system generates real-time patient advisories (via a Flutter App) about wait times and health risks, and alerts hospital staff (via a dashboard) to prepare for the predicted surge, fulfilling every requirement of this track.

**Description of your solution**

Idea Description – Safe Space

• Introduction

Our prototype is designed under the healthcare track with a strong focus on preventive care for individuals who suffer from hearing problems or breathing difficulties. Many times, environmental factors such as festival noise, traffic pollution, or seasonal smoke worsen their condition. Our app acts as a guardian assistant that monitors surroundings, sends timely alerts, and even motivates users to contribute to a healthier environment by planting trees.


---

• App Flow

1. Login / Signup

A simple onboarding system where users can create their profile.

Data is stored securely to personalize alerts and reports.



---

2. Health Track Selection

On signup, users select one of the health concerns:

Hearing Problem

Breathing Problem


This choice changes the user interface (UI) and the kind of data/alerts they receive.



---

3. Adaptive User Interface

For Hearing Problem Users:

The dashboard highlights decibel levels in the area.

If noise goes above safe levels (e.g., festivals, firecrackers, rallies), the app notifies the user to stay indoors or take precautions.

Example: “Warning! Current noise level is 95 dB, which can affect hearing. Please avoid going outside.”


For Breathing Problem Users:

The dashboard focuses on the Air Quality Index (AQI).

Users get real-time updates about pollution levels.

Alerts guide them to protect themselves:

“Air Quality is poor – close windows and use a mask.”

“Smog detected in your area due to firecrackers – avoid outdoor activity.”





---

4. Preventive Alerts (Smart Notifications)

Push notifications are sent in advance when conditions worsen.

Example:

Hearing users: “Ganpati festival today – noise levels expected to be high. Stay safe indoors.”

Breathing users: “Smoke detected nearby – keep your inhaler and mask handy.”




---

5. Plant a Tree – Community Action 🌳

A unique section to motivate users to take real action for cleaner air.

Features:

Upload a photo of the planted tree with their name on the pot/paper.

Earn rewards:

Cashback (₹5–₹20)

Discount coupons (10%–50% off).


Positive reinforcement with cheerful messages like:

“You’ve helped someone with asthma breathe better – your action counts!”

This gamified reward system not only promotes better health but also encourages sustainable habits.


---

6. Monthly Area Reports 📊

Users receive a summary report of their areas:

Average decibel levels (for hearing users).

Average air quality index (for breathing users).


Visual charts help them understand trends and prepare for high-risk days in the future.

---

• Impact & Innovation

Healthcare Benefit: Provides real-time preventive support for people who are often unaware of harmful environmental conditions.

Inclusivity: Tailors experiences for both hearing and breathing difficulties.

Sustainability: Encourages eco-friendly actions like tree plantation with a reward-based system.

Community Awareness: Daily and monthly reports not only help individuals but also spread awareness about environmental health.

---

In short, our prototype is not just an app, but a safety companion for people with sensitive health conditions, while also driving positive community change.

**Description of your solution**

Our Solution – Arogya-Prepare

Arogya-Prepare is an AI-powered hospital surge prediction and preparedness platform designed to help Indian hospitals manage sudden spikes in patients during festivals, pollution waves, or epidemics.

The platform integrates hospital data (admissions, staff, inventory) with external signals (AQI, weather, outbreak alerts, festival calendars, mobility trends) to forecast patient inflow 7–14 days in advance.

Based on these forecasts, it provides:

-  Staffing recommendations to balance workload and avoid burnout.

-  Supply chain alerts for oxygen, medicines, masks, and critical equipment.

-  Automated patient advisories via SMS/WhatsApp/social media.

-  Dashboards & reports for hospital admins to track surge risks, hotspot areas, and resource needs.

With explainable AI for transparency and a user-friendly interface, Arogya-Prepare enables hospitals to shift from reactive crisis management to proactive healthcare planning—improving efficiency, reducing chaos, and ensuring better care for patients.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our solution, Arogya-Prepare, directly fits the problem statement because it tackles the exact challenge of unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics.

- The problem is hospitals face overcrowding, staff shortages, and supply strain in these high-demand periods.

- Our platform uses agentic AI to analyze hospital data, AQI, weather, outbreak alerts, and festival calendars to predict patient inflow 7–14 days ahead.

- It then provides actionable recommendations: staffing plans, supply forecasts, and patient advisories, helping hospitals prepare before the surge happens.

- This aligns perfectly with the track’s aim of applying AI for proactive hospital management, optimized resources, and better patient outcomes.

**Description of your solution**

**Smart Diet** is an AI-powered HealthTech platform designed to connect nutritionists and users (patients or personal users) for creating personalized diet plans tailored to individual health needs and goals. The platform intelligently analyzes user data — including age, gender, height, weight, allergies, fitness goals, and health issues — to generate safe, customized, and effective meal plans.

It serves three types of users:

*Nutritionists* – Verified professionals who can provide diet plans, suggestions, and monitor patients’ progress.

*Patients* – Users who receive doctor-recommended or nutritionist-approved diet plans, with options for chat or video consultations.

*Individual Users* – Individuals looking for personal health and nutrition guidance through AI-powered tools.

**Problem**
Many people struggle with understanding what and how to eat to achieve their health goals or manage conditions such as diabetes, obesity, or hypertension. Generic diets often ignore personal allergies, medical conditions, and nutritional needs — leading to confusion, poor adherence, and potential health risks.

**Solution**
Smart Diet bridges the gap between users and certified nutrition experts while integrating AI-driven automation for personal users.

Verified nutritionists can create, monitor, and update diet plans while engaging directly with patients via chat or video consultations.

Patients receive doctor-recommended plans and expert advice tailored to their medical conditions.

Individual users enjoy a self-guided AI diet planner with tools for tracking fitness, hydration, and daily nutrition, ensuring balanced and goal-oriented eating habits.

**Key Features**
*For Nutritionists*

• Secure signup and verification using certificates and IDs.

• Ability to provide diet plans, recommendations, and monitor progress.

• Chat or video call with patients for follow-ups and feedback.

*For Patients*

• Access to doctor- or nutritionist-recommended diet plans.

• Option to chat or video call with their nutritionist.

• Receive real-time updates and feedback on progress.

• Get all the features available of individual users (AI Diet Planner, Fitness Dashboard, Water Glass Tracker, Nutrition Overview, Chatbot assistance, and healthy recipe recommendations) in addition to nutritionist support

*For Individual Users*

• AI Diet Planner that considers age, gender, health goals, and allergies.

• Fitness Dashboard with success streaks and “What I Ate Today” calorie tracking.

• Water Glass Tracker for daily hydration goals.

• Weekly/Monthly Nutrition Overview for long-term insights.

• Chatbot assistance and healthy recipe recommendations for meal variety..

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

In today’s fast-paced world, maintaining a healthy diet tailored to individual needs is difficult. People often fail to follow nutrition plans due to lack of personalization, real-time guidance, and expert support. At the same time, nutritionists face challenges in remotely monitoring and assisting multiple clients efficiently.

Our project, **Smart-Diet**, addresses this gap by leveraging Agentic AI to deliver personalized diet recommendations, adapt plans dynamically based on user progress, and enable seamless collaboration between users and nutritionists — creating an intelligent, interactive health management ecosystem.

> Reimagining health, one summary at a time

![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Neural Network](https://img.shields.io/badge/Neural%20Network-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**We are developing :** 
An **Agentic AI-powered Clinical Co-Pilot** — an intelligent reasoning layer built on top of India’s **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)**. The system automatically analyzes fragmented patient records and synthesizes them into a **single, actionable clinical summary** within seconds. It highlights **drug interactions, risky prescriptions, abnormal lab trends, and relevant historical findings**, all while ensuring **zero data storage** and complete privacy. The entire system is designed to operate within India’s legal and ethical healthcare data framework, fully aligned with the **Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023)**, the **IT Act (2000)**, and the upcoming **DISHA Act**, ensuring that every action respects consent, confidentiality, and secure handling of health information.


**GAP we are solving :** 
While ABDM provides national health interoperability, **doctors still face information overload** — dealing with piles of PDFs, diagnostic reports, and lab sheets scattered across systems.
There is **no intelligent layer** that interprets this data or generates clinical context.
For patients undergoing multiple treatments (poly-therapy), critical interactions or red-flags often go unnoticed, leading to **avoidable medical errors, delays, and re-hospitalizations**.
Our solution fills this gap by transforming raw data into **meaningful, real-time medical intelligence** that assists, not replaces, the clinician.


**WHO it’s for :**
**Frontline physicians** managing high patient volumes such as oncologists, cardiologists, nephrologists, endocrinologists in hospitals, plus **ER physicians** who need rapid patient summaries for quick response.


**GTM and Revenue System :**
We plan to onboard doctors and hospitals through partnerships with **ABDM-integrated healthcare providers**, using **ABHA ID consent-based integration** to ensure secure access. For doctors, the co-pilot will be offered through a **SaaS subscription model** that includes patient summary, conflict-medication detection, and decision-support tools, available for both **individual clinics and hospital networks with tiered pricing based on usage and physician volume.** 


We use a blend of **AI, healthcare standards, and secure cloud systems:**

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TailwindCSS for a clean, fast doctor dashboard
- Backend: Django, PostgreSQL (with vector search), Redis for speed and reliability
- AI Engine: GPT-4,LangChain, and ClinicalBERT for intelligent summarization and pattern detection
- Data Handling: PyMuPDF, Pandas, and FHIR/HL7 for structured processing
- Infrastructure: AWS Lambda and Docker — everything is encrypted, serverless, and temporary
- Security: AES-256 encryption, OAuth 2.0, and full ABDM compliance

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Our** project fits the **Bring Your Own Problem** theme because we **identified** the fragmentation of patient health records as a major barrier to clinical efficiency and safe decision-making, observed firsthand in **real-world care settings**. We developed the Agentic AI Clinical Co-pilot to address this by synthesising a patient’s existing medical history into unified, intelligent clinical insights , highlighting risks, trends, and key context within seconds. Unlike themed hackathons with pre-defined challenges, we defined both the problem and the solution, **reimagining how clinicians interact with health data under the ABDM ecosystem**.

> Smart,proactive disease tracking for public health

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Outbreak Sentinel** is an Agentic AI system that continuously monitors multiple data sources to detect and predict outbreaks in real time. It integrates:

- Pharmacy sales data – sudden spikes in fever medicines, ORS, antibiotics.

- Google Trends & search data – local health-related search surges.
 
- Social media chatter – illness mentions and symptom clusters.
 
- Historical datasets (IDSP, WHO, Kaggle) – for calibration and validation.
 
The AI uses anomaly detection and trend forecasting, then reasons over combined signals. When risk is high, it acts autonomously by generating explainable alerts (*e.g., “3× paracetamol sales + dengue searches spiking in Delhi”*) and notifying health officials instantly.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

## How *Outbreak Sentinel* Fits into the HealthTech Track  

The **HealthTech track** focuses on managing unpredictable patient surges (festivals, pollution spikes, etc.) with AI agents that autonomously analyze data and recommend proactive actions.  
Outbreak Sentinel directly aligns with this vision in the following ways:  

### 1. Early Warning of Surges  
- Monitors **pharmacy sales, Google search spikes, and social media chatter** to detect illness clusters early.  
- Example: Rising paracetamol sales + dengue-related searches in Delhi during monsoon festivals = early signal of patient inflow.  

### 2. Real-Time, Autonomous Analysis  
- Uses **anomaly detection and forecasting** to flag deviations from normal health patterns.  
- Combines multiple signals (sales + searches + chatter + historical datasets) to generate **explainable alerts** for health officials.  

### 3. Direct Relevance to Hospital Readiness  
- Once a risk is detected, the AI can recommend:  
  - **Staffing actions**: e.g., increase emergency room staff in high-risk areas.  
  - **Supply actions**: e.g., stock additional ORS, antibiotics, or respirators.  
  - **Patient advisories**: e.g., issue dengue prevention tips before large gatherings.  

### 4. Addressing Unpredictable Surges  
- **Festivals** → large gatherings, higher infection spread.  
- **Pollution spikes** → respiratory illness surges.  
- Outbreak Sentinel helps **hospitals and public health agencies prepare in advance**, reducing overwhelm and saving lives.

### MRIA-AI Healthcare Companion
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mria-ai-healthcare-companion-b604) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> "Doctors deserve time. Patients deserve presence"

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**MRIA (Medical Retrieval Intelligent Assistant)** — an AI-powered healthcare companion that transforms the way healthcare professionals work.

**The Problem and Need**

- Today, healthcare professionals face excessive workloads, heavy manual documentation, reduced doctor–patient interaction, and scattered medical records. Hospitals operate under corporate pressure, where doctors spend more time on screens and paperwork than with patients. Even with existing software like EPIC, instead of reducing time, it has actually increased the time burden with typing and system navigation.

- Doctors say this "we spend more time with computers and reports than seeing our patients, Asking a lot of questions to our patient, can actually change a lot, but we too doctors are working too much, we also deserve a better life"

- They have larger problems to focus on, such as saving lifes, they spend time creating reports and looking computers, so that they don't face any legal problems in future.

**The Solution we propose : MRIA**

 - It’s an Edge AI device, wearable on a doctor’s collar, that listens to doctor–patient conversations and automatically handles documentation, early diagnosis, and report generation. Instead of typing or writing, everything is done through voice — making healthcare faster, seamless, and natural.

- Nurses and healthcare professionals can also access patient data instantly through MRIA, getting clarity on dosages, case histories, and doctor’s advice — all by just asking it.

- Doctors gain a true personal companion that takes care of repetitive, non-cognitive tasks so they can focus on what matters most: diagnosis, surgeries, and meaningful patient care.

- All data is securely processed within highly protected hospital servers, ensuring privacy and trust.

**The impact:**

- Restores doctor–patient interaction by freeing doctors from screen-time.

- Turns healthcare into a voice-first ecosystem — from manual to typing to now voice-driven.

- Enhances collaboration, as nurses and professionals can access the right information instantly.

In short, **MRIA is not just a tool, but a healthcare AI companion** — working alongside doctors and nurses, reducing their workload, ensuring secure data handling, and bringing back the human connection in healthcare.

**The Overall workflow of MRIA**:

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/2b30d26e96b142788c777231d1e1c614/2d262352-cfc4-4f68-8fed-c013dbe2e802.png)

**The workflow of Multi Agents in MRIA: **

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/2b30d26e96b142788c777231d1e1c614/783ddf12-6379-45ba-9262-1db5a7c356f2.png)

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**MRIA is a proactive healthcare AI companion** that listens, understands, and acts, built to give doctors back their most valuable resource: time.

**Agentic AI:**

- MRIA leverages Agentic AI through a network of specialized agents that autonomously work together to assist healthcare professionals.

- Using LangGraph and LangChain, agents understand doctor–patient conversations, extract medical context, and chain tasks like documentation, report generation, and diagnosis support. Vector databases and memory systems store patient history and knowledge, enabling fast, context-aware retrieval for doctors and nurses.

- Each agent acts autonomously but coordinates seamlessly with others, reducing manual work, improving accuracy, and keeping sensitive data secure on hospital servers.

**Result**

Doctors spend less time on paperwork and more time on patients, improving care and outcomes.

Instead of spending hours typing into hospital systems, doctors can simply talk naturally and MRIA takes care of the rest.

**Description of your solution**

**TeleMed-AI (HOPE)**: *Agentic AI-Powered Emergency Care Platform*

In India, most ambulances serve only as *transport*, leaving over ***80%*** of trauma patients without timely care during the *golden hour*. TeleMed-AI (HOPE) transforms ambulances into intelligent, agentic AI-powered mobile treatment units that perceive, decide, and act autonomously.

***What we build:***
A secure SaaS telemedicine platform (Ambulance PWA + Doctor Dashboard +Agentic AI layer + Secure Backend) that enables live remote consultation, AI assisted triage, and automated hospital pre alerts during patient transport. 

- **Immediate impact:** Treatment instructions can start during transit, increasing chances of 
stabilization during the golden hour and reducing avoidable deterioration. 

- **Quantified pilot impact:** 60–80% reduction in time to first instruction, >95% connection reliability, and paring paramedic cognitive load to a few guided steps   measurable KPIs judges can request. 

*Our multi-agent AI system ensures every emergency gets proactive attention:*

**Triage Agent:** Analyzes vitals & symptoms to prioritize care instantly.

**Summary Agent:** Generates structured, real-time clinical reports.

**Routing Agent:** Connects patients to the most relevant specialists immediately.

**Pre-Alert Agent:** Sends hospital-ready handover packets before arrival.

Through live video, vitals streaming, and AI reasoning, HOPE reduces pre-hospital treatment delays by *60–80%*, ensures >95% connection reliability, and minimizes paramedic workload. It’s not just telemedicine—it’s tele-intelligence on wheels, making emergency care faster, smarter, and lifesaving.

Built with React PWA, WebRTC, and LangChain-driven multi-agent AI, HOPE demonstrates how agentic AI can act proactively in high-stakes scenarios, turning ambulances into autonomous, decision-capable care units.

***TeleMed-AI is India’s first agentic tele-emergency platform, redefining the golden hour.***

Demo: https://youtu.be/AYpx4hIeFSw

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/bb6175d6efce496eb4a33369dccfec05/d70dcb7b-2d5b-4d0f-84f0-657fbee211c6.png)

**Our Tech Stack :**

***Ambulance Client:*** React PWA, simple forms for vitals/symptoms, WebRTC (Daily/Twilio) for video.

***Doctor Dashboard:*** React + Vite, WebRTC + Socket.IO, displays AI summaries, vitals, and video.

***Backend:*** Node.js + Express, SQLite or PostgreSQL, Socket.IO for real-time messages.

***Agentic AI Layer:*** LangChain + OpenAI GPT (cloud-only), Agents: Triage, Summary, Routing.

***Security:*** HTTPS, basic auth for demo.

***Deployment:*** Vercel/Render/Railway for frontend & backend, public URLs for live demo.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, **TeleMed-AI**, directly addresses a critical gap in emergency healthcare delivery: *the lack of real-time treatment during patient transport*. In India and many parts of the world, ambulances often lack onboard doctors, leading to a dangerous delay in care during the “golden hour” the period when immediate intervention can save lives.
We’re building a software-based telemedicine platform that turns ambulances into mobile treatment units. Paramedics use our system to instantly connect with remote doctors through secure video calls, while an integrated AI assistant processes patient vitals, triages emergencies, and assists both doctor and paramedic with real-time clinical decision support.
By accelerating diagnosis and enabling early intervention before the patient reaches the hospital, TeleMed-AI improves survival rates, reduces complications, and bridges healthcare access gaps especially in underserved or rural areas. It’s a transformative solution for pre-hospital emergency care and a perfect fit for the Healthcare track.

**Description of your solution**

BreatheAI is a clever, **agentic AI system** that serves as a **personal air quality advisor** and a community health **infoline** . To keep individuals safe, it tracks the environment continuously (such as AQI, pollen, humidity) and by itself makes health suggestions that are very close to the real situation and also very personalized. However, in clinics, it helps in the preparation of patient surges through pollution. 

BreatheAI is different from the static apps as it works as an **independent** agent. It senses the environment, thinks about the impact, selects the appropriate actions, and communicates with users - all without a manual input, intervention, or command.

**🛠️ How It Works (Agentic AI in Action)**

BreatheAI operates on a modular agent-based architecture with four major agents:

1. 🛰️ **Environment Agent (Perception)**
**Role**: Continuously fetches real-time environmental data using open APIs (e.g.,          OpenWeatherMap, AirVisual, Pollen.com).
**Goal**: Understand current external conditions like:
- AQI (Air Quality Index)
- Pollen Count
- Humidity and Temperature
**Technologies used:**
- Python for scripting
- requests library to fetch data
- OpenWeatherMap API, AirVisual API, and Pollen.com API to get:
   AQI (Air Quality Index)
   Pollen Count
   Humidity & Temperature
**Data Handling:**
- Parsed using json
- Stored or displayed using Pandas 


2. 🧠 **Health Reasoning Agent (LLM-Powered AI)**
**Role**: Uses AI to reason about how the current air conditions might impact the user’s health (e.g., energy levels, breathing difficulty, allergy risk).
**Input**: Environmental data + user profile (e.g., asthma, allergies)
**Output**: Predicts symptoms and health risks
**Tool Use**: Uses a language model (e.g., GPT-4 or open-source LLM) to generate insights


3. 📋 **Planner Agent**
Role: Generates a daily health plan from the AI's analysis.
Technologies used:
- Python logic or LLM-generated plans
- Decision rules: If AQI > 150 → suggest mask; If pollen is high + allergy = warn user
- Output formatted with Markdown or HTML for display in the UI


4. 📣 **Notifier Agent (Frontend + Delivery)**
**Role**: Displays all results to the user through a simple and clean interface.
Could also notify hospitals about upcoming patient surges
**Technologies used:**
- Streamlit for rapid, beginner-friendly web app development
- Plotly for interactive graphs (e.g., Lung Health Score trends)
- Session state to store user inputs and daily logs
- Optionally: SendGrid or Twilio (future) for SMS/email alerts
UI Elements:
- Live AQI & Pollen indicators
- Personalized recommendations section
- Lung Health Score (0–100)
- History/Trend graphs

5. 📊 **Community Health Agent**
**Role**: Uses regional data to forecast possible patient surges in nearby clinics.
**Technologies used:**
- Simulated hospital intake data + environmental API data
- Pandas + Matplotlib for trend analysis
- Basic scikit-learn regression model to predict likely surge days
- Can display warnings in a dashboard heatmap or alert box

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Our project, BreatheAI, fits into the Healthtech: Agentic AI track because it applies agentic AI principles to help users proactively manage their respiratory health based on real-time environmental conditions.**

We structure BreatheAI into simple agents that work together like a full agent loop:

1. **Environment Agent** – Autonomously fetches and updates AQI, pollen, and humidity data via APIs.

2. **Health Reasoning Agent** – Uses if-else logic or prompt-based logic or basic LLM calls to assess how the environment may impact the user’s health..

3. **Planner Agent** – Suggests actions based on health risk, like “Stay indoors,” “Use an inhaler,” or “Avoid jogging.”

4. **Notifier Agent** – Delivers results in an interactive web app (Streamlit dashboard).

5. **Feedback Agent** – Could take in user input (e.g., “I felt shortness of breath today”) to refine future advice.

Each of these agents performs its role autonomously, based on a shared goal — protecting health — and can operate in a loop without needing constant user input.


**Track Alignment**

- **Healthtech**: Directly addresses air quality–related health problems like asthma, fatigue, allergies, and hospital surges.
- **Agentic AI**: Uses a multi-agent structure where each component can perceive, reason, and act toward a health-related goal — even with simple tools.
- **Beginner-Friendly**: We intentionally avoided complex models or advanced infrastructure, showing that agentic AI concepts can be built by first-year students using accessible tools like Python, APIs, logic, and Streamlit.


With **BreatheAI**, users gain personalized, **AI-driven protection from environmental health risks**, and eventually, hospitals could get early warnings about pollution-linked surges in respiratory cases. Most importantly, we prove that powerful, real-world Healthtech tools can be created by beginners using agentic AI principles.

Unpredictable patient surges → Predictive algorithms forecast demand spikes by department and time of day.

Integration API: Licensing for EHR/CRM providers to embed agentic modules.

Predictive Insights Marketplace: Paid analytics for partner hospitals on patient trends, seasonal surges, and staffing benchmarks.

To transform hospital management from manual dashboards to autonomous, predictive ecosystems where AI agents continuously balance patient load, staff capacity, and operational efficiency.

**Description of your solution**

## NabhaSeva: Solution Overview

### The Core Goal

The core goal is to provide **accessible, affordable, and real-time healthcare** by bridging the distance and connectivity gap between rural patients, the Civil Hospital's limited staff, and local pharmacies.

***

### Key Functional Pillars

The solution is built on five critical pillars, two of which are powered by **Agentic AI** for autonomous decision-making:

* **1. Resilient Teleconsultation:**
    * **Multilingual (Punjabi, Hindi, English, etc.)** app interface for patients.
    * Features high-quality **video calls** with an automatic **audio-only fallback** for low-bandwidth areas, directly addressing the 31% rural internet access reality.

* **2. Autonomous Scheduling (The 'Scheduling Boss' Agent):**
    * An **Agentic AI** that automatically **triage patients** based on symptom severity to assign an **Urgency Score**.
    * It **autonomously routes** high-priority cases to the next available doctor (local Civil Hospital staff or remote volunteer specialist), ensuring the efficient use of the severely understaffed hospital.

* **3. Offline Digital Health Records (Patient Wallet):**
    * Allows patients to securely store their medical history and prescriptions **offline** on their device.
    * Uses **QR-code based portability** for easy, secure sharing with any doctor or pharmacy, regardless of current internet connectivity.

* **4. Guaranteed Medicine Access (The 'Meds Runner' Agent):**
    * An **Agentic AI** that converts a doctor’s digital prescription into a **guaranteed pick-up plan**.
    * It **autonomously checks** the Real-Time Pharmacy Stock database, finds the closest pharmacy with **100% fulfillment capability**, and **reserves the stock** for the patient, notifying them with a pick-up QR code to eliminate wasted travel.

* **5. Proactive Community Health (The Epidemic Detector):**
    * A system that aggregates patient symptom reports and uses **clustering (K-Means)** to detect potential disease outbreaks (e.g., Typhoid, Flu).
    * Data **refreshes every 3 days** to provide a crucial early alert system for the Punjab Health Department and Civil Hospital administration.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

## 🌐 Tracks Applied for NabhaSeva

| Track / Category | Applied | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **HealthTech** | Primary Track | The solution directly enhances **rural healthcare delivery**, diagnosis, and prescription fulfillment using technology, which is the core of HealthTech. |
| **Software** | Primary Category | The entire solution is a full-stack, end-to-end software platform involving mobile applications (Android), web portals, robust **APIs (Spring Boot)**, and specialized **microservices** (for AI). |
| **AI/ML** | Secondary Track | Central to the solution via the AI Symptom Checker, the Epidemic Detector (K-Means Clustering), and the two new **Agentic AI systems** (The 'Scheduling Boss' and The 'Meds Runner'). |

**Description of your solution**

**CareFund** is an **agentic AI platform** that forecasts short-term healthcare-spending *scenarios* for gig workers and recommends transparent, user-approved financial-readiness actions.

The system ingests environmental data (AQI, weather, outbreak alerts) and optional user-consented health indicators (wearable or clinic data) to estimate *probabilistic health-risk and spending scenarios*.  
Unlike static rule-based alerts, CareFund’s **multi-agent loop** continuously plans and adapts:

> Data ingestion → Feature extraction → Prophet forecasting → Agentic decision node (LangGraph) → Financial simulation → User approval → Feedback learning

Each agent autonomously **simulates or recommends** micro-savings plans, rebalances funds, and triggers alerts or policy-readiness recommendations.  
All actions are **user-approved, transparent, and compliant** with India’s *Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023* — ensuring consent, explainability, and verifiability at every step.

For the hackathon MVP, CareFund uses open datasets, public AQI APIs, and Indian fintech sandboxes (RazorpayX / Setu) to demonstrate how Agentic AI reasoning can help gig workers build predictive, safe financial buffers against medical shocks.

**Mission:**  
> Reduce out-of-pocket medical debt for middle-income gig households by **20 % within 5 years** through early insight and preparedness.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

CareFund addresses the *healthcare-preparedness gap* that leaves uninsured citizens financially vulnerable during medical events.  
It forecasts probabilistic **health-risk and healthcare-spending scenarios** using environmental and outbreak data, enabling users to take *preventive action* before illness strikes.  
By giving gig workers explainable forecasts and preparation guidance, CareFund acts as a **personal health-readiness assistant** — a proactive layer of healthcare intelligence rather than a post-treatment solution.  
Its focus on *health-risk prediction* and *resilience building* makes it a strong fit for the **Healthtech** track.

Our project **"Aस्पताल”** aims to solve one of the biggest challenges hospitals face, managing sudden patient surges during festivals, pandemics, or emergencies. Often, hospitals run out of beds, staff, or medical supplies because there’s no proper coordination or predictive system in place.

To tackle this, we’ve built an AI-powered hospital network platform that connects multiple hospitals under one system. It shows **real-time availability of beds, ICUs, staff, ambulances, and supplies**, helping authorities make quick decisions. 🩺 Description of Our Solution – **Health Robo**

Health Robo is an innovative, solar-powered digital health companion designed to make healthcare accessible, affordable, and intelligent for everyone. Acting as a personal medical assistant, it integrates multiple health monitoring and diagnostic features into a single compact unit powered by a Raspberry Pi microcontroller.

The device connects with various medical sensors to measure blood pressure, sugar level, heart rate, oxygen (SpO₂), and body temperature, while its built-in AI camera system analyzes facial expressions, eyes, and skin tone to detect potential health issues.

Using AI-based image recognition and data analytics, Health Robo generates a comprehensive health profile for each user. It communicates real-time insights through a voice assistant, offering personalized health advice, daily fitness reminders, and preventive care recommendations based on ongoing readings.

To ensure inclusivity and sustainability, Health Robo runs on solar power, making it ideal for rural or remote regions with limited electricity or medical infrastructure. Users can sync their health data to a mobile app or cloud dashboard, enabling doctors and family members to remotely track health trends and receive instant alerts in case of abnormalities.

In essence, Health Robo bridges the gap between technology and healthcare, empowering individuals to monitor, manage, and improve their health anytime, anywhere.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

⚙ How Our Project Fits Into the Track

Health Robo perfectly aligns with the HealthTech – Leveraging Agentic AI track because it combines intelligent automation, real-time health insights, and decision-making AI to enhance personal healthcare.

Our project leverages Agentic AI — an advanced form of artificial intelligence that can perceive, reason, and act autonomously — to transform traditional health monitoring into a proactive, personalized health management system.

Here’s how it fits:

🧠 Autonomous Health Decisions:
The agentic AI in Health Robo continuously monitors vital health data, detects irregular patterns, and automatically generates personalized health recommendations — all without user intervention.

🎙 Intelligent Interaction:
Through an integrated AI voice assistant, the system provides real-time feedback, answers user queries, and offers medical guidance — acting as a virtual healthcare companion.

📊 Adaptive Learning:
The AI learns from user habits, daily routines, and medical history to predict potential health risks and dynamically adjust reminders or advice — demonstrating true agentic behavior.

🌍 Impact in HealthTech:
Health Robo brings accessible, data-driven healthcare through the synergy of AI and IoT, empowering users even in rural or underserved regions. It showcases how agentic intelligence can extend the reach of healthcare and promote preventive health awareness.

In essence, Health Robo doesn’t just collect data — it thinks, learns, and acts to support and improve human health, making it a perfect fit for the HealthTech Agentic AI track.

**Description of your solution**

Project Name:

CareCompanion – AI Health Companion for Elderly

Track:

HealthTech

Problem Statement:

Elderly individuals often struggle with medication adherence, reporting symptoms, or tracking daily health activities. Caregivers and doctors lack real-time visibility, leading to delayed interventions and avoidable health risks.

Solution Description:

CareCompanion is a mobile-first Agentic AI system that monitors elderly users’ health and daily activities. Users can update their status via a simple mobile app or voice commands. The AI agent proactively detects anomalies, sends reminders, alerts caregivers or doctors, and adapts recommendations based on individual habits. A web dashboard allows family and healthcare providers to view real-time health data, medication adherence, and AI-generated insights.

Future Vision:
CareCompanion will evolve into a full Alexa-style voice-first assistant, enabling hands-free interaction, multi-device integration (smart speakers, wearables, IoT sensors), and personalized conversational guidance for proactive elderly care.

Key Features:

Mobile app with voice and tap inputs for medication and symptom updates

AI agent analyzes health data and acts proactively (reminders, alerts, suggestions)

React web dashboard for caregiver/family monitoring

Adaptive AI that learns user habits and adjusts notifications and recommendations

Technologies:

Frontend: React Native / React PWA (mobile), React + Tailwind (dashboard)

Backend: Node.js + Express

Database: MongoDB

AI Agent: LangChain + GPT-5 API for proactive decision-making

Voice & Notifications: Web Speech API, Whisper API, Firebase Cloud Messaging / Twilio

Target Audience:

Elderly individuals (60+) living independently

Family caregivers and doctors monitoring multiple patients

Revenue Model / GTM:

B2C: Subscription for families for real-time monitoring and AI companion services

B2B: Hospitals or senior living facilities subscribing for patient monitoring dashboards

Partnerships with wearable manufacturers for integrated offerings

Impact:

Reduces missed medications and health emergencies

Provides caregivers peace of mind

Enables seniors to live independently while staying safe

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

areCompanion directly addresses a key challenge in healthcare continuous elderly care and proactive health monitoring. The project uses Agentic AI to track an elderly user’s health data, medication schedules, and daily well-being through a simple mobile app and voice interface. The AI agent analyzes patterns, detects health anomalies, sends timely reminders, and alerts caregivers or doctors when needed. This makes healthcare preventive, personalized, and accessible, especially for seniors living independently. By empowering families and healthcare providers with real-time insights and proactive alerts, CareCompanion perfectly aligns with the HealthTech goal of improving health outcomes through intelligent technology.

**Description of your solution**

**The Problem We're Solving**
India's **700,000+** AYUSH practitioners are digitally isolated from the national healthcare ecosystem. While the government mandates ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) integration for "One Nation, One Health Record," AYUSH systems use NAMASTE codes while modern medicine uses ICD-11 codes-creating a critical interoperability gap.

**The Impact:**
- ₹12,000Cr in annual insurance claim rejections due to unrecognized AYUSH coding
- 46% of AYUSH insurance claims are rejected outright
- Patients undergo duplicate tests when switching between AYUSH and allopathic care
- 83Cr ABHA users cannot access unified health records that include AYUSH treatments

**Our Solution: Intelligent Dual-Coding API with Autonomous Agent Layer**
We're building a FHIR R4-compliant microservice that seamlessly integrates AYUSH (NAMASTE codes) with modern medicine (ICD-11) through a plug-and-play API for India's 500+ EMR vendors.

**Core Architecture**
Layer 1: Fast Mapping API
- Pre-built database with 4,500+ validated NAMASTE ↔ ICD-11 mappings
- <30ms response time for real-time code translation
- FHIR-compliant output that works with any EMR system
- Redis caching for 99.9% uptime even during WHO API failures
- OAuth 2.0 + ABHA authentication for secure patient data handling

Layer 2: Autonomous Intelligence (The Agentic AI Innovation)
This is where we go beyond traditional APIs. Four specialized AI agents work continuously in the background:

Agent 1 - Mapping Maintenance Agent:
- Monitors WHO ICD-11 updates and Ministry of AYUSH code releases 24/7
- Autonomously detects new codes and generates candidate mappings using semantic analysis
- Auto-updates the database with high-confidence mappings (>95% confidence score)
- Escalates ambiguous cases to human review queue with suggested alternatives
- Why it's agentic: Makes independent decisions on which mappings to approve vs. escalate

Agent 2 - Quality Assurance Agent:
- Analyzes patterns in 100,000+ daily API requests
- Learns from doctor corrections when they override suggested mappings
- Detects inconsistencies (e.g., same NAMASTE code mapped differently by different hospitals)
- Self-adjusts confidence scores based on usage patterns
- Why it's agentic: Continuously learns and improves without manual retraining

Agent 3 - Claims Intelligence Agent:
- Monitors insurance claim approval/rejection patterns across all integrated hospitals
- Identifies which code combinations have higher approval rates
- Proactively alerts practitioners: "This mapping has 80% rejection rate—here's an alternative"
- Optimizes dual-code suggestions for maximum claim success
- Why it's agentic: Takes proactive actions to prevent rejections before they happen

Agent 4 - Interoperability Orchestrator:
- Monitors system health across WHO APIs, ABDM services, and EMR integrations
- Auto-scales API capacity during high-demand periods (festival seasons, epidemics)
- Self-heals infrastructure issues and manages failover logic
- Optimizes cache warming based on predicted usage patterns
- Why it's agentic: Makes operational decisions autonomously without human intervention

**How It Works in Practice**

**For a Doctor:**
- Types Ayurvedic diagnosis in EMR → API instantly returns NAMASTE code + ICD-11 equivalent
- Both codes auto-populate in patient record (FHIR-compliant format)
- If Agent 3 detects low approval probability, doctor gets real-time alert with better alternatives

Meanwhile, Behind the Scenes:
- Agent 1 checks if recent WHO updates affect this mapping
- Agent 2 learns from doctor's acceptance/rejection of the suggested code
- Agent 3 analyzes if this combination will pass insurance review
- Agent 4 ensures <30ms response time and system reliability

Key Differentiators

**Technical Innovation**

- First NAMASTE ↔ ICD-11 translation API in India
- Multi-agent system that gets smarter with every API call (network effects)
- Pre-built mapping database (competitors would need 6+ months to replicate)

**Business Model Clarity**

- B2B SaaS to 500+ EMR vendors (₹5K-1L/month based on hospital size)
- Transaction fees for insurance claim validation (₹2-5 per claim)
- Data licensing for de-identified AYUSH outcomes research

**Impact at Scale**

- Enables ₹4,800 Cr in insurance claim approvals (40% reduction in rejections)
- Integrates 700,000 AYUSH practitioners into ABDM ecosystem
- Saves patients ₹500-1,000 annually through reduced duplicate testing


**Technology Stack**

- Backend: Fastify (Node.js), PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis
- AI Agents: LangGraph orchestration, fine-tuned Llama 3.1 70B, Pinecone RAG
- Compliance: FHIR R4, WHO ICD-11 API, ABDM SDK, ISO 22600 audit trails
- Security: OAuth 2.0, AES-256 encryption, TLS 1.3

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project addresses healthcare interoperability, one of the most critical challenges in India's digital health transformation. Here's why it's quintessentially Healthtech:

1. Solves Core Healthcare Data Problem
Healthcare systems are only as good as their ability to share information. Currently, 700,000 AYUSH practitioners and 500+ EMR vendors cannot communicate effectively because they speak different "languages" (NAMASTE vs. ICD-11 codes). This isn't just an IT problem—it's a patient safety issue:

Patients switching from AYUSH to allopathic care undergo duplicate diagnostics
Doctors lack complete medical history when AYUSH treatments aren't in standard format
Emergency situations are complicated when past AYUSH treatments are undocumented

2. Enables Government Healthcare Mandate
The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is India's flagship healthcare initiative to create "One Nation, One Health Record" for 83 Cr citizens. However, AYUSH practitioners-who represent a significant portion of India's healthcare workforce-are currently excluded because of coding incompatibility. Our solution directly enables:

ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) integration for AYUSH patients
FHIR R4-compliant health records that work across traditional and modern medicine
Real-time health data exchange as mandated by National Digital Health Blueprint

3. Addresses Healthcare Economics

₹12,000 Cr in rejected insurance claims annually due to coding issues
Our solution reduces rejections by 40%, unlocking ₹4,800 Cr for AYUSH practitioners and patients
Reduces healthcare costs through elimination of duplicate diagnostic procedures

4. Scalable Healthcare Impact
Unlike consumer health apps or hospital-specific solutions, we're building healthcare infrastructure that benefits:

Patients: Unified health records, reduced costs, better continuity of care
Practitioners: Faster documentation, higher insurance approvals, ABDM compliance
Insurance: Reduced fraud, standardized claims, lower operational costs
Government: Real-time AYUSH morbidity data for evidence-based policymaking
Researchers: De-identified AYUSH outcomes data for clinical studies

Standard Healthtech problem statements focus on predictive models (hospital surge prediction). While valuable, we're solving a more fundamental issue: making healthcare systems talk to each other. This is infrastructure-level innovation that enables all other digital health solutions to work better.
this problem statement  has been validated by the Government of India (Smart India Hackathon 2025 - Problem Statement 25026), proving this is a priority healthcare challenge, not a theoretical exercise.

Sorea is a safe, stigma-free mental health companion that blends AI-guided reflection with community support, enabling young adults to express themselves without judgment.

Sorea bridges the gap between personal emotional expression and accessible support through:

**Description of your solution**

PulseConnect – “Connecting Your Health Needs in One Tap” is created with the heart of a companion rather than just another health app. In many homes, especially where elders live alone or families are busy, small things like forgetting a tablet or not knowing which hospital to visit can turn into serious problems. PulseConnect acts like a gentle reminder and a helping hand — it reminds users to take their medicines on time, even without internet, making sure no one feels lost in their treatment journey.

In moments of panic or need, it helps users quickly find nearby government or private hospitals based on their location, bringing hope and direction when it matters the most. To make sure language never becomes a barrier to care, PulseConnect allows people to ask health-related questions in the language they understand and feel comfortable with, giving simple and clear guidance without confusing medical terms. By bringing reminders, hospital access, easy appointment guidance, and friendly language support into one simple platform, PulseConnect feels less like a tool and more like a caring companion — making healthcare feel reachable, reassuring, and truly human.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

PulseConnect fits inside the HealthTech track as it relies on AI/mobility technology to assist with the challenges of healthcare delivery. The medication reminders, online appointment scheduling, hospital locator along with a multilingual health chatbot make it easier for patients to stay healthy and engaged with their healthcare. Its offline capability effectively supports healthcare for underprivileged and remote communities. This closes the divide between patients and providers and ensures inclusive, connected healthcare.

**Description of your solution**

## CuraLink: Your Complete AI Healthcare Companion

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/22412f4d-7601-495c-8ae0-cf3337ef5ae1.png)
### What CuraLink Actually Does

CuraLink is basically an intelligent healthcare platform that acts as a bridge between patients and doctors. Think of it as having a really smart medical assistant that never sleeps, speaks your language, and can help make sense of your health concerns before you even reach a doctor.

### The Patient Experience

When you're not feeling well, you can open CuraLink and just explain what's wrong - in Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, or whatever language you're most comfortable with. You don't need to know fancy medical terms. Just say "मुझे बुखार है और सिर दर्द हो रहा है" (I have fever and headache) and the system gets it.

You can also upload things like:
- Lab test reports you don't understand
- Pictures of medicines you found at home
- X-rays or scan images
- Old prescriptions
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/d25309f4-e9c9-4b57-8027-4b76d88fdde9.png)
The AI looks at everything you've shared, connects the dots, and helps figure out what might be going on. But here's the key - it doesn't just give you a diagnosis and send you on your way. A real doctor reviews everything and confirms whether the AI's assessment makes sense.



### Making Healthcare Feel Less Scary

One cool thing about CuraLink is that it turns taking care of yourself into something actually enjoyable. You get daily health challenges - maybe drink 8 glasses of water, take a 20-minute walk, or eat more fruits. Complete them, and you earn coins. Maintain streaks, and you get bonus rewards. These coins aren't just for show - you can use them for discounts on medical services or consultations.

It's like having a fitness app, but for your overall health, and it's connected to actual medical care.

### For Doctors: A Smart Assistant

If you're a doctor using CuraLink, it's designed to save you time. Instead of spending 15 minutes just gathering basic information from a patient, you see a well-organized summary when they arrive:
- Symptoms already translated and structured
- Risk factors highlighted
- Relevant medical history pulled up
- Initial diagnostic possibilities suggested with reasoning

You can review the AI's work, add your expertise, order tests, or adjust the diagnosis. The AI handles the grunt work; you handle the medical judgment. It's not trying to replace you - it's trying to give you superpowers.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/b752bb06-f4dd-44a0-9cad-ef58f9b31fa5.png)
### The Tech Behind the Scenes


**Multiple AI specialists working together** - Instead of one AI trying to do everything (and probably messing up), CuraLink has different AI agents that are really good at specific things. One handles translation, another analyzes symptoms, another checks medical research, and so on. They all report to a coordinator who brings everything together.

**Built with modern, reliable tech** - The interface is smooth and fast (Next.js and React), everything's secure with proper authentication (Google login), and your medical data is encrypted and stored safely in a proper database (MongoDB).

**Powered by Google's AI** - The understanding and reasoning capabilities come from Google's Generative AI, orchestrated through LangChain to make sure all the agents work together properly.

### What Makes CuraLink Different

**It speaks your language** - literally. Over 10 Indian languages supported, because healthcare shouldn't require you to be fluent in English.

**It's comprehensive** - not just symptom checking. Medicine identification, lab report analysis, medical image interpretation, nutrition advice - it's all there.

**It keeps you engaged** - through gamification and rewards, it encourages you to actually take care of yourself before problems get serious.

**It's safe and trustworthy** - doctor validation on every diagnosis, encrypted data, proper authentication, and full audit trails of everything that happens.

### Real-World Impact

Imagine a patient in a small town who's been feeling unwell but doesn't know if it's serious enough to travel hours to see a specialist. They use CuraLink, describe their symptoms in their local language, upload whatever reports they have, and within minutes get a preliminary assessment. If it's urgent, they know they need to go immediately. If it's manageable, they get guidance and can follow up locally.

Or picture an overworked doctor in a busy urban clinic seeing 50+ patients daily. With CuraLink, each patient consultation is faster and more informed because the basic diagnostic work is already done, organized, and presented clearly.

### Architecture

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/53584db6-9c39-4403-a961-f201f8a2a019.png)

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

# Why CuraLink is a Perfect HealthTech Agentic AI Project

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/d827eaa2-8248-4210-a283-8b458e7c3fb4.png)
### It's Built Like a Digital Medical Team

Think of CuraLink as having multiple AI "specialists" working together, just like doctors in a hospital consult with each other. Each AI agent has its own job:

- One agent focuses on understanding what patients say in their local language
- Another takes those symptoms and organizes them into proper medical terms
- There's an agent that digs through medical research to find relevant information
- One checks how risky the situation might be based on the patient's background
- Another brings all these pieces together into a clear diagnosis
- And a coordinator makes sure everyone's working in sync

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/2c0bb605-4a8e-4414-8fef-ccb25b0c8847.png)
This teamwork approach is what makes it truly "agentic" - these aren't just separate tools, they're AI agents that communicate and collaborate.

### Solving Real Problems in Indian Healthcare

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/d306a00a-cd6e-4096-a8d8-fec5eb58864a.png)
What makes this project special for the HealthTech track is how it tackles actual challenges people face:

**The language problem is huge** - imagine being sick but struggling to explain your symptoms because the doctor doesn't speak your language. CuraLink breaks down that wall by letting patients describe how they feel in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, or whatever language they're comfortable with.

**Doctors are stretched thin** - there simply aren't enough doctors to go around, especially in rural areas. These AI agents act as intelligent assistants, doing the groundwork so doctors can focus on what matters most - making the final call on treatment.

**Making advanced healthcare accessible** - things like analyzing X-rays or interpreting complex lab reports usually require specialists. CuraLink brings those capabilities to places where such expertise might not be readily available.

### The Smart Part: How the Agents Actually Work

The team used LangChain to wire these agents together, which is pretty clever. Each agent can think through its task, gather information, and pass insights to the next agent in line. It's not just a simple "input-output" system - there's actual reasoning happening at each step.

For example, when someone describes chest pain, the symptom analyzer doesn't just flag "chest pain" - it considers the context, related symptoms, and structures everything in a way that the next agents can work with. The risk assessor then looks at age, medical history, and other factors to gauge urgency.

### Keeping Humans in Control

Here's what prevents this from being just another "AI will replace doctors" project - every diagnosis goes through a real doctor for validation. The AI does the heavy lifting, but doctors make the final decisions. That's responsible AI design in healthcare.

### Beyond Just Diagnosis

The project goes further by gamifying health habits - turning wellness into something engaging rather than a chore. Users complete health challenges, maintain streaks, earn rewards. It's using behavioral psychology alongside clinical AI, which shows a holistic understanding of healthcare.

### Why It Matters for Agentic AI

This project showcases what agentic AI is really about:
- **Autonomy** - each agent handles its domain independently
- **Collaboration** - they work together toward a common goal
- **Adaptability** - the system can incorporate new information and adjust
- **Tool use** - agents actively use different tools (translation, image analysis, database queries)
- **Goal-oriented** - everything aims toward accurate, helpful diagnosis

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/b3b57a8577034a24ac59b31eac6a9943/a27dd366-4516-4915-b01d-d57c6e8ba306.png)
Instead of building one massive AI model trying to do everything, the team created a system where specialized agents complement each other's strengths. That's smart architecture and exactly what the agentic AI movement is pushing toward.

The fact that it's tailored for India's healthcare ecosystem - with multilingual support, gamification for a population that might be new to digital health, and integration with local payment systems - shows they're not just building cool tech, they're solving meaningful problems with appropriate solutions.

**Description of your solution**

Imagine if hospitals could predict patient surges before they happen and act on them instantly.
We’re building an AI-powered Patient Surge Management System that helps hospitals do exactly that: predict, prepare for, and prevent patient overloads before they occur.

Our solution runs on a multi-agent AI ecosystem that continuously monitors diverse real-world signals from hospital admission trends to weather, air quality, local events, and disease outbreaks. Using this data, our system forecasts patient inflow across departments like Emergency, ICU, and OPD days in advance.

When a surge is predicted, the platform automatically optimizes staff allocation, supply chains, and resource distribution, while generating real-time advisories for hospital administrators and even patients.

Behind the scenes, specialized AI agents a Forecast Agent, Resource Optimizer, and Advisory Generator work together under a central AI Orchestrator for seamless coordination.
All insights are presented through a secure, intuitive dashboard built with React and FastAPI, giving decision-makers a clear view of forecasts, alerts, and operational KPIs.

Our vision is to move healthcare from reactive crisis management to proactive operational readiness helping hospitals save time, cut costs, and ultimately, save more lives.
