### CleanBill
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cleanbill-e762) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hacknauts-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacknauts.devfolio.co)

> Transparent Healthcare Billing

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Healthcare billing in India is often confusing, opaque, and vulnerable to overcharging. Patients and their families frequently receive bills with inflated prices, duplicate entries, or unnecessary tests, yet they lack the knowledge or tools to verify whether these charges are justified.
CleanBill solves this problem by allowing users to scan or upload their hospital bill and instantly check it against standard government medical rate lists (PM-JAY, CGHS, NPPA). The system highlights possible overpricing, flags suspicious charges, and generates a ready-to-use transparency report.

People can use CleanBill to:

Verify if their hospital bill is fair and accurate

Detect duplicate, inflated, or unnecessary charges

Understand government-approved pricing for tests, procedures and medicines

Get clarity before paying large medical bills

Share the report with insurance companies or health authorities for dispute redressal

CleanBill makes medical billing safer, more transparent, and stress-free, empowering patients to make informed financial decisions during emergencies.

**Challenges we ran into**

The problem it solves

Healthcare billing in India is often confusing, opaque, and vulnerable to overcharging. Patients and their families frequently receive bills with inflated prices, duplicate entries, or unnecessary tests, yet they lack the knowledge or tools to verify whether these charges are justified.
CleanBill solves this problem by allowing users to scan or upload their hospital bill and instantly check it against standard government medical rate lists (PM-JAY, CGHS, NPPA). The system highlights possible overpricing, flags suspicious charges, and generates a ready-to-use transparency report.

People can use CleanBill to:

Verify if their hospital bill is fair and accurate

Detect duplicate, inflated, or unnecessary charges

Understand government-approved pricing for tests, procedures and medicines

Get clarity before paying large medical bills

Share the report with insurance companies or health authorities for dispute redressal

CleanBill makes medical billing safer, more transparent, and stress-free, empowering patients to make informed financial decisions during emergencies.

✅ Challenges I ran into

Building CleanBill presented several technical and real-world challenges:

1. Extracting Accurate Data from Bills

Hospital bills come in different formats—printed, typed, and handwritten. Bad handwriting and non-standard layouts made OCR accuracy difficult.
Solution: We improved text extraction using pre-processing (contrast enhancement, noise removal) and fallbacks that allow users to manually correct extracted data when OCR confidence is low.

2. No Public API for Government Medical Rates

Government-approved medical rates exist mostly in PDFs, not via API.
Solution: We extracted data directly from official PM-JAY, CGHS, and NPPA PDFs, converting them into a structured JSON database for fast comparison.

3. Comparing Inconsistent Naming Conventions

Hospitals often use slightly different names for the same test (e.g., “CBC Test” vs “Complete Blood Count”).
Solution: We built a synonym mapping system + fuzzy matching to ensure accurate comparison.

4. Maintaining Medical Transparency Without Giving Medical Advice

We had to ensure that the app does not interfere with diagnosis, only with pricing transparency.
Solution: We limited suggestions strictly to cost analysis and publicly available government rates.

5. Time Constraints of a Hackathon

Building an OCR-based medical billing checker with a complete UI in short time was challenging.
Solution: We focused on the MVP — bill scanning, rate comparison, fraud detection logic — and optimized our workflow with modular development.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/healthpulse-pro-9474) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Sharmamayankkkk/KodeKalesh-2.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://kode-kalesh-2.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-KodeKalesh%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://kodekalesh-2025.devfolio.co)

> Transform Healthcare with Intelligent Insights

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![React hook form](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20hook%20form-333333?style=flat-square) ![Radix UI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Radix%20UI-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

### The Problem It Solves

HealthPulse Pro addresses the critical "data-to-insight bottleneck" faced by clinicians in modern healthcare. Clinicians are often overwhelmed by a high volume of patient-generated data from disparate sources, including traditional clinical data (vitals, labs, medications) and new data from wearables (blood pressure, glucose, diet, activity).

This data is often delivered asynchronously, is unverified, and lacks standardization, creating a "signal-to-noise" problem. This overload makes it nearly impossible for healthcare professionals to:
* Detect subtle patient deteriorations early.
* Correlate lifestyle factors with clinical outcomes.
* Intervene effectively before a patient's condition becomes acute.

This bottleneck contributes to significant negative outcomes, including delayed interventions, clinician burnout, patient safety risks, and high rates of preventable hospital readmissions, which cost Medicare $26 billion annually. Clinicians also spend nearly half (49%) of their workday on EHR documentation, further limiting proactive monitoring.

### What People Can Use It For (How It Makes Tasks Easier/Safer)

HealthPulse Pro is an AI-powered clinical intelligence platform designed to transform this reactive healthcare environment into one of proactive intelligence. It makes tasks easier and safer by integrating multiple data streams (EHR, wearables, and lifestyle data) and using AI-assisted analysis to provide actionable insights to clinicians.

The platform is designed to detect subtle deterioration patterns 6-12 hours before a critical clinical event occurs.

Key uses and benefits include:

* **Centralized Patient Management:** Clinicians can use a comprehensive dashboard to view patient records, real-time vital signs, lab results, and medical history all in one place.
* **AI-Powered Clinical Analysis:** The system uses Google's Gemini AI to provide intelligent insights, such as contextual patient summaries, risk assessments, and treatment recommendations, helping clinicians make faster, more accurate decisions.
* **Proactive Smart Alerts:** Instead of just simple threshold alerts, the system generates real-time, AI-powered notifications for critical patient conditions, helping to reduce medical errors and support early intervention.
* **Data-Driven Analytics:** The platform provides visual dashboards and trend analysis, allowing clinicians to easily track patient data and identify patterns.
* **Improved Efficiency and Safety:** By streamlining workflows, automating analysis, and providing decision support, the platform helps clinicians save time, reduce burnout, and minimize the risk of medical errors.

**Challenges we ran into**

### 1. Dependency Conflicts with React 19
* **Hurdle:** We chose to build the project on a modern, cutting-edge tech stack, including Next.js 16 and React 19. This led to a significant hurdle with dependency management, as many existing libraries had not yet been updated, causing peer dependency conflicts.
* **Solution:** As noted in the `README.md`, we overcame this for the hackathon by using the `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` flag. This allowed us to proceed with the build despite the version mismatches, and we documented this fix in the "Troubleshooting" section for future reference.

### 2. Ensuring Reliable JSON Output from AI
* **Hurdle:** A core feature is the AI-powered patient analysis, which requires a strictly structured JSON object from the Google Gemini model. A major bug we faced was that the AI model would sometimes return extra commentary (e.g., "Here is the JSON you requested..."), markdown formatting, or fail to respond entirely, causing our application to crash when it tried to parse the response.
* **Solution:** We engineered a highly resilient multi-step process in the API route to overcome this:
    1.  **Model Fallbacks:** We defined a primary model (`gemini-2.5-flash`) and a list of fallback models (`gemini-2.0-flash`, `gemini-1.5-flash`). If the primary model fails, the code automatically retries the request with the next model in the list.
    2.  **JSON Extraction:** We wrote a custom `extractJsonFromText` function. This function attempts to find and extract a valid JSON string from the model's raw output, even if it's surrounded by text or markdown code blocks.
    3.  **Schema Validation:** After successfully parsing the JSON, we use Zod (`AnalysisSchema.safeParse`) to validate that the object's structure matches our exact requirements. If it doesn't, we treat it as a failure and retry with a fallback model.

### 3. Security Vulnerability in Role Management
* **Hurdle:** Our project's security relies on Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to protect patient data. We identified a critical bug in our initial design: the Supabase trigger (`handle_new_user`) that creates a user profile on signup was blindly trusting the `role` field from the user's metadata. This meant a malicious user could intercept the signup request and assign themselves an 'admin' role.
* **Solution:** We completely refactored this logic in the `017_secure_role_management.sql` script. The new `handle_new_user` trigger now ignores any role passed in the metadata. Instead, it defaults all new signups to the 'doctor' role. The only way to get a different role is through a secure, admin-generated invitation (`user_invitations` table), which is checked during the trigger's execution.

### 4. Environment and Build Issues
* **Hurdle:** We also ran into common but time-consuming setup hurdles, such as AI features failing silently or the project failing to build.
* **Solution:** We debugged these issues and documented the solutions in the `README.md` "Troubleshooting" section. This included:
    * Verifying that the `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` was correctly set in the `.env.local` file and that the key was active in the Google AI Studio console.
    * Noting that build errors related to Google Fonts could be solved by ensuring internet connectivity during the build process.

> XAI: Because Every Decision Matters

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![ML Classifier](https://img.shields.io/badge/ML%20Classifier-333333?style=flat-square) ![VGG16](https://img.shields.io/badge/VGG16-333333?style=flat-square) ![ResNet](https://img.shields.io/badge/ResNet-333333?style=flat-square) ![Grad-CAM](https://img.shields.io/badge/Grad--CAM-333333?style=flat-square) ![XAI](https://img.shields.io/badge/XAI-333333?style=flat-square) ![BASE44\](https://img.shields.io/badge/BASE44\-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our project is an AI-powered white blood cell classification system that not only predicts the type of blood cell from an image but also explains how and why the prediction was made.

In many AI systems, the results are accurate but not understandable — like a black box. This becomes a challenge in medical use, where trust and transparency are very important. Our project solves this by making AI explain itself visually.

How it works (in simple steps):

The user uploads a blood cell image in our app

AI analyzes the image using a trained deep learning model

The system predicts the blood cell type (e.g., Neutrophil, Lymphocyte, etc.)

Then it shows visual explanations to explain the prediction using:

LIME → Highlights the important parts of the image that influenced the decision

Grad-CAM → Shows a heatmap that indicates where the AI focused the most

The user can download the explanation results for better analysis

Why this project is important

✅ Makes AI transparent and understandable
✅ Builds trust in medical AI decisions
✅ Helps students, researchers, and doctors understand AI reasoning
✅ Works like a smart assistant that gives answers with evidence

Key Outcome

Our system does not just say “This is a certain blood cell”,
it also shows “This is why the AI believes so” — making the technology reliable, educational, and meaningful.

**Challenges we ran into**

Handling Large AI Models
Deep learning models require high memory and processing power, making them slow to load and harder to deploy on normal systems.

Making AI Explainable
Tools like LIME and Grad-CAM don’t always generate clear or accurate explanations, so we had to spend time fine-tuning them for medical image understanding.

Balancing Accuracy and Speed
We wanted fast predictions as well as high accuracy, but improving one sometimes affected the other, so optimization was needed.

Different Image Quality Issues
Medical images vary in brightness, size, and clarity. Cleaning and preparing them properly was challenging to ensure correct predictions.

Integration of Multiple Technologies
Combining AI models, explanation tools, and an interactive app (Streamlit) into one smooth workflow required careful structuring and testing.

User-Friendly Explanation Display
Showing AI reasoning in a way that both doctors and non-technical users can understand was one of the biggest challenges.

Limited Medical Datasets
Getting high-quality labeled medical images was difficult, and smaller datasets can affect how well the model learns.

Ensuring Trust and Reliability
Since this is related to healthcare, we had to ensure the model didn't just predict but also gave trustworthy explanations.

**Base44 Innovation Challenge**

I built an AI-based cancer detection tool that can predict if a tumor is cancerous or not.

A person or doctor enters medical test values about the tumor (like size, shape, texture).
Then the AI analyzes it and tells:

Is the tumor likely cancerous (Malignant) or not (Benign)?

How confident the prediction is (like 85% sure)?

The app also shows graphs and analysis so doctors or users can understand why the AI made that prediction.

It can even generate a report that can be downloaded and shared with a doctor.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vibesens-3c64) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/manish96852/vibsense-AI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-hackCBS%208.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackcbs-8.devfolio.co)

> AI-power health monitor

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

What People Can Use It For

VibeSense is an AI-powered webcam health monitoring system designed to help individuals, professionals, and organizations track vital health parameters using only a camera — no external sensors or wearables needed.

Use Cases:

 Remote Health Monitoring: Users can check vital signs like heart rate, breathing, and stress level through their webcam in seconds.

 Home Wellness Tracking: Perfect for daily health tracking without visiting a clinic.

🏥 Telemedicine Integration: Doctors can remotely analyze real-time vitals of patients during virtual consultations.

 Mental Wellness & Stress Detection: Helps users monitor stress and relaxation levels for better work-life balance.

 Educational & Research Use: Ideal for universities or research labs exploring AI-based biomedical analysis.

 How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

 Zero Hardware Cost: Traditional health devices cost $100–$1000; VibeSense only needs a webcam.

 Universal Accessibility: Works on laptops, desktops, and mobiles – anywhere, anytime.

 Privacy-Focused: All processing happens locally on the user’s device; no data leaves the system.

 Real-Time Monitoring: Provides instant, accurate feedback (<100ms response time).

 Easy to Use: One-click setup, clean dashboard, and visual analytics for non-technical users.

 AI-Powered Safety: Intelligent filters reduce motion noise, ensuring stable and reliable readings.

In short: VibeSense democratizes health monitoring — making it affordable, private, and accessible for everyone through the power of AI.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚙️ Key Challenges & How I Overcame Them
1. Unstable Signal Due to Lighting Conditions

Problem: rPPG signal accuracy dropped drastically in low or uneven lighting.

Solution: Implemented adaptive brightness correction and Kalman filtering to stabilize color-based pulse detection.

2. Motion Artifacts & Noise

Problem: Small head movements or camera shakes introduced noise in the heart rate signal.

Solution: Used a Butterworth Bandpass Filter (0.75–4 Hz) and real-time motion compensation to clean the data stream.

3. Performance Optimization

Problem: Real-time AI processing caused high CPU usage (>60%) initially.

Solution: Optimized OpenCV pipelines, implemented multi-threading, and reduced redundant computations — achieving <25% CPU usage and 30 FPS performance.

4. Cross-Platform Compatibility

Problem: Different browser camera APIs and hardware variations caused inconsistent results.

Solution: Standardized video capture using WebRTC and added adaptive frame rate handling.

5. UI/UX Design Integration

Problem: Combining real-time video feeds with a 3D glassmorphism UI created lag and visual clutter.

Solution: Used React.js + TailwindCSS optimization and lazy rendering for smooth user experience.

6. Data Privacy & Local Processing

Problem: Handling sensitive health data without cloud processing was challenging.

Solution: Designed a fully local AI pipeline ensuring data never leaves the user’s system, aligning with GDPR principles.

**The problem it solves**

CalmMind directly solves the critical and costly business problems of employee burnout, disengagement, and high attrition by shifting mental health support from a reactive crisis resource to a proactive strategic investment. We replace underutilized, stigmatized programs with a structured 6-month wellness journey that builds resilience, leading to measurable gains in productivity and focus. For employees, we dismantle the barriers of access, cost, and stigma, making mental fitness as standard as a gym membership, while for our partner therapists and hospitals, we provide a steady stream of motivated clients and reliable income, creating a sustainable ecosystem where both corporate performance and human well-being thrive together.

**Challenges we ran into**

Despite the clear need, CalmMind faces the significant challenge of shifting the corporate mindset to view mental wellness as a strategic investment rather than a soft cost, which lengthens sales cycles and requires robust ROI justification. Furthermore, we must overcome employee stigma and apathy to ensure high engagement in our programs, proving their efficacy through tangible data to secure renewals in a competitive market. Finally, scaling our curated network of therapists while maintaining consistent quality and managing unit economics presents an ongoing operational hurdle that is critical to our brand promise and long-term success.

**The problem it solves**

SAGAlyze is an offline, clinician-exclusive AI dermatology
assistant designed to help dermatologists diagnose and
track skin disease progression with accuracy, fairness, and
privacy. It uses an on-device AI model to classify skin
lesions, generate lesion heatmaps, and visualize treatment
progress — all while ensuring data security and unbiased
performance across all skin tones. The system enhances
clinical efficiency, supports evidence-based decisions, and
empowers patients with secure access to their treatment
history.

**Challenges we ran into**

As a team primarily experienced in machine learning, venturing into app development posed several challenges for us. While we were confident in building and fine-tuning models, integrating them into a functional and user-friendly application required an entirely different skill set. We initially struggled with understanding frontend frameworks, database management, and API communication between the backend and our ML models. Coordinating version control and ensuring smooth collaboration during rapid development cycles was also tricky at first. Moreover, optimizing model performance for deployment in a lightweight and responsive app environment tested our ability to balance accuracy with efficiency. Despite these hurdles, the learning curve was immensely rewarding — we grew not only as individual developers but also as a cohesive team capable of turning technical ideas into real-world, deployable solutions.

**1st Prize**

We want to be the overall winner.

This helped achieve smooth and verified Aadhaar-based registration.

### FEDHealth
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/fedhealth-86fd) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Encrypted-Lakshya/FedHealth.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACKSTROM%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackstrom-1.devfolio.co)

> Healing Through Encrypted Intelligence.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Healthcare institutions (like hospitals, clinics, and labs) generate massive amounts of sensitive patient data — crucial for building AI models for diagnosis, drug prediction, or risk assessment.

But…

❌ They can’t share this data due to privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.)
❌ Centralized storage of such data is risky (breaches, leaks, misuse).
❌ Lack of trust between hospitals prevents collaboration.
❌ Models trained on limited data become biased and inaccurate.

Hence, no single hospital can build a powerful AI model alone.

Solution:

A Federated Learning System enhanced with Ethereum blockchain integration that:

Allows hospitals to train AI models locally on their private datasets.

Aggregates only the trained model weights (not raw data).

Records every training contribution, update, and aggregation on Ethereum for transparency and trust.

Encrypts all model exchanges end-to-end to preserve confidentiality.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Data Privacy & Security

Challenge: Hospitals can’t share patient data due to strict privacy laws.
Your Solution:

Each hospital trains locally — no raw data ever leaves the institution.

Only encrypted model weights are sent for aggregation.

Sensitive information remains within local databases.

✅ Patient confidentiality preserved, no central data exposure.

2. Lack of Trust Between Participants

Challenge:
Hospitals may not trust a central server or each other — they need assurance that contributions aren’t altered or misused.

Your Solution (Ethereum):

Every model update is logged via Ethereum smart contracts.

Each transaction (model upload, aggregation, or access) is immutable and transparent.

Hospitals can verify their contribution on-chain.

✅ Trust is established without a central authority.

3. Model Tampering or Corruption

Challenge:
Model files can be maliciously altered or replaced during exchange or aggregation.

Your Solution:

Each model’s hash is stored on Ethereum before and after training.

When aggregated, the system verifies that hashes match the recorded ones.

Any tampering is instantly detectable.

✅ Ensures authenticity and integrity of model files.

4. Centralized Control & Single Point of Failure

Challenge:
Traditional federated learning systems rely on a central global server, which can be attacked or biased.

Your Solution:

Decentralize the coordination layer using Ethereum.

Use smart contracts to manage model uploads, validation, and aggregation permissions.

Even if one node fails, the blockchain ledger preserves all history.

✅ Removes central dependency, improves fault tolerance.

5. No Motivation to Contribute

Challenge:
Hospitals have little incentive to share their computational resources or data-derived knowledge.

Your Solution (Optional Ethereum extension):

Introduce token-based incentives using ERC-20 smart contracts.

Hospitals contributing high-quality model updates (that improve accuracy) get rewarded automatically.

✅ Creates a sustainable, self-driven ecosystem.

6. Model Accountability

Challenge:
When multiple hospitals train models, it’s unclear who contributed what — making performance tracking difficult.

Your Solution:

Every update has a verifiable record of ownership via Ethereum transactions.

Global model performance can be traced back to contributing hospitals.

✅ Enables fairness, transparency, and traceability.

⚙️ Challenges You Faced During Development

Secure Communication Setup

Ensuring end-to-end encryption between local and global models was tricky.

Solution: Used AES encryption for model exchange & verified integrity using hashes.

Model Aggregation Conflicts

Different hospitals may use slightly different model architectures or data scales.

Solution: Standardized architecture (same input/output shape) and normalization process.

Blockchain Integration Overhead

Storing entire models on-chain is expensive.

Solution: Only stored model hashes and metadata on Ethereum; actual models stay off-chain (e.g., IPFS or secure server).

Latency in Smart Contract Execution

Blockchain confirmations caused slight delay.

Solution: Used asynchronous event listeners and minimal on-chain data.

Maintaining Model Performance Consistency

Combining heterogeneous datasets led to inconsistent performance across hospitals.

Solution: Weighted model aggregation (FedAvg algorithm).

**Ethereum Track**

Future scope:

1. 🧾 Model Exchange Logging via Smart Contracts

Every time a local hospital uploads a model to the global server, it triggers an Ethereum smart contract.

The contract records:

Hospital ID (anonymized)

Model hash (unique fingerprint of the trained weights)

Timestamp of upload

This creates a tamper-proof log of contributions — preventing manipulation or unauthorized model substitution.

2. 🔐 Decentralized Access Control

Instead of storing keys or permissions centrally, Ethereum smart contracts can manage who can access or update the global model.

Hospitals are verified via blockchain identity before accessing the global model.

Access tokens or keys can be dynamically granted/revoked on-chain.

3. 💰 Incentivization System (Optional)

You can introduce rewards (tokens) for local hospitals that contribute high-quality model updates.

Smart contracts evaluate model contribution (e.g., accuracy improvement) and release ERC-20 tokens as incentives.

Encourages active and honest participation.

4. 🧠 Model Integrity Verification

Before aggregation, the hash of the trained model can be validated on-chain.

Ensures that the model file hasn’t been tampered with between upload and integration.

5. 🧩 Fully Decentralized Learning (Advanced)

Eventually, the global aggregation itself could be decentralized — performed via a smart contract or a DAO-style governance system where multiple nodes vote/verify updates.

> Care, Response, Medico

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our project, Health Connect, is designed to solve the widespread problem of medication non-adherence, medical mismanagement, and lack of real-time coordination between patients, doctors, and caretakers. Many patients, especially the elderly or those with chronic conditions, often forget to take their medicines on time or take the wrong ones, leading to serious health risks. Health Connect simplifies and secures this process through a smart medicine reminder system that notifies users when it’s time to take their medication. The patient can confirm intake by clicking a photo, which is analyzed using OCR to verify whether the correct medicine was taken. If the system detects a missed dose, an automatic alert is sent to the caretaker or doctor. Alongside, the platform enables doctors to monitor patient progress remotely, offer instant consultations, and provide emergency assistance when required. Future integration includes AI-driven prescription analysis and an e-commerce module for emergency and routine medicine delivery. By combining intelligent reminders, real-time monitoring, and secure communication, Health Connect transforms everyday healthcare into a safer, smarter, and more connected experience for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals alike.

> One conversation closer to peace

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Talk about stress, anxiety, depression, or loneliness in a safe, judgment-free environment.
Receive personalized breathing exercises, grounding techniques, or mindfulness prompts based on your emotional state.
Users can speak freely without typing—especially useful for people who are driving, visually impaired, or too emotionally overwhelmed to type.
Built to avoid judgment, respect confidentiality, and encourage human support when needed.

**Challenges we ran into**

Speech Recognition: Handling different accents, emotions, and background noise reduced accuracy.

Emotional Understanding: Difficult to interpret tone and detect subtle emotions correctly.

Privacy & Security: Managing sensitive voice data securely while meeting ethical standards.

Ethical Concerns: Ensuring safe, non-harmful responses and proper crisis handling.

Natural Flow: Maintaining human-like, empathetic voice interactions with minimal delay.

Integration Issues: Combining speech, NLP, and voice output systems smoothly.

User Testing: Collecting real feedback safely and ethically for continuous improvement.

> Sovereign health data for sovereign communities

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Millions miss life-saving treatments due to barriers and fragmented data.  Nebet is the answer: a blockchain platform that empowers patients with data sovereignty,giving them control, enabling transparent funding, and connecting global communities. 

Global health faces three major crises:

- **Unequal access **– Millions miss available treatments due to slow, inefficient systems.
- ****No data sovereignty**** – Patients can’t control or use their own medical/genomic data.
- ******Lack of trust****** – Donors doubt impact, patients fear privacy risks, blocking innovation.

Nebet is a modular blockchain protocol for healthcare with four pillars:

- **Medical Passport:** patients control their verified health data with ZK-proofs.
- **Marketplace:** transparent, fraud-free treatment funding 
- **Verification: **decentralized validation of diagnoses and outcomes.
- **Ethical Data: **anonymized datasets drive research while patients keep privacy.

**The problem it solves**

Health and fitness apps collect huge amounts of personal data — but users don’t own it, can’t verify it, and rarely benefit financially.
Brands want real, verifiable wellness engagement data, but can’t trust self-reported info.

PulseProof brings health data on-chain — privately, securely, and with rewards for verified progress.

Users can connect wearables (like Fitbit, Apple Watch, or Garmin), verify activity via zero-knowledge proofs, and earn tokens or perks from sponsors — without ever exposing private data.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building ZK circuits for biometric proofs.

Securely syncing wearable data without compromising privacy.

Avoiding data farming or fake device emulation.

Designing fair and non-exploitable reward mechanics.

Simplifying UX for non-crypto fitness users.

**Link to the GitHub Repo of your project**

https://github.com/pulseproof/core

**Live URL of your project**

https://pulseproof.io

**What is your product’s unique value proposition?**

ZK Health Proofs: users prove fitness activity or biometrics without revealing raw data.

On-chain Reputation: healthy lifestyle achievements stored as verifiable badges.

Brand Rewards: companies can sponsor challenges and reward verified users.

Wellness Passport: portable health identity across platforms and apps.

API for Developers: easy integration for fitness apps or insurance platforms.

In short: private fitness verification with real-world rewards.

**Who is your target customer?**

Individuals who track health and want ownership + rewards.

Brands / wellness companies that want verified engagement.

Insurance & healthcare providers that reward healthy habits.

Developers building health-based dApps.

Early adopters: biohackers, fitness DAOs, wellness apps, lifestyle brands.

**Who are your closest competitors and how are you different?**

Sweatcoin / StepN	Inflated rewards, no verification	ZK proof of real wearable data
Strava / Apple Health	Centralized, no ownership	On-chain, privacy-first
FitFi platforms	Data exposed	Zero-knowledge encrypted proofs

**What is your distribution strategy and why?**

Partnerships: with wearable brands (Fitbit, Whoop, Garmin).

Corporate wellness programs: let employers reward verified activity.

Fitness DAOs: sponsor tokenized health challenges.

ZK Dev Integration: SDK for health apps to add verification easily.

Campaigns: “Proof of Workout” NFT drops for early adopters.

Why it works: combines DeFi-style incentives with real health engagement — verified and private.

> Smarter Systems for Healthier Outcomes

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Prisma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Prisma-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**What We Plan to Build**
We’re building SurgeSense, an Agentic AI-powered web platform that helps hospitals in India proactively prepare for sudden patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics.
The system uses multiple AI agents to fetch, analyze, and predict hospital load using real-time data from social media, weather services, news feeds, and government health portals.
It then automatically:
- Warns management about predicted patient surges.
- Recommends actions for staffing, inventory, and facility management.
- Helps track and manage hospital beds, doctors, and supplies.
- Issues public health advisories through X, Instagram.
- Issues personalised health advisories through SMS for vulnerable groups.

**Pain Points:**
- Unpredictable surges in patient inflow during festivals, smog, or epidemics.
- Overcrowded hospitals due to poor preparedness.
- Manual and delayed inventory management, especially during crises.
- Absence of predictive systems that use local social, environmental, and health data for forecasting.

**What Makes It Unique**
- Uses real-time agentic AI to fetch and process data from multiple external sources (news, weather, social media).
- Localized forecasting for each hospital rather than generic national trends.
- Combines predictive analytics + operational response system — not just forecasting but also automated action planning.
- Scalable design — works for private, government, and semi-urban hospitals.
- Integrates public advisory automation through social platforms and AI-personalized SMS alerts.

**Target Audience:**

***Direct Audience***
**1) Hospital Administrators & Management Teams**
- They can use SurgeSense to forecast patient load, optimize staffing, and manage medical inventory efficiently during high-demand periods.

**2) Doctors & Medical Staff**
- Gain real-time visibility into upcoming patient surges and bed availability, allowing better shift planning and workload management.

**3) Private & Public Hospitals (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 Cities)**
- Tier 1: To optimize hospital operations and reduce waiting times.
- Tier 2 & Tier 3: To get predictive insights without needing expensive infrastructure — helping smaller hospitals prepare better with limited resources.

***Indirect Audience***
**1) Government Health Departments & Municipal Corporations**
Useful for city-wide or state-level preparedness during pollution spikes, disease outbreaks, or large public gatherings.

**2) Pharmacy Chains and Medical Suppliers**
Can predict upcoming demand for essential medicines and plan supply chain logistics proactively.

**3) Patients with Chronic Conditions (Asthma, Diabetes, etc.)**
Receive personalized advisories during pollution spikes, festivals, or epidemics, helping them stay safe and manage their health proactively.

**Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy**
1. Partner with local hospitals and health-tech startups for pilot programs.
2. Onboard 10–15 hospitals across 2–3 Indian cities to test forecasting accuracy.
3. Collaborate with state health departments for epidemic preparedness modules.
4. Gradual scale-up through cloud deployment (SaaS model) with hospital onboarding support.

**Revenue Streams**
- Subscription-based SaaS model for hospitals (monthly/annual plans).
- Freemium model: Basic forecasting dashboard free; premium includes AI advisories, staff management, and inter-hospital communication.
- Government & NGO tie-ups during large-scale rollouts (public health initiatives).

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project SurgeSense directly aligns with the HealthTech track as it focuses on managing unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics using an Agentic AI-based predictive system.

SurgeSense continuously analyzes real-time data from weather APIs, social media trends, news feeds, and government health sources to forecast patient inflow and proactively recommend actions to hospitals. These include optimal staffing schedules, inventory restocking, and facility utilization plans, all before the surge actually happens.

It also automates public and personalized health advisories—for example, sending early warnings to asthma patients during Diwali smog or alerting hospital management about potential flu outbreaks.

By bridging AI-driven forecasting with hospital operations, SurgeSense transforms how healthcare centers prepare and respond—making it a perfect fit for the HealthTech track focused on proactive, data-driven patient care management.

> Agentic AI for Predictive Healthcare

![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![XGBoost](https://img.shields.io/badge/XGBoost-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kubernetes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kubernetes-333333?style=flat-square) ![Auth0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Auth0-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

1. What we plan to build

HealthVista is an AI-powered surge prediction and response system for hospitals.
It analyzes festivals, pollution, weather, and epidemic data along with hospital records to forecast patient inflow and proactively recommend:
- Optimal staffing levels (shift adjustments, temp hires)
- Supply readiness (oxygen, meds, beds, PPE)
- Patient advisories (alerts, triage guidance, telehealth redirection) 
The system provides hospital admins with a dashboard + mobile alerts, ensuring hospitals move from reactive crisis mode to proactive preparedness.

2. Pain points addressed

- Unpredictable surges during Diwali, Holi, pollution spikes, or outbreaks.
- Overcrowding & long wait times → poor patient experience.
- Staff burnout due to last-minute overtime.
- Critical supply shortages (O₂, ICU beds) or wastage due to overstock.
- Lack of early warnings combining health + environmental + event signals.

3. Target audience

Primary: Medium & large private hospitals, public district/municipal hospitals.
Secondary: State health departments, city authorities, staffing agencies, and suppliers.

4. Go-To-Market (GTM)

- Pilot with 3–5 hospitals (mix of private & public) to prove ROI.
- Partnerships with HIS/EHR vendors and staffing agencies for faster adoption.
- Expansion through state tenders & hospital chain contracts.
- Marketing: case studies, hospital conferences, and digital campaigns showing cost savings + reduced wait times.

5. Tech Stack and Architecture:

Core principles

- Hybrid deployment (cloud + on-prem connectors) — keeps PHI local, minimal data movement.
- Microservices for modularity, containerized for portability.
- Event-driven for real-time updates.

tech stack:

- Cloud: AWS / GCP / Azure (customer choice) — multi-AZ for resilience
- Compute / Containers: Docker + Kubernetes (EKS / GKE / AKS)
- API / Backend: Python (FastAPI) microservices
- ML stack: PyTorch / TensorFlow for deep models; scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM for tabular; Prophet or TFT for T.S.
- Feature store: Feast (or in-house Redis + Postgres)
- Data lake / warehousing: S3 + Athena / BigQuery
- Streaming: Kafka or Pub/Sub for events
- DBs: Postgres for transactional, Redis for caches
- Auth & RBAC: Keycloak or Auth0 (self-host option)
- Mobile & Web UI: React (web dashboards), React Native or Flutter for mobile apps
- Notifications: Twilio / AWS SNS / WhatsApp Business API for advisories
- Integration / ETL: Airbyte or custom connectors (HL7/FHIR adapters)
- Observability: Prometheus + Grafana, ELK stack (logging)
- Security: KMS for secrets, Vault for credentials, TLS everywhere

6. Revenue streams

SaaS subscription (tiered by bed count):

- Small hospital: ₹50K–₹1.5L/month
- Mid (100–300 beds): ₹1.5L–₹6L/month
- Large chains/enterprise: custom pricing

Integration fees for custom EHR/supply connectors.
Premium add-ons: city-level dashboards, advanced supplier integrations.
Outcome-based contracts: % share of cost savings (overtime, stockouts prevented).

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

This project, HealthVista, fits squarely into the Healthtech track by directly addressing a critical, high-impact problem within the Indian healthcare system. It leverages Agentic AI—the core challenge of the prompt—to move beyond simple data analysis and create a system that acts autonomously to provide proactive, actionable solutions. Instead of merely presenting data, the AI agents within HealthVista (the data aggregator, predictive analytics, resource optimization, and communication agents) work together to forecast patient surges and then recommend specific, concrete actions, such as adjusting staff rosters or ordering supplies. This focus on predictive and proactive management during high-demand periods like festivals and epidemics is a cutting-edge application of technology to improve efficiency, patient outcomes, and resource allocation in a complex healthcare environment.

**Description of your solution**

AirAware is an intelligent chatbot designed to make weather information more accessible, personalized, and conversational. Unlike traditional weather apps, AirAware combines real-time meteorological data with natural language understanding to answer user queries directly, in plain English.

The chatbot automatically detects the user’s current location (similar to how OpenWeather APIs fetch local weather) and uses it to provide highly relevant responses. For example, if a user asks “Is there a cyclone near me?”, AirAware queries live weather alerts and gives a clear, actionable answer.

Key Features

Location-Aware Assistance – Understands where the user is and tailors weather responses accordingly.

Extreme Weather Alerts – Detects and informs about cyclones, hurricanes, sandstorms, and severe storms nearby.


Conversational Experience – Lets users ask natural questions like “Will it rain tomorrow?” or “Is the air quality safe today?”.


Powered by Groq – Integrates live data with intelligent response generation.

Safety-Oriented – Prioritizes awareness and preparedness, not just weather stats.

Future Implementation (if selected for On-Campus Hackathon)

Add a visual “Agent Network Map” showing live inter-agent communication.

Build real-time charts and analytics panels to monitor agent activity and chatbot performance.

Introduce voice-based interaction and emotion-aware responses using speech recognition and sentiment models.

Implement predictive graph visualizations (e.g., using time-series forecasting) to anticipate user behavior or system load.

Optimize the agent pipeline with reinforcement learning for better task delegation and resource utilization.

Sends timely warnings and preparedness tips to keep users safe during severe weather conditions.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**Description of your solution**

During Diwali smog, Ganesh Chaturthi crowds, or a sudden dengue wave, hospitals get flooded with patients. Doctors and nurses get overworked, beds run out, and people wait for hours. Today, hospitals only react after the rush has started.

We are building **MedikuReady – an AI assistant for hospitals that works like a “weather forecast, but for patients.”**

It looks at data like pollution levels, weather, Google searches (for fever/cough), traffic movement, and past hospital records.

Based on this, it predicts when and how many patients might arrive in the coming days.

The AI then guides the hospital:

- “You’ll need 20% more staff tomorrow evening.”
- “Order 200 extra asthma inhalers this week.”
- “Keep 5 ICU beds free during smog season.”

It can even send health alerts to the public like: “Smog spike tomorrow – asthma patients stay indoors.”

This way, hospitals are ready before the rush hits → patients get faster care, staff are less stressed, and lives are saved.

**MedikuReady transforms healthcare from reactive firefighting into proactive readiness — saving time, money, and lives.**

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

By building MedikuReady – an Agentic AI hospital assistant, we are using AI agents that don’t just predict but also act proactively. Unlike normal dashboards, our agent:

Collects and learns from real-time health, pollution, and mobility data.

Plans ahead by forecasting patient inflows.

Takes initiative by recommending staff shifts, supply orders, and bed allocation.

Communicates directly with both hospitals and citizens through advisories.

This makes our solution a true Agentic AI system: it observes, reasons, plans, and acts — exactly what the hackathon theme demands.

In short, our project = Healthtech + Agentic AI → proactive hospital readiness that saves lives.

**Description of your solution**

In India, millions of chronic patients (diabetes, hypertension, thyroid, etc.) struggle to manage their treatment because they often skip medications, forget diet restrictions, or miss follow-up visits. Doctors provide prescriptions during consultations, but there is no personalized system to ensure consistent care once patients leave the clinic. Existing hospital apps are static, generic, and fail to offer tailored support.

HealthMate AI is a software-only digital health companion that bridges this gap by acting as a virtual follow-up nurse. It integrates with hospital EMR systems and patient prescriptions, then uses AI to generate personalized reminders, dietary guidance, follow-up schedules, and health education. Beyond simple notifications, the system actively tracks patient adherence, detects risk patterns, and notifies doctors if intervention is required.

By providing continuous, AI-driven care management, HealthMate AI helps reduce hospital readmissions, improves patient compliance, and ensures proactive chronic disease management.

**Key Highlights**

- Problem Context – Chronic disease patients often fail to stick to prescribed medication schedules, diet plans, and follow-up visits, leading to deteriorating health and increased hospital burden.

- Target Users – Patients with chronic illnesses (diabetes, BP, thyroid, asthma, etc.), their caregivers, and doctors who need real-time adherence insights.

- Core Solution – A personalized, AI-powered post-consultation care platform that reminds, educates, and monitors patients like a digital nurse.

- Data Sources – Patient EMR data, prescriptions, hospital databases, wearable/smartphone health logs, and lifestyle inputs (diet/exercise patterns).

- **Key Features**-
◦Personalized Reminders – Smart scheduling of medication, diet, and check-ups tailored to each patient.
◦Follow-up Tracking – Alerts doctors about missed visits or deteriorating adherence.
◦ Diet & Lifestyle Guidance – Customized advice aligned with the patient’s condition.
◦ Risk Detection Alerts – AI flags early warning signs (e.g., irregular glucose levels).
◦ Doctor-Patient Feedback Loop – Secure communication channel for timely doctor intervention.
◦ Gamification for Patients – Reward points, streaks, and leaderboards to keep patients engaged.

- **Technology**-The solution is built with a modern web stack, where the frontend uses HTML, React, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript to deliver a clean, user-friendly interface. The backend is powered by Node.js and Python (Flask/FastAPI) for scalable API handling. A MongoDB database securely stores patient records, prescriptions, and adherence logs. The AI/ML layer includes patient adherence prediction models and risk scoring algorithms that personalize care and flag potential health risks. For seamless hospital integration and easy scaling, the system is containerized using Docker.

- **Impact**-HealthMate AI significantly improves healthcare outcomes by increasing medication adherence and diet compliance, which directly lowers the chances of missed treatments. This leads to fewer hospital readmissions and emergency cases, ensuring that resources are better utilized. The platform strengthens doctor-patient engagement beyond clinic walls, providing continuous care instead of one-time consultations. In the long term, it contributes to a reduction in chronic disease complications, creating a healthier patient population and reducing the overall burden on the healthcare system.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

HealthMate AI perfectly fits the Healthtech track by addressing one of India’s biggest gaps — the lack of personalized post-consultation care for chronic patients. While hospitals focus on in-clinic treatment, patients often fail to follow through once they leave, leading to worsening conditions and avoidable readmissions.

 By using AI-powered digital agents, HealthMate AI:
	•Automates medication, diet, and lifestyle reminders specific to each patient.
	•Predicts adherence risks and flags them early to doctors.
	•Integrates with hospital EMR systems, turning them  from static record-keepers into active care managers.
	•Acts as a virtual nurse, extending the hospital’s care ecosystem directly into the patient’s pocket.

This makes healthcare continuous, proactive, and personalized, aligning directly with the Healthtech goal of using AI to close critical gaps in patient care and outcomes.

> Intelligent Healthcare Symptom Checker

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

SympAI – Intelligent Healthcare Symptom Checker & Triage Assistant

***Problem Statement***

Millions in India struggle to interpret their symptoms and decide when to seek medical help. Delayed diagnosis and misinformation can worsen conditions. Limited access to doctors in rural and semi-urban areas exacerbates this issue. There is a need for a real-time, reliable triage system that guides users safely and responsibly.

***Our Solution***

SympAI is a web-based agentic AI healthcare assistant that helps users:

- Describe symptoms via text or voice

- Understand likely conditions and severity

- Receive actionable recommendations (home care or doctor contact)

- Access verified medical resources (WHO, CDC, MoHFW)

It does not replace doctors but empowers users with early insights and reliable guidance.

***Methodology & Workflow***

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c4cd41a129fd4487a6b7f524e085fd73/e4e18c9e-8617-484b-81b2-ee5514934e7d.png)

SympAI uses a modular agentic AI pipeline:

- Symptom Extraction Agent – Extracts structured symptoms using spaCy / DistilBERT NLP models.

- Disease Classification Agent – Matches symptoms to probable diseases using rule-based logic or ML classifiers.

- Severity Analysis Agent – Computes severity scores (mild/moderate/severe) based on symptom patterns.

- Action Recommendation Agent – Suggests home care or triggers automated doctor alerts via SMS, WhatsApp, or email.

- Resource Linking Agent – Provides credible references and educational material for each condition.

***Datasets and Mapping***

1. [Symptom-Disease Mapping](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/choongqianzheng/disease-and-symptoms-dataset?select=DiseaseAndSymptoms.csv): Kaggle Medical Symptoms Dataset, which has medical symptoms as well as precautions of almost 5000 common and uncommon diseases

2. Severity Scores: Custom mapping of mild/moderate/severe for each disease based on the dataset

3. Reference Resources: WHO, CDC, MoHFW guidelines and doctor directories

***Agentic AI Components***

- Each agent performs autonomous reasoning on a specific task.

- Modular design allows upgrades without breaking the system.

- Provides explainable recommendations, enhancing user trust.

- Supports potential future extensions: multilingual input, voice input, telemedicine integration.

***Concluding Impact***

- Provides accessible first-level diagnosis for underserved populations

- Reduces unnecessary doctor visits and medical system burden

- Promotes trustworthy healthcare awareness through verified resources

- Bridges the gap between uncertainty and timely action

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

India faces a major challenge: people often misjudge symptoms or delay care due to limited access and misinformation. SympAI bridges this gap using agentic AI, offering instant, reliable triage support.

*Key Points:*

- **Agentic AI Workflow**: Breaks healthcare reasoning into specialized agents — symptom extraction, disease prediction, severity scoring, and action recommendation.

- **Real-time Guidance**: Analyzes symptoms to provide safe next steps — home care tips or doctor contact alerts.

- **Explainable & Modular**: Each agent reasons independently, ensuring transparency and scalability.

- **Social Impact**: Makes early medical insight accessible to remote and underserved populations.

- **Responsible AI**: Uses verified medical data (WHO, CDC, MoHFW) and anonymized processing for privacy.

SympAI mirrors a doctor’s reasoning process through collaborative AI, making healthcare guidance smart, safe, and accessible for everyone.

**Description of your solution**

What CuraAI Does?
**CuraAI** is designed to be an **intelligent digital healthcare assistant** that helps users understand, monitor, and take control of their health through artificial intelligence. The main goal of CuraAI is to simplify the way people access medical information and interact with healthcare systems. It provides users with instant, reliable, and easy-to-understand medical insights, all in one place, without requiring prior medical knowledge.

At its core, CuraAI uses **Natural Language Processing (NLP)** and **Machine Learning (ML)** to communicate with users naturally, analyze their symptoms, interpret medical reports, and suggest possible actions or next steps. The solution is built to assist rather than replace healthcare professionals, ensuring that users receive preliminary support and clarity before consulting a doctor.

**Key Functionalities**

**1. AI Health Chatbot (Symptom Checker):**
Users can describe their health problems in plain language, for example, “I’ve had headaches and fatigue for the past few days.” The AI then interprets these symptoms, checks for possible conditions, and provides a basic understanding of what might be happening. It also suggests whether the issue could be minor or if medical consultation is advisable.

**2. AI-Powered Report Interpreter:**
Most people find lab reports confusing due to medical jargon and complex metrics. CuraAI allows users to upload their medical reports (like CBC, thyroid, or sugar tests). The AI scans each parameter, highlights abnormal values, and explains what they could indicate, all in simple, human language. This helps users make sense of their data and take informed action.

**3. Nearby Doctor and Hospital Finder:**
The system integrates location-based services to help users discover nearby hospitals, clinics, or pharmacies. It also connects them to verified medical professionals, making healthcare access seamless, especially in emergencies or unfamiliar areas.

**4. Appointment Booking & Follow-ups:**
CuraAI simplifies the process of booking consultations, whether online or offline. Users can schedule appointments directly through the platform and receive reminders or updates for follow-ups.

**5. Personal Health Record (PHR) System:**
Every user gets a secure space where their health data, medical reports, and chat history are stored safely. This allows continuous tracking of health progress and ensures data-driven personalization of future recommendations.

**6. Predictive Health Insights:**
Using historical data, CuraAI applies predictive models to detect early signs of diseases such as diabetes, obesity, or hypertension. It then suggests preventive measures related to diet, lifestyle, and regular checkups, promoting proactive healthcare rather than reactive treatment.

**Technology Stack**

**Frontend:** React / Next.js with Tailwind CSS for a clean, responsive, and user-friendly interface.

**Backend:** Node.js or FastAPI for efficient data handling, chatbot logic, and report processing.

**AI Layer:** GPT-based NLP model for conversational understanding and Scikit-learn for predictive analytics.

**Database:** Firebase or MongoDB for secure data storage and user authentication.

**APIs & Integrations:** Google Maps API for hospital locations, Twilio for real-time alerts or reminders.

**Impact and Vision**

CuraAI aims to bridge the gap between individuals and the healthcare system by providing instant, AI-powered medical support. It empowers users to take control of their health, understand medical reports with confidence, and make informed decisions without panic or confusion.

In the long term, CuraAI envisions a world where **AI becomes a trusted healthcare partner**, one that can guide users from early detection to recovery, reduce hospital burden through preventive insights, and make healthcare assistance accessible to everyone, regardless of location or background.

CuraAI isn’t just another health app, it’s a step toward a **smarter, more connected, and patient-centered digital healthcare ecosystem.**

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

**CuraAI** perfectly aligns with the HealthTech track as it leverages Artificial Intelligence to transform healthcare accessibility, diagnostics, and patient support. The project addresses one of the most critical gaps in healthcare today , **limited access to instant, reliable medical guidance and decision support**, especially in underserved regions.

By integrating **AI-powered health chat, report interpretation, symptom-based disease prediction, and personalized medical recommendations**, CuraAI brings intelligent healthcare assistance directly to users’ devices. The solution embodies the hackathon’s theme by demonstrating how **AI can augment healthcare delivery, improve early detection, and empower patients and doctors** through smart automation and data-driven insights.

In short, CuraAI uses AI **not to replace** healthcare professionals, but to **assist and scale** their capabilities, aligning strongly with the HealthTech AI innovation goal of this track.

**Description of your solution**

# Solution

### What are we planning to build

Our platform is designed to turn unpredictable surges into predictable, manageable events through AI-driven forecasting, automation, and decision support. The key modules include:

- **Patient Surge Prediction** – Leverages historical hospital records, pollution/AQI trends, and local event calendars to forecast daily and weekly patient inflow, enabling hospitals to prepare in advance.
- **Staff & Roster Optimization** – Generates dynamic duty schedules that balance workloads, reduce overtime, and minimize burnout while ensuring adequate coverage during peak periods.
- **Supply Chain & Oxygen Forecasting** – Anticipates demand for critical supplies (oxygen, medicines, PPE) to prevent shortages and ensure continuity of care.
- **Command Dashboard** – A unified interface for management teams to monitor predicted surges, staffing levels, bed/ICU occupancy, and supply status in real time.
- **Patient Advisory Automation** – Delivers real-time WhatsApp updates to staff regarding updated rosters, duty timings, last-minute adjustments, or additional work hours. We will also update the patients about possible wait times and bed availability.

### How Our Platform Addresses Pain Points

Our solution turns healthcare surges into predictable, manageable events through AI-driven forecasting and automation.

- **Unpredictable Surges → Patient Surge Prediction**
    
    Events like **1,500+ Holi emergencies in Lucknow (24 hrs)** or **280 Ganesh Chaturthi injuries in Mumbai** overwhelm hospitals. Our model forecasts inflows using **records, AQI trends & event calendars**, enabling advance **bed allocation & staff alerts**.
    
- **Staff Shortages → Dynamic Roster Optimization**
    
    With only **1.7–1.96 nurses/1,000 vs WHO’s 3** and **68% burnout**, our AI duty rosters **balance shifts, reduce overtime, and auto-pull temporary staff** to prevent fatigue.
    
- **Low Bed & ICU Capacity → Demand-Aware Allocation**
    
    India has just **2.3 ICU beds/100k**. Our dashboard projects occupancy, enabling **reserving ICU beds & redirecting cases**, improving efficiency.
    
- **Oxygen & Medicine Gaps → Predictive Procurement**
    
    COVID demand spiked from **700–1,000 → 11,200 MT/day**; essential drugs show **17–51% availability with 4–14 week stockouts**. Our system forecasts demand, automates procurement alerts, and prevents shortages.
    
- **Overcrowding & Long Waits → Dashboards + Patient Advisories**
    
    Baseline waits are **20–40 mins, >30 mins for 63% in tertiary centres**. Our dashboards track load in real time, while WhatsApp advisories share **wait times & bed availability**, reducing panic and queues.
    

### Target Audience

This solution targets stakeholders across India’s healthcare ecosystem who face sudden surges in demand during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics. By using predictive insights and proactive planning, it supports decision-makers, frontline staff, and communities in managing care more efficiently.

1. **Hospitals & Administrators:** Public/private hospitals and nursing homes needing better surge management. The system aids in **resource planning, staffing, and supply chains**.
2. **Medical Staff & Frontline Workers:** Doctors, nurses, and paramedics under heavy workloads. Our solution ensures **optimized schedules, less burnout, and improved care**.
3. **Government & Health Agencies:** State and national bodies coordinating festival/pollution/emergency responses. The platform gives **predictive insights for efficient resource allocation**.
4. **Patients & Communities:** Citizens relying on services during peaks. **Advisories and preparedness reduce waits, overcrowding, and improve access to care**.

### Value Proposition and GTM

We help Indian hospitals prepare for unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics. Our AI forecasts demand, optimizes staff schedules, predicts supply needs, and automates patient advisories, working with existing hospital IT.

**GTM:** Start with 3-month pilots before known high-demand seasons (e.g., Diwali smog), prove impact (shorter wait times, fewer stockouts, reduced overtime), then expand across hospital chains and state systems. Build scale through partnerships with IT vendors, system integrators, and ambulance/diagnostic networks, supported by seasonal “Surge Outlook” reports and hospital case studies.

**Revenue:** Core subscriptions (by hospital size) with add-ons (rostering, supply, advisories, dashboards), pay-per-use (messages, simulations), performance-linked contracts, and setup/training services. Additional streams include government/state licenses, anonymized insights, partner royalties, and a “Surge Ready Hospital” certification. Seasonal passes lower entry costs and drive long-term adoption.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project fits the problem statement by directly addressing the root cause of healthcare disruption in India—unpredictable surges in patient inflow during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics. Current hospital systems operate reactively, leading to staff burnout, medicine/oxygen shortages, overcrowding, and longer wait times.  

We solve this by deploying an **AI agent** that autonomously analyzes hospital records, AQI/pollution data, and event calendars to **forecast patient demand in advance**. Based on these predictions, the agent recommends **optimal staffing schedules, supply chain adjustments, and patient advisories**, converting sudden surges into manageable, pre-planned events.  

By aligning predictive insights with real-time decision support, our solution ensures **hospitals are prepared before surges happen**, enabling administrators to balance workloads, prevent stockouts, and improve patient care delivery. This transforms India’s healthcare response from reactive crisis management to proactive surge readiness, fitting seamlessly with the stated challenge.

**Description of your solution**

MindGuard is an intelligent AI system that works like having a personal mental health guardian watching over you 24/7. It uses four smart AI assistants that work together: one watches for warning signs in your phone usage and sleep patterns, another predicts if you might be in crisis, a third automatically gets help when needed, and the fourth learns to get better over time. The system safely monitors things like your texting patterns, heart rate, and sleep quality using mobile apps and web platforms, all while keeping your information completely private and encrypted. When it detects potential mental health risks, it can instantly connect you with doctors, counselors, or emergency support - responding in under 5 minutes compared to hours with traditional methods, potentially preventing thousands of mental health crises through early warning and automatic intervention.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Agentic AI is the revolutionary core of MindGuard that makes it truly autonomous and proactive, unlike traditional reactive mental health systems. Here's how these intelligent agents transform mental healthcare:

 Autonomous Decision-Making
The four AI agents work independently without human oversight - they can detect crisis patterns, analyze risk levels, deploy interventions, and learn from outcomes all on their own. This means help arrives automatically, even when users can't ask for it themselves during a mental health crisis.

Continuous Self-Improvement
The Learning Agent makes the entire system smarter over time by studying what interventions work best for different people and situations, constantly adapting its approach to become more effective at preventing crises.

 Real-Time Collaboration
Unlike single AI systems, these agents work as a team - while one monitors your patterns, another predicts risks, and a third prepares interventions simultaneously, enabling sub-5 minute response times instead of hours or days.

Personalized Autonomous Care
Each agent learns your unique patterns and triggers, creating a personalized mental health profile that can predict and prevent your specific crisis situations before they escalate, providing truly individualized care without requiring constant human supervision.

**Description of your solution**

**Arogya-NextGen: Intelligent Healthcare Orchestration for a Resilient Future Vision: To transform reactive hospital management into a proactive, data-driven, and collaborative ecosystem, ensuring timely and efficient healthcare for all.**

Arogya-NextGen is an advanced AI and IoT-powered command center platform designed to address the critical challenges of modern healthcare: overcrowding, resource depletion, and operational inefficiency. By unifying hospitals, clinics, and community healthcare assets into a single intelligent network, the platform strengthens the entire healthcare delivery chain.

Core Modules & Capabilities
1. Predictive Operations & Resource Command Center:
The heart of Arogya-NextGen is a centralized dashboard providing a real-time, 360-degree view of hospital operations.

AI-Powered Demand Forecasting: Utilizes machine learning models that analyze historical admission data, public health trends, seasonal disease patterns, and local events to accurately predict patient inflow. This allows for proactive staffing recommendations, ensuring optimal deployment of doctors, nurses, and support staff.

Real-Time Resource Management: Integrates with hospital inventory systems and IoT sensors to provide live tracking of critical resources. This includes bed occupancy rates, availability of medicines, oxygen supply levels, and the status of equipment like ventilators, preventing critical shortages before they occur.

Operational Analytics: Delivers actionable insights on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as patient wait times, length of stay, and resource utilization rates, empowering administrators to make data-backed decisions for operational improvement.

2. Intelligent Patient Load Balancing & Triage:
This module focuses on directing patients to the right level of care efficiently, decongesting emergency rooms and optimizing the patient journey.

Automated Clinic Collaboration Protocol: Seamlessly connects with a network of local clinics and primary care centers. When hospital capacity is high, the system intelligently redirects patients with non-critical conditions to verified partner clinics, ensuring they receive faster care while freeing up hospital resources for emergencies.

AI-Assisted Preliminary Triage: For common primary care cases, the platform’s AI can perform a preliminary assessment, suggesting potential diagnoses and safe, evidence-based prescriptions. Crucially, all AI recommendations are flagged for mandatory validation and final approval by a qualified doctor, reducing their cognitive load and standardizing initial care.

Integrated Emergency Response: Features real-time ambulance tracking and a one-touch emergency alert system. This ensures that emergency departments are prepared for incoming critical patients, with necessary resources and personnel ready upon arrival.

3. Dynamic Workforce & Community Engagement:
Arogya-NextGen extends beyond the hospital walls to build a flexible, on-demand healthcare support network.

Volunteer & Student Onboarding Portal: Provides a streamlined system for medical students and temporary healthcare volunteers to register and be credentialed.

Skill-Based Task Assignment: During emergencies or periods of high patient load, the system can assign validated volunteers to non-clinical tasks such as first-level triage, patient guidance, administrative support, and crowd management, allowing core medical staff to focus on critical care.

The Arogya-NextGen Impact
For Hospitals: Drastically improves operational efficiency, reduces costs associated with mismanagement, and enables data-driven capacity planning.

For Patients: Significantly reduces wait times, ensures faster access to appropriate medical care, and improves overall patient outcomes and satisfaction.

For the Healthcare System: Builds a resilient, interconnected public health network that can effectively manage daily patient loads and scale rapidly during crises. It fosters a collaborative environment between private and public health entities.

HealthHIVE-AI Emergency Load Balancer

An Agentic AI for Dynamic Hospital Resource Management

🌍 The Problem: Urban Overload During Medical Emergencies

In large cities like Mumbai, emergencies such as mass accidents, festival surges, or pollution-induced health crises often lead to chaos:

🚨 The nearest hospital becomes overwhelmed, while nearby hospitals remain underutilized.

🕒 Delays occur due to long ER wait times and bottlenecks in critical care.

❌ Decisions are made reactively without a city-wide, real-time view of hospital capacity.

This lack of intelligent coordination results in preventable delays and poorer patient outcomes.

💡 Our Solution: An Agentic AI for Proactive Response

We built an AI-powered emergency coordinator that continuously monitors, predicts, and optimizes hospital utilization across the city.

The system works in a Sense → Think → Act cycle:

🧠 SENSE

Collects live hospital data: bed occupancy, staff availability, ICU/ventilator counts, and trauma readiness.

Detects new incidents with patient counts and location.

⚡ THINK

Prediction Engine : Forecasts hospital wait times and future loads.

Optimization Engine: Calculates a Time-to-Treatment score by balancing travel time, predicted wait, and real-time capacity.

🚀 ACT

The AI doesn’t just report—it issues actionable directives:

🚑 Ambulance Routing: Assigns patients to the best-fit hospitals.

👨‍⚕️ Resource Allocation: Recommends extra doctors, ICU beds, and supplies.

📣 Network Alerts: Notifies hospitals and the public of expected surges.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, HealthHIVE – AI Emergency Load Balancer, directly applies Agentic AI to a critical Healthtech challenge: managing hospital overloads during emergencies. By continuously sensing real-time hospital capacity, predicting patient surges, and autonomously generating actionable directives (ambulance routing, hospital assignments, and resource allocation), our system goes beyond passive analytics.

It exemplifies Agentic AI by not only analyzing but also acting as an intelligent coordinator across the healthcare network—ensuring faster treatment, balanced hospital loads, and improved patient outcomes in urban emergency scenarios.
