**Description of your solution**

**Description:**

Our platform provides a smart telemedicine experience by connecting patients, doctors, and pharmacies through AI-driven workflow automation.

When a user logs into the app, the AI manages the consultation queue. If a doctor is available, the AI connects the user with the doctor via a secure video call. After the consultation, an e-prescription is generated and sent simultaneously to the user and a registered pharmacy. The pharmacy checks the availability of the prescribed medicine and notifies the user via SMS when the medicine is ready for pickup or delivery.

If a doctor is unavailable, the AI provides preliminary treatment based on the user’s symptoms and medical history. The AI-generated prescription is then reviewed by a doctor once available, ensuring medical accuracy. After approval, the prescription is sent to both the user and the pharmacy, continuing the medicine fulfillment process.

This system ensures timely medical **attention, reduces waiting times**, and guarantees quick access to prescribed medicines, even during doctor unavailability. By combining AI-driven triage, teleconsultation, and pharmacy integration, our platform offers a seamless, end-to-end healthcare experience.

**Key Features:**

**AI-Managed Queue:** Optimizes doctor availability and consultation scheduling.

**Video Consultations:** Secure and real-time interactions with certified doctors.

**AI Preliminary Treatment:** Provides guidance when doctors are unavailable, minimizing delays.

**E-Prescriptions:** Automatically generated and shared with users and pharmacies.

**Pharmacy Integration:** Checks medicine availability and sends instant SMS notifications.

**User-Centric Design:** Intuitive interface for patients, doctors, and pharmacies.

**Impact:**

- Ensures continuous access to medical guidance, even when doctors are busy.
- Reduces delays in consultations and medicine procurement.
- Improves patient experience and adherence to treatment.
- Bridges telemedicine and pharmacy services in a fully automated workflow.

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Postman](https://img.shields.io/badge/Postman-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![JWT](https://img.shields.io/badge/JWT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![pytest](https://img.shields.io/badge/pytest-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We, **"Dual Core"**, are presenting our idea on the problem brought by us related to healthcare problem, i.e., to make a system which can help doctors to get the patients' previous medical reports summary in a crisp and short way along with presenting patients' profile that will allow doctors to know more about the patient's previous illnesses, diseases medication and last visited doctors/consultants.

**#Project Overview:-**
This project is an Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) System built using Python automatically reads and interprets patients’ historical medical reports, generating concise summaries within seconds. This enables doctors to make faster, more informed decisions without manually reviewing lengthy documentation.

It can also manage each patient’s profile, including: 
•History of past illnesses and diseases 
•Current medications and prescriptions 
•Summarized medical reports in structured formats
•Patients' EHR and EMR

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/97e47e74eab9438a8f6d6908424c0469/bf5b1012-bd92-4dee-b8f8-c6eedfa2834a.png)

**DocAide** is designed to operate on hospital internal servers for secure data handling and can also be deployed on online platforms to facilitate inter-hospital communication and patient referrals.

**#Main Objective:-**
The primary goal of DocAide is to save doctors’ time and enhance diagnostic efficiency by: 
• Automatically analyzing long medical reports 
• Presenting a short, crisp summary of key findings 
• Displaying a patient’s medical history and medication records 
• Offering easy-to-read formats of Electronic Health Records (EHR) and Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
• Supporting new doctors with instant access to patient background

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/97e47e74eab9438a8f6d6908424c0469/3f0a7369-0fef-4557-9c35-793dcd6ce0e3.png)


**#Key Features:-** 
✅ **Report Reading:**
Reads PDFs and images using OCR.

✅ **Smart Summarization:** 
Uses NLP to generate short, meaningful summaries.

✅ **Profile Management:**
 Stores diseases, medicines, and summaries in SQLite.

✅ **Agentic Automation:** 
Auto-detects new reports, summarizes, and updates data.

✅ **User Dashboard:** 
Streamlit-based interface for uploading and viewing reports.

✅ **ABHA Integration:** 
Auto-syncs patient data with the national ABHA portal.

✅ **EHR & EMR Support:** 
Maintains structured records for continuity and referrals.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/97e47e74eab9438a8f6d6908424c0469/d20ada82-f1aa-46f8-8f80-7b3d7e98b9ba.png)

**#Technologies Used:-**

1. OCR- Tesseract
2. NLP Summarization- Hugging Face Transformer 
3. Agentic Logic- LangChain
4. Medical NLP- scispaCy
5. Backend language- Python
6. File monitoring- Watchdog or Fast api
7. Database- PostgreSQL(structured data) and MongoDB(unstructured data)
8. EHR/EMR format- FHIR standard via HAPI-FHIR or Medplum
9. Frontend- Streamlit
10. Auth and Access- JWT
11. ABHA sync- RESTful API + Scheduled jobs
12. Testing- Pytest + Postman

**#Workflow (Step-by-Step):-**
- **Upload Report:**
Doctor uploads PDF/image via dashboard.

- **OCR & NLP:**
Text is extracted and summarized using AI.

- **Profile Update:** 
Summary, diseases, and medicines saved in SQLite.

- **Automation:** 
System auto-detects new reports and updates data.

- **ABHA Sync:**
Patient info pushed to ABHA portal.

- **EHR/EMR Creation:**
Structured records generated for continuity.

- **Doctor Access:**
Dashboard shows summaries and patient history.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/97e47e74eab9438a8f6d6908424c0469/de8db3f3-0bfd-46cf-bc9a-cb2c325092ca.png)

All these steps happen automatically once the report is added.

**#Advantages:-**
✅ Saves doctors’ time by instantly summarizing reports 
✅Doctors can reach to more no. of patients since their time to look after each patient will reduce 
✅ Reduces manual data entry work 
✅ Operate on internal servers (secure and private) 
✅ Keeps all patient records in one place 
✅ Can be scaled or modified easily 
✅ Can be integrated into hospital systems in the future 
✅ Ensures continuity and personalization in treatment plans 
✅ Minimizes human error in interpreting complex medical data 
✅ Promotes better communication between healthcare providers

**#Possible Real-Life Uses:-**
•**Hospitals & Clinics:** Doctors can view summarized medical histories instantly. 
•**Health Check Centers:** Can automatically generate short reports for patients.
•**Medical Research:** Helpful in analyzing large sets of patient reports quickly.

**#Future Enhancements:-**
🚀 Add Voice Summaries using text-to-speech. 
🩺 Integrate disease and medicine detection using spaCy or scispaCy. 
📢 Send doctor notifications when a new report is processed. 
📊 Build visual graphs of patient progress. 
🧩 Add multiple intelligent agents (for example: one for summarizing, one for analysis, one for updates).

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The audience target for the project "DocAide" is doctors itself. DocAide is an Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) system developed using Python, designed to streamline the way healthcare professionals interact with patient data.

**1. Problem:**
Health misinformation has become a global epidemic—over 70% of users encounter false health advice weekly. Current verification tools are largely manual, reactive, and limited to text-based claims, leaving a significant gap in real-time, multimodal verification.

**2. Solution (Our System):**
VeriHealth AI is an agentic, autonomous AI-based verifier designed to address this gap. It accepts any form of input—text, images, videos, or reel links—and determines whether the claim is True or Misleading through advanced multi-agent reasoning. The system works by:
Extracting the health claim from the input.
Searching authoritative sources such as WHO, PubMed, and CDC.
Validating the evidence through AI reasoning.
Producing explainable verdicts with confidence percentages and trusted references.

**3. Tools & Technology Stack:**

**- AI/ML:** LLaMA 3, GPT-4, Mistral, Whisper, Tesseract OCR, LangChain, CrewAI, FAISS
**- Backend:** FastAPI (Python) / Node.js (Express)
**- Frontend:** Next.js (React + TypeScript), Tailwind CSS, ShadCN/UI
**- Database:** MongoDB Atlas + FAISS / Weaviate
**- APIs:** SerpAPI, PubMed, WHO, CDC
**- Hosting:** Vercel (frontend), Railway / Render (backend)

**4. Impact / Outcome:**
VeriHealth AI combats misinformation-driven health risks, thereby saving lives through trusted, data-backed awareness. Key benefits include:
Educating the public on verified health information.
Supporting journalists and health professionals with credible data.
Reducing economic losses caused by false health practices.

**5. Future Outlook:**
VeriHealth AI is designed to scale into multilingual verification, social media integrations, and “Verification-as-a-Service” offerings for media outlets, hospitals, and NGOs. The platform envisions a future where AI acts as a global guardian of health truth.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/6e2eef6f9e9343bc922e8766e582659c/4e077828-1aac-4f52-8a39-8e1180a3e7a1.png)



![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/6e2eef6f9e9343bc922e8766e582659c/e8b82099-dfa9-4be8-84d4-4c8c5722f27e.png)
Our project, VeriHealth AI, directly addresses the Misinformation track by tackling one of the most critical and life-threatening challenges today—health misinformation. In a world where over 70% of users encounter false or misleading health advice weekly, existing verification tools are reactive, text-limited, and heavily manual. VeriHealth AI transforms this landscape through Agentic AI, building an autonomous, multimodal verification ecosystem capable of independent reasoning and decision-making.

The workflow of VeriHealth AI is driven by a multi-agent system that functions collaboratively yet autonomously. The Input Agent first detects the type of input—text, image, video, or reel link—and extracts the underlying health claim using OCR, Whisper, and NLP models. The Research Agent then autonomously queries credible databases such as WHO, PubMed, and CDC through APIs, retrieving verified scientific evidence. The Validation Agent compares this evidence against the extracted claim using reasoning models (LLaMA 3, GPT-4, and Mistral), assessing credibility and determining whether the claim is True, Misleading, or False. Finally, the Explainability Agent generates a transparent report that includes the verdict, confidence percentage, and reference links—ensuring clarity and accountability.

By enabling these AI agents to plan, reason, and act independently toward a shared verification goal, VeriHealth AI exemplifies the essence of Agentic AI. It not only combats the spread of false medical content in real time but also empowers users, journalists, and healthcare professionals with trustworthy, evidence-backed insights—positioning AI as a global guardian of health information integrity.

**Description of your solution**

CareGuard AI is a simple and smart helper that stays connected to patients after they leave the hospital. It calls patients every day using Phone call or WhatsApp to ask how they are feeling and listens carefully for any problems. It reminds patients to take their medicines on time and lets family or doctors know if help is needed. It also turns complicated medical reports into easy daily instructions in local languages so patients and families can understand what to do. This way, CareGuard AI helps people get better safely at home, avoiding unnecessary trips back to the hospital, and gives families peace of mind. It works all by itself, keeping a watchful eye 24/7 without needing humans to keep checking.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

CareGuard AI fits perfectly into the "Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI" track because it uses autonomous AI agents to solve a critical healthcare gap: post-discharge patient monitoring to reduce hospital readmissions.Unlike traditional AI or chatbots that only respond when prompted, CareGuard AI's agents actively perceive patient health signals daily, make intelligent decisions to detect risks, and autonomously take actions like calling patients, sending medication reminders, translating complex medical reports into simple local languages, and alerting doctors or family members when intervention is needed.This goal-driven, adaptive agentic AI approach improves patient outcomes by preventing complications early, reduces healthcare system burden by lowering costly readmissions, and enhances personalized care tailored to India's healthcare ecosystem and multilingual population.Thus, CareGuard AI exemplifies agentic AI's potential to automate, optimize, and personalize healthcare workflows beyond the hospital, making it a strong fit for this Healthtech track that values innovative, autonomous AI solutions addressing real patient care challenges.

> An AI-driven Health Coverage Navigator

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

“An AI-driven Health Coverage Navigator” — a unified digital assistant that helps patients and families make smart, stress-free hospital decisions during emergencies by providing instant clarity on Insurance Coverage, Hospital Costs, and Quality of Care — all in one place.
How It Works:
1.Smart Policy Analyzer
The user uploads or scans their health insurance policy.
The AI extracts key details like network hospitals, room rent limits, co-pay clauses, and coverage exclusions.
2.Hospital Network & Cost Checker
Given a hospital name or location, the system instantly verifies if it’s in-network for cashless claims.
Shows estimated treatment costs, compares them across nearby hospitals, and highlights where the policy gives maximum coverage.
3.Quality & Feedback Insights
Integrates government and crowd-sourced hospital data (NABH ratings, patient reviews, response time, etc.)
Ranks hospitals by care quality, claim approval rate, and patient satisfaction.
4.AI-Powered Emergency Mode
In an emergency, the assistant quickly recommends the nearest hospitals with cashless approval and good ratings.
Offers direct call or navigation options and pre-fills claim request forms to save time.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

"The Triple Threat in Healthcare: When a family faces a medical emergency, they are forced to make critical, high-stress decisions while blind to three vital factors: Insurance Coverage, Hospital Cost, and Quality of Care.
The Reality: 70% of medical claims in India face some form of rejection or deduction, often because patients choose an out-of-network hospital or select a room-type that exceeds their policy cap (leading to 'co-pay shock'). Families lose precious time frantically calling TPAs, getting surprise bills, and often settling for a lower-quality hospital just to ensure coverage.

**Description of your solution**

Solution For AI-Driven Public Health Chatbot

1. Disease Awareness Focus (not diagnosis only):

Most existing health chatbots (like symptom checkers) focus on diagnosis.

Your chatbot is awareness-driven, emphasizing prevention, lifestyle, and early detection education.



2. Verified & Trusted Information Only:

Unlike general chatbots that may pull data from the internet (risking misinformation), this bot will strictly use WHO, CDC, and Govt health databases.



3. Multilingual & Inclusive Design:

Supports regional languages → ensuring access for rural and low-literacy populations.

Most existing bots are only in English.



4. Emotion & Intent-Aware Chatbot:

Uses NLP with sentiment analysis to detect user urgency/concern.

Example: If a user sounds panicked, the chatbot shifts to a reassuring, urgent response mode.



5. Public Health Campaign Integration:

Can be adapted quickly for new outbreaks (e.g., COVID, Dengue, Monkeypox).

Acts as a dynamic awareness tool for governments, NGOs, and schools.



6. Personalized Preventive Recommendations:

Goes beyond static advice → provides personalized tips based on age, location, lifestyle.

Example: For someone in a Dengue-prone area, it suggests “Use mosquito nets, avoid stagnant water near home.”



7. Cross-Platform Accessibility:

Works on WhatsApp, Telegram, Web, and SMS, not just apps.

Makes it usable even without smartphones in some regions.

**Description of your solution**

The proposed solution is an AI-powered hospital assistant designed to predict patient surges in advance and automatically plan resources such as staff, medicines, beds, and patient advisories. By using data like festival calendars, weather, air quality, and past patient trends, the AI forecasts high-risk days (e.g., Diwali burns, pollution-related asthma spikes) and generates proactive action plans instead of last-minute reactions.

The system:

Forecasts crowd surges using machine learning models.

Automatically creates optimal shift schedules, inventory orders, and bed allocations.

Notifies staff via app and sends public advisories via WhatsApp/SMS, ensuring no app dependency for patients.

Continuously learns from real-time data and adjusts plans dynamically to prevent overcrowding, burnout, and stockouts.

In short, it transforms hospitals from reactive to proactive, ensuring preparedness before surges happen.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

This solution falls under HealthTech (Healthcare Technology) because it uses AI, data analytics, and automation to solve operational inefficiencies in hospitals—a major gap in current healthcare systems. Traditional HealthTech tools focus on electronic health records, telemedicine, or diagnostics, but very few systems focus on hospital preparedness and resource planning.

This project introduces a new layer in HealthTech:
👉 “Predictive Hospital Operations & Resource Intelligence.”

It leverages:

Predictive Analytics (AI forecasting) → part of HealthTech data intelligence.

Automated hospital workflow optimization → fits into Hospital Management Systems (HMS 2.0).

Digital communication via WhatsApp/SMS for patient care coordination → HealthTech communication layer.

AI-driven staff and inventory planning → falls under Smart Hospital & AI Ops (Operational HealthTech).

**Description of your solution**

India's healthcare system often faces sudden patient surges during festivals, seasonal pollution events, and disease outbreaks, leading to overcrowded hospitals and resource strain. To address this challenge, we present an AI-driven, agentic hospital management system that enables proactive preparedness and intelligent response during such high-demand periods.
The system combines real-time environmental data (such as weather and pollution APIs) with historical hospital records to accurately forecast patient inflow and health risk patterns. Specialized AI agents autonomously handle staffing recommendations, optimize shift schedules, monitor medical inventory, and trigger automated supply restocking when shortages are detected.
Additionally, the platform issues region-specific health advisories and can dynamically reallocate critical resources—such as ambulances, oxygen cylinders, or personnel—based on GIS-driven demand heatmaps. This intelligent and adaptive system empowers hospitals to reduce overcrowding, streamline operations, and deliver timely care when it matters most.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project fits the Healthtech track as it focuses on managing sudden surges in patients during festivals, pollution peaks, and disease outbreaks through an AI-driven, agentic hospital management system. It autonomously analyzes real-time environmental data and hospital records to predict patient inflow and health risks. The system’s AI agents optimize staffing schedules, monitor and restock medical inventory, and issue region-specific health advisories. Using GIS-based demand mapping, it also reallocates critical resources like ambulances and oxygen supplies when needed. By enabling proactive preparedness and intelligent hospital response, our project helps reduce overcrowding, streamline operations, and ensure better patient care during high-demand periods.

**Description of your solution**

**🩺 MedCanopy**
From Data to Delivery — Health Under One Roof

MedCanopy is an AI-powered healthcare intelligence platform that aggregates, analyzes, and optimizes real-world health and logistics data.
It acts as a data canopy — covering multiple layers of healthcare information such as lab reports, drug sales, environmental conditions, and disease patterns — to drive actionable insights and smarter logistics decisions.

**🚀 Overview**

Healthcare systems often operate in silos — labs, pharmacies, logistics, and city health data rarely interact efficiently.
MedCanopy bridges these gaps by creating a unified intelligence layer that:

Collects data from diverse medical and environmental sources.

Analyzes trends using AI-driven disease and condition mapping.

Predicts outbreaks, supply shortages, and health risks.

Optimizes logistics for medicine delivery, cold-chain management, and response routing.

**🧠 Core Features**

Multi-Source Data Integration – Aggregate lab reports, pharmacy transactions, temperature data, and disease metrics.

AI-Driven Analytics – Detect correlations, predict emerging health patterns, and assess risk zones.

Smart Logistics Layer – Recommend optimized delivery routes, supply reallocation, and emergency planning.

City Health Dashboard – Visualize live data with geospatial analytics and predictive indicators.

Agentic Operations – AI agents act autonomously to trigger alerts, notifications, or operational actions.

**🏗️ System Architecture**

Top-Down Approach:

Data Layer: Collects structured/unstructured data from APIs, reports, and IoT sensors.

Processing Layer: Cleans, validates, and transforms data for analytical readiness.

Intelligence Layer: AI models run predictions and disease-drug-condition mapping.

Agent Layer: Triggers automated decisions and logistics updates.

Visualization Layer: Presents insights through dashboards or alerts.

**🧩 Tech Stack**
Layer	Technologies
Frontend	Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
Backend	Python (FastAPI / Flask) or Node.js
Database	PostgreSQL / MongoDB
AI / ML	Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow), NLP for report analysis
APIs	Weather API, Health Data APIs, Drug Market APIs
Agent Framework	LangChain / CrewAI / OpenDevin
Visualization	React + Chart.js / Recharts / Mapbox
Auth & Security	JWT, OAuth2, Role-based Access
⚙️ Example Use Case

MedCanopy detects a spike in fever-related prescriptions and rising city temperatures.

The AI predicts a potential dengue outbreak zone.

The logistics agent reallocates mosquito-control supplies and medical kits to high-risk areas.

Dashboards update in real time — helping city authorities act before escalation.

**🌍 Vision**

MedCanopy aims to become the operating intelligence layer for healthcare ecosystems,
helping governments, hospitals, and logistics partners make data-backed, proactive decisions.

“Smarter health begins with connected intelligence.”

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

My project, MedCanopy, fits perfectly within the HealthTech track because it tackles one of the most critical challenges in healthcare today — managing unpredictable patient surges and system strain during events like festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics.

I’m building an AI-powered medical agent that continuously analyzes real-world data — from lab reports, drug sales, temperature variations, and city conditions — to detect early signs of rising health demand. Using these insights, the system autonomously recommends staffing adjustments, supply reallocation, and patient advisories well in advance.

This makes MedCanopy more than just a data analytics tool — it’s a decision-intelligence layer for healthcare ecosystems. It helps hospitals and local authorities predict and prepare, rather than react after a crisis hits.

In essence, my project fits the HealthTech track because it focuses on operational resilience, AI-driven foresight, and data-integrated decision-making — all aimed at improving how healthcare systems respond to real-world, time-sensitive challenges. It’s about bringing intelligence and coordination to the infrastructure that supports health, not just to diagnostics or treatment.

**Description of your solution**

Healthcare in rural areas encounter major obstacles. These involve a shortage of physicians, inadequate facilities, unreliable connections, and minimal tech skills among locals. Such factors contribute to postponed care, elevated expenses, and unfavorable results for patients. In response to these critical problems, a comprehensive telemedicine framework has been created. It includes three linked systems. **Medico** targets patients. **Medico-Doc** focuses on physicians. **MediServe** handles pharmacies. **Medico** functions as a multi-language app that works without internet. It allows video and audio sessions for patients. It offers **AI agent** based checks for **symptoms**. Users get protected medical files that can be viewed offline and updated online. Reminders for medications come automatically. Community aides help those who struggle with tech to make it work for everyone. **Medico-Doc** gives doctors a safe online site. They can review patient backgrounds there. **AI agent** helps with **diagnoses**. Prescriptions get made **digitally**. The setup connects to the official registry of health experts for proper checks. **MediServe** lets pharmacies track inventory right away. They handle orders through digital means. It recommends substitutes when items run out. Another agent analyses and provides a **sales report** to the pharmacies right away.

These systems combined create a full chain for medical services. Access becomes easier for patients. Doctors gain better workflow. Pharmacies see clearer operations. Officials receive data reports to spot illness patterns and direct supplies more effectively. The goal stands to close the divide in care for countryside spots. Quality treatment reaches everyone. Location barriers or tech know-how do not matter.

These agents act autonomously to perform complex tasks, making healthcare more efficient, accessible, and easier to understand.

**Description of your solution**

To truly understand a user’s spending habits and offer personalized recommendations, we need to focus on two key components:

1. **User Profile & Life Goals**
   The first step is gathering a comprehensive understanding of the user's life goals and financial aspirations. We need to know what financial challenges they are facing and how they envision us helping them overcome those obstacles. A detailed onboarding process will collect the essential data points that will allow us to recommend solutions tailored to their unique needs and goals.

2. **Effortless Financial Tracking**
   To track user spending seamlessly, we will integrate with **Bank Aggregator APIs**, as established by the RBI’s Account Aggregator framework. This will allow us to securely access and retrieve financial data directly from the user’s bank accounts, eliminating the friction of manual data entry. This approach ensures the process is smooth, secure, and automated, providing accurate and up-to-date insights into their financial behavior.

By combining both **user insights** and **automated tracking**, we will be able to build a powerful **Two-Tower Recommendation System**. This model, will enable us to deliver truly personalized financial advice, continuously adapting as we gather more information.

With regular updates to our knowledge base, we will learn more about the user’s financial habits and goals, ensuring we offer the best and most relevant recommendations, keeping their financial journey on track.

A significant challenge many individuals face is the lack of accessible financial literacy resources. The internet is saturated with conflicting advice, much of which carries inherent biases that may not serve our users' best interests. 
To address this, we're introducing an AI-powered financial tutoring system based on trusted advisor personas, similar to Delphi [https://www.delphi.ai](url) but exclusively focused on finance.
 Each persona will be built from the expertise of verified and reputable financial advisors whose content is publicly available. Users can interact with these AI personas to receive unbiased guidance, helping them develop a robust financial mindset and make informed decisions.

By combining intelligent automation, personalized insights, and trusted AI-powered guidance, we're creating a comprehensive financial companion that not only tracks spending but also educates and empowers users to achieve lasting financial wellness.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/digital-health-record-and-management-system-4af1) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://1drv.ms/p/c/83a0503b9073103e/EVO4LivScPtLmw5ljEps5kkBL8a8TcBh73G1frF0V-cw9w?e=lnozzo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co)

> Connecting Workers to Digital Healthcare

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

1. Introduction & Problem Context Migration is one of the defining features of India’s labor economy. Kerala, a state heavily dependent on migrant workers, particularly from states such as Bihar, West Bengal, Odisha, and Assam, faces unique challenges in ensuring equitable access to healthcare for this population. Migrant workers play a critical role in construction, agriculture, manufacturing, and service sectors, yet remain among the most vulnerable groups when it comes to healthcare access. A major gap lies in the absence of centralized and portable health records. Unlike residents with easier access to state-supported health services, migrants often lack continuity of care. They move between districts and jobs, and rarely carry medical histories or vaccination records. This lack of documentation prevents timely treatment, complicates diagnosis, and increases the risk of disease outbreaks. The situation is especially concerning for communicable diseases such as tuberculosis, hepatitis, malaria, and COVID-19, where early detection and monitoring are essential. Without effective tracking, governments struggle to anticipate outbreaks, employers cannot ensure safe workplaces, and workers remain vulnerable to untreated illnesses. Language barriers, low digital literacy, and lack of awareness further exacerbate the issue. Many workers come from rural or economically disadvantaged backgrounds, making them unfamiliar with hospital protocols or online systems. This project directly aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): SDG 3: Good health and well-being SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth SDG 10: Reduced inequalities SDG 11: Sustainable cities and communities The proposed solution seeks to bridge this gap by creating a Digital Health Record Management System (DHRMS) specifically designed for migrant workers in Kerala, with potential for nationwide scalability. 2. Proposed Solution The DHRMS will serve as a centralized, secure, and accessible platform where health records of migrant workers are stored, updated, and shared with authorized stakeholders. The system is designed to balance three key priorities: accessibility for workers, usability for healthcare providers, and scalability for government and employers. 2.1 Migrant Registration Registration is facilitated at government hospitals, primary health centers, or employer-led health camps. Each worker is assigned a unique health ID, linked to Aadhaar or another identity document, and represented through a QR code for quick access. A simple, multilingual, and voice-assisted interface ensures inclusivity for low-literacy workers. 2.2 Access to Medical Records Workers can securely access their health history, lab reports, prescriptions, and vaccination status via a web or mobile portal. Voice narration in Hindi, Bengali, Odia, Tamil, and Malayalam makes health data understandable even for workers with minimal literacy. QR-based authentication ensures privacy while enabling easy access. 2.3 Hospital Integration Government hospitals across Kerala are connected to the platform. Doctors and authorized staff can upload diagnostic results, prescriptions, and treatment notes directly into the system. The centralized platform ensures continuity of care, preventing repetitive tests and reducing delays. 2.4 Employer Screening Employers, with worker consent, can verify communicable disease status during recruitment. This prevents workplace outbreaks, protects other employees, and creates safer working environments. The system encourages ethical hiring practices by balancing health verification with worker privacy. 2.5 Public Health Tracking Real-time dashboards enable the government to track disease trends, hotspots, and outbreaks. Analytics and visualization tools help allocate resources, plan interventions, and prioritize high-risk areas. Long-term data collection supports evidence-based policymaking. 3. Innovation & Uniqueness What makes this solution innovative is not just its functionality but its focus on inclusivity, security, and scalability: Inclusive Access Multilingual user interface in major migrant languages (Hindi, Bengali, Odia, Tamil, Malayalam). Voice-guided navigation for workers with limited literacy. Privacy & Security Aadhaar-linked login combined with QR-based scanning for easy yet secure access. Consent-driven sharing ensures workers control who sees their records. End-to-end encryption and role-based access prevent misuse. Digital Health Accessibility Workers can receive digital prescriptions, reducing dependency on physical reports. Hospitals and doctors benefit from historical data visibility, enabling better treatment. Integration with National Missions Aligned with India’s National Digital Health Mission (NDHM). Can be scaled beyond Kerala, integrating with existing national health databases. 4. Technical Approach Cloud-based Databases: Secure and scalable infrastructure for storing health records. Secure APIs: Ena

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our project perfectly aligns with the Digital Governance and Healthcare Innovation track, focusing on inclusivity, accessibility, and digital transformation in the public health sector.

Kerala has a large population of migrant workers who often face difficulties in maintaining consistent and accessible health records due to frequent job and location changes. Our Digital Health Record and Management System directly addresses this issue by providing a centralized, secure, and portable digital platform where migrant workers’ medical data can be stored, updated, and accessed by authorized government hospitals across the state.

By integrating Aadhaar-based authentication, OTP verification, and cloud-backed health data storage, the system ensures each worker has a unique, lifelong health identity accessible anytime, anywhere. This aligns with the government’s vision of Digital India, Ayushman Bharat, and eHealth Kerala, promoting interoperability and efficiency in healthcare delivery.

The solution contributes to:

Improved healthcare access for vulnerable migrant communities

Digital management of patient data for hospitals and government authorities

Transparency, data security, and scalability through a robust digital framework

Social impact, empowering workers with digital inclusion in health services

In essence, our project leverages technology for social good, aligning seamlessly with the hackathon’s track on digital innovation for governance and public welfare, while supporting Kerala’s mission toward a digitally inclusive healthcare ecosystem.

> Healing the financial side of healthcare

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**MediFund: Healing the Financial Side of Healthcare**

---

### **Problem Statement**

* During medical emergencies, patients and their families are burdened not only by health concerns but also by financial confusion.
* Hospital bills are complex, insurance processes are slow and unclear, and government schemes are often underutilized.
* As a result:

  * Reimbursements are delayed or denied.
  * Eligible patients miss out on financial aid.
  * Families face unnecessary out-of-pocket expenses.
  * Stress and errors increase during a critical time.

---

### **Objectives**

* Automate the complete financial workflow during hospitalization.
* Ensure faster insurance claims and government scheme utilization.
* Provide real-time, intelligent financial assistance to patients.
* Eliminate manual paperwork, delays, and human errors in claim processing.
* Empower users with proactive financial decision-making powered by AI.

---

### **Solution Description: MediFund AI Agent**

**MediFund** is an autonomous Agentic AI platform that acts as a virtual financial assistant for patients and caregivers. It simplifies medical financial management through intelligent automation, real-time decision-making, and integration with health financing systems.

**Key Features and Workflow:**

1. **Upload and Document Understanding**

   * Patients upload hospital bills, prescriptions, and insurance policies.
   * MediFund uses OCR and NLP to extract relevant data from these documents accurately.

2. **Eligibility Verification**

   * The AI checks insurance coverage and matches data against real-time APIs (e.g., IRDAI, Ayushman Bharat, and other schemes).
   * It identifies whether the treatment is covered and by which schemes.

3. **Automated Claim Filing and Tracking**

   * If eligible, MediFund auto-fills and files claims to insurers or government bodies.
   * It tracks claim status end-to-end and provides real-time updates to the user.

4. **Agentic Intelligence and Action**

   * If insurance is insufficient or claims are rejected, the AI:

     * Suggests alternate health schemes, subsidies, or NGO support.
     * Recommends personalized financial strategies or better policy options.
   * The system learns from user data to improve future recommendations and decisions.

5. **Dashboard and Interaction**

   * Users get a personalized dashboard to monitor expenses, reimbursements, and pending actions.
   * An intelligent floating chatbot guides users and answers financial questions contextually.

---

### **Technology Stack**

* **Frontend:** React + Tailwind CSS
* **Backend:** Python (FastAPI / Flask)
* **AI Components:**

  * OCR: Tesseract / EasyOCR
  * NLP: HuggingFace Transformers / OpenAI APIs
  * Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen
* **Database:** PostgreSQL / MongoDB
* **Integrations:** IRDAI, Ayushman Bharat, and other government/insurance APIs

---

### **Target Audience**

* Patients and caregivers who need financial clarity during or after hospitalization
* Hospitals and insurance companies looking to automate and speed up claims
* NGOs and government health departments aiming to improve scheme access and transparency

---

### **How MediFund Saves Time and Money**

* Reduces time to file claims by auto-filling forms with AI-extracted data
* Prevents delays caused by human error or missing documentation
* Ensures users don’t miss out on financial benefits they are eligible for
* Minimizes manual hospital administration for claims, saving institutional time and effort
* Lowers patient out-of-pocket spending by surfacing hidden financial aid options

---

### **Revenue Model**

1. **B2C – Freemium Model**

   * Free Tier: Upload and track claims manually.
   * Premium Tier: Full automation, personalized recommendations, real-time tracking.

2. **B2B – Enterprise Licensing**

   * Hospitals and insurers can integrate MediFund into their systems for automated claim management and internal dashboards.

3. **Commission Model**

   * MediFund earns a small service fee from partners (hospitals/insurers) for every successful claim filed or approved via the platform.

---

### **Social and Market Impact**

* Supports underserved communities in accessing health financing schemes with ease.
* Helps reduce claim rejection rates through AI-driven accuracy and automation.
* Brings FinTech and HealthTech together for a stronger digital health infrastructure.
* Supports India’s goal for inclusive and digitized healthcare financing.
* Builds trust and transparency in medical finance during life’s most vulnerable moments.

---

### **Conclusion**

MediFund is not just a digital assistant — it’s a self-driven financial agent for healthcare. By intelligently managing everything from bill analysis to reimbursement, it allows patients and their families to focus on healing while the AI handles the paperwork. In a complex and high-stakes environment like healthcare, MediFund provides timely and reliable financial relief.

**Fintech: Bring your own problem in Fintech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

### **Why We Chose the FinTech Track for MediFund**

1. **Healthcare Financing is Fundamentally a Financial Problem**

   * Managing hospital bills, insurance claims, and accessing government schemes are complex financial workflows that require intelligent financial handling.

2. **MediFund Automates Financial Transactions in Healthcare**

   * The core functionality of MediFund involves automating claim filing, reimbursement tracking, and financial decision-making — all of which fall within the scope of financial technology.

3. **Focus on Financial Inclusion and Accessibility**

   * MediFund helps patients, especially those from underserved communities, discover and access financial aid and insurance benefits, contributing directly to the FinTech goal of financial inclusion.

4. **Agentic AI for Financial Decision-Making**

   * The platform doesn’t just assist with information; it takes financial actions (e.g., initiating claims, suggesting aid programs), aligning perfectly with modern FinTech innovations like autonomous agents and smart advisors.

5. **Integration with Financial Ecosystems**

   * MediFund connects to real-time insurance APIs, government financial databases, and banking/payment systems for claim disbursement and processing, making it a strong example of FinTech infrastructure integration.

6. **Revenue and Business Models are Finance-Oriented**

   * The monetization strategy (freemium, commissions on claims, enterprise licensing) is rooted in FinTech models, based on financial transactions and value-added financial automation.

7. **Addresses a Critical Gap in Health Finance Management**

   * While healthcare tech focuses on treatment and records, MediFund solves a missing piece: the **financial layer of healthcare**, making it a strong fit for FinTech innovation.

8. **Improves Efficiency of Financial Workflows in a Regulated Sector**

   * MediFund operates within the rules and frameworks of insurance, reimbursement, and health scheme governance — a space where regulatory-compliant financial technology is essential.

**Description of your solution**

**VitalWise** is an AI-powered health assistant that simplifies medication management. Instead of using clunky forms, users simply chat with an AI in plain English (e.g., "I took my Lisinopril") to automatically track their pill inventory, log doses, and get smart alerts before they run out of medication.

### **Project Description**

We are building a functional prototype featuring:
*   **An AI Chat Assistant :** To understand and process natural language commands for managing medication.
*   **Automated Inventory Tracking:** A system that automatically calculates "Days of Supply" and triggers critical refill alerts.
*   **Caregiver Communication Module:** A tool to generate quick health summaries and allow caregivers to ask the AI questions about the patient's status.

### **What specific pain points it addresses**

1.  **Medication Non-Adherence:** Makes it effortless to log doses, reducing forgetfulness.
2.  **Tedious Manual Tracking:** Replaces manual pill counting and logging with simple conversation.
3.  **Running Out of Medication:** Proactively alerts users to get refills, preventing dangerous gaps in treatment.
4.  **Poor Patient-Caregiver Communication:** Gives caregivers a simple way to get clear, data-driven updates.

### **Target audience :**

*   **Patients with Chronic Conditions** who manage multiple medications.
*   **Elderly Patients & Their Caregivers** who need a simple, accessible way to manage health and stay coordinated.

### **Business Model**

*   **Go-To-Market:** Start with a direct-to-consumer freemium app to build a user base, then partner with clinics and pharmacies to expand reach.
*   **Revenue Streams:**
    1.  **Premium Subscription (B2C):** Monthly fee for unlimited medications, advanced analytics, and caregiver features.
    2.  **SaaS Licensing (B2B):** Charge healthcare providers a per-patient fee to use the platform for remote monitoring.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The problem we're tackling is **medication non-adherence**, a critical issue in healthcare where up to 50% of patients with chronic conditions fail to take their medication as prescribed. This is largely because manual tracking is tedious, error-prone, and a significant cognitive burden.

Our healthtech solution directly addresses this friction. We replace outdated manual logs with a smart, **Agentic AI** that allows patients to manage their health through simple, natural conversation. By making the process effortless, we aim to dramatically improve adherence, prevent dangerous gaps in treatment, and provide better data for patient and caregiver collaboration.

**Description of your solution**

**CuraCheck **is an **AI-powered misinformation detection agent **designed to identify and correct false or misleading health-related claims in real time. The system leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP), fact-checking APIs, and verified medical knowledge bases to help users distinguish between credible information and misinformation circulating on digital platforms.
1) How It Works
User Input / Data Capture
Users can input any health-related claim (e.g., “Turmeric milk prevents cancer”) through a web interface, chatbot, or browser plugin.
AI-Powered Claim Understanding
CuraCheck uses NLP models to extract key medical entities and context (disease, treatment, symptom, etc.) from the user’s text.
Real-Time Verification Layer
The system then cross-verifies the extracted claim against trusted sources — such as WHO, NIH, PubMed, and Google Fact Check APIs — and uses AI models (like BART-MNLI / RoBERTa) to determine whether the statement is True, False, or Partially True.
Explanation and Source Validation
Once verified, CuraCheck generates a concise explanation (using GPT or a summarization model) with verified references, explaining why the claim is true or false and citing authoritative medical sources.
Result Visualization (Real-Time UI)
The frontend instantly displays the verdict with:
Status (True / False / Partially True)
Confidence Score
Verified Explanation
Source Links (WHO, CDC, NIH, etc.)
2) Core Features
Real-Time Detection: Instant claim verification as users type or paste statements.
Trusted Source Integration: Cross-checks with WHO, PubMed, and verified health APIs.
AI Reasoning Engine: Uses transformer models for fact classification and evidence scoring.
Multi-Platform Compatibility: Can be deployed as a web app, browser extension, or chatbot.
Educational Impact: Provides simplified, trustworthy explanations to combat misinformation.
3) Pain Points Solved
The spread of fake medical advice on WhatsApp, YouTube, and social media.
Public confusion during epidemics or health crises.
Lack of real-time tools for users to verify health claims.
Difficulty in distinguishing scientifically-backed facts from viral myths.
4) Target Audience
General Public: To check if health tips or remedies are legitimate.
Students & Researchers: To validate claims and learn evidence-based facts.
Healthcare Organizations & NGOs: To monitor and counteract misinformation trends.
Media & Fact-Checkers: To support verified medical reporting.
5) Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy
Phase 1: Launch a free web platform for public use.
Phase 2: Partner with hospitals, NGOs, and universities to integrate the API.
Phase 3: Develop a browser extension & chatbot for WhatsApp and Telegram.
Phase 4: Create partnerships with media houses for real-time misinformation alerts.
 Revenue Streams
API Licensing: Offer API access to news/media companies and healthcare institutions.
Subscription Plans: Premium version for professionals with detailed reports.
B2B Integration: Collaboration with government and health organizations for misinformation monitoring dashboards.
Advertisement & Sponsorships: From verified health brands or awareness campaigns.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

CuraCheck perfectly fits the Misinformation track as it tackles one of the most critical and harmful forms of misinformation — health-related false claims. Using AI and NLP, CuraCheck analyzes user-submitted health statements in real time, verifies them through trusted medical sources like WHO, NIH, and PubMed, and provides fact-based explanations with confidence scores. By detecting and clarifying misinformation instantly, it empowers users to make informed decisions, promotes digital health literacy, and supports the hackathon’s goal of leveraging Agentic AI to combat misinformation and enhance societal trust in verified information.

Aarogya Unified Health Network

Aarogya is an AI-powered, patient-centric health network that connects wearable data, hospital records, and personal health logs into a single, secure, and portable medical profile. The goal is to eliminate fragmented healthcare by giving every individual a universal, consent-based health record that travels with them — not locked to a single hospital or platform.

The system continuously syncs health metrics (like heart rate, SpO₂, and sleep quality) from devices and stores them in a privacy-preserving cloud vault. When a patient visits a new doctor, they can instantly share their complete health history through a secure QR-based access system.

At its core, Aarogya runs on a multi-agent AI architecture:

The **Orchestrator **understands doctor commands and manages AI workflows.

The **Analyst **detects anomalies and health risks in real time.

The **Scribe **generates reports, alerts, and follow-ups automatically.

Together, they enable proactive, personalized care, reduce diagnostic delays, and bring Agentic AI into practical, human-aligned healthcare.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Aarogya Unified Health Network fits the HealthTech × Agentic AI track by transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. It connects fragmented medical data—hospital records, lab reports, and wearable streams—into one secure, portable health record accessible anywhere.

At its core, Aarogya uses a multi-agent AI system:
an Orchestrator Agent that interprets natural language queries,
an Analyst Agent that autonomously detects health anomalies, and
a Scribe Agent that generates clear summaries and alerts.

These agents collaborate to continuously monitor, interpret, and act on health data—not just analyzing, but reasoning and assisting in real time. By enabling preventive care, early warnings, and patient-controlled data sharing, Aarogya embodies the future of autonomous, human-aligned healthcare—making it a perfect fit for this year’s HealthTech and Agentic AI theme.

> Fog alert system for patients

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![NodeMCU IoT](https://img.shields.io/badge/NodeMCU%20IoT-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Hardware, Setup, and Data Acquisition
​0. Hardware & Placement
​The system uses an ESP32 controller to manage data from both an EMG sensor (monitoring muscle signals) and an IMU sensor (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope, e.g., MPU6050). The device is worn on the lower leg, between the shin and calf. The IMU is best placed on the lower shank or ankle for gait phase detection.
​1. System Setup & Calibration
​Upon power-on, the device performs an automatic setup:
​IMU Bias Calibration: The IMU is allowed to sit still for 5–10 seconds to record the static mean bias for the accelerometer (\text{acc\_bias}) and gyroscope (\text{gyro\_bias}). These biases are subtracted from all subsequent readings.
​Sampling: The system samples the IMU data (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz) at a common rate of 100 Hz (or 200 Hz for finer detail) along with the EMG signals.
​2. Sampling & Data Format
​The system samples both sensor streams at each time step \mathbf{t}:
​\text{ax}(t), \text{ay}(t), \text{az}(t) in \text{m/s}^2
​\text{gx}(t), \text{gy}(t), \text{gz}(t) in \text{^\circ/s}
​EMG raw signal (voltage/amplitude).
​Data is processed in real-time using a sliding window (e.g., 0.5 s size, 0.1 s step).
​II. Data Processing and Signal Cleaning
​3. Filtering (Clean the Data)
​Raw data is processed to remove noise:
​IMU Filtering: Low-pass filters are applied (e.g., \text{cutoff} \approx 20 \text{ Hz} for accelerometer, \approx 30 \text{ Hz} for gyroscope).
​EMG Processing: EMG signals are typically rectified and filtered (often a bandpass followed by an envelope filter) to get a signal that represents muscle effort.
​4. Compute Acceleration Magnitude & Orientation
​The ESP32 computes metrics to aid detection:
​Acceleration Magnitude: \text{acc\_mag}(t) = \sqrt{\text{ax}^2 + \text{ay}^2 + \text{az}^2}.
​Orientation (Optional): If needed for accurate gait phase and displacement, a complementary or Madgwick filter fuses gyro and accel data to estimate pitch, roll, and yaw angles.
​III. Gait Analysis and Freezing of Gait Detection
​5. Step Detection (IMU-only)
​The system analyzes the filtered IMU data for cyclic walking patterns:
​Peak Detection: Local peaks in the \text{acc\_mag} or vertical acceleration (\text{acc\_z}) are found above a specific threshold (e.g., 1.2 \text{ m/s}^2) and separated by a minimum time (e.g., \text{min\_peak\_distance} \approx 0.4 \text{ s}). Each peak is marked as a step event (e.g., heel-strike).
​Gait Event Detection (HS/TO): Heel-Strike (\mathbf{HS}) and Toe-Off (\mathbf{TO}) are more accurately detected by looking for sharp changes in \text{acc\_z} and characteristic peaks/sign changes in the gyroscope data (\text{gyro\_y}).
​6. Freezing of Gait (FOG) Detection (The Core Mechanism)
​The ESP32 controller performs the critical comparison:
​Compare Sensors: It compares the processed EMG signals (the patient's intention to move) with the IMU readings (the actual movement of the leg).
​FOG Rule (EMG + IMU): If the EMG signal shows intent (muscle activity is above a threshold indicating an attempt to walk) BUT the IMU shows no movement (no step peaks detected, and \text{acc\_mag} RMS is below a motion threshold for a specified duration), the system detects Freezing of Gait.
​FOG Rule (IMU-only): The system can also use an IMU-only rule: if the \text{acc\_mag} RMS is low for a minimum time (\text{T\_freeze\_min} \approx 0.5 \text{ s}) AND there's a sudden, long gap between steps (>1.5 \times \text{mean step time}), it flags a possible FOG or stop.
​7. FOG Correction/Cueing
​Correction Output: As soon as FOG is detected, the device provides a immediate, quick vibration cue (placed behind the neck). This acts as a sensory stimulus to "break the freeze" and allow the patient to continue walking.
​IV. Post-Processing, Metrics, and Safety Features
​8. Compute Gait Metrics
​The system computes clinical metrics from the detected events (HS, TO, Steps):
​Temporal Metrics: Cadence (steps/min), Step time (s), Stride time (s).
​Phase Metrics: Stance phase duration (\text{HS} to \text{TO}) and Swing phase duration (\text{TO} to next \text{HS}), and their percentage of the gait cycle.
​Spatial Metrics (Technical): Step and Stride length (m) are estimated either empirically (model-based) or via double integration of world-frame acceleration, using ZUPT (Zero Velocity Update) during the stance phase to reset drift.
​9. Data Logging and Remote Monitoring
​Cloud Storage: The device continuously sends the raw data and computed gait metrics to Firebase cloud storage via Wi-Fi, ensuring the patient’s walking history and event logs are accessible for later review.
​Alerts and Safety:
​If the patient experiences prolonged freezing or if the IMU detects an unusual, sudden movement (e.g., a fall), the system immediately sends a critical alert message to family members or a doctor, ensuring a quick response in emergencies.

**Description of your solution**

🏥 HealthAI — Smart Virtual Health Companion

Problem Statement
Health-tech (2): Bring your own problem in Health, leveraging AI

Modern healthcare is often inaccessible, scattered, and reactive rather than proactive.
Patients struggle to get instant, reliable advice for basic health concerns, oral issues, or traditional care guidance. Many lack access to general practitioners or delay treatment due to uncertainty — especially in rural and semi-urban regions.

There’s also a gap between primary health awareness and professional medical consultation — something an intelligent, AI-powered platform can bridge.
💡 Solution

HealthAI is an all-in-one AI-powered virtual health assistant that helps users understand and manage their health with ease.
It offers specialized chatbots trained for three key domains of healthcare — General Medicine (MBBS), Ayurveda (BAMS), and Dentistry (BDS) — providing quick, safe, and personalized health guidance.

Each domain has its own dedicated AI chatbot:

🩺 MBBS AI Assistant – Provides safe, general medical advice and temporary cures for common symptoms.

🌿 BAMS AI Assistant – Suggests Ayurvedic home remedies, natural therapies, and holistic wellness tips.

🦷 BDS AI Assistant – Gives dental care tips, oral hygiene suggestions, and first-aid for dental discomfort.

**Description of your solution**

Modern drug discovery produces vast amounts of biological, chemical, and clinical data — from preclinical biomarkers to patient-reported adverse events. Interpreting this data to assess a drug’s safety remains a major challenge.
This project presents an AI-driven agentic system that integrates multiple biomedical datasets (such as eTox, Open TG-GATEs, FAERS, DisGeNET, and ChEMBL) to predict drug toxicity, adverse reactions, and drug–drug interactions. The system uses dedicated predictive agents — each trained or fine-tuned for specific safety-related tasks — and a central LLM reasoning agent that synthesizes all analytical outputs into a comprehensive, human-readable safety report.
The system is implemented as a web-based platform where users can input compound or biomarker data, trigger automated analysis, visualize risk predictions, and receive a structured report containing safety profiles, predicted organ toxicity, possible adverse drug reactions, drug–drug interaction risks, and an overall recommendation for preclinical or clinical testing.
This MVP focuses on modularity, interpretability, and end-to-end automation — combining traditional ML, domain knowledge, and LLM reasoning to enable faster, data-driven decisions in drug safety evaluation.

**Description of your solution**

# AURA — Agentic Urban Resilience Architecture
AURA (Agentic Urban Resilience Architecture) is a predictive management system designed to improve resilience of Mumbai's public healthcare network. It transforms reactive crisis response into proactive, data-driven planning by combining multi-source real-time data with agentic AI modules that forecast demand, manage supplies, support workforce resilience, and engage citizens.

## Vision
Enable hospitals, public health authorities, and communities in Mumbai to anticipate and mitigate surges (festival-related trauma, pollution-driven respiratory waves, seasonal epidemics) and prevent cascading failures caused by specialized resource shortages, staff burnout, and fragmented data.

## Key Problems Addressed
- Predictable and unpredictable patient surges (festivals, pollution, epidemics)
- Resource bottlenecks and specialized resource mismatches
- Chronic staff burnout and absenteeism
- Fragmented, delayed, or missing ground-truth data for decision-making

## Datasets & Inputs
AURA ingests structured and unstructured streams:
- Structured: AQI forecasts, weather APIs, anonymized HMIS (admissions, bed occupancy, inventory), public calendars, epidemiological case counts (BMC, NCDC)
- Unstructured: News (EN/MR/HI), social media trend signals, anonymized internal communications
- Citizen-sourced: Symptom reports & triage data collected via The Scribe (WhatsApp)

## System Overview
AURA is a multi-agent system operating as a centralized intelligent command center:
- The Oracle — Predictive Intelligence Agent: fuses all data to produce high-resolution surge forecasts and risk maps.
- The Scribe — Public Interaction & Triage Agent: WhatsApp-based triage, OCR/NLP for prescriptions/reports, collects anonymized ground truth and delivers targeted public advisories.
- The Quartermaster — Predictive Supply Chain Agent: forecasts supply needs and recommends pre-emptive redistribution or procurement.
- The Sentinel — Workforce Resilience Agent: predicts staffing needs, flags burnout risk, and suggests optimized rosters.

Agents form a closed feedback loop: The Oracle issues forecasts → Scribe collects ground-truth from citizens → Oracle refines forecasts → Quartermaster & Sentinel act on refined intelligence → Scribe communicates public advisories (upon human approval).

## Example Scenario (Holi + Pollution Spike)
1. Oracle forecasts hazardous AQI coinciding with Holi and predicts dual surge (respiratory + trauma).
2. Scribe detects local spikes in breathing-related WhatsApp queries from a neighborhood.
3. Oracle integrates these signals, raises confidence and issues targeted alerts.
4. Quartermaster recommends pre-emptive stock transfer (e.g., salbutamol) to nearby hospitals.
5. Sentinel adjusts staffing rosters and puts specialists on-call.
6. Scribe sends localized preventive advisories to residents (after approval).

## Interfaces & Features
- Interactive Agent Chatbot: conversational oversight for public health officials (query any agent, inspect forecasts and recommended actions).
- Hospital Dashboard: supply-level heatmaps, procurement recommendations (Quartermaster), staffing forecasts & roster suggestions (Sentinel).
- Community Forum & Supply Exchange: peer-to-peer hospital requests, vendor marketplace for rapid sourcing.
- WhatsApp Integration: secure upload and explanation of prescriptions/reports, triage, and proactive alerts via The Scribe.

## Privacy, Security & Ethics
- All patient and citizen data is anonymized and aggregated before storage/analysis.
- Minimal data retention policies, access controls, and audit logs are expected in deployment.
- Human-in-the-loop approvals required for public advisories and critical automated actions.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

# How Project AURA Fits into the Healthtech Track

Project AURA is a solution designed to address the critical challenge of managing **unpredictable surges in patient demand** caused by festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics in urban healthcare systems. It fits perfectly into the **Healthtech** track as it leverages **AI**, **predictive analytics**, and **real-time data integration** to optimize healthcare management, improve resource allocation, and ensure better resilience and responsiveness during peak periods. Here’s how:

## 1. **Predictive Management of Patient Surges**
The core of the solution revolves around **predictive analytics** to forecast patient surges, enabling healthcare systems to act **ahead of time**. 
- **Proactive Planning**: Project AURA doesn’t wait for the crisis to unfold—it uses AI to **anticipate** surges in demand (from festivals, pollution, or epidemics) and prepares the system in advance. This approach moves from reactive to **proactive healthcare management**, a key focus of the **Healthtech** track.
- **Real-Time Data Integration**: By analyzing real-time data streams from **environmental sensors, hospital management systems**, and even **social media**, AURA can predict surges in patient numbers and specific medical needs. This helps prevent overwhelm and ensures that the right resources are available at the right time.

## 2. **Autonomous Actions for Resource Allocation**
Project AURA enhances resource allocation through **autonomous decision-making** driven by AI.
- **AI-Powered Resource Planning**: The system’s **Quartermaster** and **Sentinel** agents predict the demand for supplies and staffing, ensuring that the right resources—whether **medications, ventilators, or specialists**—are pre-positioned before surges hit. This is a key element of **Healthtech**, where AI is used to drive **efficient, timely responses** to healthcare crises.
- **Optimized Workforce Management**: The **Sentinel** agent predicts and adjusts staffing levels based on surge forecasts, helping prevent **burnout** and ensuring adequate staffing during peak periods. 

## 3. **Scalability and System-Wide Coordination**
AURA integrates **AI-powered communication** and coordination across the entire healthcare system, making it a **scalable** solution for large cities like Mumbai. 
- **Cross-Hospital Collaboration**: Through the **Community Forum & Supply Exchange**, AURA allows **real-time resource sharing** between hospitals and vendors, optimizing the entire healthcare system’s response to surges. This scalability and interconnectedness fit perfectly into the **Healthtech** vision of building **holistic**, **integrated systems** to manage urban health crises.
- **Dynamic Decision Making**: With the **interactive dashboard** and **chatbot oversight**, public health officials can monitor the system’s operations, ensuring **transparency** and **flexibility** in crisis management.

## 4. **Leveraging Real-Time Citizen Data for Proactive Public Health**
AURA enhances **public health communication** by integrating **WhatsApp**-based engagement, allowing the system to interact directly with citizens and gather real-time data on symptoms and concerns.
- **Public Interaction & Early Warning**: Through the **Scribe** agent, citizens can report symptoms, get automated triage, and receive early warnings about potential health threats (like pollution spikes or disease outbreaks). This direct citizen interaction is a key element of **Healthtech**, where **AI** is used to improve **public health outcomes** and **preventive care**.
- **Data-Driven Health Advisory**: The Scribe sends proactive, **targeted alerts** to the public based on predictive models from the Oracle agent. This ensures that citizens are **informed and prepared**, preventing health crises from escalating.

## 5. **Sustainability and Efficiency in Healthcare**
Project AURA is designed to optimize both **human resources** and **medical supplies**, addressing the issue of **sustainability** in urban healthcare systems.
- **Reduced Burnout and Overcrowding**: By using AI to **predict and prepare** for surges in demand, AURA helps reduce **staff burnout** and **hospital overcrowding**, creating a more sustainable healthcare environment. This focus on **workforce wellness** is aligned with the **Healthtech** track’s emphasis on creating **long-term solutions** that balance technology with human-centered care.
- **Supply Chain Resilience**: AURA enhances the **supply chain resilience** by predicting medical needs and ensuring timely procurement, preventing shortages during critical periods.

## Conclusion
Project AURA is a **cutting-edge solution** that integrates AI-driven **predictive management**, **autonomous decision-making**, and **real-time citizen engagement** to ensure **resilience** and **efficiency** in urban healthcare systems. Its ability to handle unpredictable patient surges and optimize healthcare resources makes it a perfect fit fo

**Description of your solution**

Healthy_Bot is an intelligent AI-powered chatbot designed to help people understand their health symptoms in a simple and reliable way. Whenever someone feels unwell or confused about their health condition, they can chat with Healthy_Bot just like they talk to a friend.

The bot will ask clear and guided questions about the user’s symptoms — such as pain areas, duration, severity, lifestyle habits, and medical history. Based on these answers, Healthy_Bot will use AI-driven health analysis to suggest possible causes or diseases related to those symptoms.

It doesn’t replace a doctor but helps users identify early signs, understand risk factors, and learn about preventive measures such as home remedies, healthy diet tips, and when to seek medical help.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Healthy_Bot uses Agentic AI to behave like a virtual health assistant — not just a Q&A bot.
Here’s how:
1. Understands the Problem:
When a user types something like “I have a headache and fever,” the AI doesn’t stop there. It acts — by asking intelligent questions such as:
“How long have you had these symptoms?”
“Do you feel any body pain or cold?”
“Have you been under stress or lacking sleep?”

2. Thinks and Decides:
Based on the user’s answers, the AI analyzes the pattern and compares it with known disease data — just like a doctor’s reasoning process.

Takes Action:
The AI then suggests a possible diagnosis (e.g., “This could be viral fever or migraine-related”) and guides next steps — such as:

“You should drink more fluids, rest, and if fever continues for 2 days, consult a doctor.”

Learns Over Time:
With each conversation, the bot learns how users describe symptoms and becomes better at identifying them — a key feature of an agentic system.

 3. Why It Matters:

By using Agentic AI, Healthy_Bot becomes more than just a chatbot — it becomes a proactive digital health companion that:
 

1. Interacts naturally like a human doctor’s assistant

2. Learns from user patterns and improves advice

3. Takes initiative in suggesting actions and follow-ups

4. Offers personalized health guidance in real time

**Description of your solution**

The system is designed to assist medical professionals in diagnosing AK—a precancerous skin lesion—by providing accurate, rapid, and interpretable results. EfficientNet, a state-of-the-art deep convolutional neural network, functions as the core classifier, offering high accuracy and efficiency for skin lesion analysis, particularly when trained on large, well-balanced datasets. After a skin image is uploaded, the model automatically predicts whether the lesion is AK or non-AK. To make the diagnosis transparent, the workflow incorporates Grad-CAM, a technique that overlays a heatmap highlighting the image regions most influential to the model’s prediction. This visualization assists dermatologists in understanding and trusting the AI’s decision process.

![Visual Studio Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visual%20Studio%20Code-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Beautiful Soup](https://img.shields.io/badge/Beautiful%20Soup-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![BERT](https://img.shields.io/badge/BERT-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Problem Statement:
Over 65% of online users in India are exposed to false or misleading health information about vaccines, diseases, and treatments, leading to fear, confusion, and mistrust. There is a need for an intelligent system that can detect, verify, and correct such misinformation using authentic data sources.

Solution Description:
MediFact is an AI-driven chatbot platform designed to identify and counter health-related misinformation in real time. It leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Machine Learning (ML) to detect misleading content, verify it against reliable medical databases such as WHO, CDC, and MoHFW, and provide fact-checked corrections directly through an interactive chat interface. The chatbot automatically fetches verified information via API integrations and delivers clear, conversational responses. It also provides LLM-based multilingual support, improving accessibility and inclusivity. The system is developed using Python, LangChain, Flask (for backend), MongoDB (for data storage), and Hugging Face NLP models (BERT/RoBERTa), along with News API and BeautifulSoup for real-time data collection. The chatbot enhances digital health literacy, builds trust in credible sources, and helps reduce the spread of health misinformation in the digital ecosystem.

**Misinformation: Bring your own problem in Misinformation, leveraging Agentic AI.**

MediFact aligns perfectly with the misinformation track by addressing the critical problem of health-related misinformation in India, where false information about vaccines, diseases, and treatments spreads widely. The platform leverages AI, NLP, and ML to autonomously detect misleading content, verify it against trusted sources like WHO, CDC, and MoHFW, and provide fact-checked corrections through an interactive chatbot. Acting as an intelligent agent, MediFact not only identifies misinformation but also engages users in real time to deliver accurate, accessible, and multilingual health information. By tracking and correcting false content, the system enhances digital health literacy, builds trust in credible sources, and directly contributes to reducing the spread of online misinformation.

Team **MediFact** -- Vedika Tipugade, Krushnali Patil, Aditi Sapkal, Prajakta Suryawanshi
