**Description of your solution**

Our hackathon project, “AI-Powered Crop & Soil Health Advisor”, aims to empower small and marginal farmers by providing a smartphone-based, online AI assistant that helps assess both soil and crop health without requiring expensive lab tests or internet connectivity. The app guides farmers through simple “Desi Soil Tests” using household items to check soil pH, texture, moisture, and fertility, while an integrated photo-based AI system analyzes soil and leaf images to detect deficiencies and diseases. Based on these inputs, the system generates a Soil Health Score and provides personalized, actionable recommendations for fertilizers and crops suitable for their region. Designed with inclusivity in mind, it offers voice and video guidance in Hindi for low-literacy users and runs entirely offline using TensorFlow Lite. Built with React, Node.js, MongoDB, and TensorFlow, the solution combines AI-driven insights with traditional farming wisdom, making soil testing affordable, accessible, and practical for rural India while also enabling agriculture officers and NGOs to use aggregated data for sustainable interventions.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

n rural agriculture, misinformation is one of the biggest hidden challenges — farmers often rely on unverified local advice, myths, or outdated practices about soil fertility, fertilizer use, and crop health. For instance, many believe adding more urea always improves yield or that soil color alone can determine fertility. Such misleading or incomplete information leads to soil degradation, low productivity, and economic loss.

Our solution directly combats agricultural misinformation by replacing guesswork and hearsay with data-backed, AI-powered insights. The app uses photo-based analysis and scientifically validated “Desi Soil Tests” to give farmers reliable, personalized guidance in simple Hindi — not generic or misleading tips. It also features voice and video tutorials to ensure correct test execution, minimizing errors caused by misinformation spread through word of mouth or social media.

In essence, the project acts as a trusted AI educator, helping farmers distinguish facts from myths, learn correct soil practices, and make evidence-based farming decisions, thus promoting truthful and sustainable agriculture in the fight against misinformation.

> Guiding India to Better Health

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Swasthya Path: India's First Vertically Integrated Healthcare Intelligence Platform**
We're building an AI-powered healthcare platform that transforms how Indians prevent disease, access care, and manage health across their lifetime. 

The core insight: healthcare isn't broken because of lack of hospitals or doctors - it's broken because of lack of intelligence. Medical data is scattered, disease patterns go unrecognized, and individuals make health decisions in the dark.

We’re solving real, everyday problems: repeated tests due to missing records, late diagnosis of hereditary diseases, confusion about where to go when you’re sick, and a public health system that reacts too late or fails to serve in surge.

Our target users are Indian families managing chronic conditions, working adults ignoring early signs, and doctors who want better data. We’ll start with pilot users in Mumbai, labs and clinics, and grow through partnerships with hospitals and public health bodies(enterprise scale archive).

Revenue comes from a freemium user model, B2B tools for providers, and anonymized insights for health authorities — always privacy-first.

This idea creates a comprehensive health intelligence system through five integrated layers powered by Agentic AI:
**Layer 1: Historical Report Analysis**
We automatically aggregate every medical record a patient has ever generated - blood tests, imaging, prescriptions, diagnoses - from every hospital, lab, and clinic they've visited. Our AI pulls this scattered data into one unified health timeline through existing health data frameworks. This isn't just storage - the AI analyzes temporal patterns, identifies anomalies, tracks biomarker trends over years, and creates a complete medical story. When patients switch doctors or visit new hospitals, their entire history is instantly available. Most importantly, this prevents diagnostic waste - if a patient already has a valid lipid panel from 45 days ago, our AI alerts the new doctor before they order a duplicate test, saving money and time.

**Layer 2: Individual Intelligence (VanshRaksha) - (Optional - if the user opts/ wants to give access to family data)**
This is where prevention gets personal. Our AI doesn't just look at your health records - it analyzes your entire family's medical history across multiple generations. We identify disease patterns in your genetic lineage: if your father developed diabetes at 48, your uncle at 46, and grandfather at 50, the AI recognizes this clustering and predicts your risk with high accuracy. But we go beyond prediction - we generate personalized prevention protocols based on how diseases actually expressed in YOUR family, what interventions worked for relatives, and your current biomarker trajectory. This is predictive healthcare that catches diseases 5-10 years before symptoms appear, when prevention is still possible.

**Layer 3: Population Intelligence**
When millions of individuals use Layers 1 and 2, we aggregate anonymized data to reveal population-level patterns invisible to any single doctor or hospital. Our AI maps geographic disease clusters - for example, identifying 47,000 families in South Mumbai with respiratory genetic vulnerabilities or 23,000 families in Andheri with cardiac risk patterns. By combining these vulnerability maps with real-time environmental data (pollution levels, festival calendars, epidemic surveillance), we predict healthcare surges weeks in advance with precision. This enables proactive intervention: we send targeted prevention advisories to high-risk populations before triggers hit, reducing surge volume by 30-40 percent. 
On an enterprise level - For hospitals and health departments, we can provide exact resource requirements, optimal staffing levels, and supply chain recommendations. This transforms crisis management into crisis prevention.

**Layer 4: QuickCare**
Healthcare intelligence is useless if people can't act on it immediately. When someone has symptoms right now, QuickCare provides instant solutions: AI analyzes symptoms and suggests appropriate and safe generic medicines , finds nearby doctors (with required specializations) with real availability and wait times, maps quality-certified pharmacies with stock confirmation, and provides compliant digital prescriptions. It bridges the gap between long-term prevention and immediate care needs, ensuring the platform is useful daily, not just during annual checkups.

**Layer 5: Daily Health Logging**
Continuous health tracking creates the feedback loop that makes everything smarter. Users log symptoms, vitals, medication adherence, lifestyle factors, and how they're feeling daily. This data feeds back into all other layers: improving individual risk predictions, validating prevention protocols, detecting early deterioration patterns, and enhancing population models. The more data flows through the system, the more accurate everything becomes. Gamification and nudges ensure consistent engagement.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Healthcare today is fragmented—your reports sit in one folder, your parents' conditions are never connected to yours, and when symptoms hit, you're Googling in panic. We're changing that with AI that actually understands context. Our platform weaves together your medical history, your family's health patterns, and real-world health trends to give you insights that matter. Think of it as having a doctor who knows three generations of your family, stays updated on global health data, and is available 24/7 when you need quick answers about symptoms or finding the right specialist nearby.

What makes this powerful? It learns and improves constantly. Every time someone logs their daily health, the AI gets smarter about spotting patterns early—turning reactive "sick visits" into proactive health management. We're essentially democratizing the kind of comprehensive care that's usually locked behind expensive hospitals, making it accessible to anyone. It bridges the immediate (I have a fever, what now?) with the long-term (my family has diabetes, what's my risk?).

This isn't just another healthcare solution—it's an AI companion that grows with you, learns from millions, and cares about one: you. For a country like India with massive healthcare gaps, this is how we make prevention possible and quality care personal.

Team **Kernel Ctrl** -- Sumeet Doshi, Shravani Deshpande

> Smart healthcare for rural India

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Introduction & Origin of the Idea

I come from a small village in Gujarat called Gagodar, home to around 4,000–5,000 people. Like many villages in India, Gagodar has only one small hospital, a few local clinics, and a single medical shop. Most residents are elderly, and healthcare access is often delayed due to distance, lack of awareness, and limited medical infrastructure.

During a recent visit to my village, I noticed two government medical officers going door to door, asking villagers about their eye health—whether they could see properly, if they’d had any cataract (Moti Bindu) operations, and when. The initiative was part of a state government drive to identify and support cataract patients.

That sparked a thought — why does this data collection have to happen reactively and manually every time?
What if we could build an AI-based village health monitoring system that continuously collects, analyzes, and predicts health trends in the village, helping both villagers and healthcare workers act before a problem spreads?

Description of the Solution

GramArogya AI is an AI-driven rural health monitoring and early-warning system designed to make village healthcare proactive instead of reactive.

It connects local health touchpoints — clinics, medical stores, and government health workers — into a unified, intelligent ecosystem that can track, analyze, and respond to emerging health trends.

Core Features

Village Health Index (VHI):
A dynamic score that reflects the real-time health of the village based on clinic visits, medicine sales, disease trends, and demographics.

Multi-Agent AI System:

Data Agent: Collects anonymized data from local clinics, pharmacies, and ASHA worker reports.

Analysis Agent: Detects patterns like recurring diseases, seasonal spikes, or shortages in medicines.

Preventive Agent: Suggests proactive actions—like stocking up medicines before flu season or organizing a health camp for common issues (like cataract).

ASHA Assistant Agent: Helps frontline workers by summarizing case trends, reminding follow-ups, and generating easy-to-read health summaries.

Environmental & Behavioral Insights:
Correlates environmental data (e.g., rainfall, temperature, water quality) with common illnesses to predict upcoming risks.

Community Dashboard:
Provides a simple, language-friendly interface to track key metrics like top health issues, available resources, and upcoming risks.

Scalable Blueprint:
Once piloted successfully in one village, the same AI-powered model can be replicated across multiple villages to build a larger “Rural Health Intelligence Network.”

Long-Term Vision

To build India’s first AI-powered Rural Health Intelligence Layer — enabling the government, NGOs, and local communities to make data-backed health decisions, improve preventive care, and ensure every village has a real-time pulse on its people’s well-being.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

In rural India, healthcare remains largely reactive and disconnected — villagers visit clinics only when problems worsen, and health data stays fragmented across hospitals, pharmacies, and government workers. GramArogya AI addresses this by using an Agentic AI system that actively monitors, analyzes, and predicts health trends at the village level. Through multi-agents that collect data from local touchpoints, identify disease patterns, and guide preventive actions, it transforms how villages manage health—from treatment to continuous, AI-assisted care. This aligns perfectly with Healthtech innovation, as it leverages AI to bring data-driven, preventive healthcare to underserved rural populations.

**Description of your solution**

Our solution adopts a dual-layer hospital surge prediction system to strengthen emergency preparedness. The first layer analyzes real-time hospital data such as patient admissions, seats availability, and ambulance call frequency to instantly detect sudden surges and alert nearby hospitals for quick action. The second layer uses external indicators—including festivals, climate changes, pollution levels, accident trends, and past seasonal data (e.g., monsoon-linked viral spikes)—to predict surges in advance, prompting hospitals to stock essential medicines and equipment early. By combining immediate data with predictive insights, the system builds a connected, proactive hospital network that minimizes overcrowding, optimizes resource sharing.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

My project leverages AI and data-driven insights to tackle the core challenge of unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics. The dual-layer system aligns perfectly with this track:

1. Real-time Surge Detection: By monitoring live hospital data like admissions, bed occupancy, and ambulance calls, your AI agent instantly detects sudden surges and alerts nearby hospitals—this directly supports proactive hospital operations.


2. Predictive Planning: By analyzing external indicators such as festivals, climate changes, pollution, accident trends, and historical seasonal patterns, your system forecasts potential surges and recommends preemptive actions—optimizing staffing, resource allocation, and patient advisories.


3. Outcome Alignment: This creates a connected, proactive hospital network, minimizing overcrowding, improving resource utilization, and ultimately enhancing emergency preparedness.

my solution doesn’t just react to surges; it predicts, plans, and coordinates hospital responses using AI

> An Autonomous Healthcare Coordination Platform

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![REST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/REST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS Lambda](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS%20Lambda-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebRTC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebRTC-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

CareConnect AI is an autonomous healthcare coordination platform that delivers hospital-grade care to the home by orchestrating triage, nurse dispatch, one-to-one video consultations, and home diagnostics through specialized AI agents. The system conducts a structured symptom interview, evaluates risk using medical history and vitals, and then independently selects the next best action—ambulance escalation, instant video consult with the patient’s preferred doctor, or booking a nurse visit with optimized routing and time windows. It completes the loop by scheduling home sample collection with partner diagnostics, parsing lab reports into structured summaries, and sharing a unified care timeline with the patient and clinician to maintain continuity across cities.

**Agentic AI core (what makes it “agentic”)**

- Triage Agent: Conversational intake + risk scoring to determine urgency and care pathway; continuously learns from clinician outcomes to improve precision.

- Dispatch & Routing Agent: Autonomously books nurse/home-collection slots, optimizes routes and staffing, and reassigns resources as conditions change.

- Continuity Agent: Preserves long-term doctor-patient relationships across geographies, compiles visit notes, vitals, and lab deltas into a concise, clinician-ready summary.

- Monitoring & Nudging Agent: Tracks symptoms and device/vital inputs, detects deterioration risk, auto-schedules follow-ups, and manages adherence reminders.

- Interop Agent: Extracts key values from PDFs/images of lab reports, normalizes them, and syncs via standards-compliant APIs for downstream sharing.

**Primary user journeys
**

- Routine home care: Patient reports symptoms → Triage Agent recommends low-urgency care → nurse visit is auto-booked → vitals and samples captured → report is parsed → doctor receives a summary and can consult asynchronously or live.

- Emergency flow: Chest pain triggers high-risk score → system escalates to ambulance/hotline, notifies nearest on-call clinician, and coordinates a rapid tele-triage while showing ETA/instructions to family.

- Cross-city continuity: Student in another city books a video consult with their childhood doctor → local home-collection is scheduled → results are summarized and shared → e-prescription + follow-up reminders are issued.

**Problem and impact**

- Access: Brings care to the doorstep, reducing travel burden for elderly, chronic, and remote patients.

- Speed and safety: Autonomous triage + routing shorten time-to-care and reduce unnecessary ER visits, while high-risk paths keep a human-in-the-loop.

- Continuity: Maintains preferred-doctor relationships and unified records across cities.

- Efficiency: Automates admin, summarizes records, and optimizes field operations to lower provider costs.

**What we will build during the hackathon (MVP scope)
**

- End-to-end triage flow: symptom intake → risk score → next step (video consult, nurse visit, or escalation).

- Dispatch MVP: book nurse and lab-home-collection slots with basic route/time-slot optimization.

- Video consult module: secure one-to-one patient–doctor calls with notes capture.

- Report ingestion MVP: upload diagnostic PDF → OCR + extraction → summary card in a unified timeline.

- Patient/Doctor dashboards: patient app for booking/status; clinician view with timeline and AI-generated summary.

**Tech stack (implementable in hackathon)**

- AI: LLM-driven symptom reasoning with rule constraints; lightweight risk scoring; OCR for labs; retrieval for guideline snippets; feedback loop to refine prompts/rules.

- Frontend: React Native (patient), web dashboard (provider); WebRTC for video; OTP login; multilingual UI (English + one Indian language).

- Backend: Node.js/Python microservices; event-driven orchestration; document store for records; standards-aligned data models and audit logs.

- Security & privacy: Encryption in transit/at rest, explicit consent flows, role-based access, minimal retention for MVP.

**Safety, compliance, and limits**

- Human-in-the-loop for all high-risk recommendations and emergency escalations.

- Clear disclaimers and care pathway transparency for users.

- Start with general medicine + cardiac/diabetes flows; expand specialties post-hackathon.

- City-limited operations in MVP with a short list of partner clinics/diagnostics to ensure reliability.

**Success metrics we’ll track**

- Time from first symptom entry to clinician touchpoint.

- Clinician-validated triage accuracy.

- Follow-up completion rate via autonomous scheduling and nudges.

- Patient satisfaction and provider adoption.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project is firmly Healthtech: an agentic-AI platform that autonomously triages symptoms, dispatches nurses for home care, coordinates one-to-one teleconsults with the patient’s own doctor, and schedules home diagnostics with structured report summaries. It reduces time-to-care, preserves continuity across cities, and optimizes scarce clinical resources with autonomous decision-making, routing, and proactive follow-ups. Safety is built-in via human-in-the-loop for high-risk cases, consent-driven data sharing, and standards-aligned interoperability—delivering faster, safer, and more accessible care at home.

Team **datavengers** -- Kalyan Lakshmannagari, Shirisha N

**Description of your solution**

Our MedAstra project is an AI hospital management aide that assists medical facilities in anticipating and preparing for last-minute surges in patients during festivities, air pollution surges, or epidemics.

In India, hospitals frequently face sudden patient rushes—particularly during Diwali, smog season, or waves of epidemics. This means clogged wards, insufficient staff, and not enough medical supplies. MedAstra's solution to this challenge is with Agentic AI, which is not only capable of analyzing data but can think, decide, and act like an intelligent virtual hospital administrator.

MedAstra continuously gathers live data from various sources:

Hospital databases (bed availability, staff rosters, patient flow)

Pollution and weather APIs (air quality, temperature, humidity)

Festival and event calendars (anticipating probable surge days)

News and social media trends (identifying outbreaks or spikes in illness)

Our system's AI pipeline, using this data, employs predictive algorithms such as LSTM and anomaly detection to predict future patient load. Once a likely surge is identified, MedAstra's Agentic AI engine makes intelligent recommendations such as:

Hiring additional staff shifts or recalling backup physicians

Refilling critical medicines, oxygen, and equipment

Alerting the early warnings to surrounding clinics or patients

MedAstra also has an interactive dashboard and chatbot interface that enables hospital administrators to query directly such as:

"What is next week's forecasted patient volume?"
"Should we order additional oxygen cylinders?"

The system produces clear, data-informed insights and visual reports—transforming complicated analytics into easy decisions. It learns from previous outcomes through reinforcement learning over time, becoming a more accurate predictor with each round.

Summarizing, MedAstra turns the management of hospitals from a reactive process to a proactive process. It merges data analytics, forecasting, and an intelligent conversational agent to ensure that hospitals are always ready—saving time, resources, and most importantly, lives.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our MedAstra project is a perfect fit for the Healthtech track since it solves the actual challenge of unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution bursts, or epidemic outbreaks. MedAstra is an agentic AI system that continuously collects live data from hospital databases, pollution and weather APIs, social trends, and event calendars to forecast patient inflow patterns. Employing a blend of LSTM-based forecasting, anomaly detection, and reinforcement learning, it pre-emptively suggests best staffing, supply distribution, and patient advisories in advance of crises.
The AI agent is a virtual operations manager of healthcare, independently analyzing and reasoning about real-time data to enable hospitals to make timely, fact-based decisions. By translating raw predictions into understandable, actionable insights using an interactive conversational dashboard, MedAstra enables healthcare administrators to be one step ahead—reversing reactive crisis management to proactive healthcare readiness.

**Description of your solution**

Healthcare enterprises(Majorly USA based) process thousands of claims daily using RPA bots(Blue Prism, UiPath, etc) that navigate through multiple systems (mainframes, web applications, SQL databases, and other enterprise specific applicaiton), and gather very specific data and processes the claims.
The bots produce rich, structured data logs of critical claims information. These logs align precisely with the Process Design Document (PDD), which serves as the authoritative blueprint for each bot's operation and behavior.
However, this valuable data remains trapped and underutilized.


**Our solution** enables healthcare enterprises to unlock actionable business insights from claims and operational data processed by RPA bots (such as Blue Prism) - data that is typically buried in complex log tables.

We will build a platform that parses these logs, organizes the extracted information in a secure database, and layers an agentic AI (using local LLMs for privacy and HIPAA compliance) on top. This allows business users to simply ask questions in natural language (“What is the denial rate by provider this quarter?” or “Which claim types have the highest processing delays?”) and instantly receive accurate answers, charts, and custom reports, all without direct IT intervention.

By combining real-world healthcare automation with agentic AI, our solution democratizes data access for non-technical users, optimizes operational efficiency, and provides critical visibility into bottlenecks, denial trends, and compliance risks empowering organizations to accelerate revenue cycles and improve compliance, all while keeping sensitive patient data fully secure.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This project directly addresses a critical healthtech business problem, unlocking actionable operational and financial insights from healthcare claims processed by RPA bots (such as Blue Prism) - which today remain trapped in complex logs that business users cannot easily access or utilize.
Leveraging Agentic AI, our approach builds a conversational agent on top of locally-hosted LLMs that fully respect data privacy and HIPAA constraints. This agent empowers non-technical healthcare business users to ask natural language questions about their process data (claims volumes, denial rates, bottlenecks, compliance flags) and instantly get meaningful, contextual answers, charts, and reports.


By connecting real-world healthcare process automation with cutting-edge Agentic AI, our project bridges the gap between raw operational data and strategic decision-making, improving efficiency, compliance, and financial outcomes for healthcare enterprises.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

🩺 Project Title

“SyncDoc: Real-Time Clinical Companion”
🧠 Problem

Doctors spend up to 40% of their time documenting patient interactions and updating records. This administrative overload leads to fatigue, slower decisions, and inconsistent treatment plans.

💡 Solution

MediAssist AI listens to doctor–patient conversations, transcribes them in real time, and generates an editable prescription draft plus treatment insights from past visits.
Doctors only verify the draft — the system handles storage, comparison, and summarization automatically.


---

🎯 Hackathon MVP Goal

Demonstrate an end-to-end workflow:

1. Record a short consultation.
2. Transcribe speech → text
3. Generate a draft prescription using AI.
4. Allow doctor to verify/edit.
5. Save to database (Supabase).
6. On next visit, show differences/insights between visits.

⚙️ Core Flow (MVP)

1️⃣ Audio Capture

Doctor records a short conversation using Expo’s Audio module.

Audio file uploaded to API endpoint.

2️⃣ Transcription

Whisper API converts .m4a → text.

Text stored temporarily in Supabase.

3️⃣ Prescription Generation

LLM prompt:
“Generate a medical prescription summary based on this transcript, including diagnosis, medicines, and advice.”

AI returns draft; displayed on screen.

4️⃣ Doctor Verification

Doctor edits the draft in a simple text area.

On “Save & Verify,” data is pushed to Supabase (visits table).

5️⃣ Insight Comparison

When the same patient visits again, fetch last record:
“Compare the previous and current prescriptions; summarize progress and treatment changes.”

Display output in “Insights” panel.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

We are using AI to assist doctor's with their administrative works with the patients by allowing him to automate the patients details automatically and making the consultation and prescription process more efficient and easy by applying AI to assist the doctor like a tutor with him.

**Description of your solution**

**Serenity: AI Powered Mental Health Assessment & Tracking**

1. What We Plan to Build: 

We are building Serenity, an integrated AI-powered mental health platform redefines mental health evaluations by moving away from static questionnaires and embracing a fully dynamic, machine learning powered approach. By analyzing user responses in real time, our ML engine adapts the assessment process, providing nuanced insights and personalized recommendations.

This innovation is complemented by an intelligent chatbot, interactive dashboard, secure WebRTC doctor portal, and a thriving community space, creating a holistic ecosystem for mental health support.This is seamlessly integrated with our Core Platform Features:

 * Empathetic AI Assessment: The core of our solution is an agentic AI powered by Llama 3.3. It delivers a dynamic, conversational self-assessment that moves beyond impersonal, static questionnaires.
 * Personalized Wellness Tools: We will provide an integrated suite for self-reflection, including a secure personal journaling feature with AI-driven insights and a progress-tracking dashboard.
 * Resource Hub: Students will have access to curated mental health articles and resources, sourced from trusted providers like the NHS.
Key Integrations:
 * Professional Teletherapy: The platform is integrated with a secure WebRTC portal, allowing students to book confidential, one-on-one video sessions with verified on-campus counselors.
 * Stigma-Free Community Support: A moderated, anonymous peer support forum is a key feature, enabling students to safely share experiences, find solidarity, and combat loneliness.
Institutional Tools:
 * Actionable Insights Dashboard: For our B2B clients, we offer an institutional insight dashboard. This tool provides high-level, fully anonymized data and trend analytics, empowering college administrations to build proactive and effective wellness policies.

2. Specific Pain Points Addressed
Student-Facing Problems
 * Inaccessible First Step & Stigma: We tackle the primary barrier to seeking help. Serenity offers an immediate, private, and non-intimidating entry point, reducing counselor wait times from weeks to minutes. The anonymous features directly combat the cultural stigma around mental health.
 * Impersonal & Ineffective Care: Standard evaluations are generic and lead to a 60% user drop-off rate for competitors. Our adaptive AI personalizes the assessment process, providing 25-30% more accurate insights and making students feel truly heard.
Institution-Facing Problems
 * Fragmented Support Systems: Students often juggle separate, disconnected apps. Serenity unifies essential tools AI assessment, therapy, community, and journaling into a single, seamless ecosystem.
 * Reactive vs. Proactive Policies: Institutions lack the real-time data needed for effective wellness planning. Our dashboard provides these actionable insights, allowing them to shift from a reactive to a proactive support model.
3. Target Audience
 * Primary Audience: Students in Higher Education
   * They are the direct beneficiaries of 24/7 confidential support, peer community, and professional care access.
 * Secondary Audience: Higher Education Institutions
   * College administrations will leverage our analytics dashboard to implement data-driven wellness policies, improve student retention, and foster a healthier campus culture.
 * Tertiary Audience: Guardians and Parents
   * They gain peace of mind through anonymized progress insights that support their child's holistic development.
4. Go-To-Market (GTM) and Revenue Streams
GTM Strategy
 * B2B2C (Primary Focus): Our core strategy is to partner directly with University and College Student Welfare Departments. We will drive adoption through on-campus awareness campaigns, onboarding workshops, and a "Campus Ambassador" program to build trust and integrate Serenity as an official wellness benefit.
Revenue Streams
 * B2B Institutional Licensing: A recurring SaaS fee (estimated at ₹830/user/month) for universities to provide the full platform to their students and access the institutional dashboard.
 * B2C Premium Subscription: A freemium model where core features are free. A premium subscription (estimated at ₹830/month) unlocks unlimited AI chats, advanced analytics, and premium content for individual users.
 * Pay-Per-Session: A platform fee on teletherapy sessions booked with licensed professionals through the app.
Our financial model is designed for scalability, projecting a total revenue of ₹10.79 Cr by Year 3.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project addresses a critical problem in Healthtech: 
Static, impersonal mental health assessments that fails to provide nuanced, individual care. A issue faced by 75% of the Indian student population!

Students in higher education face a severe mental health crisis, yet significant barriers prevent them from receiving effective care. The cultural stigma surrounding mental health discourages many from seeking help, while existing digital solutions like Calm or BetterHelp often fail due to their static, impersonal approach, leading to high user drop-off rates of 60%. These one-size-fits-all tools lack the ability to provide the nuanced, personalized insights required for early detection and meaningful support, leaving students feeling unheard and disconnected from genuine care pathways.  

​At the same time, educational institutions are ill-equipped to address this challenge proactively. Lacking the necessary tools to gather and analyze real-time wellness data, college administrations are forced into a reactive stance, unable to identify underlying trends or implement effective, data-driven policies to foster a healthier campus environment. This creates a critical gap for an integrated digital system that not only provides students with accessible, personalized, and stigma-free psychological support but also empowers institutions with the actionable insights needed to build a truly supportive academic community. This is where our product comes in more description about in the solution section.

Primo as a Healthcare Agentic AI: Key Points
Autonomous Decision-Making: The AI doesn't just process data; it independently analyzes symptoms, classifies case severity (low-risk, doctor-needed, emergency), and determines the correct course of action without human oversight.

Goal-Oriented Task Execution: Its primary goal is to streamline primary care. It achieves this by actively executing a sequence of tasks: structured data collection, autonomous care for minor issues, and creation of pre-consultation briefs for doctors.

Proactive Intervention: The system acts as a safety agent. It doesn't wait for a user's prompt but proactively identifies emergency triggers (e.g., chest pain) and takes immediate, decisive action to connect the user with emergency services.

End-to-End Workflow Automation: Primo is an agent that manages the entire patient journey. Its actions extend beyond assessment to coordinating logistics like medicine delivery and insurance processing, interacting with external systems to complete its objectives.

Hospitals and clinics often face unpredictable patient surges during festivals, pollution waves, or localized disasters. Current systems are reactive — by the time hospitals mobilize, critical delays have already occurred in staffing, medicine procurement, and patient advisories.

Your project addresses this by creating an AI-driven, proactive response ecosystem that autonomously forecasts surges and coordinates all operational units (Pharmacy, Supplies, Doctors, and Patients).

**Solution**
This system leverages multi-agent architecture to mirror a hospital’s real operational ecosystem:

- Supervisor Agent (Hospital Node): Central decision-maker managing all other nodes.

- Analytical Agent: Gathers external, real-time data (news, pollution levels, local incidents, etc.) to trigger early alerts.
 
- Pharmacy Agent: Predicts medicine demand and initiates restocks or supplier payments via the Agent-to-Payment (A2P) protocol.
 
- Doctor/Patient Agents: Communicate real-time advisories, triage information, or alerts (e.g., AQI-based warnings).

By using LangGraph + LangChain, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent communication, each component behaves as an independent yet cooperative AI entity — enabling autonomous hospital orchestration.

**Social & Health Impact**
- Predictive preparedness: Reduces chaos during epidemics or emergencies by ensuring hospitals are stocked, staffed, and informed.

- Cost efficiency: Minimizes wastage of drugs and deadstock through data-driven procurement.

- Public safety: Sends real-time health advisories to local citizens (e.g., smog alerts, viral outbreak warnings).

- Scalability: Can be replicated across hospitals, districts, or even integrated into national health systems.

**Technology:**

- Built on Python, React, and Google Cloud Platform, the system integrates:
 
- LangGraph + LangChain: For orchestrating and connecting AI agents.
 
- MCP: To define interoperable, secure agent communication standards.
 
- Postgres: For structured data storage and agent state persistence.

- Google ADKs (A2A,AP2): For real-world payment, mapping, and environmental data.

This stack aligns with the track’s focus on real-world deployability, interoperability, and automation in healthcare.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Instead of waiting for crises to unfold, our system predicts and mobilizes resources in advance — ensuring hospitals are staffed, stocked, and ready.

By combining multi-agent collaboration, real-time data analysis, and automated decision-making, it addresses one of healthcare’s biggest challenges: slow institutional response during sudden surges. The project uses cutting-edge technologies like LangGraph, MCP, and GCP to create a scalable, intelligent infrastructure capable of saving time, reducing costs, and improving patient outcomes.

- AI for early detection (preventive healthcare)
- Automation for coordination (operational resilience)
- Agent-based systems for decision-making (adaptive health response)

This will help make it a next-generation HealthTech innovation, where hospitals evolve from reactive systems to intelligent, predictive ecosystems.

**Description of your solution**

**"Health Sarthi"** is an autonomous AI agent designed to shift urban health crisis management from reactive to proactive.

Currently, hospitals often get overwhelmed after a crisis like a pollution spike or flood begins. Health Sarthi acts as a digital "mission control," constantly sensing real-time city data (live AQI via API, live social media chatter via Twitter API) and contextual factors (festivals, flood alerts).

Based on this multi-modal input, the agent thinks by analyzing the severity and type of crisis. It then autonomously acts by executing a pre-emptive 3-part plan:

1.***Staffing:*** Sends immediate email alerts (via Nodemailer/Gmail) to on-call medical staff, warning them of the specific expected surge (e.g., respiratory vs. waterborne).

2.***Supplies:*** Logs necessary supply orders based on the crisis type (e.g., inhalers for pollution, water purification tablets for floods) – currently mocked for demo.

3.***Public Advisory:*** Posts real-time warnings and health advice to the public via Twitter, tailored to the specific threat and location.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

- ***Autonomously Analyzes Data:*** It integrates and analyzes multiple live data streams (AQI, Twitter chatter, user-provided context like 'Festival Day') to predict potential surges and their nature (respiratory, waterborne, etc.).

- ***Recommends Staffing Actions***: Based on the analysis, it automatically generates and sends urgent email alerts to relevant medical staff, recommending preparedness for the specific type of expected surge.

- ***Recommends Patient Advisory Actions:*** It autonomously generates and posts public health advisories via Twitter, providing timely warnings and preventative advice to citizens based on the detected crisis and location.

Essentially, Health Sarthi acts as the AI agent described in the problem statement, automating the analysis and recommendation of key preparedness actions in advance of patient surges.

The feature at the heart of the app is an advanced **"health friend"** that stretches beyond measurement tracks. This **agent keeps active eyes on health data** (manual log and then, AI nail scans) to **recognize any worrying trends and take action without prompting**.

The most important agent-driven characteristics are **personalized insights, proactive reminders, and an entirely autonomous critical alerting system**. If, for instance, the agent's analysis reveals that the patient is facing significant health risks through her health data (hemoglobin levels), this agent may **independently escalate an emergency by sending a priority alert** and relevant data directly to a healthcare professional with whom she is connected.

This agent does not only visualize your data but and **analyzes your nutrition, water, sleep, and activity for real-time recommendations**.

* **AI-Powered Nail Analysis (an Agent's Tool):** An **innovative camera module** for a live preview of nail scans. Using this tool, the **AI agent can calculate hemoglobin levels** with detailed results logging for trend analysis.

* **Daily Tracker:** A **comprehensive recording** for all meals, hydration, steps, and iron intake so that your **agent tracks them** to determine whether you're within your prescribed health parameters.

* **AI Visualization & Agent-driven Insights:** The **graphical representation of hemoglobin trends** and iron consumption, as perceived by your **Agentic AI that analyzes these patterns** for personal prediction and actionable insights as to why you might sometimes feel a certain way.

* **Doctor Connect & Agent Escalation:** **Integrated chat module to connect with certified hematologists**. This module will be an **essential tool for your AI agent to use** at emergency times.

* **Autonomous Critical Alerts:** This is **where Agentic AI rules**. When your health data point towards an emergency (such as a critically high or dangerously low hemoglobin level), the **AI agent takes actions on its own**. First, it **escalates things by sending a priority message** and your relevant data through the Doctor Connect module, **to your connected doctor**, and at the same time advising you on the immediate next moves.

* **FAQ Chatbot (RAG based):** An AI assistant (another tool your main agent will use) **trained with trusted health sources** such as WHO, CDC, and Mayo Clinic so that he can **produce contextual yet reliable answers** for your queries.

* **Profile & AI Decision Logs:** The customizable profile with **AI autonomy controls** and privacy options. The most important element of it includes a **daily "AI Decision Log"** which **tells you what actions your agent took** (e.g., "Noticed iron intake was low for 3 days, suggested an iron-rich recipe") **and why**.

* **Voice-Activated Assistant:** A **floating AI button for quick voice actions** commanding your agent to, say, "scan my nails," "remind me to take my supplement," or "schedule a check-in with my doctor."

**Description of your solution**

1) Short summary (one line)

Train a powerful generative model across many hospitals without moving patient data (via Federated Learning). Then use that model to create large amounts of synthetic patient data that looks real but contains no real people’s records.


---

2) Main building blocks

1. Local nodes (hospitals / labs) — keep real data and run local training.


2. Federation server (or coordinator) — sends model to nodes, collects updates, aggregates them.


3. Generative model — a diffusion model (or similar) trained via federated updates.


4. Privacy layer — secure aggregation, differential privacy, optional encryption.


5. Synthetic-data service / API — lets researchers request synthetic datasets.


6. Audit & governance — logging, consent management, model cards, approval flows.




---

3) Recommended tech stack (practical choices)

Federated Learning frameworks: Flower, TensorFlow Federated (TFF), or PySyft.

ML libraries: PyTorch or TensorFlow (PyTorch is popular for diffusion models).

Diffusion model libs: use open-source diffusion implementations (PyTorch-based) and adapt for tabular/genomic data.

Secure aggregation / privacy: OpenMined tools, PySyft, Google’s DP libraries.

Infrastructure: Kubernetes for scaling, Docker for packaging, cloud/on-prem servers.

APIs & storage: FastAPI/Express, encrypted S3 or local storage.

Monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana, audit logging.

CI/CD: GitHub Actions / GitLab CI.



---

4) Step-by-step implementation plan

Phase A — Design & setup

1. Define exact data schemas

Decide data types (EHR, genotype, phenotype, timestamps).

Standardize columns and formats across sites.



2. Setup PoC

Pick 2–3 partner sites, run Dockerized “node” locally.

Use synthetic toy data first.



3. Choose FL framework & protocol

Use FedAvg with Flower or TFF.

Server sends model → nodes train → send updates → aggregate.



4. Implement local training node

Node trains locally, returns updates only (no raw data).



5. Add secure aggregation

Aggregate updates

![Google Colab](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Colab-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Project Title: Clinic Mate – AI-Powered Clinical Assistant
Problem Statement:
In many healthcare settings, doctors face significant time constraints and an overwhelming number of patients daily. Manual recording of symptoms, repetitive questioning, and limited consultation time often lead to missed details or delayed diagnosis. Moreover, early triage of patients to identify urgent conditions is not always efficient, especially in crowded clinics or rural healthcare centers lacking sufficient staff. This results in longer waiting times, diagnostic delays, and increased workload on doctors — ultimately affecting the quality of patient care.

 Proposed Solution – Clinic Mate

Clinic Mate is an AI-powered medical assistant designed to autonomously interact with patients, understand their symptoms, and assist doctors by providing an organized pre-diagnosis summary before examination. The system uses speech recognition and natural language processing (NLP) to “listen” to patients’ symptom descriptions, analyze the context, and generate structured symptom reports.

It also applies an intelligent triage mechanism to flag potentially urgent or critical conditions that require immediate attention. After the doctor’s confirmation and final diagnosis, the system generates a QR code containing the complete digital report for secure access and future reference.

 

 Innovation in Our Solution

AI-driven pre-assessment: The system autonomously interprets patient speech, reducing the need for manual symptom entry.

Urgency detection: Intelligent triage flags critical patients early to optimize doctor attention.

Paperless smart reporting: Secure QR code–based reports replace manual documentation.

Doctor-assistive AI, not replacement: The model works alongside doctors, providing structured data for faster, more accurate decisions.

Integration-ready: Can be linked to hospital management systems or telemedicine platforms for large-scale use.


Role of Agentic AI in Clinic Mate

Clinic Mate integrates the principles of Agentic AI, enabling it to act autonomously rather than merely respond to commands. Unlike traditional AI models that rely solely on static prompts, Agentic AI continuously observes, reasons, and acts based on the situation.

In this project:

It autonomously conducts pre-assessments, without requiring step-by-step human instruction.

It can adapt and learn from new patient data, refining its understanding of medical symptom patterns.

It takes initiative by flagging high-risk conditions proactively.

It can collaborate with other systems (e.g., electronic health records or diagnostic tools) to provide richer insights for doctors.


Thus, agentic AI transforms Clinic Mate from a passive chatbot into an active digital assistant that intelligently supports medical workflows.

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Mapbox](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mapbox-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural Language Processing](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20Language%20Processing-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Teachable Machine](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Teachable%20Machine-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

The Autonomous Health Information Defense System (AHIDS) is an intelligent, nation-scale AI framework built to protect communities from the rapid spread of health misinformation. Just like the human immune system defends the body, AHIDS works continuously in the background to spot, analyze, and respond to harmful information before it goes viral.

At its core, AHIDS brings together real-time monitoring, smart decision-making, and coordinated action to keep the public informed and safe. It operates through three powerful modules: the Tracker Core, which scans digital spaces for emerging misinformation; the Community Sentinel, which steps into conversations to share clear and accurate health information; and the Institutional Shield, which helps hospitals and organizations detect and respond to targeted attacks.

By blending public health expertise with autonomous AI agents, AHIDS offers governments, health agencies, and local communities a unified, proactive defense system. It’s a new way to build public trust and resilience in an age where false information can spread faster than any virus.

**Misinformation: Create an Agentic AI system that continuously scans multiple sources of information, detects emerging misinformation, verifies facts, and provides easy-to-understand, contextual updates to the public during crises.**

Our project, AHIDS, fits this track perfectly because it does exactly what the prompt describes — but in a smarter, more autonomous way. Through its Tracker Core, AHIDS constantly scans a wide range of online spaces — from major social media platforms to niche forums — to catch misinformation early, just as it starts to spread. Once potential false information is detected, it automatically checks against trusted health sources to separate facts from rumors.

Next, the Community Sentinel steps in to share clear, easy-to-understand updates directly with the public. Instead of simply flagging misinformation, it joins conversations with accurate information in a friendly, contextual way. Finally, the Institutional Shield helps hospitals and organizations spot and respond quickly to misinformation attacks that target them.

Together, these modules make AHIDS a complete, agentic AI system that monitors, verifies, and communicates in real time—exactly the kind of solution needed to keep the public informed and safe during crises.

**AarogyaFlow: Agentic AI for Autonomous Hospital Operations**

**Problem Statement: Operational Chaos in Indian District Hospitals**

Public hospitals in India face serious workflow issues.Queues are unmanaged, files are lost, and staff rotations are often confusing. These issues lead to long waiting times, overworked staff, and poor patient experiences. Current systems are manual and reactive. There is no technology that dynamically manages hospital operations in real time.
**HealthTech Solution: AarogyaFlow - An Agentic AI for Hospital Workflow Management**
AarogyaFlow is an intelligent agent that acts as an autonomous operations manager for hospitals. It uses real-time data from CCTV, registration timestamps, and hospital systems to monitor patient flow and staff workload. The system detects congestion, predicts bottlenecks, and automatically reassigns staff or coordinates ambulances to reduce overload. It sends clear WhatsApp-style instructions to hospital staff for immediate action.

**Why This Fits the HealthTech Track**

AarogyaFlow directly improves healthcare delivery efficiency using AI-driven decision-making. It reduces patient wait times, prevents staff burnout, and optimizes hospital resource use. It focuses on system-level improvement, not just diagnosis or treatment, making healthcare faster, fairer, and more accessible. Keywords: HealthTech, Hospital Automation, Agentic AI, Workflow Optimization, Real-Time Decision Making, Patient Flow Management.
**Core Features**
• Dynamic Patient Flow Arbitration: Monitors queues and assigns patients to the right counters or departments.
• Autonomous Staff Reassignment: Uses AI to redistribute staff based on patient load and skill type.
• Inter-Hospital Load Balancing: Shares patient load across nearby hospitals for better resource use.
• XAI-Powered Communication: Sends explainable instructions with reasons for each action.
Technical Overview
• SENSE: Uses CCTV and hospital databases for live data.
• THINK: AI core uses reinforcement learning to optimize hospital operations.
• ACT: Sends real-time commands to staff and integrates with ambulance routing systems.
Impact
• For Patients: Shorter waiting times, faster emergency response.
• For Staff: Balanced workload, reduced stress.
• For Hospitals: Higher efficiency and reduced operational costs.
**Vision**
AarogyaFlow aims to make hospitals intelligent and autonomous. It represents the next generation of HealthTech where AI not only predicts but acts to save time, resources, and lives.

**Description of your solution**

**MediPredict** is an autonomous AI system designed to help cities manage unpredictable surges in hospital patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics. Instead of reacting late, **MediPredict** forecasts patient inflow in advance and recommends staffing, supply, and advisory actions automatically.

Our system continuously monitors multiple data sources — pollution APIs, weather patterns, social media trends, and hospital intake records — to detect early signs of health stress in the community. Using **time-series models (Prophet/LSTM)**, it predicts upcoming patient surges and triggers intelligent recommendations through an **agentic AI framework (Lang Chain/Crew AI).**

The AI agent acts like a “health traffic controller” by:

**1**. Forecasting demand across hospitals in the city. 
**2.** Suggesting optimal staff allocation and equipment distribution .
**3.** Automatically generating and sending public health advisories via WhatsApp/Twilio.
**4.** Continuously learning from real-time feedback to improve prediction accuracy.

The insights are visualized on an intuitive **React-based dashboard** connected to a **Fast API backend** with **Firebase/AWS** for secure data handling. Hospitals can monitor trends, view recommendations, and take preventive actions — all before a crisis hits.

In essence, MediPredict transforms reactive healthcare into a **proactive**, **coordinated**, and **data-driven system** that minimizes chaos, reduces patient waiting times, and enhances the overall readiness of hospitals.

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**

In India, timely medical assistance and hospital access during emergencies or disease onset remain a major challenge - especially for people in remote or under-resourced areas.
Accident victims often fail to get immediate care; families struggle to find hospitals with available beds for specific diseases; and emergency cases like heart attacks suffer from delayed first aid and overcharging due to lack of transparency.

There’s a pressing need for a personalized, intelligent, real-time assistant that continuously monitors health, predicts emergencies, and autonomously coordinates response and resources.

**Description of Your Solution**

We propose AID (Agentic Intelligent Doctor) a multi-agent AI ecosystem integrating wearable IoT sensors, medical data analysis, and intelligent healthcare coordination.
AID operates as a personal health guardian, capable of:

1. Continuous health & environment monitoring via IoT sensors (heart rate, BP, oxygen level, GPS, etc.).
2. Accident or abnormal health detection using agentic AI that fuses data from sensors, environment, and activity patterns.
3. Emergency response orchestration automatically notifying family, calling ambulances, and sending patient vitals and GPS location.
4. Hospital discovery & booking identifying nearby hospitals treating specific conditions, checking bed availability, and booking instantly.
5. Health finance guidance providing real-time insights on estimated treatment costs, government benefits, and raising emergency funds if needed.
6. Healthcare chatbot agent offering disease overviews, first-aid guidance, and medication recommendations.
7. Transparency module recording critical timestamps (e.g., accident time, hospital arrival, death confirmation) to prevent malpractice or overcharging.

AID functions as a collaborative multi-agent system, where:

- A Sensor Agent monitors live vitals,
- A Health Analysis Agent interprets anomalies,
- A Rescue Agent coordinates emergency logistics,
- A Finance Agent explores medical benefits,
- And a Chatbot Agent provides interactive health support.

Technologies You Plan to Use

- Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, ADK
- LLMs: OpenAI GPT, Llama 4, or fine-tuned health-specific models
- IoT & Edge Devices: Wearable health sensors (BP, SPO2, ECG, accelerometer)
- Database: PostgreSQL / Firebase for patient and hospital records
- Mobile Application: (Optional) Flutter-based app for real-time alerts and updates
- APIs & Integrations: Google Maps, Gov health APIs (Ayushman Bharat, NDHM), hospital data APIs
- MCP / A2A protocols: For multi-agent communication and coordination

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

AID (Agentic Intelligent Doctor) is a next-generation AI-driven health monitoring and response system powered by a multi-agent architecture.
It continuously analyzes user health data, environmental conditions, and context to detect early signs of accidents or medical emergencies.
When an anomaly occurs, AID autonomously coordinates ambulance dispatch, hospital admission, and family notifications reducing human dependency in critical moments.
Beyond emergencies, AID serves as a personalized healthcare assistant helping users diagnose symptoms, find affordable treatments, and access financial or government assistance.
Our vision is to make healthcare proactive, transparent, and accessible, driven by real-time agentic intelligence.

### AI-Driven Multilingual Health Awareness Chatbot
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/aidriven-multilingual-health-awareness-chatbot-38e3) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co)

> Your health. Your language. Your guide.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whatsapp API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whatsapp%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

- Description of the Solution
-- Overview

The proposed solution is an AI-driven multilingual health awareness chatbot designed to make verified healthcare information accessible to everyone — especially in rural and semi-urban communities where access to doctors, credible information, and digital literacy are limited.

The system bridges the gap between public health communication and the end user by combining AI, local language support, and voice-based interfaces. It empowers citizens to receive preventive health information, vaccine reminders, hygiene tips, and outbreak alerts — all in their own language and over familiar channels like WhatsApp, SMS, and IVR.

-- What We’re Building

We are developing a multilingual conversational AI assistant that provides trusted, real-time, and contextual health guidance — not as a one-time app, but as an integrated communication system.

-- Key functionalities include:

Multilingual Support: Marathi, Hindi, and English (expandable to other Indian languages).

Voice + Text Interface: Supports speech and text on WhatsApp, SMS and a lightweight PWA (web app).

Proactive Outreach: Push notifications and reminders for vaccinations, hygiene campaigns, and seasonal disease prevention (like dengue or heatstroke).

Local Health Integration: APIs from CoWIN, Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), and WHO content ensure verified and updated information.

Human-in-the-Loop: Complex or emergency queries are escalated to local ASHA workers, NGOs, or doctors, ensuring safety and reliability.

Misinformation Detection: Uses AI models with citation-based answers to prevent harmful or false health information.

-- Problem It Solves

Traditional health awareness campaigns rely heavily on manual outreach, such as pamphlets, radio talks, or door-to-door visits by ASHA workers. These efforts are:

Slow, costly, and inconsistent across regions.

Limited in reach, especially in remote or low-connectivity areas.

Reactive rather than proactive — people seek help only after falling ill.

Language-dependent, excluding large populations that prefer dialects or oral formats.

Vulnerable to misinformation, especially on social media.

Our chatbot directly addresses these barriers by providing an accessible, reliable, and proactive information channel available 24×7, even in areas with low data access or literacy.

-- How It Works

Users interact via WhatsApp, SMS, or voice calls (IVR).

The chatbot processes the query, identifies intent, and retrieves validated answers from a curated knowledge base (built using RAG – Retrieval Augmented Generation).

If a health concern seems critical (e.g., “breathing difficulty” or “severe fever”), the bot escalates to a local ASHA worker or clinic contact.

The system also sends proactive alerts about local outbreaks, vaccination dates, or government programs.

In low-connectivity regions, pre-recorded audio messages or SMS summaries are delivered.

-- Technical Foundation

Frontend (User Channels): WhatsApp, SMS, IVR, and PWA built with Next.js (React + Tailwind).

Backend: FastAPI (Python) or NestJS (Node.js) for APIs, orchestrating chatbot sessions, escalations, and integrations.

AI Layer: Llama-3.1 / GPT-4o-mini via RAG pipeline with pgvector, using verified health datasets from WHO, MoHFW, and ABDM.

Database: PostgreSQL + pgvector for structured + semantic search; Redis for sessions; S3 for audio/media storage.

Voice and Translation: IndicTrans2 for local translation; Google/Azure TTS-STT for voice.

-- Target Users

Citizens in rural and semi-urban India seeking trustworthy health advice in local languages.

Community Health Workers (ASHA, Anganwadi, NGO staff) who need quick access to verified information.

Government Health Departments & NGOs that require centralized dashboards for outreach and analytics.

-- Revenue & Sustainability

Government Partnerships: Integration with state and central digital health initiatives under ABDM, National Health Mission, or CSR programs.

Public–Private Partnerships: NGOs and hospitals co-fund regional deployments.

Subscription Dashboards: Paid analytics dashboards for NGOs and agencies (insights into awareness impact and engagement).

Sponsored Health Campaigns: Verified co-branded health education drives (ensuring no bias or misinformation).

-- Expected Impact

25–30% increase in health literacy (based on global chatbot studies).

Reduced misinformation and improved vaccination adherence.

Localized, trusted health communication that scales across languages and states.

Lower outreach cost per user vs traditional human campaigns.

-- Why It’s Unique

Unlike generic AI assistants or health apps, this system is:

Inclusive (works even via SMS/IVR, not just smartphones).

Trust-based (integrates local health workers as part of the loop).

AI-powered yet human-safe (confidence-based escalation).

Scalable, low-cost, and built for Bharat, not just cities.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This problem squarely fits under HealthTech because it leverages artificial intelligence, multilingual digital interfaces, and data-driven communication to improve public health access, literacy, and preventive care, making healthcare more inclusive, intelligent, and scalable.

**Description of your solution**

We are building a Multilinugal Multimodal Multi-Agent Medical Assistant - an AI-powered healthcare assistant capable of understanding **speech, text, and image inputs** to help with **symptom triage, preliminary diagnosis support, medical research, and patient follow-up.**
The system coordinates multiple specialized sub-agents under one unified conversational interface. It maintains **stateful memory** across sessions, supports **multilingual communication,** and includes a **graph-based UI for care visualization**. A **human-in-the-loop** validation mechanism ensures clinical safety, while **self-improving RL based post-training** continuously enhances accuracy through verified feedback.

**Specific pain points addressed**

- **Limited healthcare access**: Many patients in both rural and urban areas, lack timely medical consultation due to doctor shortages and travel barriers.

- **Language and literacy barriers**: Existing digital health solutions often fail to support regional languages or voice-based interactions.

- **Clinician workload** : Repetitive triage, patient follow-ups, and basic symptom assessments consume valuable clinician time.

- **Fragmented patient journey**: Missed follow-ups and poor continuity of care lead to delayed or incomplete treatments.

- **Trust in AI tools**: Lack of explainability and human oversight makes patients hesitant to rely on automated systems.

Our solution directly tackles these challenges by combining accessibility, safety, and contextual intelligence.

**Target audience**

- Primary: Patients in rural and semi-urban areas seeking affordable and accessible preliminary medical guidance.

- Secondary: Hospitals, telemedicine platforms, and private clinics looking to automate triage and improve patient engagement.

- Tertiary: Government and NGO health programs aiming to scale preventive and community health initiatives through digital tools.

Integration APIs: Offer embeddable APIs for hospitals and healthcare apps to integrate the assistant into existing workflows.

Localization Drive: Launch in multiple Indian languages to reach non-English-speaking populations and support regional government health schemes.

Trust & Safety Branding: Emphasize clinician oversight and data privacy to build user trust and regulatory acceptance.

**Revenue Streams**

B2B Licensing: Subscription-based model for hospitals, telehealth platforms, and clinics.

API Monetization: Pay-per-use or tiered access for third-party app integrations.

Enterprise Customization: Custom deployments for healthcare providers, insurers, and research institutions.

Public Sector Partnerships: Collaborations with government or NGO healthcare programs to scale in low-resource areas.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

**Problem Statement**
In the interconnected world of electronic health records (EHRs), smaller third-party vendors—powering up to 40% of integrations—create critical weak points through unpatched API flaws, such as outdated OAuth endpoints or SQL injection vectors. These niche exploits enable targeted ransomware attacks that lock out access to vital patient timelines, often during emergencies, leading to disrupted care and life-threatening delays. In 2025, a hacker leaked 7.24 terabytes of sensitive personal and medical data from Star Health, affecting over 31 million customers.

**What Our Solution Is All About**
Our solution is an AI-powered security platform that acts as an automated "immune system" for third-party EHR ecosystems. It continuously scans vendor APIs for vulnerabilities using machine learning models trained on healthcare standards like FHIR, simulates tailored ransomware scenarios to test resilience without risking live systems, and deploys zero-downtime micro-patches to neutralize threats in real-time. Designed for seamless integration into existing networks, it ensures HIPAA-compliant continuity, generates actionable risk reports, and enables proactive vendor management—ultimately safeguarding patient data access and preventing cascade failures in high-stakes environments like ERs and ICUs.

**Why It Is Unique with Its Unique Features**
This solution differentiates itself by hyper-focusing on EHR-specific interoperability challenges, going beyond generic cybersecurity tools to address the nuanced risks of healthcare's fragmented vendor landscape. Its uniqueness stems from five tailored features that deliver precision, speed, and adaptability absent in competitors like Nessus or OWASP ZAP:
**1.	FHIR-Semantic Vulnerability Fuzzing:** Leverages PyTorch-based ML to semantically dissect API payloads against FHIR schemas, uncovering "shadow vulnerabilities" in HL7 exchanges with 95% accuracy—catching EHR-only issues like insecure data serialization that rule-based scanners overlook.
**2.	Zero-Downtime Micro-Patching with Code Synthesis:** Uses generative AI to create and deploy containerized fixes via Kubernetes in under 1 second, complete with built-in HIPAA audit trails and sandbox efficacy testing, solving the 70% unpatched rate in vendor APIs without operational halts.
**3.	Tailored Ransomware War-Gaming Simulator:** Crafts synthetic payloads mimicking 2025 threats (e.g., LockBit or BlackCat variants) for ecosystem-specific stress tests, including probabilistic modeling of failure cascades—providing predictive insights that generic simulators can't match.
**4.Real-Time Third-Party Risk Scoring Dashboard**:  Employs graph neural networks to compute dynamic vendor scores (0-100) based on telemetry like patch history and API exposure, integrating with SIEM tools for automated alerts and vetting—empowering data-driven decisions in a sector where third-party risks dominate 60% of disruptions.
**5.Community-Driven Modularity for Evolving Standards:** Features an open-source plugin system for user-contributed modules (e.g., for USCDI v4), with embedded bias audits for equitable coverage across diverse networks, ensuring rapid adaptation without vendor lock-in.
These features collectively reduce breach risks by up to 80%, turning reactive patching into predictive defense tailored to healthcare's unique data flows.


**Feasibility & Viability**

**Feasibility:**

1. A functional prototype (built with Python, PyTorch, Docker, K8s) successfully blocked 100% of simulated attacks on mock Epic/Cerner setups with <1s latency.

2. The lightweight solution deploys in under 15 minutes on standard hardware, runs efficiently in low-resource clinics, and scales cloud-agnostically (AWS/GCP) via Helm charts.

**Viability:**

1. It delivers immediate ROI by averting average breach costs of $10.22M, achieving a projected 80% risk reduction and ensuring compliance.

2. This positions it as a scalable, cost-effective bulwark for healthcare, ready for immediate deployment.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Medishield is a core Health Tech solution, acting as an automated immune system built specifically to protect patient safety.

This solution is not a generic tool; it is hyper-focused on EHR interoperability. It stops ransomware attacks that cause life-threatening delays in high-stakes environments like ERs and ICUs.

The technology is healthcare-native, using AI trained on FHIR standards to find shadow vulnerabilities that generic scanners miss. To support 24/7 hospital operations, its generative AI deploys zero-downtime micro-patches.

This solution uses advanced, tailored AI to protect patient data, ensure hospital operations, and ultimately save lives.

**Description of your solution**

Problem Overview

Hospitals, especially in densely populated or pollution-prone regions, face unpredictable surges in patient inflow during:

Festivals and mass gatherings

Pollution and smog spikes

Seasonal outbreaks and epidemics

These surges lead to:

Overcrowded wards and bed shortages

Staff fatigue and inefficient shift allocation

Delayed treatments and increased cross-infections

Unplanned shortages of oxygen, PPE, and essential supplies

Higher hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) due to poor sterilization turnaround times

Despite technological advances, most hospitals rely on manual forecasting and reactive decisions, resulting in costly inefficiencies and safety risks.

🤖 Proposed Idea: SurgeShield AI

SurgeShield AI is an AI-powered autonomous system designed to predict, prepare, and protect hospitals during patient surges and infectious outbreaks.

It combines two synergistic modules:

1️⃣ AI Surge Prediction & Management Engine

A machine-learning–driven analytics core that continuously monitors and predicts patient inflow, staff load, and supply requirements.

Key Features:

📈 Predicts patient surges 24–168 hours in advance using hybrid models (BiLSTM + Prophet).

🌦 Integrates external triggers — air quality index (AQI), festivals, weather, public events, outbreak alerts.

🏥 Monitors internal hospital data — admissions, OPD visits, inventory, staff rosters, and triage logs.

🧮 Provides prescriptive actions — staff shift recommendations, supply top-ups, and bed allocation plans.

🔔 Issues real-time alerts and dashboards for administrators and clinicians.

🧠 Learns continuously from feedback to improve forecasting accuracy.

2️⃣ SparShield+ Hybrid Light Barrier Disinfection System

A continuous disinfection module that ensures safe, chemical-free sterilization in occupied hospital spaces.

Core Mechanism:

Uses 405 nm indigo-blue light to eliminate pathogens without harming patients or staff.

Functions as a light barrier between beds, reducing cross-bed infection spread.

Modular, portable, and IoT-enabled for integration with AI control systems.

Can auto-adjust disinfection intensity based on real-time occupancy or infection alerts from the AI engine.

Prescriptive Decision Engine
Generates actionable recommendations:

“Increase triage staff by 2 from 8 AM–4 PM tomorrow”

“Reorder 40 N95 masks; stockout in 48 hours”

“Enable SparShield+ high-intensity mode for respiratory ward”

Autonomous Action Layer

Auto-adjust SparShield+ operation (intensity, timing)

Notify staff & procurement via SMS/app

Issue preventive public advisories

Dashboard & Feedback Loop

Displays surge forecast graph, heatmaps, and confidence levels

Clinician approval before critical actions

Logs actions and outcomes for model refinement

Layer	Technology
Data Sources	Hospital HIS, IoT sensors, AQI/weather APIs
Forecasting	Python (TensorFlow, Prophet, XGBoost, BiLSTM)
