Economic

💰 Cuts operational surge costs by 25–35%.

⚡ Reduces energy and consumable waste vs manual disinfection.

Scalability

Suitable for district hospitals, urban health centers, and mobile clinics.

Integrates easily with national digital health platforms (NDHM / ABDM).

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/6229ebda293e4237acacff79aed847d6/9edea073-6661-4e9e-8562-4fe3da02474f.png)
🧠 Innovation & Uniqueness

First integrated AI + IoT hospital surge and infection management solution.

Works autonomously yet transparently with explainable AI decisions.

Uses visible light disinfection (405 nm) — safe for occupied wards.

Provides end-to-end predictive response, not just alerts.

Designed for low-resource public hospitals — modular and affordable.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Statistics (Current Challenges & Data Reality)

20–30% of Indian hospitals experience severe patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, or local outbreaks, leading to ER overcrowding.

Average bed occupancy in government hospitals exceeds 120% capacity during high-risk seasons (e.g., post-Diwali smog, flu outbreaks).

Hospital-acquired infection (HAI) rates increase by up to 40% in overcrowded general wards during surge periods.

30–40% of medical supplies and staffing shortfalls occur reactively, not proactively — due to lack of real-time predictive systems.

National Health Profile data shows 1 doctor for every 1500+ people; surge events magnify this shortage.

Manual infection control and staffing adjustments are slow and error-prone, resulting in treatment delays and preventable fatalities.

💡 Solution: AI-Driven Surge & Infection Management

Integrated Concept:

Combine SparShield+ (Hybrid Light Barrier Disinfection System) with an AI Surge Prediction Engine that autonomously forecasts patient inflow and infection risk, then recommends actions in advance.

How it Works:

Data Fusion: Collects data from hospital systems (admissions, bed occupancy, inventory), air quality, weather, and event calendars.

Forecasting Engine: Predicts patient surges 24–168 hours ahead using hybrid ML models (LSTM + Prophet).

Prescriptive AI: Suggests staffing schedules, supply top-ups, triage policies, and automated patient advisories.

Real-Time Infection Control: Adjusts SparShield+ disinfection cycles and light intensity based on detected crowd density and contamination levels.

Human-in-the-Loop Validation: All recommendations come with confidence scores and clinician approval options.

Continuous Learning: System refines itself after each surge event using historical data.

Core Technologies:

AI Forecasting (BiLSTM + ML ensembles)

IoT-enabled Light Barrier (SparShield+)

Predictive Analytics Dashboard

Cloud Integration (FHIR/HIS compatible)

SMS/IVR-based Public Advisory System

🌍 Impacts (Measurable Outcomes & Benefits)

Operational Impacts:

⚙️ Up to 45% reduction in ER waiting times during surge periods.

🧑‍⚕️ 20–30% better staff allocation efficiency, reducing overtime and burnout.

🧴 Zero disinfection downtime: SparShield+ runs continuously even in occupied wards.

📦 30% fewer stockouts of critical supplies (oxygen, PPE, N95 masks).

Clinical Impacts:

🦠 60–70% decrease in cross-bed infection risk due to hybrid optical disinfection barrier.

💊 Lower HAI rates → improved patient recovery times and safety in crowded wards.

🔄 Faster containment of seasonal or localized outbreak surges.

Economic & Strategic Impacts:

💰 Reduced emergency procurement & overtime costs by predictive staffing.

🏥 Improved hospital resource ROI through optimized usage of beds, staff, and equipment.

🌱 Sustainable infection control — no harmful UV-C or chemicals, eco-safe.

🌐 Scalable to regional health networks, disaster centers, and public health missions.

Each medicine pack will have a unique QR code or digital ID that records details such as manufacturing date, batch number, and expiry date on a secure blockchain network. When scanned using a mobile application, consumers, pharmacists, and healthcare authorities can instantly verify whether the medicine is genuine or counterfeit.

Additionally, the system sends automatic alerts to pharmacies and users when medicines near their expiry date, preventing the sale or use of expired products. The AI analytics module monitors supply chain data to detect irregularities or suspicious activities, helping authorities act quickly against fake medicine distributors.

This solution enhances transparency, safety, and trust in the healthcare system by ensuring that every medicine reaching the consumer is authentic, traceable, and safe to use.

**Description of your solution**

The proposed solution is an Agentic AI–driven Predictive Hospital Management System designed to help Indian healthcare centers proactively manage patient surges during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemic outbreaks. Unlike traditional static prediction models, this system uses autonomous, goal-oriented AI agents that collaborate, reason, and act in real time to ensure hospitals remain fully prepared during high-demand periods.

The system integrates AI, Machine Learning, and Google Cloud infrastructure (Vertex AI, Cloud Healthcare API, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore) to create a self-learning and adaptive hospital management ecosystem. It continuously collects and analyzes data from multiple sources—such as festival calendars, pollution indices, epidemic data, hospital EHR records, and IoT devices—to forecast patient inflow and optimize staffing, inventory, and resource allocation.

At its core, the system operates through a network of specialized AI agents:

The Event Prediction Agent forecasts patient surges by correlating festival schedules, air quality data, and epidemic trends.

The Resource Allocation Agent optimizes bed, oxygen, and equipment availability across departments.

The Staffing Agent dynamically adjusts shift schedules and workforce distribution based on forecasted load.

The Diagnosis & Risk Agent predicts potential deterioration in patients using ML models and NLP-based analysis of EHR data.

The Care Coordination Agent interacts with patients through chat or app notifications, providing health advisories and updates.

The Learning Agent monitors system performance and retrains models continuously on Vertex AI Pipelines for improved accuracy.

The platform features a real-time interactive dashboard that visualizes surge forecasts, patient risk levels, agent decisions, and resource status. Automated alerts are triggered through Cloud Pub/Sub whenever thresholds are crossed, ensuring hospital administrators and doctors can respond immediately. The entire system complies with HIPAA, GDPR, and ABDM data protection standards, employing Cloud IAM for role-based access and Cloud KMS for encryption.

By integrating Agentic AI with healthcare operations, the solution transforms hospitals from reactive systems into proactive, intelligent ecosystems. It minimizes manual workload, reduces patient wait times, and ensures timely interventions during crisis periods. The result is a scalable, cloud-based platform capable of self-learning, autonomous decision-making, and real-time hospital management, ultimately improving patient outcomes and operational resilience across India’s healthcare network.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Whatsapp API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Whatsapp%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-333333?style=flat-square) ![pydantic](https://img.shields.io/badge/pydantic-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Modern AI chatbots like ChatGPT or symptom checkers often lose context over time. They forget patient state, can’t interpret health reports, and lack personalization. Real health improvement requires continuous, context-aware engagement.

**The key problems**:

*Context Loss* : Chatbots forget who you are and what changed.

*Generic Recommendations* : Everyone gets the same “eat better, sleep more” answers.

*No Autonomy* : They don’t act unless you prompt them.

---

**KENKO** is an autonomous health companion that continuously learns from your data, habits, and feedback.
It doesn’t just chat, it acts by adjusting plans, sending reminders, and detecting patterns in your wellbeing.

**How It Works**: 
1. *Onboarding:* 
KENKO starts by learning what you actually care about. Instead of long forms, users select health themes via visual cards:
     - Sleep 
     - Nutrition 
     - Fitness 
     - Focus 
     - Heart

This builds your goal vector profile.

2. *Continuous Sensing*:
Every message, report, and check-in refines your context:

    - WhatsApp/Telegram messages → Daily habits, emotions
    - Uploaded reports → Biomarker data (via OCR + SciSpaCy)
    - Wearable or manual inputs → Sleep, weight, activity


3. *Contextual Memory + Reasoning*:
A vector memory (ChromaDB) stores your evolving story. The agent’s reasoning engine combines LLM + rule-based logic and detects meaningful trends.
e.g - “You’ve been sleeping less this week. Let’s adjust your caffeine timing.”

4. *Proactive Action Loop*:
If KENKO detects an issue, it acts autonomously:

    - Sends a check-in
    - Adjusts weekly health plan
    -  Updates user's dashboard if anomalies persist


**Technologies Used**:
Node.JS
Next.JS
Python
PostgreSQL
TypeScript
WhatsApp API
Telegram
Pydantic
OpenAI SDK
DSPy
pywa
Redis
Celery

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

This project applies Agentic AI by integrating LLM reasoning with rule-based logic and memory, forming a closed Perceive-Reason-Act-Learn loop. This transforms static chatbots into continuous health companions that evolve with the user, something which is still missing in traditional chatbots.

Proactive SMS/email alerts via Twilio will notify staff of upcoming surges and suggest preparation plans, while patients receive advisories on alternative care options during peak times. The backend, powered by Flask and hosted on AWS, ensures scalability and real-time processing.
HealthSurgeAI targets hospital administrators in urban and semi-urban Indian healthcare facilities and public health officials managing epidemic responses. By proactively addressing surges, it reduces operational strain, enhances patient care, and improves resource efficiency. For the on-ground hackathon, we’ll develop a prototype with predictive models, a functional dashboard, and sample alerts, demonstrating real-time surge management for a Mumbai hospital during Diwali.
This solution combines predictive analytics, resource optimization, and user-centric design to transform how hospitals handle high-demand periods, making healthcare delivery smarter and more resilient

What We'll Build for the hackathon:
**Core Agentic AI Engine**: Our agent autonomously analyzes claims through four intelligent modules that work together without human intervention:

**Description of your solution**

# **Problem Statement Title: Autonomous Medical Bureaucracy Busting Agent**
# **Tagline: Reducing Admin Bottlenecks in Patient Care**


## Context and Pain Points

Healthcare providers and patients lose countless hours to administrative bottlenecks: insurance pre-authorizations, prescription denials, cross-system document handling, scheduling conflicts, and repetitive form corrections. These bureaucratic barriers delay critical treatment, frustrate medical staff, and may result in worse health outcomes. In Indian hospitals and clinics, fragmented infrastructure amplifies these inefficiencies, especially during high-demand periods.

## Agentic AI Challenge Description
Design an agentic AI system that independently interfaces with hospital IT systems, insurers, pharmacies, and national health portals to resolve or escalate administrative obstacles in real time. The agent should reason about required actions, pursue solutions via digital APIs/IVR/calls/emails, request missing documents, notify patients or clinicians only when human input is needed, and track resolution status. Its goal is to eliminate admin-induced delays in care pathways, streamline systemic hurdles, and enhance the quality and speed of patient treatment.

## Solution Overview
We propose a multi-agent AI platform that receives cases of administrative friction—e.g., denied claims, prescription shortages, repeat form issues—and autonomously takes the next step on each front. The system coordinates with external API endpoints (hospital, insurer, pharmacy, health ministry), makes decisions to advance cases, seeks clarifications, requests alternative documentation, and only asks for human guidance when progress stalls. An analytics dashboard surfaces bottleneck insights and agent impact measurements.

## Target Audience
Hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, insurance companies, and patients—particularly in urban and semi-urban India where admin pain points slow down healthcare delivery across all layers.

## Planned Tech Stack

- Python, FastAPI backend (agent cognitive engine)
- LLM-powered reasoning (OpenAI GPT-4o, local Ollama models)
- RAG pipelines for custom document and workflow retrieval
- API bridges for hospital, insurer, and pharmacy systems
- Telephony/IVR APIs, form recognition modules (CV)
- React dashboard frontend
- Secure cloud deployment (AWS/GCP)

## High-level Go-to-Market Idea
The solution will be offered as a SaaS interface for healthcare institutions, with plug-and-play modules for integration into popular hospital management systems and insurer backends. Initial rollout will focus on larger hospitals and specialist clinics facing acute admin bottlenecks, followed by pharmacies and insurers. Revenue can be generated via subscription/licensing models and pilot partnerships with private health networks.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project directly addresses critical administrative bottlenecks in healthcare by developing an autonomous agentic AI system that interfaces with hospital, pharmacy, and insurer systems. The agent continuously monitors for delays such as claim denials or missing authorizations, plans the next resolution step, acts across digital channels (API, email, telephony), and checks if the bottleneck is resolved—all with minimal human intervention. This brings goal-driven reasoning and autonomy to routine yet time-consuming admin workflows, demonstrating the unique strengths of agentic AI in Healthtech. The solution aligns perfectly with the track’s theme, bringing tangible improvements to care delivery, hospital efficiency, and patient experience through true AI agency.

Key features include:

Pain Points

India’s healthcare system often experiences unpredictable surges in patient volume during festivals, pollution spikes, and epidemics. These events lead to:

	Overcrowding and longer wait times

	Shortages of essential medicines, oxygen, and equipment

	Understaffed hospitals during critical times

	Lack of early warning systems for hospital administrators

	No centralized forecasting or planning tool

Most hospitals operate in a reactive mode, without data-driven forecasting to prepare for these recurring challenges. Our solution directly addresses this gap by offering an AI-powered, predictive management tool that helps:

	Forecast demand surges in advance using diverse datasets

	Assist in timely staff planning and shift management

	Improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiency during high-demand periods

Multi-specialty hospitals and government healthcare institutions managing large patient inflows.

State and national health departments, which could use this system to anticipate region-wide surges during festivals, epidemics, or seasonal illnesses.

**Description of your solution**

**Meet PixelCare - Your Health, One Pixel at a Time**

Imagine sitting in front of your laptop after a long day at work. You're feeling stressed, maybe a bit tired, and you wonder - "How am I really doing health-wise?" Instead of ignoring these feelings or booking an expensive doctor's appointment, you simply open PixelCare.

**Here's what happens next:**

You sit comfortably in front of your camera. PixelCare's AI immediately starts working - it notices you look a bit tense from your facial expressions and adjusts its tone to be more gentle and supportive. "Hey there, you seem a little stressed today. Let's check how you're doing," it says warmly.

**The Magic Behind the Scenes:**

While you're just sitting there, PixelCare is busy analyzing thousands of pixels from your camera feed. It's measuring your heart rate by detecting tiny color changes in your face as blood flows through your skin. It's watching your breathing patterns, checking your posture, and even assessing your stress levels through micro-expressions you don't even realize you're making.

**But PixelCare is More Than Just a Health Scanner:**

It's like having a caring health buddy who remembers everything about you. Upload your recent blood test report, and PixelCare will explain what those confusing numbers actually mean in simple terms. Tell it about that headache you've been having, and it connects the dots with your stress levels and sleep patterns it's been tracking if augmented with the wearable devices.

It's not just monitoring your physical health - it's understanding your emotional state and responding like a human would.

**Your Personal Health Story Unfolds:**

Over time, PixelCare learns your patterns. It notices that your heart rate spikes every Tuesday (maybe that weekly meeting?), or that your posture gets worse when you're working late. It becomes your personal health detective, spotting trends you'd never notice yourself.

Just your camera and an AI that genuinely cares about your wellbeing. PixelCare makes health monitoring as natural as looking in a mirror, but infinitely smarter.

**What You'll Experience:**
- Sit in front of any camera and get instant health insights
- Have natural conversations about your health concerns
- Receive personalized advice that considers both your physical state and your mood
- Track your health journey over time with an AI that remembers and cares
- Upload medical reports and get them explained in human language

PixelCare isn't just another health app - it's your first step toward a future where technology doesn't just monitor your health, but truly understands and supports your wellness journey.

- **Your Camera** becomes a sophisticated health sensor (no expensive devices needed)
- **Your Medical Data** gets intelligently analyzed and explained in simple terms
- **Your Schedule** - monitor health anytime, anywhere without clinic visits

## **Agentic AI Core**
- **Autonomous Monitoring**: AI independently detects vitals, mood, and health patterns
- **Intelligent Adaptation**: Adjusts communication style based on detected emotional state
- **Proactive Insights**: Makes health connections and suggestions without manual programming
- **Continuous Learning**: Evolves recommendations based on personal patterns and outcomes

## **Revolutionary Impact**
Traditional health monitoring requires expensive wearables and regular clinic visits. PixelCare delivers the same insights using just your existing camera and truly autonomous AI that acts as an intelligent health companion.

Idea Description (detailed)

Rural India struggles with a digital health divide:

40% families only have basic phones, limiting access to apps.

70% depend solely on ASHA workers for health information.

Language barriers and misinformation spread faster than official updates.

No reminder system → missed vaccinations and late outbreak responses.

Our proposed solution is a digital health assistant for rural India:

Works on any phone (IVR, SMS, WhatsApp).

Multilingual chatbot (powered by Rasa + IndicBERT) that responds in local dialects.

Smart vaccination reminders and outbreak alerts delivered in real time.

Offline-first approach with preloaded health content.

ASHA/Government Dashboard built with React.js for sending push alerts, tracking village-level health stats, and monitoring awareness campaigns.

Impact:

+30% increase in timely vaccinations.

40% reduction in misinformation (verified WHO/MoHFW data).

Empower 50K+ ASHA workers and reach 2M rural families in Year 1 → scalable to 200M users nationwide.

Ultra-low cost (~₹0.20 per SMS), making it sustainable for Govt/CSR adoption.

**Description of your solution**

“**HealthSeva: Agentic AI for Rural Health Access**”
🚨 **Problem**
In India’s rural and semi-urban areas, millions of people face limited access to qualified doctors and verified health advice. Due to poor connectivity, language barriers, and dependence on local pharmacies, patients often receive delayed or inaccurate treatment, especially during seasonal outbreaks.

💡 **Solution**
HealthSeva is an Agentic AI-powered voice assistant designed to provide instant, trusted, and regional-language health guidance for rural communities — even in low-network areas.
The system listens to symptoms (spoken in Hinglish or local language), analyzes them using a medical reasoning model, and autonomously recommends:
- Possible causes and risk levels
- Preventive care and home remedies
- Nearby clinics or government hospitals
- Safe, affordable medicine alternatives available locally

Each AI “agent” performs a specific task:
- Voice Agent – Transcribes and translates user speech
- Symptom Agent – Interprets health issues
- Knowledge Agent – Fetches verified government/WHO guidelines
- Decision Agent – Generates a final advisory in simple language

The system can also log anonymized data to help authorities detect early patterns of local disease outbreaks.

🌍** Impact**
HealthSeva aims to bridge the healthcare gap in rural India by making medical awareness accessible, multilingual, and affordable. It empowers people to make early, informed health decisions — ultimately saving lives.

- **AI & Machine Learning / Agentic AI** – Multi-agent reasoning system for autonomous health advisories and decision-making.
- **Voice & Speech Technology / ASR** – Hinglish and regional language speech recognition for low-resource environments.
- **Social Impact / Rural Innovation** – Improves health outcomes, detects early disease trends, and empowers local communities.

Arogya-Dutta: A Detailed Project Description 
1. Vision & Mission
Vision: To create a future where every family can manage their health proactively, collaboratively, and intelligently, bridging the gap between daily life, financial support systems, and professional medical care through a single, unified AI-powered ecosystem.

Mission: Arogya-Dutta aims to be the central nervous system for family health. By leveraging Agentic AI, we transform reactive healthcare into a proactive, predictive, and personalized wellness journey, empowering users to make informed decisions, access financial aid through government schemes, and ensure timely intervention in critical moments.

2. The Core Problem
Modern family healthcare is fragmented and chaotic. Families often juggle:

Multiple medication schedules for children, adults, and elderly parents.

Various doctor appointments across different specializations.

Manual tracking of vitals using disparate apps or notebooks.

The significant financial burden of healthcare, coupled with a lack of awareness or difficulty navigating complex government health schemes.

Panic and confusion during emergencies, struggling to locate the right facility and communicate critical data.

This fragmentation leads to medication errors, missed appointments, financial distress, and delayed emergency responses.

3. The Arogya-Dutta Solution: An Agentic AI-Powered Wellness Hub
Arogya-Dutta is an intelligent, autonomous system built on a foundation of Agentic AI. It employs software agents that perceive a user's health and financial environment, reason about it, and act autonomously to achieve specific goals.

These agents work continuously to:

Monitor & Analyze: Ingest and analyze data streams from manual entries, connected devices, and user profiles.

Predict & Alert: Use predictive models to identify health risks and financial opportunities (like eligibility for a new health scheme).

Act & Automate: Take actions like sending intelligent reminders, scheduling appointments, triggering emergency protocols, and guiding users through scheme applications.

4. Key Features in Detail
a) The Agentic Core: Your Family's Digital Health Guardian This is the brain of the system, transforming passive data into active management.

Personalized Insight Generation: The system learns each family member's baseline health patterns and provides context-aware insights and recommendations.

Medication Adherence Agent: Manages complex medication schedules, sends smart reminders, alerts caregivers about missed doses, and automates prescription refill requests.

Preventive Care Agent: Monitors vitals and lifestyle data to recommend preventive actions and lifestyle modifications to mitigate long-term health risks.

b) Unified Family Health Dashboard A centralized, intuitive interface providing a holistic view of the entire family's health and wellness status.

Multi-Profile Management: Seamlessly switch between profiles for each family member.

At-a-Glance Vitals: Visualizes trends in key health metrics over time.

Integrated Calendar: Consolidates all medical appointments, medication times, and health-related tasks.

c) Real-Time Smart Map & Emergency Response System This feature goes far beyond a standard map lookup.

AI-Powered Prioritization: Ranks nearby hospitals not just by distance but by real-time traffic, specialization, user insurance coverage, and empanelment under government schemes.

One-Tap Emergency Alert: A dedicated SOS button instantly alerts family members, transmits a concise health summary to the selected hospital, and opens a direct line of communication.

d) Collaborative Care with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Securely bridges the communication gap between all stakeholders in a person's health journey.

Patient/Family Member: Full access to their own data.

Caregiver: Can be granted permission to view detailed health data, track adherence, and receive critical alerts for a specific family member.

Clinician/Doctor: A read-only, HIPAA-compliant portal where a doctor can view historical data to make more informed diagnostic and treatment decisions.

e) Government Schemes & Insurance Navigator This module directly addresses the financial aspect of healthcare by making public health initiatives accessible.

AI-Powered Eligibility Matching: The system automatically cross-references a user's profile (location, income bracket, age, gender, medical conditions) against a comprehensive database of central and state government health schemes (e.g., Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana - AB-PMJAY, state-specific scheme

**Description of your solution**

## **MyStree Soul: The Hackathon Pitch**

**Project Name:** MyStree Soul
**Tagline:** *Hyper Personalized Health Companion for Her, Clinically Verified, Compassionately Delivered.*

### ** The Problem: Anxiety, Delay, and Clinical Inefficiency**

In women's healthcare, patients are caught in a damaging cycle: **under-diagnosis** (ignoring critical symptoms due to fear or embarrassment) versus **over-diagnosis** (panic fueled by alarming, non-contextual internet searches). This friction creates overwhelming **anxiety**, leads to **delayed treatment** as conditions progress, and wastes valuable doctor time on non-urgent intake and data collection.

---

### **About MyStree (Our Clinical Foundation)**

This project is built in collaboration with **MyStree**, a dedicated holistic women's health platform. They are not just a clinic, but a multi-specialty wellness hub with **decades of certified clinical experience** spanning OBGYN, Psychology, Nutrition, and Physiotherapy.

**MyStree is uniquely equipped for this task** because their comprehensive service model ensures that the AI’s guidance is backed by deep expertise in hormonal balance, mental wellness, and physical health. This collaboration guarantees that every output of MyStree Soul is *holistic, empathetic, and clinically verified* by their expansive team.

---

### ** Our Solution: MyStree Soul (Agentic AI in Action)**

MyStree Soul is a secure, **Agentic AI platform** providing a comprehensive, **Hyper Personalized** health companion and rapid triage system, backed by MyStree's expert professionals.

### ** How It Works: Leveraging Agentic AI**

We deploy two specialized AI agents that interact with the user and the clinical team:

#### **1. Agentic Companion for Hyper-Personalization (The Frontend Agent)**

The AI functions as a **personal health agent** residing securely on the user’s device (via a native app). This agent continuously processes and correlates all personal data, including cycles, lab reports, moods, vitals, and medication logs, to build a dynamic, evolving user profile.

* **Proactive Guidance:** The agent autonomously identifies patterns and triggers, offering *personalized activities, diet adjustments, and wellness tips* appropriate for the user’s current physiological state.
* **Sensitive Communication:** The agent can **securely draft explanatory updates** for a designated partner, translating complex physiological or mental states into clear, non-confrontational updates, fostering mutual support.

#### **2. Agentic Triage & Expert Validation (The Backend Agent)**

When a user logs an urgent symptom, a second agent initiates the clinical workflow.

* **Instant Triage:** This **triage agent** instantly structures the unstructured symptom input against the user's entire historical health record, performing a multi-factor **risk classification** (Normal, Consultation-Needed, or Urgent).
* **Expert Handoff & TAT Guarantee:** The agent generates a concise, clinically relevant summary with risk flags for MyStree's doctors. This automation allows MyStree's experts to **skip manual intake** and focus purely on verification and diagnostic next steps, fulfilling our promise of *clinical verification in **6 hours.***

---

### ** Impact and Competitive Edge**

* **For Patients:** **Reduced Anxiety** and a guaranteed, rapid path to **Clinically Verified** expert care. We replace "Dr. Google" with trusted expertise.
* **For MyStree:** The system provides **Structured, High-Quality Cases** that maximize the efficiency of their expert team, allowing them to focus on diagnosis and treatment rather than data entry.
* **Competitive Edge:** We combine **Hyper-Personalized AI** (superior to generic trackers like Flo/Clue) with a **Certified Human-in-the-Loop Model** (superior to unverified symptom checkers), solving the trust and scale challenge simultaneously.

### ** Monetization Potential**

* **Subscription (B2C):** Premium features will include the **Partner Communication** functionality and the **guaranteed 6-hour clinical verification** service for urgent symptoms.
* **B2B Licensing:** We can license the proven **Agentic Triage Platform** and data structure to other clinic systems globally, streamlining their intake process and providing a clear, scalable B2B revenue stream.

**MyStree Soul is a prime example of Agentic AI solving a deep human problem with efficiency, empathy, and clinical excellence.**

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

Our project, MyStree Soul, addresses the widespread problem of anxiety and delayed care in women's health. We use Agentic AI to transform reactive confusion into personalized, verified action.

1. Agentic AI as a Hyper-Personalized Companion: The AI acts as a personal health agent, continuously processing multiple data streams (cycles, reports, moods, vitals). This allows it to:

--Proactively Guide: Automatically offer personalized diet/wellness tips based on the user’s phase.
--Facilitate Communication: Securely explain the user’s current physiological state to a partner, fostering mutual understanding.

2. Agentic AI for Rapid Clinical Triage: The AI functions as a triage agent, structuring unstructured symptom input against the user's history for instant risk classification (Normal, Consultation-Needed, Urgent).
--TAT Reduction: The agent sends the human gynecologist a pre-analyzed, concise summary, cutting down intake time and guaranteeing our 6-hour time-to-action (T.A.T.) promise.

Conclusion: MyStree Soul is a prime example of Agentic AI delivering Hyper-Personalized care and Clinically Verified rapid triage. A perfect fit for this track.

For Indian professionals and families, our project, MediNest AI, is an intelligent financial (insurance) coach.  In order to suggest the best insurance plans that fit their requirements and financial constraints, it examines users' health profiles, medical histories, locations, and spending habits.  It helps regular people, including gig workers and the unorganized sector, to make more informed financial decisions and steer clear of expensive blunders by demythologizing complicated insurance jargon, exposing hidden policy gaps, and tailoring recommendations to user conditions (such as chronic medications and hospital networks).  It targets underserved groups, fills knowledge gaps, and empowers users with AI-driven insight all of which are in perfect harmony with the track's goal of providing flexible, user-centric financial advice.

# ArogyaSahayak v1.0 – AI-Powered Health Assistant

**Overview:**  
ArogyaSahayak is a comprehensive AI-powered mobile app designed to transform medical reports into actionable health insights. It bridges the gap between patients, doctors, and medical teams, providing a seamless, end-to-end workflow. Users receive personalized analytics, AI-guided recommendations, exercise suggestions, product guidance, and real-time notifications, while doctors and medical teams can efficiently manage and dispense treatments using QR and barcode technology.

---

## User Interface (Patients)
- **Report Upload & Analytics:** Users can upload lab or medical reports (PDF/image) and receive instant analytics, highlighting key risk factors and providing a clear summary.  
- **AI Chatbot:** A personalized chatbot answers user queries based on their report, explains results, and guides next steps.  
- **Progress Reports:** Users can track their health over time; differences between reports are visualized for easier understanding.  
- **Yoga & Exercise Recommendations:** AI suggests suitable yoga poses and exercise routines tailored to the user’s condition.  
- **Video Resources:** Curated educational videos (like YouTube) appear alongside reports for instant reference.  
- **Community Feed:** Users see relevant posts from a community-like feed with health tips and success stories.  
- **Food & Product Guidance:** Users can scan barcodes to verify if a product or food item is suitable based on their health reports.  
- **Maps Integration:** One-tap navigation to recommended hospitals or clinics.  
- **Notifications & Reminders:** Timely alerts for medications and proactive recommendations based on AI or doctor prescriptions.

---

## Doctor Interface
- **QR Scan for Access:** Each user has a unique QR code; doctors scan it to instantly retrieve all reports and summaries.  
- **Highlighted Risk Factors:** Critical metrics and flagged health concerns are displayed upfront for quick triage.  
- **Prescription Management:** Doctors can add medicines and instructions, which automatically sync to the user profile and trigger notifications.  
- **Notes & Summary:** Doctors can leave comments and a structured summary for the user’s reference.

---

## Medical Team / Pharmacist Interface
- **QR/Barcode Scanning:** Scan user QR codes or medicine barcodes to fetch user prescriptions and medicine details.  
- **Efficient Dispensing:** Medicines can be marked as dispensed, updating the database and ensuring timely tracking.  
- **Synchronization:** Updates from dispensing flow reflect immediately in the user’s profile, keeping all stakeholders informed.

---

## Tech Stack
- **Mobile App:** Flutter  
- **Backend:** Django, Flask, FastAPI  
- **AI/NLP & Chat:** LangChain, LangGraph  
- **Other Integrations:** Barcode/QR scanning, Google Maps, push notifications, video embedding  

---

## Demo Flow for Judges
1. Upload a sample medical report → view instant analytics & risk factor summary.  
2. Interact with the AI chatbot for personalized guidance.  
3. Upload a subsequent report → observe progress tracking and differences.  
4. Scan product barcodes → receive AI recommendations for foods or medications.  
5. Explore the community feed for relevant posts and health tips.  
6. Doctor scans the user QR → accesses full report → adds prescriptions and notes.  
7. Medical team scans user QR or medicine barcode → dispenses medicine → user receives notifications.  
8. Observe real-time notifications for medications and AI suggestions.  

---

## Notes
- **Prototype Status:** Hackathon version; features demonstrate end-to-end interaction between patients, doctors, and medical teams.  
- **Android Requirement:** Minimum 6.0 (Marshmallow)  
- **Privacy & Security:** Reports are linked only to user accounts. Doctor access requires QR scan. Data is for demo purposes; production-grade security not implemented.  
- **User Experience:** Designed for smooth flow with minimal clicks and clear visuals to facilitate rapid evaluation by judges.

---

**Summary:**  
ArogyaSahayak v1.0 showcases a complete health management ecosystem with AI-powered analytics, recommendations, QR/barcode integrations, and notifications — demonstrating an innovative, real-world-ready prototype for hackathons.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

## Overview
ArogyaSahayak v1.0 is an innovative **AI-powered health assistant** that leverages **agentic AI** to provide personalized, autonomous guidance for patients, doctors, and medical teams. Our platform demonstrates how AI agents can autonomously analyze medical reports, recommend treatments, suggest exercises, and manage workflows — all while integrating real-time notifications and community-driven insights.

Using advanced AI agents, ArogyaSahayak can:  
- Interpret user-uploaded medical reports instantly.  
- Provide actionable health insights and summaries.  
- Suggest personalized yoga/exercise routines and video resources.  
- Recommend foods and OTC products with real-time barcode scanning.  
- Enable patients to interact with AI agents via an intelligent chatbot that understands the user’s medical context.  

---

## Agentic AI Workflow & Interfaces

### 1️⃣ User (Patient) Interface
- **AI Report Agents:** Autonomous agents parse uploaded lab reports and generate instant analytics highlighting key risk factors.  
- **Chat Agent:** Contextual AI agent answers user questions, explains health metrics, and recommends lifestyle interventions.  
- **Progress Tracking Agent:** Monitors report history and generates comparative progress visualizations.  
- **Recommendation Agent:** Suggests yoga, exercises, foods, and products tailored to the user’s health condition.  
- **Community Feed Agent:** Curates relevant community posts and tips to the user’s health profile.  
- **Notification & Reminder Agent:** Sends timely alerts for medications, check-ups, and AI-recommended actions.

### 2️⃣ Doctor Interface
- **QR Scan Agent:** Fetches user reports instantly via QR scan.  
- **Risk Factor Highlighting:** Autonomous agent flags critical metrics for rapid triage.  
- **Prescription Agent:** Doctors add medicines and instructions; AI schedules notifications for adherence.  
- **Summary Agent:** Generates patient summaries highlighting progress, concerns, and recommendations.

### 3️⃣ Medical Team / Pharmacist Interface
- **Barcode Agent:** Scans medicines or user QR codes to validate prescriptions.  
- **Dispense Tracking Agent:** Updates user medication database in real-time.  
- **Synchronization Agent:** Ensures all stakeholders (user, doctor, pharmacist) have updated, consistent data.

---

## Technology Stack & AI Tools
- **Mobile App:** Flutter  
- **Backend & APIs:** Django, Flask, FastAPI  
- **AI / Agentic Components:** LangChain, LangGraph — autonomous agents for report analysis, chat, and recommendation workflows.  
- **Integrations:** Barcode/QR scanning, Google Maps navigation, push notifications, video embedding for educational resources.  
- **Data Flow:** Reports → AI agents → Recommendations → Notifications → Doctor/Medical Team → User feedback loop.

---

## Key Highlights
- Fully autonomous **agent-driven report analysis**.  
- **Context-aware AI chat** tailored to each user’s medical data.  
- Barcode/QR-based interaction for **medications, foods, and hospital navigation**.  
- Community-driven insights powered by AI agents.  
- Multi-stakeholder workflow: **Patient → Doctor → Medical Team**.  
- Notifications and reminders integrated in a **closed-loop health management system**.  

---

## Demo Flow for Judges
1. Upload sample report → AI report agent generates analytics & summary.  
2. Chat with the AI agent for personalized guidance.  
3. Upload subsequent report → progress tracking agent shows trends.  
4. Scan product barcode → recommendation agent validates foods/medications.  
5. Explore community feed → agent-curated relevant posts.  
6. Doctor scans user QR → prescription agent adds medicines → notification agent triggers alerts.  
7. Pharmacist scans QR/barcode → dispense agent updates database → user receives notifications.  

---

**Summary:**  
ArogyaSahayak v1.0 demonstrates how **agentic AI can autonomously manage health workflows**, analyze complex data, provide personalized recommendations, and connect multiple stakeholders in a HealthTech ecosystem — all in a hackathon-ready, demo-friendly mobile app.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

We are building SurgeSense, an agentic AI system that enables hospitals to predict, prepare for, and respond to patient surges during festivals, pollution peaks, and epidemic waves—scenarios that are uniquely frequent and intense in India.

The system ingests multivariate real-world signals—historical patient inflow, EMR trends, AQI levels, weather, mobility data, government health bulletins, and festival/event calendars. Using Temporal Fusion Transformers (for forecasting), Bayesian changepoint detection (for outbreak/surge onset), and OR-Tools + RL-based optimization (for staffing and inventory decisions), SurgeSense generates 7–14 day demand forecasts and prescriptive action plans instead of mere dashboards.

Core Features

Surge Forecasting Engine: Predicts ER/ICU/OPD load by department, accounting for seasonal and event-driven spikes.

Staffing Optimizer: Auto-recommends shift rosters and workforce rebalancing to prevent overload and burnout.

Supply & Bed Planner: Forecasts oxygen, ventilator, and consumable needs; recommends reorder points and bed allocation.

Patient Advisory Automation: Sends proactive WhatsApp/SMS alerts for vulnerable groups during high-risk days (e.g., AQI spikes).

Real-time Monitoring Agent: Continuously watches new data and triggers alerts when projected thresholds are breached.

Simulation Mode: Runs “What if?” scenarios (e.g., “What if AQI hits 400 on Diwali?”) to support admin decisions.

What Makes This Unique

India-specific surge modelling (festival calendars + pollution cycles + epidemiology), unlike generic hospital analytics tools.

Agentic closed-loop system — Sense → Predict → Optimize → Alert → Act — not just charts or reports.

Human-in-loop workflow for trust and accountability, giving admins control while reducing reaction time from days to minutes.

City-level scalability, enabling future integration with state health departments or NDMA for macro surge management.

By shifting hospitals from reactive crisis management to proactive surge preparedness, SurgeSense directly reduces wait times, stockouts, overcrowding, and mortality risks, especially during India’s predictable but unmanaged peak-demand periods.

Now coming to the business side of the idea.

Phase 1 – Beachhead Market (24 months)

Start with large hospital chains that already have digital EMR data.

Deploy ward-by-ward (ER → ICU → IPD), prove ROI.

Present clinical validation at NASSCOM, NATHEALTH, IBMS.

Phase 2 – Government Partnerships (Year 3–5)

City-level deployment via state health departments (Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka).

Tie-in with AQI and epidemic surveillance programs.

Phase 3 – Ecosystem Integrations (Year 5+)

Integrations with EMR providers (Practo, MedPlum, OpenEMR).

API marketplace for telemedicine players and insurance networks.

Sales Motion: B2B direct sales + strategic partnerships with EMR vendors.
Pricing Model: SaaS subscription + per-bed surcharge.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

It uses agentic AI to autonomously analyze, forecast, recommend, and trigger actions instead of just predicting—directly aligning with the Agentic AI Systems track.

It addresses a real operational bottleneck in healthcare by combining time-series forecasting, environmental signals, and decision optimization, which fits the AI for public infrastructure and emergency response problem space.

It leverages multimodal data (AQI, festivals, epidemiology, mobility, EMR) and converts it into actionable workflows for hospitals, which matches the track’s goal of building AI systems that proactively solve complex, real-world challenges.

It creates a closed-loop “sense → predict → optimize → act” system, reflecting the track’s emphasis on autonomous, outcome-oriented agents rather than basic analytics or rule-based automation.

BookMyDoc – Smart Healthcare, Simplified.

BookMyDoc is an intelligent healthcare platform designed to simplify the process of booking doctor appointments — making it smarter, faster, and more accessible, especially for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in India.

Currently, over 70% of doctor appointments are still booked offline, causing confusion, overcrowded clinics, missed appointments, and poor patient–doctor communication. While major healthcare apps focus mainly on metro cities, smaller regions remain underserved due to high setup costs and limited awareness.

BookMyDoc bridges this digital gap with a smart, AI-powered appointment booking system. The platform enables patients to:

1.Search for nearby doctors based on specialization or symptoms.

2.Instantly view real-time availability and book, reschedule, or cancel appointments.

3.Receive automatic reminders to reduce no-shows and improve reliability.

Doctors, on the other hand, can:

1.Manage schedules digitally.

2.Track patient history and reliability scores.

3.Increase visibility through a low-cost, easy-to-use dashboard.

The integration of AI and location-based intelligence ensures personalized healthcare access. The system uses Gemini API for symptom-based specialist recommendations and LocationIQ for discovering nearby clinics.

Key Features:
1.AI-based Specialist Recommendation: Suggests the right doctor based on patient symptoms.

2.Smart Scheduling System: Provides real-time slots, automated reminders, and rescheduling options.

3.Location-Aware Discovery: Finds nearby doctors using map integration.

4.Doctor Dashboard: Lets doctors manage slots, availability, and appointments easily.

5.Patient Dashboard: Allows booking, tracking, and managing appointments seamlessly.

**Description of your solution**

MediMate: Smart Health. Real-Time Lifelines.
MediMate is an innovative, integrated HealthTech platform designed to bridge the massive healthcare access gap in rural and semi-rural India. It addresses the limitations of modern healthcare facilities and the shortage of workers by providing an AI-driven, highly accessible, and trustworthy solution.

1. The Patient Interface: Smart, Accessible Awareness
This pillar ensures healthcare is readily available, reliable, and easy to use for everyone, regardless of digital literacy.

AI Health Assistant (Chatbot): Provides immediate health information, symptom checks, and first-aid advice. It is powered by advanced AI and runs primarily over WhatsApp (no app download required).

Trusted Data Source: All health content, suggestions, and awareness information are strictly verified and grounded in guidelines from the WHO and ICMR, directly combating health misinformation.

Maximum Inclusion: Features robust multi-language and voice support for major regional Indian languages, ensuring accessibility even for users with low literacy or limited data connectivity.

Preventive Engagement: Uses engaging quizzes and myth-busting games to actively promote preventive health awareness in a fun, interesting format.

2. The Critical Resource Lifeline: Real-Time Inventory
This unique feature transforms emergency preparedness by providing instant data on vital resources.

Live Blood Bank Search: Allows patients or local health workers to check the real-time availability of specific blood groups (e.g., O+, A-) at affiliated hospitals and blood banks.

Essential Medicine Stock Check: Users can instantly confirm if crucial or specialized medicines are in stock at the associated hospital pharmacy.

Immediate Impact: This functionality eliminates dangerous delays during medical emergencies by providing reliable, current inventory status.

3. The Provider Interface: Seamless Clinic Management (PMS)
This dashboard enhances the operational efficiency of clinics and hospitals, especially in resource-constrained areas.

Integrated Digital Practice: Manages appointments, creates digital case papers (EHRs), and handles e-prescriptions, streamlining administrative workflows.

Smart Operational AI:

No-Show Prediction: Uses AI analysis of appointment history to predict patient cancellations, allowing clinics to optimize schedules.

Disease Trend Analysis: Analyzes local patient symptoms to provide early alerts regarding potential outbreaks (like flu or dengue surges) in the community.

Inventory Control: Provides the toolset for staff to easily update and manage the real-time blood and medicine inventory data that feeds the public-facing search tool.

MediMate is the Integrated Health Network that delivers AI-driven awareness and real-time operational efficiency to serve the under-connected populations of India.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

That's an insightful question. The MediMate solution's success depends on the deployment of Agentic AI—meaning the systems aren't just giving preset answers; they're designed to make autonomous decisions, look up dynamic data, and trigger actions.

Here is a clean breakdown of how MediMate leverages agentic capabilities across its critical functions:

How MediMate Leverages Agentic AI
1. The Resource Coordination Agent (Logistics)
This agent acts as a dynamic manager, linking patient needs directly to real-time, life-saving hospital inventory.

Real-Time Data Lookup: When a user queries the AI Chatbot or the Live Lifeline Search (e.g., "Is O+ blood available?"), the agent doesn't give a static answer. It autonomously executes a database query, processes the live inventory status, and returns the current stock levels and nearest location.

Proactive Alerts: The agent continuously monitors stock levels against defined thresholds. If the essential medicine stock drops below the reorder point, the agent autonomously sends an instant notification (via SMS/WhatsApp) to the designated clinic admin, acting as a supply-chain safeguard.

2. The Predictive Health Agent (Clinical Intelligence)
This agent uses data analysis to move the clinic from reactive treatment to proactive community health management.

No-Show Optimization: The agent processes historical appointment patterns (time, location, recurrence) to build a predictive model. It then autonomously flags high-risk appointments for no-shows, allowing staff to confirm the booking or use the time slot for other patients.

Disease Surveillance: The agent analyzes anonymized symptom data from the AI Chatbot and digital case papers. If it detects a clustering or statistically significant spike in related symptoms within a specific village or postal code, it autonomously generates a Public Health Alert for the Clinic Dashboard, enabling staff to prepare for an outbreak (e.g., predicted dengue surge).

3. The Conversational Agent (Trusted User Experience)
This is the user-facing AI system, built not just for conversation but for safety, trust, and inclusivity.

Grounded Trust Policy: The agent is given a strict system instruction to use Google Search grounding (simulated here with WHO/ICMR verification) for all medical answers. This ensures the information provided is scientifically validated, not fabricated, and addresses the challenge of misinformation directly.

Multilingual Triage: The agent seamlessly detects the user’s regional language (e.g., Hindi, Tamil) from text or voice input. It uses this information to translate, simplify, and respond in the native dialect, breaking down literacy and language barriers automatically .

Emergency Handoff: If the agent detects symptoms indicative of an acute crisis (e.g., "loss of consciousness," "severe breathlessness"), it autonomously overrides general advice and pushes the local emergency number to the user immediately, prioritizing safety.

In short, MediMate’s agentic AI layers are what transform it from a passive app into a functional, reliable, real-time healthcare operator, capable of informed decision-making and autonomous action.

### ArogyaAI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/arogyaai-eff1) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MumbaiHacks%202025%20--%20Round%201%20(Online)-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mumbaihacks25-round1.devfolio.co)

> ArogyaAI: Wisdom. Data. Health.

![Kaggle](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kaggle-333333?style=flat-square) ![fast.ai](https://img.shields.io/badge/fast.ai-333333?style=flat-square) ![Database](https://img.shields.io/badge/Database-333333?style=flat-square)

**Description of your solution**

Executive Summary
ArogyaAI is a dual-sided (B2B/B2C) wellness ecosystem designed to solve the problem of fragmented and incompetent medical data in India. We are building a traditional wellness ecosystem powered by an agentic AI and a structured knowledge graph. Our platform integrates data from ancient wisdom (Ayurveda, Yoga, Astrology, Nada Yoga) and modern diagnostics to create a "deep arogya persona" for each user. This allows us to move beyond surface-level symptom treatment and provide holistic, personalized, and proactive health guidance. The entire system is built on a "privacy-by-design" foundation and is powered by a B2B2C flywheel growth model.

The Problem We Solve
Our solution directly addresses three core problems in the Indian wellness landscape:


Mistrust & Access: The public is increasingly wary of allopathic solutions for common and chronic ailments (like viral fevers, diabetes, etc.) but lacks access to authentic Āyurvedāchāryas and reliable "gharelu" (home-based) or yogic solutions.


Surface-Level Care: Most existing solutions are reactive, treating symptoms rather than addressing the deep, multi-layered root cause of an issue.


Data Fragmentation: Patient health data is completely fragmented, split between modern diagnostic reports and traditional wellness goals, with no single system to bridge them.

Our core insight is that foundational health is declining (e.g., viral fevers now last 5-7 days instead of 2-3) , and the solution must be a system that empowers long-term health, not one that monetizes sickness.

Our Solution: The ArogyaAI Technical Architecture
We are building a dual-sided ecosystem with a single AI core, which consists of four distinct, interconnected components:

1. The VedaWell Knowledge Core: This is the foundational "brain" of our AI. It is a structured knowledge graph built by embedding a vast corpus of data, including classical texts (like Charaka Samhita, Yoga Sutras), modern medical research, and traditional texts on Nada Yoga (sound healing) and Jyotisha (Vedic astrology).

2. The Holistic Profile Engine (Privacy-by-Design): This is our secure data synthesis engine.


Pseudonymization: When a user registers, their Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is cryptographically separated from their health data.


Data Synthesis: All health data—including medical history, dincharya (daily routine) logs, uploaded reports, and even astrological parameters (Nakshatra, Dasha)—is tied only to this anonymous, unique ID.


Composite Persona: This process creates a holistic "wellness vector" or "persona" for each user. This allows our AI to find deep, novel correlations (e.g., "Users with this Nakshatra and Dincharya pattern are highly responsive to Nada Yoga for stress") without ever knowing the user's real-world identity.

3. The Deep Diagnostic Core: This is our "7-Layer Chain of Thought" engine that acts as the input mechanism for the platform. It dynamically analyzes the user's state by synthesizing four key data streams:


Onboarding Assessment: To establish a baseline Prakriti (constitution).


User-Logged Data: Continuous tracking of dincharya, mood, diet, etc..


Medical Report Analysis: Using NLP to extract key biomarkers from uploaded allopathic and Ayurvedic reports.


On-Device Biometrics: An opt-in feature to analyze the user's tongue, face, and voice for real-time diagnostics.

4. The Agentic Intervention Module: This is the output engine that delivers value to the user. It reads the user's anonymous "composite persona" to provide proactive, personalized, and actionable protocols, such as:

Personalized Dincharya (daily routine) plans.

Our "music-based healing" (Nada Yoga) module.

An optional Jyotish (astrology) guidance module.

Target Audience & Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy
We will employ a B2B2C Flywheel model to create a self-reinforcing growth loop.


B2C Persona: The "Holistic data anabler"


Who: Digitally native, health-conscious Indians (aged 22-35) in Tier 1/2 cities who are frustrated by the "guidance vacuum" and want a single, credible platform for their well-being.


B2B Persona: The "Digital Vaidya"


Who: Independent Āyurvedāchāryas and wellness clinics who lack modern tools to gather holistic patient data and monitor their adherence to wellness plans.

Our GTM strategy is phased:


Phase 1 (B2C): User & Data Acquisition. We will first launch the feature-rich B2C freemium app. This will be marketed to the "Holistic Optimizer" persona to rapidly build a large user base and a deep, proprietary data moat.


Phase 2 (B2B): Flywheel Activation. We will then roll out the "Practitioner Dashboard," a B2B SaaS product. Practitioners will subscribe to this dashboard to monitor their consenting patients' data (which is logged via the B2C app). This provides immense value to the practitioner, and in turn, they will drive mass B2C app adoption by onboarding their entire patient base.

**Healthtech: Bring your own problem in Healthtech, leveraging Agentic AI.**

The Problem: data incompetency of medical data 
Problem 1: Mistrust & Access: People are wary of allopathy for common (viral, cough) and chronic (diabetes, hypertension) issues, but lack access to authentic Āyurvedāchāryas and reliable "gharelu" (home-based) or yogic solutions. 
Problem 2: Surface-Level Care: Most solutions treat symptoms, not the deep, multi-layered root cause of an issue. 
Problem 3: Fragmentation: Patient data is fragmented between modern diagnostics (allopathy reports) and traditional wellness goals.

Insight: 
Foundational health is declining (e.g., viral fevers now last 5-7 days, up from 2-3).
The system must be built on empowering long-term health, not just monetizing sickness.

What We Plan to Build: The Traditional wellness ecosystem powered by structured knowledge graph

We are building a dual-sided ecosystem powered by a single, agentic AI core. The core technology consists of four distinct, interconnected components:
1. The VedaWell Knowledge Core: This is our foundational "brain." We will build a knowledge graph by embedding classical texts (Charaka Samhita, Yoga Sutras), modern research, and texts on Nada Yoga (sound healing) and Jyotisha (astrology).
2. The Holistic Profile Engine (Privacy-by-Design):
Pseudonymization: When a user registers, their Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is cryptographically separated from their health data.
Data Synthesis: All health data—medical history, dincharya, uploaded reports, astrological parameters (Nakshatra, Dasha)—is tied only to this anonymous ID.
Composite Persona: This allows our AI to perform deep synthesis and create a holistic "persona" or "wellness vector" for each user. The AI can then find correlations (e.g., "Users with this Nakshatra, Dasha, and Dincharya pattern are highly responsive to Nada Yoga for stress") without ever knowing the real-world identity of the user.

**Description of your solution**

This project is an agentic AI system designed to shift hospitals from reactive crisis management to proactive preparation. It functions as a "hospital weather forecast" by ingesting public signals like AQI, festival calendars, and weather data to accurately predict patient surges 7-21 days in advance.

Unlike simple forecasting tools, this system's core is an LLM-based agentic planner. This "brain" reasons with the prediction, considers a hospital's current resources (like staff and inventory), and then autonomously generates a prioritized, human-readable operational plan. The system's final action is to deliver this plan as alerts, SMS advisories, and exportable CSVs for rostering and procurement, ultimately helping hospitals reduce wait times, prevent supply shortages, and save lives.

**Healthtech: Manage unpredictable surges in patients during festivals, pollution spikes, or epidemics with an AI agent that autonomously analyzes data and recommends staffing, supply, and patient advisory actions in advance.**

Our solution is a great fit for this track because it is an agentic AI that is specifically built to deal with patient surges from the very same causes enumerated: festivals, spike in pollution, and epidemics. It independently examines data such as AQI, festival schedules, and outbreak signals to predict patient load 7-21 days in the future. Most significantly, it finishes the track's necessary loop by going beyond simple prediction to actively suggest the given actions: staffing, supplies, and patient advisories, so that hospitals can plan ahead.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Real Problems This Website Solves
1. People Forget Their Medicines
It’s very common for people to miss doses because of busy schedules, stress, or simple forgetfulness.
How your site helps:
Lets users create personalized medicine schedules (daily, weekly, or custom).
Sends instant browser or email reminders at the exact time.
Shows everything clearly on the dashboard so they always know what’s next.

2. Tracking Becomes a Mess
Manually keeping track of taken or missed doses is tedious and often unreliable.
How your site helps:
Automatically logs every dose as “taken” or “missed” in real time.
Builds a complete history of medication adherence.
Helps people and caregivers spot patterns, like repeated missed doses at certain times.

3. Hard to Visualize Progress
It’s hard to stay consistent when you can’t easily see how you’re doing.
How your site helps:
Displays graphs and charts showing adherence trends over time.
Highlights missed doses with color-coded indicators.
Turns data into motivation by showing progress and improvement clearly.

4. Schedules Keep Changing
Medicines, timings, or dosages often need to be updated.
How your site helps:
Allows easy editing and deletion of schedules.
Updates reminders automatically after any change.
Keeps the dashboard organized and accurate.

5. Scattered Reminders Across Devices
People use multiple devices, and reminders can easily get lost between them.
How your site helps:
Syncs all medication schedules with Google Calendar (Great Sky Calendar).
Automatically updates calendar events if doses are changed or skipped.
Keeps reminders accessible from any device or platform.

6. No Easy Way to Ask Quick Health Questions
Most apps don’t let users ask questions in plain language about their medicines or routines.
How your site helps:
Includes an AI Health Assistant (Mystic) that responds to natural questions such as:
“What medicines do I take today?”
“Did I miss any doses this week?”
Gives quick, accurate answers based on real user data.

7. Poor Medication Adherence Leads to Poor Outcomes
Missed or inconsistent doses can reduce treatment effectiveness or cause complications.
How your site helps:
Builds structure around the entire medicine routine.
Combines reminders, visual feedback, and AI guidance.
Encourages steady adherence and timely medication use.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
1. Integrating Real-Time Notifications

One of the biggest challenges was getting browser notifications to work reliably across different devices and browsers. Initially, reminders weren’t triggering at the correct times, and permission handling in browsers (especially Chrome and Safari) was inconsistent.

How I solved it:
I implemented a dedicated notificationService that requests permission from the user as soon as they open the dashboard. It also schedules notifications using precise dose times from the backend. I tested it on multiple browsers and adjusted the timing logic to handle time zone differences and delayed triggers. After refining the permission flow and event scheduling, notifications started working consistently.
2. Building and Integrating the AI Assistant (Mystic)

Another major hurdle was connecting the AI assistant with real user data like schedules and dose logs. The main issue was getting the assistant to understand natural language queries such as “What do I take today?” and map them to actual database queries.

### MedKnock
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/medknock-02cb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/singhalharsh1611/MedKnock) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/MLckMvY5Vdo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeSangam%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codesangam2k25.devfolio.co)

> Beyond remiders, complete medicine health app

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing **medication schedules** manually often leads to missed doses, confusion, and poor adherence — especially for patients with multiple prescriptions. This project simplifies and automates the process by sending smart reminders, logging doses, and predicting missed habits using AI insights.

It also integrates with Google Calendar for seamless scheduling, provides detailed health report analysis, and generates shareable reports. By combining reminders, analytics, and AI-driven nudges, it helps users stay consistent, informed, and healthier without extra effort.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Google Calendar API Rate Limits**
While syncing medication schedules with Google Calendar, we frequently hit rate limits during bulk updates. To overcome this, we implemented request batching and exponential backoff, ensuring reliable synchronization without exceeding quota limits.

**Web Scraping for Drug Information**
Integrating accurate drug information required scraping multiple pharmaceutical sources. Challenges included inconsistent HTML structures, CAPTCHA restrictions, and dynamic content rendering. We resolved this by using headless browsers and caching results to reduce redundant scrapes.

**AI Report Analyzer Integration**
Connecting the Gemini API for AI-based report analysis presented issues with API response parsing and latency. The initial implementation failed due to improper handling of asynchronous responses. We fixed it by restructuring the logic to await responses properly and adding robust error handling and fallbacks.

**Dosage Log Timezone Conflicts**
Users across different time zones caused inconsistencies in dosage reminders and missed log timestamps. We standardized all time-based operations to UTC and converted times locally during display, ensuring accurate reminders and AI predictions.

**PDF Generation and Download Issues**
Generating detailed health reports using @react-pdf/renderer caused crashes when large datasets were processed. We optimized rendering by splitting report sections and handling images separately before merging the final PDF.

**Frontend Responsiveness and Layout Alignment**
Making dashboard components (like buttons and tables) responsive was challenging due to mixed CSS frameworks and component libraries. We resolved it by using Tailwind’s grid and flex utilities consistently across all pages.

**File Upload and Cloud Storage**
Migrating from local file storage to Cloudinary involved authentication and response mismatches. We integrated multer-storage-cloudinary to streamline uploads and ensured secure URL generation for each file.

**The problem it solves**

Data Fetching Issues:
Faced problems while syncing real-time data from Supabase. Solved by using useEffect with correct dependencies to ensure consistent updates.

Build Errors in JSX Loops:
Encountered parsing errors due to misplaced parentheses in nested .map() loops. Fixed by restructuring the code and properly closing return blocks.

UI Overlap and Animation Lag:
Framer Motion animations caused overlapping and lagging elements. Resolved by fine-tuning animation delays and adjusting component layering.

Authentication Handling:
User sessions were not persisting after page refresh. Solved by implementing supabase.auth.getSession() for reliable session management.

Chatbot Integration:
The embedded chatbot iframe conflicted with layout elements. Fixed by using fixed positioning and responsive sizing for a clean interface.

### EnviroSync
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/envirosync-6743) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Irfan-Hussain107/Health-Dashboard) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/etBFq0u4Dzw) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-EcoCode-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ecocode.devfolio.co)

> The Hyperlocal Enironmental Health Dashboard

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Urban residents in cities like Delhi face difficulties in making informed decisions due to fragmented and complex environmental data, including real-time air quality, noise pollution, and civic complaint responsiveness. The Hyperlocal Environmental Health Dashboard with AI-Powered Insights consolidates this information into a single, easy-to-understand platform. By providing hyperlocal data, AI-generated summaries, personalized health guidance, and automated complaint assistance, the system enables informed relocation choices, improves quality of life, and fosters meaningful civic engagement.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, our biggest challenge was the lack of reliable, real-time data for key environmental metrics.

First, for Noise Pollution, we discovered that no public, real-time API for noise levels exists. Instead of abandoning this crucial metric, we engineered our own solution. We built a robust proxy model that queries the OpenStreetMap database via the Overpass API. This model identifies all known noise sources—like highways, railways, and commercial zones—near a given address and calculates a realistic, data-driven noise score based on their proximity and impact.

Similarly, for Civic Complaints, we found that scraping official portals for live, hyperlocal data was unreliable. To solve this, we pivoted to a machine learning approach. We collected historical, zone-wise complaint data from trusted open sources and trained a predictive model. Now, instead of just showing past issues, our application predicts the expected number of complaints for an area based on these historical trends.

These data limitations forced us to innovate, resulting in a more unique and powerful solution that combines live APIs, a geographical proxy model, and predictive machine learning to create our comprehensive environmental score.

**Data for Impact: Visualization & Civic Tech**

The Hyperlocal Environmental Health Dashboard leverages real-time environmental data—air quality, noise pollution, and civic complaints—to create meaningful impact. Using interactive maps, charts, and neighborhood comparisons, complex data is visualized in an intuitive way, helping residents make informed decisions. AI-powered summaries, a contextual chatbot, and automated complaint assistance enhance accessibility and personalization. By combining data integration, visualization, and advanced technology, the project empowers residents to understand their environment, improve quality of life, and engage effectively with civic systems.
