[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mediverse-ai-2daf) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://mediverseai.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> “Your Health, Their Care, One Ecosystem.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Healthcare systems today struggle with fragmented data, slow diagnostics, and heavy administrative burdens. Patients often face delays in getting accurate reports, doctors spend excessive time on paperwork instead of patient care, and hospitals lack real-time visibility into resources like beds and staff.

MediVerse AI solves this by bringing intelligent automation, AI-powered diagnostics, and role-based dashboards into one seamless ecosystem. Patients get faster and more accurate health insights, doctors save time with smart scheduling and clinical analytics, and hospitals achieve better resource optimization with real-time tracking.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges I faced while building this project was integrating AI diagnostics (Gemini API) with real-time data from Supabase. Initially, the system was returning incomplete diagnostic reports because of mismatched data formats between the uploaded medical files (DICOM, PDFs, and images) and the AI model’s expected input.

To overcome this, I implemented a secure file preprocessing pipeline that handled automatic format conversion, compression, and validation before sending the files to the AI layer. This not only fixed the issue but also improved the overall accuracy and speed of the diagnostic results.

Another hurdle was role-based access and security compliance (HIPAA standards). Setting up fine-grained row-level security and multi-factor authentication required extensive debugging because some users were seeing data outside their role scope. After several iterations, I refined the role-based policies in Supabase and thoroughly tested them with different user accounts until the access controls worked flawlessly.

These challenges taught me the importance of robust data handling, strict access control, and iterative debugging in building healthcare solutions.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

MediVerse AI is designed for the Open Track as it represents a next-generation healthcare ecosystem built on intelligent automation, advanced AI, and seamless integration. The platform unifies three critical layers of healthcare: AI-powered diagnostics for patients, workflow optimization for doctors, and real-time operational management for hospitals. Patients can securely upload medical images and receive AI-driven diagnostic reports with confidence scores, doctors gain clinical efficiency through smart scheduling and comprehensive patient dashboards, while hospitals benefit from dynamic bed tracking, staff roster management, and resource monitoring. Backed by HIPAA-compliant security, role-based access, and end-to-end encryption, MediVerse AI ensures both safety and scalability. By transforming healthcare delivery into a faster, more accurate, and patient-centric experience, our solution demonstrates true cross-domain innovation—making it an ideal fit for the open category.

> Smart Health, Simple Habits

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OAuth](https://img.shields.io/badge/OAuth-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tesseract OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tesseract%20OCR-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MediAlert helps people remember to take their medicine and manage their health safely, with a special focus on elderly individuals and those living with chronic illnesses in India.

**What People Can Use It For**

1) Medication Reminders: Friendly notifications and easy-to-follow tracking help users stay on top of their medication schedule.

2) Prescription Management: OCR scanning reduces manual errors in logging complex prescriptions.

3) Health Journaling: Mood and symptom tracking provides doctors with a richer context for diagnosis and treatment.

4) Doctor Communication: Automatic, secure PDF reports improve accuracy and reduce miscommunication.

5) AI Guidance: In-app safety checks and awareness tools help avoid harmful mistakes.

6) Offline Access: Works without an internet connection, ensuring reliability in low-connectivity regions.

**How It Makes Tasks Easier/Safer**

1) Reduces the risk of hospitalization due to missed or incorrect medication.

2) Reduces the complexity of treatment regimens into simple, actionable reminders.

3) Prevents prescription errors through automated scanning and logging.

4) Increases patient independence, especially for elderly users with limited digital literacy.

5) Strengthens doctor-patient collaboration with structured, shareable data.

6) Minimizes healthcare costs by preventing avoidable complications.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

While building MediAlert, our team faced a few key challenges:

1. OCR Accuracy with Prescriptions

Challenge: Medical prescriptions are often handwritten and messy, which made it difficult for the OCR (Tesseract.js) to read them correctly.

Solution: For the prototype, we restricted OCR testing to printed prescriptions and added a manual edit option for users. In future iterations, we plan to train a custom model for better accuracy.



2. Push Notifications in PWA

Challenge: Setting up real-time reminders through browser notifications was tricky because of service worker limitations.

Solution: We implemented a basic Firebase Cloud Messaging integration for testing and plan to refine it further for cross-device sync.



3. Database Structure & Sync

Challenge: Designing a database that could handle both offline-first logging and online synchronization was complex.

Solution: For now, we use MongoDB Atlas with local caching for the prototype, and will explore IndexedDB for smoother offline support.



4. UI/UX for Elderly Users

Challenge: Ensuring that the interface is simple enough for seniors with low digital literacy.

Solution: We created large buttons, minimal text, and color-coded reminders to improve accessibility.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

Our project embodies open innovation by merging healthcare, AI, and accessible tech into a modular, scalable platform. It’s designed for low-connectivity and diverse users with multilingual/voice support, while enabling collaboration across patients, doctors, and NGOs through reports, dashboards, and APIs. By embedding privacy compliance and a freemium–B2B model, it becomes not just an app but an open ecosystem for healthcare innovation and impact.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/sehatsathi-6962) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://sathtl.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NexHack-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nexhack.devfolio.co)

> Smart Rural Tele-Health for Every Family

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

💡 The Problem It Solves
1. Doctor Shortage in Rural Areas

50% doctor posts in rural India remain vacant.

Patients can consult state-level doctors remotely → no need to travel long distances.

2. Poor Internet Connectivity

Only ~31% of rural areas have stable internet.

Our Offline-First PWA works even without internet and syncs data once network returns → zero data loss.

3. Medicine Stock-Out

Rural pharmacies often run “Out of Stock”.

The pharmacy dashboard shows real-time stock with green/red ticks and future availability → patients know where to buy medicine.

4. High Travel Cost & Wage Loss

On average, rural patients lose ₹500 and 4 hours per hospital visit.

With tele-consultation, time + money saved → healthcare becomes affordable.

5. Untracked Prescriptions

Prescriptions not logged properly lead to gaps in govt. healthcare records.

Every prescription is stored in database + reported to govt → better policy & transparency.

✅ In simple words:
People can use it for remote doctor consultations, offline medical record storage, medicine availability checks, and cost savings — making healthcare easier, safer, and more reliable in rural India.

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into
1. Offline-First PWA Sync Issues

Problem: Patient data stored offline (IndexedDB) was creating duplicate records during sync.

Solution: Implemented Background Sync API with unique visitID to ensure one-time sync.

2. Low Bandwidth Video Consultations

Problem: Video consultations were lagging in rural 2G/3G areas.

Solution: Enabled Daily.co SDK low-bandwidth codec (144p + audio fallback). The system auto-switches to audio-only mode if the network is too weak.

3. Medicine Availability Tracking

Problem: Patients could not know when an “Out of Stock” medicine would be available again.

Solution: Added a waitlist + auto-check system. Patients get an SMS notification once the medicine is restocked.

4. OTP Verification Flow

Problem: Resend OTP option had bugs; users often didn’t receive repeated OTPs.

Solution: Added throttling + retry logic (30 sec cooldown) and connected fallback SMS gateway.

5. Prescription Storage & Reporting

Problem: If a patient didn’t buy medicine, the issued prescription was not being logged to the system or government records.

Solution: Every prescription is now stored in the central database and reported to the government, regardless of medicine purchase.

✅ Learnings: These challenges taught us the importance of making the system resilient, user-friendly, and reliable for rural healthcare.

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Mental health diagnosis today relies heavily on self-reporting and therapist/Doctors observation, which are often subjective, incomplete, and prone to bias. Patients may hide or underreport emotions due to stigma, memory gaps, or discomfort. Therapists lack objective, real-time physiological data that could reveal how a patient’s body reacts when discussing trauma or stress.

Existing solutions like smartwatches provide raw vitals but are not designed for therapy contexts, leaving a critical gap in tools that can help mental health professionals make accurate, data-driven diagnoses and personalized treatment plans.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Sensor Accuracy & Calibration**

- Raw signals from HR, SpO₂, and GSR sensors were noisy.
- Required filtering techniques (e.g., moving average, smoothing) to get stable readings.

**2. Hardware Integration Issue**

- Multiple biosensors on Arduino caused signal interference and power limitations.
- Needed proper wiring management and stable power supply.

**3. Real-Time Data Transmission**

- Continuous data transfer created latency and packet loss.
- Optimized by reducing data frequency and using lightweight communication methods.

**4. Dashboard Development**

- Designing a therapist-friendly UI was difficult.
- 
- Had to balance detailed graphs with simple, quick-to-read 

visuals.

**5. Data Privacy Concerns
**
Patient health data is sensitive and required secure handling.

Implemented basic encryption and authentication in prototype.

**$300(Open): Cash Prize**

Our project, NeuroWell, is a complete health monitoring system built for the healthcare track. We have developed both the hardware and a professional website to provide a seamless solution. The hardware component accurately collects essential health data such as. This information is then transmitted to our custom-built website, which serves as a central dashboard. The website visualizes the data in real-time and includes features like [automated alerts, historical data tracking, or a user-friendly interface]. This combined hardware and software system allows for proactive health management, enabling both patients and healthcare providers to monitor vital signs effectively and improve patient outcomes.So this makes our Project Fit for this Track.

Lack of Personalized Health Insights: Generic health apps don't understand individual patterns. Our AI learns from user data to provide personalized predictions and recommendations based on unique health patterns.

Unreliable Health Information: Women get conflicting advice from random internet sources. HerHealthChain provides medically-accurate information through AI chatbots and verified expert content.

1. AI-Powered Symptom Tracker
Innovation: Instead of basic logging, the AI learns individual patterns and predicts cycles. For example, it identifies if irregular periods correlate with stress levels or diet changes. The system becomes more accurate over time by analyzing thousands of data points from the user's history.

Sensitivity Handling: All data is anonymized and encrypted. The AI doesn't store personal identifiers, only pattern data, ensuring privacy while providing personalized insights.

Innovation: The AI analyzes combinations of symptoms (mood, pain levels, cycle irregularities) to identify potential health concerns. It can detect patterns like PCOS, endometriosis indicators, or hormonal imbalances that users might miss.

Innovation: Creates a judgment-free space where women can ask sensitive questions about periods, sexual health, fertility, or mental health without embarrassment. The chatbot provides medically-accurate information while maintaining conversational warmth.

Privacy-First Design: Conversations aren't stored with user profiles. The chatbot can discuss taboo topics that women might be uncomfortable asking real people about, breaking down barriers to health education.

This combination makes discussing sensitive women's health topics feel safe, private, and scientifically-backed while maintaining the human touch through community features.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/agri-snap-9a66) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Hriday-31/Agri-snap) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-UDAYA%201.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://udaya-1-0.devfolio.co)

> Your farm's health in a heartbeat

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

AgriSnap solves the critical problem of delayed or inaccessible agricultural expertise for smallholder farmers. When farmers discover a potential disease on their crops, they often have no immediate way to identify it, leading to incorrect treatment, widespread crop loss, and significant financial hardship. This information gap is a major contributor to the estimated 40% of crop yield lost globally each year.

How People Can Use It
AgriSnap acts as an AI-powered agronomist that fits in a farmer's pocket, making their work easier, faster, and more effective.

1. Instant Disease Diagnosis
A farmer can simply take a photo of a suspicious leaf on their plant. Instead of guessing or waiting days to find an expert, the app uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to analyze the image and provide an accurate diagnosis within seconds. This transforms a moment of uncertainty into a moment of clarity.

2. Actionable Treatment Advice
The app doesn't just identify the problem; it provides a solution. Farmers receive clear, step-by-step advice on how to treat the specific disease, including recommendations for organic sprays or commercial pesticides, along with correct dosages. This prevents the overuse of incorrect chemicals, making farming safer and more sustainable.

3. On-Demand Expert Support
Our integrated Rasa chatbot acts as an on-demand assistant. Farmers can ask follow-up questions in their own language, get connected to nearby suppliers for recommended products, or receive information on relevant government support schemes. It replaces the difficult task of finding information with a simple conversation.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles we ran into was the high latency of the disease prediction API. When we first integrated the system, the time between a user snapping a photo and receiving a diagnosis was over 10 seconds, which is far too long for a smooth mobile experience, especially on a slow network.

The Problem
The slowness came from two main bottlenecks:

Large Image Uploads: The React Native app was sending the raw, high-resolution image file directly from the phone's camera. Uploading these large files (often 3-5 MB) over a mobile network was a major source of delay.

Model Loading Time: Our initial implementation in Django loaded the entire TensorFlow CNN model from the disk for every single API request. This model-loading step alone was taking several seconds, creating a severe bottleneck on the server side.

How We Solved It
We tackled this with a two-part optimization strategy:

1. Client-Side Image Compression
First, we implemented an image processing library (expo-image-manipulator) in the React Native app. Before uploading, the app now resizes the image to a more manageable resolution (like 800x800 pixels) and compresses it to a high-quality JPEG. This drastically reduced the file size to under 200 KB without a significant loss in quality for the model's prediction, cutting down the upload time by over 90%.

2. Pre-loading the AI Model
Second, we refactored our Django backend. Instead of loading the model on each request, we now load our trained TensorFlow (.h5) model into memory once when the Django server first starts up. We configured it as a global singleton object. This way, every subsequent API call to the prediction endpoint could access the already-loaded model instantly, completely eliminating the model-loading delay from the response time.

By combining these client-side and server-side optimizations, we successfully reduced the total prediction time from over 10 seconds to an average of just 2-3 seconds, creating a responsive and practical application for our users.

**AI in Agriculture**

Computer Vision for Precision Agriculture
The core of your project is using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a type of computer vision model, to analyze images of plant leaves. This is a direct application of AI to solve a real-world agricultural problem.

Automated Diagnosis: Instead of relying on the naked eye or waiting for a human expert, your AI model automates the complex task of identifying specific diseases from visual data.

Precision and Speed: This technology allows for precision agriculture. Rather than guessing or applying broad-spectrum pesticides to an entire field, a farmer can get an instant, accurate diagnosis for a specific plant. This enables targeted treatment, which saves money, reduces chemical usage, and is better for the environment. Your project uses AI to bring expert-level precision to the individual farmer.

Natural Language Processing (NLP) for Farmer Support
Your use of a Rasa chatbot brings another powerful aspect of AI to the farm: conversational support.

Accessible Information: Many farmers face barriers due to technical jargon or literacy levels. Your chatbot uses NLP to understand questions asked in simple, natural language and provides clear, easy-to-understand answers.

On-Demand Knowledge: The chatbot acts as an on-demand agricultural expert. It makes vast amounts of information—like treatment options, market prices, or government schemes—instantly accessible through a simple conversation. This democratizes knowledge that was previously hard to find.

**The problem it solves**

🧩 The Problem It Solves

Students and professionals today face:

* High stress from **deadlines, exams, and workload**.
* Difficulty maintaining **consistent focus and healthy habits**.
* Too many scattered apps for journaling, mood tracking, coaching, and timers.
* Lack of **personalized, real-time guidance** tailored to their current state.

**Mindful Mentor** solves this by offering an **all-in-one wellness assistant** that:

* Provides **real-time AI coaching** for stress, focus, and exam nerves.
* Simplifies journaling with **voice notes and AI summaries**.
* Helps users stay accountable through **mood & health logging**.
* Breaks big goals into **manageable 7-day micro-plans**.
* Combines **wellness timers, TTS, and engaging UI** into a single, student-friendly platform.

✨ Instead of juggling multiple apps, users have a **central hub for wellness and productivity**—making tasks easier, safer for mental health, and more enjoyable.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building **Mindful Mentor**, I faced several hurdles:

Streamlit Session Management

   * Challenge: Keeping user mood logs, goals, and AI conversations consistent across different pages.
   * Solution: Used `st.session_state` effectively to store and update user data during the sessionAI Response Formatting**

   * Challenge: Raw AI outputs were sometimes too long or unstructured.
   * Solution: Added **prompt engineering** and text-cleaning functions to make responses more concise and user-friendly.
Dependency & Environment Issues**

   * Challenge: Errors while running Streamlit in virtual environments (permissions and installation problems).
   * Solution: Fixed by carefully managing a **virtual environment**, adjusting **PowerShell execution policy**, and creating a `requirements.txt` for smoother installs.

 **UI/UX Engagement**

   * Challenge: A plain UI felt less engaging for students.
   * Solution: Integrated **Lottie animations, glass-effect cards, and dark mode** to make the interface calming and interactive.

 **Real-Time AI Integration**

   * Challenge: Ensuring AI responses were fast enough for live coaching.
   * Solution: Chose **Groq Llama-3 model** for its **ultra-low latency inference**, which greatly improved the user experience.

---

✨ These challenges helped me learn more about **session management, AI integration, UI design, and debugging Python environments**.

**AI in HealthCare**

## 🏆 Tracks Applied

Our project **Mindful Mentor** fits into multiple tracks:

* **Artificial Intelligence (AI/ML):**
  Uses Groq’s Llama-3 model for real-time AI coaching, insights, and summarization.

* **Health & Wellness:**
  Helps students and professionals manage stress, improve focus, and build healthier routines.

* **Productivity & Lifestyle:**
  Includes tools like breathing timers, goal tracking, and mood logging to improve daily efficiency.

* **Education & Student Support:**
  Provides study-focused AI modes (Exam Nerves, Focus Reset) to guide learners during high-stress periods.

### Wellio - Telemedicine APP
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/wellio-telemedicine-app-6b6b) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Abhiram2004-glitch/wellio-app) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-UDAYA%201.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://udaya-1-0.devfolio.co)

> Low latency and 2g network AI optimized APP

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![react-native](https://img.shields.io/badge/react--native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ollama](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ollama-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This telemedicine app is designed to provide accessible healthcare services, especially for people in rural areas. It enables low-latency video consultations even on 2G networks using WebRTC, ensuring that patients can connect with doctors without worrying about poor internet connectivity. In addition to video calls, the app supports real-time chatting, allowing users to communicate efficiently with healthcare providers.

Users can book appointments anytime, making healthcare more flexible and convenient. The app also includes an offline chatbot that can answer common health-related queries, providing instant guidance when a doctor is not immediately available. Overall, it simplifies access to medical consultation, reduces travel for patients in remote areas, and ensures timely healthcare support.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main hurdles I faced while building this project was achieving low-latency video streaming over 2G networks. WebRTC is optimized for high-speed networks, and on low bandwidth, the video would often lag, freeze, or drop entirely.

How I overcame it:

Implemented adaptive bitrate streaming to automatically lower video resolution and frame rate based on network conditions.

Used H.264 encoding instead of VP8 for better compression efficiency.

Integrated a TURN server to improve connectivity in networks with strict NAT/firewall configurations.

For messaging, ensured offline chat functionality so users could still interact even when the network was unstable.

Another challenge was Firestore querying and indexing errors, which would prevent fetching appointments properly. I solved it by creating the required Firestore indexes as suggested by the Firebase console.

Finally, deploying the server itself had its hurdles, especially configuring WebRTC and socket connections on a live server. I resolved this by carefully setting up the STUN/TURN servers and testing multiple deployment configurations to ensure stable connectivity.

These solutions significantly improved performance, reliability, and accessibility, even in rural areas with low internet speeds.

**AI in HealthCare**

It has offline chatbot system and low latency or 2g network video consultation with the doctor

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Core ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/Core%20ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem It Solves

India's healthcare system is *fractured and overburdened*, leading to:

* *Physician burnout* – Doctors spend 1–2 hours daily on documentation, often more than on direct patient care.
* *Rural-urban divide* – Most rural clinics lack computers, internet, and specialist doctors.
* *Data inefficiency & privacy risks* – 80% of EHR data is unstructured, 60% still rely on paper, and cyberattacks are rising.

These challenges cause delays, errors in diagnosis, poor trust in digital tools, and unequal access to care.

## How People Can Use It

The *Intelligent Clinical Operating System* makes existing tasks *easier, safer, and more efficient* by:

### Saving Doctors' Time
* Auto-generates patient summaries in <60 seconds.
* Cuts documentation time by ~90%, saving 5–10 hours per week.
* Lets doctors spend more time with patients instead of paperwork.

### Enhancing Accuracy & Safety
* Reduces diagnostic errors from ~25% to <5% with AI-powered data highlighting.
* Digitizes lab reports in <10 seconds with >99% accuracy.
* Provides explainable AI outputs, building trust and reducing "black-box" risks.

### Bridging the Rural Gap
* Runs on low-cost mini-PCs/tablets (~₹40,000 vs ₹5 Lakh+ servers).
* Works *100% offline* for core tasks, crucial in areas with poor internet.
* Brings AI-CDSS (Clinical Decision Support Systems) to 70–80% of PHCs that currently have 0% coverage.

### Automating Workflows
* <2-minute patient registration with >99% accuracy using ABHA.
* Appointment booking via IVR/SMS, cutting no-shows to <10%.
* Conversational diagnostic chatbot answers clinical queries in <30 seconds.

*In short: This solution **reduces burnout, improves safety, and makes quality care accessible even in low-resource settings*—a foundation for a more equitable healthcare system in India.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

## 1. Aligning Medical Context with AI Responses

At first, the model gave generic answers that didn't always fit medical scenarios. It sounded correct but lacked the *domain-specific precision* doctors expect.

* *How I solved it:* I integrated medical guidelines into the retrieval pipeline and fine-tuned prompts so every response was *grounded in verified medical context*.

## 2. Explainability vs. Speed

Initially, adding explainability layers slowed down response time, which defeated the purpose of "fast insights."

* *How I solved it:* I introduced lightweight explainability (like SHAP-style highlights + summarized reasoning) instead of full-length model tracing, balancing speed with clarity.

## 3. Offline Functionality

Many clinics had limited or no server infrastructure, so cloud-only deployment wasn't feasible.

* *How I solved it:* I created a *hybrid setup*—core inference runs locally with a lightweight model, while heavier tasks sync when internet is available.

## 4. Integration Bugs

During testing, the system sometimes mismatched patient queries with irrelevant guideline snippets.

* *How I solved it:* I tuned the retrieval pipeline with better ranking metrics and applied feedback loops to continuously refine query results.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCV-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLAlchemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLAlchemy-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problem BreatheSmart aims to solve is the invisibility and unpredictability of air pollution in cities. Existing air quality index (AQI) applications only provide average data, which lacks the personalized and hyperlocal insights people need. This leaves citizens with no motivation to report pollution sources, and governments without timely, specific data for taking action.

BreatheSmart offers a solution by connecting citizens, AI, and government authorities to promote awareness, participation, and proactive health measures.

How People Can Use It
For Citizens:

Report Pollution : Users can upload photos of pollution sources like vehicle smoke, garbage burning, or dust to the Citizen Portal.


Earn Rewards: By submitting verified uploads, citizens can earn "Green Credits" that can be redeemed for rewards. This gamification, which includes a leaderboard, motivates participation.





Stay Informed: Users can view hyperlocal AQI forecasts for their specific street or area.


Receive Health Alerts: The system provides personalized health alerts based on a user's location and the current AQI.

Government Portal Features

Real-time Data and Interventions: The government dashboard displays a real-time AQI map and a heatmap of pollution sources. This allows officials to see reported pollution hotspots and dispatch teams for targeted interventions. For example, they could send a sanitation crew to a reported garbage burning site or alert traffic police about excessive vehicle smoke.


Citizen Feedback Loop: To encourage continued participation, the government can use the dashboard to validate citizen reports and send a notification to the user confirming that action is being taken. Officials can then upload a "proof of action" photo, which would be visible on the citizen's portal, to show that their report led to a tangible result. This transparency helps build trust and motivates the community.

Data-Driven Decisions: By analyzing the data from citizen reports, the government can develop long-term strategies to prevent future pollution. This could include targeted awareness campaigns or infrastructure improvements in areas frequently identified as high-risk.


Rewarding Participation: The government can track citizen engagement and the leaderboard to identify top contributors. This allows them to 

allot rewards to these participants, further reinforcing the gamification and incentivizing public participation.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Imageverification was the major hurdle due to lack of proper dataset- we     overcame this with directly using CLIP model and opencv to verify 
2. integrating DB problems- used json and SQLAlchemy 
3. integrating heatmaps - took gps locations from users and connected to IQAPI to get the user locationspecific aqi data and created heatmap
4. gamification was also a major problem we used leaderboard and robust logic to solve the problem 
5. connecting frontend and backend - we used flask cors to solve this

### ArogyaAI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/arogyaai-60be) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Mohd2Shaan/AarogyaAI.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/LhNQ5R2hHZA?si=mxRFMqqghlWy0O3P) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Aarogya AI- Healthcare Driven Intelligence!

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Healthcare today is still mostly reactive. Patients forget to take their medicines on time, skip meals, or ignore diet and care instructions given by doctors. Many people do not track their daily health activities, and when they finally visit the doctor, important details are missing. On the other side, doctors face a big challenge — they cannot monitor every patient’s health daily, and medical records are often scattered or incomplete. Because of this, treatments get delayed, mistakes happen, and health risks increase, especially for patients in rural or underserved areas who already struggle to access timely care.

ArogyaAI is built to solve this gap and make healthcare proactive instead of reactive. Our AI works like a continuous health companion. It automatically checks the daily activities of patients such as medicine intake, diet, sleep patterns, and exercise. Based on these activities, the AI gives reminders, useful advice, and even early warnings when it notices something unusual. For example, if a patient misses medicines or shows irregular habits, the AI can guide them immediately before it turns into a bigger health issue.

For patients, ArogyaAI provides one place for everything: online doctor appointments, a complete health profile with past and present medical reports, daily guidance from the AI, and easy-to-understand analytics about their health progress. This makes their life easier and safer because they don’t need to remember everything themselves — the AI does it for them.

For doctors, ArogyaAI creates a 360° view of every patient. They can see organized reports, AI-generated insights, and trend analytics that help them understand the patient’s condition faster. Doctors can also connect with other doctors for advice and collaboration, while the AI continuously supports them by flagging risks, reducing errors, and saving time.

This makes healthcare smarter, safer, and more accessible for everyone.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Data Management & Integration

Hurdle: Patient data comes in many forms — lab reports, prescriptions, scans — and it was difficult to organize everything into one system.

Solution: We built a structured digital health record format and pipelines to store, retrieve, and share all reports in a unified way.

2. AI Accuracy & Balance

Hurdle: The biggest challenge was making sure our AI didn’t behave like a “black box” that blindly gives alerts. Patients could get anxious with false alarms, and doctors needed accurate, trustworthy insights.

Solution: We trained the AI to not only detect patterns but also to give context-based guidance. We also designed a doctor-validation loop — AI highlights issues, but doctors confirm critical decisions. This made the system reliable and safe.

3. User Experience for Two Different Groups

Hurdle: Patients need something very simple, while doctors need deep analytics and details. Balancing both in one app was tough.

Solution: We designed separate dashboards — a clean, simple one for patients with reminders and guidance, and a detailed one for doctors with analytics, reports, and collaboration tools.

4. Connectivity in Rural Areas

Hurdle: Many patients in rural areas face poor internet connectivity, making real-time features harder to use.

Solution: We optimized the app for low bandwidth, added offline data entry, and made it sync automatically once internet is available.

👉Every challenge we faced made ArogyaAI stronger. Especially with AI, we learned that the real power is not just in automation, but in combining AI + human expertise to create trust and reliability.

**The problem it solves**

VitalVoice addresses the common challenge of accessing immediate, reliable healthcare guidance without waiting or confusion. People can use it to:

Get instant symptom assessment and understand the seriousness of their condition

Receive clear, empathetic health information and explanations in everyday language

Navigate the healthcare system with care coordination and preparation guidance

Obtain emergency escalation recommendations for urgent symptoms

Engage in voice-driven health conversations anywhere, anytime, without privacy concerns

This AI assistant makes existing healthcare tasks easier, faster, and safer by providing accessible, 24/7 health support through natural voice interaction, reducing anxiety and unnecessary hospital visits.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, integrating seamless real-time voice input/output with the conversational AI posed a challenge due to latency and UX complexities. Initially, the ElevenLabs widget looked generic and didn’t align well with the MVP design vision, so I built a custom chat UI integrated via ElevenLabs APIs to better control user experience.

Another hurdle was crafting precise prompt flows for symptom triage that balanced medical safety and helpful guidance without diagnosing. This required iterative testing and refining the agent prompts and emergency keyword handling.

Finally, maintaining user privacy while offering effective care coordination meant designing the conversation as stateless and carefully handling sensitive prompts—achieved by making every user session independent without data storage

### CareNest
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/carenest-619f) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://home-hospital-hero.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-mosAIc:%20AI%20in%20action%20with%20The%20Product%20Folks-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mosaicbytpf.devfolio.co)

> Transform Your Home Into a Complete Hospital

![lovable](https://img.shields.io/badge/lovable-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. The Problem of Emotional and Social Disconnection 🫂
The most significant problem addressed is the profound emotional and social disconnection that results from prolonged hospitalization. The solution aims to remove the feeling of a patient being "lost" to their family and friends for years due to their illness. By bringing the hospital setup home, it allows the patient to stay within their familiar environment, surrounded by loved ones. This combats the loneliness, isolation, and psychological distress often associated with long-term hospital stays. It helps maintain family bonds and allows patients to experience a sense of normalcy despite their medical condition.

2. The Problem of High Costs 💰
The solution tackles the issue of exorbitant healthcare costs for long-term care. Hospitals charge premium rates for beds, specialized equipment, and round-the-clock care. By offering a rental-based service for different medical equipment, the proposed model provides a more affordable alternative. Families can tailor their rental package to their specific needs, avoiding the high, fixed costs of an in-patient hospital room. This makes long-term, high-quality care more financially accessible.

3. The Problem of Patient and Family Convenience 🏡
This service solves the problem of inconvenience and burden for both the patient and their family. Patients with chronic illnesses often struggle with the rigid schedules, sterile environment, and lack of personal space in a hospital. For families, frequent hospital visits are time-consuming and emotionally draining. The proposed solution eliminates these logistical challenges. It provides a comfortable, personalized space for the patient and allows family members to be present and involved in their care without the constraints of hospital visiting hours. The inclusion of interior designers to create a less clinical atmosphere further enhances the patient's comfort and well-being.

> Track your emotions, nurture your mind.

![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hough Transform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hough%20Transform-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MindCare is a personal mental health companion that makes journaling easier, smarter, and safer. Instead of just writing down thoughts, users can track emotions automatically through AI-powered sentiment analysis, spot mood patterns with clear visual insights, and access reliable mental health resources in one place. It reduces the effort of manual reflection, helps identify early warning signs of stress or anxiety, and provides a secure, non-judgmental space for self-care.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into:

Integrating AI Models: Setting up Hugging Face’s DistilRoBERTa for emotion detection and making sure it worked smoothly with Streamlit required extra effort, especially around handling model size and response speed.

Database Management: Ensuring journal entries, user data, and emotion logs were stored securely while keeping the app lightweight was tricky.

User Authentication: Implementing a safe login/registration flow in Streamlit (which isn’t built-in) took additional work.

Emotion Accuracy: Sometimes the AI misinterpreted context or sarcasm, which made me explore ways to improve reliability.

UI/UX in Streamlit: Streamlit is great for quick prototypes, but customizing the interface to feel less like a data app and more like a user-friendly journal was challenging.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Smart Health Companion solves several key problems in personal health management by providing a comprehensive, all-in-one solution.

Accessibility and Reliability
It addresses the issue of immediate access to reliable health information. Instead of relying on a confusing and often overwhelming internet search, users can get instant, trustworthy advice for a wide range of common symptoms and health concerns.

Emergency Preparedness
In emergencies, panic and lack of knowledge can be dangerous. The chatbot's First Aid Coach feature provides clear, step-by-step instructions, empowering users to act confidently and effectively during critical moments.

Medication Adherence
Many people struggle to remember their medication schedules or understand why they are taking certain drugs. The app's reminders and advice help ensure users stick to their treatment plans, improving health outcomes and reducing the risk of missed doses.

Personalized Wellness
Generic health advice doesn't work for everyone. By generating a personalized 3-day action plan, the chatbot uses a user's specific health inputs to create a custom wellness strategy, helping them achieve their goals more effectively than a one-size-fits-all approach.

Integrated Women's Health
Women's health needs are often siloed. The integrated period tracker provides a seamless way for users to monitor their menstrual cycle alongside their general health, offering a more complete picture of their well-being

**Challenges we ran into**

Creating an AI-powered health companion is a complex undertaking, and you're right to anticipate significant challenges. The problems you'd likely run into can be grouped into a few key areas:

1. Data and Medical Accuracy
Garbage In, Garbage Out: The AI's effectiveness is entirely dependent on the quality of its training data. Sourcing a vast, diverse, and medically accurate dataset is incredibly difficult. Medical data is often messy, unstructured, and filled with nuances.

Avoiding Misinformation and "Hallucinations": An AI chatbot, especially one built on a large language model, can sometimes generate plausible-sounding but incorrect or even dangerous advice. This is a critical risk in a medical context, where a mistake could have serious consequences.

Handling Ambiguity: Symptoms are rarely clear-cut. A user's description can be vague, emotional, or incomplete. The AI must be able to ask clarifying questions and understand the difference between a minor concern and a potential emergency, all without being a human doctor.

Keeping Up with Medical Science: Medical knowledge is constantly evolving. The chatbot's information base needs to be regularly updated to reflect new research, treatment protocols, and drug information.

2. Technical and Integration Hurdles
Dialogue Management: Maintaining context in a conversation is a huge challenge. The chatbot needs to remember a user's previous inputs (e.g., "I mentioned I have a headache and a fever,") and build upon that information, even if the user jumps between topics (e.g., "Can you also check my period dates?").

Personalization Complexity: The personalized 3-day action plans require a sophisticated system that can synthesize inputs from the symptom checker, medication reminders, and period tracker. Building an algorithm that can create genuinely useful and safe recommendations from this mix of data is a major technical feat.

Backend Integration: For a seamless user experience, the app needs to be able to talk to different components (e.g., the symptom database, the period tracker's data storage). This requires robust and secure backend systems.

3. Safety, Ethics, and Regulation
Liability: Who is responsible if the chatbot gives advice that leads to a negative health outcome? This is a huge legal and ethical gray area. It's why most health chatbots include a prominent disclaimer that they are not a substitute for a medical professional.

Data Privacy and Security: The chatbot will handle highly sensitive personal health information (PHI). This makes data privacy and security paramount. You would have to comply with strict regulations like HIPAA in the U.S. and GDPR in Europe, which requires robust encryption, access controls, and a clear data retention policy.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MedicorumAI is designed to streamline and enhance medical imaging workflows for healthcare professionals, researchers, and telemedicine providers. Here’s how people can use it and how it makes existing tasks easier and safer:

- **Automated Medical Image Analysis:** Users can upload CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound images for AI-powered analysis, helping to quickly identify anomalies and generate diagnostic reports.
- **Faster Diagnosis:** The platform accelerates the diagnostic process by providing instant, AI-generated insights, reducing the time clinicians spend on manual image review.
- **Improved Accuracy:** By leveraging advanced models, MedicorumAI helps reduce human error and supports more accurate, consistent interpretations of medical images.
- **Telemedicine Integration:** The system can be integrated into telemedicine platforms, enabling remote consultations and second opinions with AI-assisted diagnostics.
- **Sample Reports & Visualization:** Users can access sample reports and visualizations, making it easier to understand findings and communicate results to patients or colleagues.
- **Data Security:** The platform is designed with data privacy in mind, ensuring that sensitive medical information is handled securely.

Overall, MedicorumAI makes medical imaging tasks faster, more reliable, and accessible, supporting better patient outcomes and more efficient healthcare delivery.

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges Faced During Development

One significant hurdle we encountered was managing the compatibility between different machine learning model formats and the Python libraries required to load them. Some models were trained using newer versions of libraries like TensorFlow and PyTorch, which were not always backward compatible with the server environment.

**How We Overcame It:**
- We created isolated Python virtual environments for each model type, ensuring that the correct library versions were installed for each use case.
- Docker containers were used to encapsulate dependencies and provide a consistent runtime environment across development and production.
- Comprehensive testing scripts were added to catch version mismatches early in the deployment process.

This approach minimized runtime errors and made the system more robust and maintainable.

**The problem it solves**

Healthcare today faces multiple challenges:

Accessibility Issues – Patients struggle to find the right doctors, labs, or hospitals quickly.

Fragmented Services – Health records, prescriptions, lab reports, and appointments are often scattered across different platforms or offline.

Delays in Care – Manual booking, long queues, and lack of real-time updates delay treatment.

Limited Personalization – Patients don’t always get proactive recommendations or tailored health insights.

Communication Gaps – Coordination between patients, doctors, and diagnostic centers is often inefficient.

How Medix Solves This--

Provides a one-stop digital platform for appointments, lab tests, reports, and health tracking.

Offers real-time doctor availability & booking to save waiting time.

Ensures easy access to digital health records anytime, anywhere.

Uses AI-powered health insights for better diagnosis and preventive care.

Bridges the communication gap between patients, doctors, and pathlabs through a unified system.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges Faced in Developing Medix

Integrating Multiple Roles – Managing separate features and flows for Patients, Doctors, and Pathlabs while keeping the UI/UX consistent.

Data Management – Storing and retrieving large volumes of medical data (appointments, prescriptions, reports) securely and efficiently.

Security & Privacy – Ensuring sensitive health data is encrypted and follows compliance standards (HIPAA-like practices).

Real-Time Updates – Implementing appointment slots, cancellations, and notifications that sync instantly without conflicts.

Scalability – Designing the backend so it can handle growing numbers of users, doctors, and reports without performance issues.

AI/ML Integration – Training and integrating disease prediction or recommendation models with limited, clean medical datasets.

Deployment Issues – Handling server errors, environment mismatches (like Node.js + Python services), and Render/Vercel deployment limitations.

User Experience Balance – Making the app intuitive for patients while still offering advanced features for doctors and pathlabs.

Third-Party API Dependencies – Reliance on APIs (e.g., for maps, payments, or email/notifications) sometimes caused downtime or errors.

Testing Across Roles – Ensuring all three roles (Patient, Doctor, Pathlab) work seamlessly together without breaking each other’s workflows.

**The problem it solves**

🧩 The Problem It Solves

Staying consistent with fitness and nutrition is hard. Most people struggle with:

❌ Generic workout plans that don’t account for fitness level, injuries, or personal goals.
❌ One-size-fits-all diet charts that ignore allergies, preferences, or nutritional needs.
❌ Lack of guidance—beginners don’t know where to start, and experienced users plateau.
❌ Low motivation—manual tracking and boring routines reduce consistency.

❌ Fragmented tools—fitness apps for workouts, others for diet, and none that adapt in real time.

**Challenges we ran into**

🛠️ Challenges I Ran Into

Building Datadynamos wasn’t without hurdles. Some key challenges included:

🔑 Environment Variable Setup
Issue: Managing multiple API keys for Clerk, Vapi, Convex, and Gemini AI was tricky.
Fix: Created a well-structured .env file and used NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixes only where client access was required.

🎙 Integrating Voice AI (Vapi)
Issue: The voice assistant initially failed to sync with the LLM responses, leading to broken conversations.
Fix: Adjusted the workflow IDs and API key handling, then tested with sample prompts until responses streamed correctly.

🔒 Authentication with Clerk
Issue: Redirect URLs didn’t match in local vs. production builds.
Fix: Configured both http://localhost:3000 and the Vercel domain in Clerk’s dashboard to handle sign-in/sign-up correctly.

⚡ Real-time Database (Convex)
Issue: Handling dynamic program generation with real-time updates sometimes caused state mismatches.
Fix: Implemented client & server components carefully and leveraged Convex’s live query system to stay in sync.

🎨 UI Consistency
Issue: Mixing Shadcn UI components with custom Tailwind styles led to inconsistent layouts.
Fix: Standardized design tokens and applied a consistent theme configuration.

### GazeBoard
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/gazeboard-294e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Im-BlackDevil/gazeboard/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackOdisha%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackodisha-4.devfolio.co)

> Eye-controller for the paralyzed patients

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Millions of people worldwide suffer from conditions like paralysis, ALS, spinal cord injuries, or are in a coma-like state, which make them unable to communicate verbally or physically. Traditional assistive devices are either too expensive or require physical movements that these patients cannot perform.

GazeBoard solves this problem by providing an eye-controlled communication board that allows patients to express their needs, emotions, and basic commands using just their eyes. It eliminates the dependency on costly hardware and instead uses a normal webcam and AI-powered gaze tracking.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I ran into

Eye-tracking accuracy
At first, the eye-tracking model (WebGazer.js / MediaPipe) was not detecting gaze points accurately, leading to wrong selections on the board. We solved this by adding a calibration step and applying smoothing filters to stabilize the pointer.

Latency & performance issues
Running real-time gaze detection in the browser was causing lag, especially on lower-end devices. To fix this, we optimized the code by reducing frame processing frequency and handling only essential calculations per frame.

Integration with communication board
Mapping gaze to UI elements (buttons/phrases) was tricky, as small screen movements caused false selections. We introduced a dwell-time selection mechanism (looking at a button for ~2 seconds to confirm).

Cross-browser compatibility
Some browsers had issues accessing webcam or rendering the speech API. We overcame this by testing on multiple browsers and using fallbacks where possible.

User experience design
Since the tool is built for patients with severe impairments, we had to keep the interface minimal, distraction-free, and easy to calibrate. We refined the design after testing with multiple layouts.

**The problem it solves**

## Healthcare Monitoring for Isolated Individuals

Many people, particularly elderly individuals or those living alone, lack consistent caretakers or medical supervision. This leaves them vulnerable to undetected health deterioration, emergency situations without immediate help, and delayed medical intervention.

## What People Can Use This For

- **Voice-based health monitoring** through natural conversations with AI
- **Automated health reporting** to track wellness patterns over time
- **Early warning system** for potential health risks and emergencies
- **Medication adherence tracking** and health questionnaire responses
- **Organ donation portal** where donors can register and receivers can find suitable matches

## How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

- **Eliminates complex health tracking** - just natural conversation
- **Provides 24/7 monitoring** without human scheduling constraints
- **Transforms reactive to proactive healthcare** through continuous assessment
- **Accelerates organ transplant matching** through efficient donor-receiver connections
- **Generates comprehensive reports** for healthcare providers and family members

This solution transforms healthcare from reactive to proactive while fostering life-saving organ donations through intelligent voice interactions and automated health analysis.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of this system, several significant challenges were encountered and overcome:

### Speech-to-Text & Text-to-Speech Integration
- **Challenge**: Implementing reliable STT and TTS functionality using Deepgram API
- **Issues**: Managing real-time audio processing, handling audio quality variations, and ensuring accurate speech recognition for medical terminology
- **Solution**: Fine-tuned Deepgram API parameters and implemented error handling for audio processing edge cases

### Client-Server Communication
- **Challenge**: Establishing stable real-time communication between client and server
- **Issues**: Initial connection drops, latency issues, and data synchronization problems
- **Solution**: Implemented WebSocket connections to enable real-time bidirectional communication and instant updates

### Avatar Creation & Animation
- **Challenge**: Developing an interactive AI avatar for natural user engagement
- **Issues**: Creating a voice assistant avatar (similar to Siri's interface) that responds visually to speech patterns and user interactions
- **Solution**: Designed a responsive animated avatar with visual feedback indicators and smooth transitions that enhance the conversational experience

### Health Report Generation
- **Challenge**: Converting conversational chat data into meaningful medical reports
- **Issues**: Extracting relevant health information from unstructured conversation data and formatting it for medical professionals
- **Solution**: Developed data parsing algorithms and report templates to structure health insights effectively

### Organ Donation Matching Algorithm
- **Challenge**: Creating an efficient donor-recipient matching system
- **Issues**: Implementing complex matching criteria (blood type, location, organ compatibility) and ensuring quick search results
- **Solution**: Designed optimized matching algorithm considering multiple compatibility factors and geographic proximity

**Vultr Cloud Deployment Track**

This healthcare AI solution leverages Vultr's cloud infrastructure for:

- **Real-time processing** of voice interactions and medical data
- **Scalable deployment** to serve multiple users simultaneously
- **Reliable hosting** for critical healthcare monitoring services
- **Global accessibility** through Vultr's distributed network infrastructure

Demonstrates effective cloud deployment for healthcare applications.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

Utilized Google's Gemini API for intelligent conversational responses, enabling natural healthcare dialogues and accurate medical query processing for comprehensive patient interactions.

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

Leveraged MongoDB Atlas cloud database for secure storage and retrieval of patient health data, conversation histories, and organ donation records with scalable NoSQL architecture and used MongoDB ORM for connection to the database.

- **Life-saving organ matching** accelerating transplant processes

Bridges technology and medicine for proactive, accessible healthcare delivery.

### MEDISCAN
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mediscan-e2cb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Srinjoy2004/Status-Code-MedLens) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/UUOf6Q6AyEA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co)

> Prescription to Doorstep: Smart, Fast, Healthy

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Manual Entry of Prescription Details

Traditionally, patients or pharmacists have to manually read and enter prescription details into systems.

This process is prone to human error, such as misreading drug names, incorrect dosages, or wrong scheduling.

Errors in transcription can lead to delayed treatment or even harmful consequences for patients.

2. Lack of Transparency in Medicine Availability

Patients often do not know whether the prescribed medicines are available nearby.

They may have to visit multiple pharmacies or wait long periods without clarity.

This creates frustration and delays in starting or continuing treatment.

3. Inefficient Medicine Purchase & Delivery

Without an integrated system, patients need to:

Carry the physical prescription to a pharmacy.

Check stock manually.

Wait for availability updates or delivery timelines.

This leads to time wasted, especially for elderly patients or those with chronic illnesses.

How the Solution Helps
1. Automated Prescription Reading (OCR Integration)

By using OCR, the system can instantly scan and digitize prescriptions.

No manual entry is required, reducing the risk of errors.

Patients and platforms can quickly extract:

Drug names

Dosage instructions

Frequency and duration

2. Real-Time Stock and Availability Checking

The platform connects to the e-commerce system of pharmacies.

Patients can see which medicines are available immediately and where.

The system also suggests alternatives if prescribed drugs are out of stock.

3. Intelligent Delivery & Scheduling

Based on availability, the platform informs patients:

When they will get their medicines.

How the delivery will be scheduled.

This ensures timely access to treatment, avoiding treatment gaps.

Benefits for Users

Accuracy: Eliminates human errors in reading prescriptions.

Convenience: No need to visit multiple pharmacies.

Speed: Faster ordering and delivery process.

Safety: Ensures correct medicine, dosage, and timely intake.

Accessibility: Especially useful for elderly patients, remote areas, or those managing multiple medications.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. OCR Accuracy with Handwritten Prescriptions

Problem: Medical prescriptions are often handwritten, with messy or unclear writing styles. Standard OCR models struggled to recognize drug names and dosages accurately.

Solution:

We fine-tuned OCR models with a custom dataset of medical terms and prescriptions.

Added a post-processing step using a medical dictionary to auto-correct OCR misreads (e.g., distinguishing Paracetamol vs. Paracitamol).

Improved accuracy significantly through contextual spell-checking.

2. Mapping Medicines to E-Commerce Database

Problem: Even if OCR captured the drug name correctly, mapping it to the standardized product names in the pharmacy database was difficult.

Solution:

Implemented fuzzy string matching and synonym mapping for medicines.

Created a lookup table with brand names vs. generic names to bridge gaps.

Ensured that slight OCR errors or different naming conventions still mapped to the correct medicine.

3. Handling Prescription Layout Variations

Problem: Prescriptions vary in format (doctor’s notes, hospital printouts, scanned images). OCR often misread text because of alignment issues or overlapping handwriting.

Solution:

Preprocessed images using OpenCV (deskewing, removing noise, adjusting contrast).

Broke down the prescription into structured zones: patient details, medicine details, dosage instructions.

This structured extraction helped standardize the workflow.

4. Integration with Delivery Scheduling

Problem: After identifying medicines, syncing with delivery timelines across pharmacies created complexity.

Solution:

Built a real-time API integration with pharmacy inventory and delivery services.

Designed fallback mechanisms: if one pharmacy was out of stock, the system automatically suggested alternatives or redirected to the nearest supplier.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

The Gemini API can serve as the intelligence layer of your prescription-to-delivery platform. Once OCR extracts raw text from medical prescriptions, Gemini can be used to interpret, validate, and structure this information into actionable data. For example, it can identify drug names, detect dosages, extract instructions like frequency and duration, and even normalize medical terms to match with pharmacy inventory databases. Gemini’s natural language understanding can also help resolve ambiguities in handwritten prescriptions, cross-check against standard drug lists, and flag potential errors or unsafe combinations. Additionally, it can power a conversational interface, allowing patients to ask questions in plain language—such as "When will my medicine arrive?" or "What is an alternative if this drug is unavailable?"—and receive accurate, contextual answers. This not only enhances accuracy and safety but also makes the platform more interactive and patient-friendly.

**Medical Track**

1. Digital Transformation of Prescriptions

In healthcare, prescriptions are the starting point of treatment.

By using OCR to digitize prescriptions, your project supports the medical track by:

Reducing dependency on handwritten or paper-based records.

Creating structured, digital medical data that can be easily shared, analyzed, and stored.

2. Enhancing Patient Safety

Medication errors are a major challenge in healthcare, often caused by misreading prescriptions or dispensing the wrong drug.

Your system addresses this by:

Automatically extracting drug names, dosage, and timing with high accuracy.

Cross-verifying extracted data with a medical dictionary and standardized drug database.

This reduces risks of human error, aligning with the medical track’s focus on patient safety and quality of care.

3. Supporting Continuity of Care

The project ensures that patients receive medicines on time without disruption, which is crucial in chronic disease management and post-surgery care.

By connecting prescriptions to real-time stock availability and delivery, it ensures continuity of treatment, a key healthcare goal.

4. Accessibility & Inclusivity

Many patients—especially the elderly or those in remote areas—struggle with visiting multiple pharmacies or tracking availability.

The platform supports the medical track by making healthcare more accessible, inclusive, and patient-centered through:

Home delivery of medicines.

Clear visibility into availability and timelines.

5. Data-Driven Healthcare Ecosystem

The medical track emphasizes the importance of data-driven decision-making.

Your project contributes by:

Collecting structured data on prescriptions, medicine demand, and availability.

Helping pharmacies forecast stock needs.

Enabling healthcare providers to analyze prescription patterns and improve care strategies.

> Your health is our priority

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MediEase transforms healthcare access by uniting appointments, test results, and real-time chatbot support into one platform. Patients get faster, safer care while doctors manage schedules effortlessly. By streamlining critical medical tasks and enhancing emergency response, MediEase makes healthcare more accessible, reliable, and impactful for everyone.

**Challenges we ran into**

Bug: Initially, the dashboard.js and chatbot.js weren’t working correctly because the frontend was not receiving responses from the backend (Unexpected end of JSON input).
Fix: I debugged the API calls by checking request/response structures in the browser console and server logs. Then I standardized the backend routes to always send proper JSON responses, even for errors. This fixed the “no response” issue.

Hurdle: Managing two different dashboards with a single login flow caused confusion—users weren’t redirected properly.
Fix: We added a simple role check. Later, this logic can be extended with proper role flags in the database.

**Medical Track**

This project is a unified digital healthcare assistant that addresses these pain points:
1.User Authentication & Role-based Dashboards
2.Patients and doctors log in separately.
3.Patients get an interface to manage appointments, test results, and chatbot help.
4.Doctors get a dashboard to manage appointments, track patients, and oversee reports.
5.Appointments & Test Bookings
6.Patients can book, view, or cancel doctor appointments directly from the dashboard.
7.Medical tests can also be booked in the same flow.
8.Doctors get a synced view of these bookings, helping in smoother coordination.
9.Chatbot Integration

A built-in health chatbot guides users:
1.Finding nearby hospitals/doctors.
2.Suggesting test bookings.
3.Handling emergencies (pointing to nearest emergency center).
4.Answering FAQs in natural language.
5.Emergency Support
6.A dedicated emergency option in the chatbot ensures patients can instantly access critical information (nearest hospital/emergency contact).

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Accessing healthcare services can often be confusing, time-consuming, and fragmented. Patients face challenges such as:

Forgetting medications or not tracking them properly.

Difficulty in identifying symptoms and deciding whether to consult a doctor.

Lack of quick access to emergency help.

Inefficient process of booking doctor appointments.

Limited centralized system to manage personal health information.

These issues can lead to delayed treatment, poor medication adherence, and higher health risks, especially in critical situations.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.User Authentication & Security

2.Ensuring secure login and signup with OTP/email verification was tricky.

3.Challenge: Preventing unauthorized access while keeping the process simple for users.

Solution: Implemented secure password hashing and OTP-based verification.

4.Database & Data Management

Challenge: Designing a database structure to store user details, medical history, appointments, and prescriptions without redundancy.

Solution: Normalized the database and added validation checks for consistency.

5.Real-time Emergency Features

Solution: Used event-driven logic and backend APIs to trigger immediate notifications.

6.AI-based Symptom Checker

Challenge: Integrating AI to provide meaningful health suggestions without replacing professional medical advice.

Solution: Used external APIs/AI models, added disclaimers, and ensured the feature guided users responsibly.

Frontend & User Experience

Challenge: Making the dashboard intuitive with responsive design and easy navigation.

Solution: Implemented a clean UI using modern frameworks (React/Tailwind, etc.) and tested layouts on multiple devices.

Team Collaboration

Challenge: Coordinating work across different modules (login, dashboard, symptom checker, appointments).

Solution: Used GitHub for version control and divided tasks based on strengths (frontend/backend/database).
