### Health@stic
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/healthstic-a557) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SatyajitKumarKhawas/Status_Code2) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/AhZnfRv4gz8?si=XsI2Aus1Ytr-s2a0) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-StatusCode%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://statuscode-2.devfolio.co)

> Built for the Busy

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our entire project is designed to help teenagers, college students, and bachelors—especially those who often live alone and may not always take proper care of themselves. Everyday accidents like cuts, burns, or minor injuries happen quite often. In such situations, it’s difficult to know what immediate action to take, how serious the injury is, and what the next step should be. Our solution makes this entire process faster, safer, and easier. We added features which will help them to do the immediate solution in a easier and safer way.
The features are :- 
(CORE FEATURES)
1. Vision + Voice + Rag
2. Finding nearest doctor 
3.Call to book an appointment  
4.OCR Prescription Scanning 
5.Medicine Price Finder
6.Find similar medicine
7.Medicine Comparison

(ADDITIONAL FEATURES)
1.Blood Bank Automation
2.Call to remind Medicine
3.Health and Diet recommendations.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building this project, we faced a few hurdles:

1.Backend setup – Integrating AI models, OCR, and datasets into one system was tricky. We solved it by breaking things into smaller modules and connecting them with APIs.

2.Designing the UI – Making the interface simple and easy to use was harder than expected. We kept testing with friends and improving the design until it felt clear.

3.Centering the document – Prescriptions were often misaligned, which reduced OCR accuracy. We fixed this by preprocessing the images before running OCR.

4.Automation testing – Making sure the outputs were consistent was a challenge. We created test cases with different inputs to check reliability.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

We Have Used Gemini API For:

1.Embedding in RAG – To generate high-quality embeddings that improve retrieval accuracy and make the knowledge base more context-aware.

2.Gemini Chat Model – For providing conversational AI capabilities, enabling natural, human-like interactions with users.

3.Extracting OCR Text from Images – To accurately process and extract text from medical prescriptions and images for further analysis.

4.Vertex AI API – To integrate Gemini seamlessly with Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, allowing scalable deployment, model management, and automation.

**Medical Track**

Our project fits the medical track because it empowers students and bachelors with an end-to-end AI-driven healthcare assistant. It starts by providing instant first aid guidance through vision + RAG, ensuring users take the right steps immediately after an injury. If the situation is serious, it seamlessly connects them to doctors for consultation, removing delays in getting professional care. Once a prescription is provided, our OCR technology simplifies it into clear, understandable instructions, eliminating the confusion of handwritten medical notes. Finally, by matching prescriptions with a large medicine dataset, we suggest affordable and safe alternatives, helping users save costs without compromising treatment quality. In short, our project makes healthcare more accessible, faster, safer, and more affordable while bridging the gap between self-care, professional medical consultation, and cost-effective treatment.

> Your Health Buddy

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Sehat Buddy is an AI-powered Medical Diagnosis & Q&A System that enables users to:

Predict diseases from symptoms or uploaded medical images using machine learning & deep learning models.

Get real-time medical advice through an LLM-powered chatbot.

Locate nearby doctors for timely consultation and follow-up.
The platform integrates both image classification for diseases like Pneumonia and tabular data-based pipelines for chronic illnesses like Heart Disease and Kidney Disease, ensuring a hybrid diagnosis approach.

**Challenges we ran into**

Integrating Multiple Models
Combining image classification (VGG19) with tabular ML pipelines for hybrid disease prediction required careful model management and seamless switching based on user input type.

Accuracy vs. Speed Trade-off
Deep learning models for image classification had high accuracy but slower inference time. Optimizing them for faster predictions without losing accuracy was challenging.

LLM Integration for Medical Q&A
Ensuring the chatbot provided relevant, safe, and accurate health-related responses while avoiding misinformation was a major focus.

Location-Based Doctor Search
Implementing a reliable and precise location-based doctor recommendation system with limited healthcare API data availability posed technical hurdles.

User Experience for Non-Technical Users
Designing a clean, simple UI so that even elderly users or those unfamiliar with technology could easily interact with the system.

### CareQueue
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/carequeue-f812) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17e34ymGMYabxsZqrptxEoR2kMcxdf73A/view) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackBuild-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackbuild.devfolio.co)

> CareQueue – Smarter Queues, Healthier Communities.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![OAuth](https://img.shields.io/badge/OAuth-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

CareQueue makes everyday healthcare simpler and less stressful for patients. Instead of waiting endlessly in crowded clinics, people can check in remotely, track real-time wait times, and arrive only when it’s their turn. Families benefit too, with the option to register multiple members in a single booking. Even in low-network areas, patients can still check in through SMS, ensuring no one is left behind. The system also flags emergencies instantly, guiding urgent cases to the right facility faster. In short, CareQueue gives patients more control, safety, and convenience in their healthcare journey.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest hurdles we ran into was when we tried to make the queue updates real-time. In the early version, patients would often see wait times that were already outdated by the time they arrived. This created frustration and trust issues. At first, we struggled to figure out how to sync data without overwhelming the system. After a lot of trial and error, we switched to WebSockets and built an AI-driven prediction engine that factored in both live check-ins and historical patterns. The difference was huge — wait times became reliable, patients felt reassured, and clinics saw smoother flow. It was one of those moments where a technical fix actually changed the whole user experience.

### HealthGrid

> Mapping clinics, simplifying care

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Cloud Messaging](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Cloud%20Messaging-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Visiting a local clinic often means long waits, confusion, and no idea how crowded it is. Clinics struggle too—managing queues on paper, handling endless calls, and facing chaos during peak hours.

How It Helps

HealthGrid makes the process simple: patients can see nearby clinics, real-time wait times, and book a slot in just a tap. Clinics get an easy admin panel to manage queues and send updates.

Why It’s Better

Less waiting, less stress, safer spaces, and smoother operations for clinics—so healthcare feels easy, not exhausting

**Challenges we ran into**

Real-time updates were tricky — syncing patient and clinic data without delays caused bugs at first.
 * Solved it by using WebSockets/Firebase for smooth live updates.

Maps integration was confusing — getting accurate nearby clinics with live status wasn’t straightforward.
* Fixed it by using Google Maps API with location filters and caching results.

Queue management logic was harder than expected — handling walk-ins, cancellations, and priority cases broke the flow.
* Overcame it by designing a flexible queue structure and testing edge cases.
